(25)krung go'i bod rig pa zhib 'jug lte gnas kyi bka' bstan dpe sdur khang gis dpe bsdur zhus/rikrung go'i bod rig pa dpe skrun khang /

'bum/ lgo'i (25)0025 shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa/ 3re gnyis pa/ mtshan nyid med pa'i le'u/(smad) 3re gsum pa/ mtshan dpe'i le'u/ 21re bzhi pa/ mnyam pa nyid kyi le'u/ 188re lnga pa/ chos nyid 'khrug pa med pa'i le'u/ 261re drug pa/ mi dmigs pa dang sems can yongs su smin pa'i byed pa'i phrin las ston pa'i le'u/ 423re bdun pa/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing dag pa'i le'u/ 600re brgyad pa/ sems can yongs su smin par byed pa'i le'u/ 604re dgu pa/ dngos po dang dngos po med pa'i sems can le'u/ 708bdun cu pa/ kun nas nyon mongs dang rnam byang med pa'i le'u/ 720don gcig pa/ don dam pa'i rnal 'byor gyi le'u/ 736don gnyis pa/ chos nyid mi 'gyur ba bstan pa'i le'u/ 7961

mtshan re gnyis tsam las ma yig tu mi gsal bas/de dag gcig gyur dang lta klog bde ba'i ched du 'dir le'u'i mtshan ma byi/ tu mi gsal ba rnams bstan 'gyur dpe bsdur ma'i deb nga gsum pa'i chos tshan (3027)pa gzhir bzung ste bsgrigs

〉 〉kā04sa tsho ci ci — chi chirsha rte tshe /—— tsho ci ci dzā (1 du / ci sna sto rsha kā tsho tsho mu / — 4rka ci/ rta ri rdzi'i/ mi ji rtsi /tsho cas— sgro — — — 4ri nya rmepa 〉ri tsho ci ridzi tsi/3537 7 — 4 5 ri la sna sa la ci tsho ji mo tsho ci snag 3 zla sa/lto :lha rdo/tsho ma 13 mi cas hā ༷ ci mi rngo tsho shā —4 1 〉 lto tsho tsho / yi / ṇa la ma shā5666ci 〉 / ci /me tsho lhe ngu — 9tre — tsho ga la chang — dzo tsho meci ca kho /zab rgyas bdud rtsi stsal ba'i sras/ /shes rab can mchog shā ri'i bu/ /

— — — —— — — — ———32/ri — —4 9 sna — ci tri ciXstu pag ci rikācir 5 ci nga 4 24 ri / tshang ——pa gci nga gyi hreX/ ci ji rgyu ci sa ོ nga sha rdzu /(de —— ——ba// rnying shen zhed ge dhetho ————————— —— ———— 1— wa tshiX ci 'i —3 rme ri40 53 pa casnye rgyas nga da ge kho /gdengs can dbang po'i bsti gnas nas/ /sher phyin spyan 'dren klu sgrub rje/ /

stong phrag brgya pa/①༄77/ /shes rab kyi pha rold tu phyind pa stong phrag brgya pa/ glegs bam bcu gnyis pa/② bam po dang po / de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor de ni 'di ltar gzugs la rang bzhin myed 0de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /tshor ba la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /'du shes la rang bzhin myed de/gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /'du byed la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /rnam par shes pa la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /myig la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /rna ba la rang bzhin skyed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /sna la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa 25—3

de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /lce la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /lus la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /yid la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin skyed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /gzugs la rang bzhin myed de/gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /sgra la rang bzhin myed de/gang la rang bzhin ②skyed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /dri la rang bzhin myed de/gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /ro la rang bzhin myed de/gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du ②skyed pa'o/ /reg dul rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /chos la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /myig gi rnam par shes pa la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de duni brjod du myed pa'o/ /rna ba'i rnam par shes pa la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /sna'i rnam par shes pa la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /lce'i rnam par shes pa la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /lus kyi rnam par shes pa la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /yid kyi rnam par shes pa la rang bzhin myed ⑤de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /myig gi 'dus te reg pa la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang dubazhin myed ⑦pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /sna'i 'dus te reg pa la 25—4

rang bzhin skyed de/ gang la rang bzhin skyed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /lce'i 'dus te reg pa la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du skyed pa'o/ /yid kyi 'dus te reg pa la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin skyed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ①ba la rang bzhin myed de gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du skyed pa'o//sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /lus kyi ②'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba la rang bzhin skyed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba la rang bzhin skyed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du skyed pa'o/ /sa'i khams la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /chu'i khams la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du skyed pa'o/ /mye'i khams la rang bzhin myed de/gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /rlung gi khams la rang bzhin skyed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /nam mkha'i ②khams la rang bzhin skyed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /rnam par shes pa'i khams la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang 25—5

bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /ma rig pa la rang bzhin skyed de/gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /'du byed la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /rnam par shes pa la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o / /mying dang gzugs la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /skye mched drug la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin skyed pa de ni brjod du skyed pa'o/ /reg pa la rang bzhin myed de/gang la rang bzhin skyed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /tshor ba la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /sred pa la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa ①de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /len pa la rang bzhin myed ②de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /srid pa la rang ③bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin skyed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /skye ba la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin skyed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /rga shi la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la rang bzhin myed de/gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la rang bzhin myed de/ gang 25—6

la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du skyed pa'o/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /nang stong pa nyid la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /phyi stong pa nyid la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /phyi nang stong pa nyid la rang bzhin myed de/gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed ①pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /chen po stong pa nyid la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /don dam pa stong pa nyid la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /'dus byas stong pa nyid la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid la rang bzhin myed de/gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /chos thams cad stong pa nyid la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid la 25—7

rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid la rang bzhin myed de/gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag ①pa rnams la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /yang dag par spong ba rnams la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang ②bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /dbang po rnams la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /stobs rnams la rang bzhin myed de/gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /byang chub kyi yan lag rnams la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o / /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /'phags pa'i bden pa rnams la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /bsam gtan rnams la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /tshad myed pa rnams la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams la ②rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /rnam par thar pa brgyad la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang 25—8

bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang /smon pa myed pa la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /mngon par shes pa rnams la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /ting nge 'dzin rnams la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /gzungs kyi sgo rnams la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o / /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /myi 'jigs pa bzhi la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /byams pa chen po la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /snying rje chen po la rang bzhin myed de/gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa brtswa ①brgyad la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu la rang bzhin myed de/gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /lan cig ②phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'ol/ /phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu la rang bzhin myed de②/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /dgra bcom pa nyid la rang bzhin 25—9

myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /rang byang chub la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o//lam gyi rnam pa 0)shes pa nyid la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /rab 'byor 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i skyon myed pa ste/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i duskyon myed par zhugs pa ②ting nge 'dzin dang / snyoms par 'jug pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa de ni ting nge 'dzin dang / snyoms par 'jug pa'i dbang gis kyang myi skye na/ 'dod chags sam/zhe sdang ngam/ gti mug gis skye bar 'gyur zhing de la gnas te/ de'i las mngon par 'du byed pa dang / las de ④mngon par 'du dubyas pas 'gro ba lnga'i 'khor bar ltung bar 'gyur ba lta ci smos te/ de ni gnas myed do/ /gzhan du na (6)sgyu ma lta bu'i chos rnams la gnas shing / sems can thams cad kyi don byed de/ sems can nam sgyu mar yang dmyigs pa myed do/ /de sems can dang sgyu ma myi dmyigs pas/ sems can rnams yongs su spyin par byed cing / sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su 'dzin te⑦/ rab 'byor de ltar na/byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ ting nge 'dzin gyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par byas nas/chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ⑧ba'i bar du ste/ myi dmyigs pa'i 'khor lo dang /stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa'i 'khor lo bskor ⑨ra/ /rab 'byor gzhan 0yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' 25—10

chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ chos thams cad spyi lam lta bur yongs su shes so/ /chos thams cad sgra brnyan lta bur yongs su shes so/ /chos thams cad myig yor lta bur yongs su shes so/ /chos thams cad sgyu ma lta bur yongs su shes so/ /chos thams cad snyig rgyu lta bur yongs su shes so/ /chos thams cad sprul pa lta bur yongs su shes so/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe ji ltar na chos thams cad spyi lam lta bur yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du yongs su 'tshal ba lags/ ji ltar na chos thams cad sgra brnyan lta bur yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du yongs su 'tshal ba lags/ ji ①ltar na chos thams cad myig yor ②lta bur yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du yongs su 'tshal ba lags/ ji ltar na chos thams cad sgyu ma lta bur yang dag pa ji lta ba ③bzhin du yongs su 'tshal ba lags/ ji ltar na chos thams cad smig rgyu lta bur yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du yongs su 'tshal ba lags/ ji ltar na chos thams cad sprul pa lta bur yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du yongs su 'tshal ba lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ spyi lam myi mthong ngo / /spyi lam mthong ba myi mthong ngo / /sgra brnyan myi thos so/ /sgra brnyan nyan pa myi mthong ngo / /myig yor myi mthong dungo / /myig yor mthong ba myi mthong ngo / /sgyu ma myi mthong ngo / /sgyu ma mthong ba myi mthong ngo / /snyig rgyu myi mthong ngo / /snyig rgyu mthong ba myi mthong ngo / /sprul pa myi mthong ngo /sprul pa mthong ba ⑤kyi mthong ngo / /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar byis pa so 25—11

so'i skye bo rnams kyi spyi lam ni phyin ci log go/ /sgra brnyan ni phyin ci log go/ /myig yor ni phyin ci log go/ /sgyu ma ni phyin ci log go/ /snyig rgyu ni phyin ci log go/ /sprul pa ni phyin ci log go/ /dgra bcom pa ni nyuspyi lam myi mthong ngo //spyi lam mthong ba myi mthong ngo / /sgra brnyan myi thos so/ /sgra brnyan nyan pa myi mthong ngo / /myig yor myi mthong ngo / /myig yor mthong ba myi mthong ngo / /sgyu ma myi mthong ngo / /sgyu ②ma mthong ba myi mthong ngo / /snyig rgyu myi mthong ngo /rtsig rgyu mthong ba myi mthong ngo / /sprul pa myi mthong ngo / /sprul pa mthong ba myi mthong ngo / /rang sangs rgyas ni khyi lam myi mthong ngo / /kyi lam mthong ba myi mthong ngo / /sgra brnyan myi thos ②so/ /sgra brnyan nyan pa myi mthong ngo / /myig yor myi mthong ngo / /myig yor mthong ba myi mthong ngo / /sgyu ma myi mthong ngo / /sgyu ma mthong ba myi mthong ngo / /snyig rgyu myi mthong ngo / /phyig rgyu mthong ba myi mthong ngo / /sprul pa myi mthong ngo / /sprul pa mthong ba myi mthong ngo / /byang chub sems dpa' ni spyi lam myi mthong ngo / /spyi lam mthong ba myi mthong ngo / /sgra brnyan myi thos so/ /sgra brnyan nyan pa myi mthong ngo / /myig yor myi mthong ngo //myig yor mthong ba myi mthong ngo / /sgyu ma myi mthong ngo / /sgyu ma mthong ba myi mthong ngo / /rtsig rgyu myi mthong ngo / /rtsig rgyu mthong ba myi mthong ngo / /sprul pa myi mthong ngo / /sprul pa mthong ba myi mthong ngo / /de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ni rmi lam myi gzigs so/ /spyi lam mthong ba myi gzigs so/ /sgra brnyan myi gsan noX/ /sgra brnyan nyan pa myi gzigs so/ /myig yor myi gzigs so/ /myig yor mthong ba myi gzigs so/ /sgyu ma myi gzigs so/ /sgyu ma mthong ba myi gzigs so/ /snyig rgyu myi gzigs so//25—12

rtsig rgyu mthong ba myi gzigs so/ /sprul pa myi gzigs so/ /sprul pa mthong ba myi gzigs so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar yang dag pa ①ma yin pas/chos thams cad ni dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid de/ yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa dang mnyam pa ste/ yang dag pa ma yin pa'i phyir chos thams cad yongs su grub pa myed na/ de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ dngos po'i 'du shes sam/yongs su grub pa'i 'du shes sam/ yang dag pa'i 'du shes su 'gyur ba lta ga la yod de②/ de ni gnas myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ gal te chos la la zhig gi ngo bo nyid dam/ yongs su grub pa'am/ yang dag par gyur pa zhig zhudamyigs na ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin par yang myi 'gyur te/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la de ltar spyod na/gzugs la chags pa myed do/ /tshor ba la chags pa myed do/ /'du shes la chags pa myed do/ /'du byed la chags pa myed do/ /rnam par shes pa la chags pa myed do/ /khams rnams la chags pa myed do/ /skye mched rnams la chags pa myed do/ /rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba la chags pa myed do/ /'dod pa'i khams la chags pa myed do/ /gzugs kyi khams la chags pa myed do//gzugs myed pa'i khams la chags pa myed do/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la chags pa myed do/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la chags pa myed do/ /bzod ④pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la chags pa myed do/ /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la chags pa myed do/ /bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la chags pa ⑤myed do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la chags pa 0skyed do/ /nang stong pa 25—13

nyid la chags pa myed do/ /phyi stong pa nyid la chags pa skyed do/ /phyi nang stong pa nyid la chags pa myed do/ /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid la chags pa myed do/ /chen po stong pa nyid la chags pa ②skyed do/ /don dam pa stong pa nyid la chags pa myed do/ /'dus byas stong pa nyid la chags pa myed do/ /'dus ma ②byas stong pa nyid la chags pa myed do/ /mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid la chags pa myed do/ /thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid la chags pa myed do/ /dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid la chags pa myed do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid la chags pa myed do/ /chos thams cad stong pa nyid la chags pa myed do/ /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid la chags pa myed do/ /myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid la chags pa myed do/ /dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid la chags pa myed do/ /ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid la chags pa myed do/ /dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid la chags pa myed do/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams la chags pa myed do//yang dag par spong ba rnams la chags pa myed do/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams la chags pa myed do/ /dbang po rnams la chags pa myed do/ /stobs rnams la chags pa myed do/ /byang chub kyi yan lag rnams la chags pa myed do/ /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa la chags pa myed do/ /'phags pa'i bden pa rnams la chags pa myed do/ /bsam gtan rnams la chags pa myed do//tshad myed pa rnams la chags pa myed do/ /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams la chags pa myed do/ /rnam par thar pa brgyad la chags pa skyed do/ /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu la chags pa myed do/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa 25—14

la chags pa skyed do/ /mngon par shes pa rnams la chags pa myed do/ /ting nge 'dzin rnams la chags pa skyed do/ /gzungs kyi sgo rnams la chags pa myed do//de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams la chags pa myed do/ /myi 'jigs pa rnams la chags pa myed do/ /so so yang dag par rig pa rnams la chags pa myed do①/ /byams pa chen po la chags pa myed do/ /snying rje chen po la chags pa myed do/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams la chags pa myed do/ /rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu la chags pa myed do/ /lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu la chags pa skyed do/ /phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu la chags pa myed do//dgra bcom pa nyid la chags pa myed do/ /rang byang chub la chags pa myed do/ /lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid la chags pa myed do/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la chags pa myed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di la gnas shing /sa dang po yongs su rdzogs par byed de/ de la 'dod pa'i 'dod chags myi skyed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar des sa de yang ②phyi dmyigs na/de la 'dod pa'i 'dod chags skyed par lta ga la 'gyur te/ ①shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di la gnas shing sa gnyis pa yongs su rdzogs par byed de/ de la 'dod pa'i 'dod chags myi skyed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar des sa de yang myi dmyigs na/ de la 'dod pa'i 'dod chags skyed par lta ga la 'gyur te④/ ⑤shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di la gnas shing sa gsum pa yongs su rdzogs par byed de/ de la 'dod pa'i 'dod chags myi skyed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar des sa de yang myi dmyigs na/ de la 'dod pa'i 'dod chags skyed par lta ga la 'gyur teyi/ gshes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin 25—15

pa 'di la gnas shing sa bzhi pa yongs su rdzogs par byed de/ de la 'dod pa'i 'dod chags myi skyed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ①ltar des sa de yang myi dmyigs na/ de la 'dod pa'i 'dod chags skyed par lta ga la 'gyur te②/①shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di la gnas shing / sa lnga pa yongs su rdzogs par byed de/ de la 'dod pa'i 'dod chags myi skyed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/de ni 'di ltar des sa de yang myi dmyigs na/ de du'adod pa'i 'dod chags skyed par lta ga la 'gyur⑤/ de 0shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di la gnas shing / sa drug pa yongs su rdzogs par byed de/ de la 'dod pa'i 'dod chags myi skyed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar des sa de yang myi dmyigs na/ de la 'dod pa'i 'dod chags skyed par lta ga la 'gyur te⑦/nishes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ⑨'di la gnas shing / sa bdun pa yongs su rdzogs par byed de/ de la 'dod pa'i 'dod chags myi skyed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar des sa de yang myi dmyigs na/ de la 'dod pa'i 'dod chags skyed par lta ga la 'gyur te⑩/ ⑩shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di la gnas shing / sa brgyad pa yongs su rdzogs par byed de/ de la 'dod pa'i 'dod chags myi skyed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar des sa de yang myi dmyigs na/ de la 'dod pa'i 'dod chags skyed par lta ga la 'gyur te'u/tsoshes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di la gnas shing / sa dgu pa yongs su rdzogs par byed de/ de la 'dod pa'i 'dod chags myi skyed do④/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/de ni 'di ltar des sa de yang myi dmyigs na/ de la 'dod pa'i 'dod chags skyed par lta ga la 'gyur te(nye/ tunyeshes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di la gnas 25—16

shing / sa bcu pa yongs su rdzogs par byed de/ de la 'dod pa'i 'dod chags myi skyed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar des sa de yang myi dmyigs na/ de la 'dod pa'i 'dod chags skyed par lta ga la 'gyur te①/⑤shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di la gnas shing ②/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa de yang myi dmyigs so/ /de myi dmyigs pa'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa der chos thams cad kyang rjo'adus par mthong ste/ chos de dag kyang myi dmyigs so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/de ni 'di ltar chos de dag dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa de la gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar skyed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar chos de dag ni tha dad du bya ba gang yang skyed de/ chos kyi dbyings su bstan pa dang /de bzhin nyid ⑤du bstan pa dang / yang dag pa'i mthar bstan pas/ chos thams cad dbyer myed do/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de ltar chos thams cad dbyer ma mchis pa lags na/ ji ltar dge ba dang myi dge ba'i chos rnams bstan pa lags/ ji ltar 'jig rten pa dang / 'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos rnams bstan pa lags/ ji ltar zag pa dang bcas pa dang /zag pa ma mchis pa'i chos rnams bstan pa lags/ ji ltar 'dus byas dang /'dus ma byas kyi chos rnams bstan pa lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis 0bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de ji snyam ⑦du sems/ chos rnams kyi chos nyid gang yin pa de la 'dus byas samani/ 'dus ma byas sam/ rgyun tu zhugs ⑨pa'i 'bras bu'am/ lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu'am/ phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu'am/ dgra bcom pa nyid dam/ rang byang chub bamatshu/ byang chub ⑪25—17

sems dpa' 1rdzogang yang brjod du yod dam/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de ni ma lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis ②bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de bas na khyod kyis rnam grangs des 'di ltar chos thams cad dbyer myed pa dang /chos thams cad mtshan nyid myed pa dang / skye ba myed pa dang / 'byung ba myed par rig par bya'o/ /rab 'byor nga zhusngon byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa'i tshe/ gzugs shes ④bya ba'am/ tshor ba zhes bya ba'am/ 'du shes zhes bya ba'am/ 'du byed ces bya ba'am/ rnam par shes pa zhes bya ba'am / myig ces bya ba'am/ rna ba zhes bya ba'am/ sna zhes bya ba'am/lce zhes bya ba'am/ lus shes bya ba'am/ yid ces bya ba'am/ gzugs shes bya ba'am/ sgra zhes bya ba'am/ dri zhes bya ba'am/ ro zhes bya ba'am/reg ces bya ba'am/ chos shes bya ba'am/ myig gi rnam par shes pa zhes bya ba'am / rna ba'i rnam par shes pa zhes bya ba'am/ sna'i rnam par shes pa zhes bya ba'am/ lce'i rnam par shes pa zhes bya ba'am/ lus kyi rnam par shes pa zhes bya ba'am/ yid kyi rnam par shes pa zhes bya ba'am/ myig gi 'dus te reg pa zhes bya ba'am/ rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa zhes bya ba'am/ sna'i 'dus te reg pa zhes bya ba'am/ lce'i 'dus te reg pa zhes bya ba'am/ lus kyi 'dus te skureg pa zhes bya ba'am/ yid kyi 'dus te reg pa zhes bya ba'am/myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba zhes bya ba'am/ rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba zhes bya ba'am/ sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba zhes bya ba'am/ lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba zhes bya ba'am/lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba zhes bya ba'am/ yid kyi 'dus te 25—18

reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba zhes bya ba'am/ sa'i khams shes bya ba'am/ chu'i khams shes bya ba'am/ mye'i khams shes bya ba'am/ rlung gi khams shes bya ba'am/ nam mkha'i khams shes bya ba'am/ rnam par shes pa'i khams shes bya ba'am/ ma rig pa zhes bya ba'am/ 'du byed ces bya ba'am/ rnam par shes pa zhes bya ba'am/ mying dang gzugs shes bya ba'am/ skye mched drug ces bya ba'am/ reg pa zhes bya ba'am/ tshor ba zhes bya ba'am/ sred pa zhes ①bya ba'am/ len pa zhes bya ba'am/ srid pa zhes bya ba'am/ skye ba zhes bya ba'am/ rga shi zhes bya ba'am/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa zhes bya ba'am / tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zhes bya ba'am/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu ②phyin pa zhes bya ba'am/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zhes bya ba'am / bsam gtan gyi ①pha rol tu phyin pa zhes bya ba'am/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zhes bya ba'am/ nang stong pa nyid ces bya ba'am/ phyi stong pa nyid ces bya ba'am/ phyi nang stong pa nyid ces bya ba'am/ stong pa nyid stong pa nyid ces bya ba'am/ chen po stong pa nyid ces bya ba'am/ don dam pa stong pa nyid ces bya ba'am/ 'dus byas stong pa nyid ces bya ba'am/ 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid ces bya ba'am/ mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid ces bya ba'amadu/thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid ces bya ba'am/ dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid ces bya ba'am/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid ces bya ba'am/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid ces bya ba'am/ rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid ces bya ba'am/myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid ces bya ba'am/ dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid ces rjo bya ba'am/ ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid ces bya ba'am/ dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo 25—19

nyid stong pa nyid ces bya ba'am/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams shes bya ba'am/yang dag par spong ba rnams shes bya ba'am/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa ①rnams shes bya ba'am/ dbang po rnams shes bya ba'am/ stobs rnams shes bya ba'am/byang chub kyi yan lag rnams shes bya ba'am/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa zhes bya ba'am/ 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams shes bya ba'am/ bsam gtan rnams shes bya ba'am/ tshad myed pa rnams shes bya ba'am/ gzugs skyed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams shes bya ba'am/ rnam par thar pa brgyad ces bya ba'am/ mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu zhes bya ba'am/rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa rnams ⑤shes bya ba'am/ mngon par shes pa rnams shes bya ba'am/ ting nge 'dzin rnams shes bya ba'am/ gzungs kyi nisgo rnams shes bya ba'am de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu zhes bya ba'am/ myi 'jigs pa bzhi zhes bya ba'am/ so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi zhes bya ba'am/ byams pa chen po zhes bya ba'am/ snying rje chen po zhes bya ba'am/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa brtswa brgyad ces bya ba'am/ dge ba'i chos rnams shes bya ba'am/ myi dge ba'i chos rnams shes bya ba'am/ nyon mongs pa dang bcas pa'i chos rnams shes bya ba'am/ nyon mongs pa myed pa'i chos rnams shes bya ba'am/ 'jig rten pa'i chos rnams shes bya ba'am/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos rnams shes bya ba'am / zag pa dang bcas pa'i chos rnams shes bya ba'am/ zag pa myed pa'i chos rnams shes bya ba'am/ thun mong dugi chos rnams shes bya ba'am/thun mong ⑤ma yin pa'i chos rnams shes bya ba'am/ 'dus byas kyi chos rnams 25—20

shes bya ba'am/ 'dus ma byas kyi chos rnams shes bya ba'am/ rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu zhes bya ba'am/ lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu zhes bya ba'am/phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu zhes bya ba'am/ dgra bcom pa nyid ces bya ba'am/rang byang chub ces bya ba'am/ lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid ces bya ba'am/rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ces bya ba'am/ chos gang gi rang bzhin yang mi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor de ①ltar ②byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ sems dang po bskyed pa nas nye bar bzung ste/ bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas kyi bar du myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin la mkhas par bya'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin la mkhas pa ni byang chub kyi lam yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /sems can rnams niyongs su sbyin par byed do/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su 'dzin to/ /de la gnas te/ bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas/sems can rnams ci nas kyang dul bar gyur nas/ srid pa gsum na myi snang ba de ltar rnam par btul lodu/ /rab 'byor de ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos mtshan nyid myed pa'i tshul gyis/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la bslab par bya'o/ /shes rab kyi pha rold tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa las/ le'u drug cu gnyis so༅// //de nas tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byord kyis bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad 25—21

ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das chos thams cad spyi lam lta bu dngos po ma mchis pa/ dngos po ma mchis pa'i ngo bo nyid rang gi mtshan nyid kyis ②stong pa rnams la 'di dag ni dge ba'i chos so/ /'di dag ni myi dge ba'i chos so/ /'di dag ni 'jig rten pa'i chos so/ /'di dag ni 'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos so/ /'di dag ni zag pa dang bcas pa'i chos so/ /'di dag ni zag pa myed pa'i chos so/ /'di dag ni 'dus byas kyi chos so/ /'di dag ni 'dus ma byas kyi chos so/ /'di dag ni rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mngon du bya ba'i rgyur 'gyur ba'o/ /'di dag ni lan ②cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu mngon du bya ba'i rgyur 'gyur ba'o/ /'di dag ni phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu mngon du bya ba'i rgyur 'gyur ba'o/ /'di dag ni dgra bcom pa'i 'bras bu mngon du bya ba'i rgyur 'gyur ba'o/ /'di dag ni rang byang chub kyi rgyur 'gyur ba'o/ /'di dag ni bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi rgyur 'gyur ba'o/ /zhes bgyi bar ①ji ltar ④rnam par dgod par 'gyur/ chos thams cad dusgra brnyan lta bu/myig yor lta bu/ sgyu ma lta bu/ snyig rgyu lta bu/ sprul pa lta bu/ dngos po ma mchis payi/ dngos po ma mchis pa'i ngo bo nyid rang gi mtshan nyid kyis stong pa rnams la/ 'di dag ni dge ba'i chos so/ /'di dag ni myi dge ba'i chos so/ /'di dag ni 'jig rten pa'i chos so/ /'di dag ni 'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos so/ /'di dag ni zag pa dang bcas pa'i chos so/ /'di dag ni zag pa myed pa'i chos so/ /'di dag ni 'dus byas kyi chos so/ /'di dag ni 'dus ma byas kyi chos so/ /'di dag ni rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mngon du bya ba'i rgyur 'gyur ba'o/ /'di dag ni lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu mngon du bya 25—22

ba'i rgyur 'gyur ba'o/ /'di dag ni phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu mngon du bya ba'i rgyur 'gyur ba'o/ /'di dag ni dgra bcom pa'i 'bras bu ①mngon du bya ba'i rgyur 'gyur ba'o/ /'di dag ni rang byang chub kyi rgyur 'gyur ba'o/ /'di dag ni bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi rgyur 'gyur ba'o zhes bgyi bar ji ltar rnam par dgod par 'gyur/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/rab 'byor 'di la byis pa ②thos pa dang / myi ldan pa so so'i ②skye bo ni spyi lam yang dmyigs la/ spyi lam mthong ba yang dmyigs so/ /sgra brnyan yang dmyigs la/ sgra brnyan nyan pa yang dmyigs so/ /myig yor yang dmyigs la/myig duyor mthong ba yang dmyigs so/ /sgyu ma yang dmyigs la/ sgyu ma mthong ba yang dmyigs so/ /snyig rgyu yang dmyigs la/ snyig rgyu mthong ba yang dmyigs so/ /sprul pa yang dmyigs la/ sprul pa mthong ba yang dmyigs so/ /des spyi lam yang ⑤dmyigasayi/ spyi lam mthong ba yang dmyigs/ sgra brnyan yang dmyigs/ sgra brnyan nyan pa yang dmyigs/ myig yor yang dmyigs/myig yor mthong ba yang dmyigs/ sgyu ma yang dmyigs/ sgyu ma mthong ba yang dmyigs / smig rgyu yang dmyigs/ snyig rgyu mthong ba yang dmyigs/ sprul pa yang dmyigs/ sprul pa ⑦mthong ba yang dmyigs nas/ lus dang ngag dang /yid kyis dudage ba'i ⑨'du bya ba yang mngon par 'du byed do/ /lus dang ngag dang / yid kyis myi dge ba'i ⑩'du bya ba yang mngon par 'du byed do/ /de bzhin du lus dang ngag dang / yid kyis bsod nams dang / bsod nams ma yin pa dang / myi g.yo ⑩ba'i 'du bya ba yang mngon par 'du byed do/ /de bas na byang chub sems dpa' 4)sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu ⑫25—23

phyin pa la spyod pa/ mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang / thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa ①nyid dang / stong pa nyid gnyis la gnas shing / sems can rnams la chos ston te/ khams gsum ②'di ni stong pa ste/ 'di la gzugs sam/ tshor ba'am/ 'du shes sam/ 'du byed dam/ rnam par shes pa'am/ phung po rnams sam/ khams rnams sam/ skye mched rnams myed do/ /'di ni spyi lam/ 'di ni ③sgra brnyan/ 'di ni myig yor/ 'di ni sgyu ma/ 'di ni snyig rgyu/ 'di ni sprul pa ste/ 'di la duphung po rnams sam/ khams rnams sam/ skye mched rnams myed do/ /'di la spyi lam myed do/ /spyi lam mthong ba myed do/ /sgra brnyan myed do/ /sgra brnyan nyan pa myed do/ /myig yor myed do/ /myig yor mthong ba myed do/ /sgyu ma myed do/ /sgyu ma byed pa ⑤skyed do/ /rtsig rgyu skyed do/ /smig rgyu mthong ba myed do/ /sprul pa myed do/ /sprul pa byed pa myed do0/ /chos 'di dag thams cad ni dngos po myed pa dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid yin na/ 'on kyang khyed ⑦ni phung po myed pa la phung por 'du shes pa/ khams myed pa la khams su 'du shes pa/skye mched myed pa la skye mched du 'du shes pa dag ste/ chos 'di dag thams cad ni nyurten cing 'brel par 'byung ba phyin ci log las skyes pa/ las kyi rnam par smin pas yongs su bzung ba yin na/ khyed rnams ci'i phyir chos thams cad dngos po myed pa la dngos po'i 'du shes su ⑨byed ces te/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/thabs mkhas pas sems can ser sna can dag ser sna las rnam par bzlog nas/sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la sbyor te/ sbyin pa yongs su btang ba de yang de 25—24

dag la longs spyod chen po'i rgyur 'gyur ro/ /des de ①dag de las bskyod nas/tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la sbyor te/ tshul khrims yang dag par blangs pa de yang de dag la mtho ②ris su skye ba'i rgyur 'gyur ro/ /des de dag de las bskyod nas/ ting nge 'dzin la sbyor te/ ting nge 'dzin de yang de dag la tshangs pa'i 'jig rten du skye ba'i rgyur 'gyur ro/ /des de dag de las bskyod nas/ bsam gtan dang po la sbyor te/ bsam gtan dang po las bskyod nas bsam gtan gnyis pa la sbyor ro/ /bsam gtan gnyis pa las bskyod nas/bsam gtan gsum pa la sbyor ro/ /bsam gtan gsum pa las bskyod nas/bsam gtan bzhi pa la sbyor ro/ /bsam gtan bzhi pa las bskyod nas/nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched kyi snyoms par 'jug pa la sbyor ro/ /nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched kyi snyoms par 'jug pa las bskyod nas/ rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched kyi snyoms par 'jug pa la sbyor ro/ /rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched kyi snyoms par 'jug pa las bskyod nas/ chung ②zad myed pa'i skye mched kyi snyoms par 'jug pa la sbyor ro/ /chung zad skyed pa'i skye mched kyi snyoms par 'jug pa las bskyod nas/ 'du shes myed 'du shes myed myin skye mched kyi snyoms ①par 'jug pa la sbyor ro/ /des sbyin pa dang sbyin pa'i 'bras bu dma' ba de las rnam grangs du mas bskyod de/ phung po ma lus pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings su dbugs 'byin to/ /gzhog go/ /rab tu 'god do/ /des tshul khrims dang ⑤/ tshul khrims kyi 'bras bu de las rnam grangs du mas bskyod de/ phung po ma lus pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings su rab tu gzhog go/ /des ting nge 'dzin dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi 'bras bu de las 25—25

rnam grangs du mas bskyod de/ phung po ma lus pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings su rab tu gzhog ①go/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi la yang dag par ston to/ /yang dag par skul lo/ /yang dag par gzeng stod ②do/ /yang dag par dga' bar byed do/ /'dul lo/ /gzhog go/ /rab tu 'god do/ /yang dag par spong ba bzhi la yang dag par ston to②/ /yang dag par skul 0lo//yang dag par gzeng stod do/ /yang dag par dga' bar byed do/ /'dul lo/ /gzhog go/ /rab tu 'god do/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang ⑤pa bzhi la yang dag par ston to/ /yang dag par skul ༅lo/ /yang dag par gzeng stod do/ /yang dag par dga' bar byed do/ /'dul lo/ /gzhog go/ /rab tu 'god do / /dbang po lnga la yang dag par ston to/ /yang dag par skul rgyalo/ /yang dag par gzeng stod do/ /yang dag par dga' bar byed do/ /'dul lo//gzhog go/ /rab tu 'god do/ /stobs lnga la yang dag par ston to/ /yang dag par skul lo/ /yang dag par gzeng bstod nido/ /yang dag par dga' bar byed do/ /'dul lo/ /gzhog go/ /rab tu 'god do/ /byang chub kyi yan lag bdun la yang dag par ston to/ /yang dag par skul lo/ /yang dag par gzeng bstod 0do/ /yang dag par dga' bar byed do/ /'dul lo/ /gzhog go/ /rab tu 'god do/ /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa la yang dag par ston to/ /yang dag par skul lo/ /yang dag par gzeng stod do/ /yang dag par dga' bar byed do/ /'dul lo/ /gzhog go/ /rab tu 'god do/ /'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi la yang dag par ston to/ /yang dag par skul lo/ /yang dag par gzeng stod do/ /yang dag par dga' bar byed do/ /25—26

'dul lo/ /gzhog go/ /rab tu 'god do/ / bsam gtan bzhi ①la yang dag par ston to/ /yang dag par skul lo/ /yang dag par gzeng stod do/ /yang dag par dga' bar byed do/ /'dul lo/ /gzhog go/ /rab tu 'god do/ / tshad myed pa bzhi la yang dag par ston to/ /yang dag par skul lo/ /yang dag par gzeng stod do/ /yang dag par dga' bar byed do/ /'dul lo//gzhog go/ /rab tu 'god do/ /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa bzhi la yang dag par ston to/ /yang dag par skul lo/ /yang dag par gzeng stod do/ /yang dag par dga' bar byed do/ /'dul lo/ /gzhog go/ /rab tu 'god do/ /②rnam par thar pa nibargyad la yang dag par ston to/ /yang dag par skul lo/ /yang dag par gzeng stod do/ /yang dag par dga' bar byed do/ /'dul lo/ /gzhog go/ /rab tu 'god do/ /mthar kyis duganas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu la yang dag par ston to/ /yang dag par skul lo/ /yang dag par gzeng stod do/ /yang dag par dga' bar byed do/ /'dul lo/ /gzhog go/ /rab tu 'god do/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa la yang dag par ston to//yang dag par skul lo/ /yang dag par gzeng stod do/ /yang dag par dga' bar byed do/ /'dul lo/ /gzhog go/ /rab tu 'god do/ /mngon par shes pa rnams la yang dag par ston to/ /yang dag par ④skul lo/ /yang dag par gzeng stod do/ /yang dag par dga' bar byed do/ /'dul lo/ /gzhog go/ /rab tu 'god do/ /ting nge 'dzin rnams la yang dag par ston to//yang dag par skul lo/ /yang dag par gzeng stod do/ /yang dag par dga' 25—27

bar byed do/ /'dul lo/ /gzhog go/ /rab tu 'god do/ /gzungs kyi sgo rnams la yang dag par ston to/ /yang dag par skul lo/ /yang dag par gzeng stod do/ /yang dag par dga' bar byed do/ /'dul lo/ /gzhog go//rab tu 'god do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu la yang dag par ston to//yang dag par skul lo/ /yang dag par gzeng stod do/ /yang dag par dga' bar byed do/ /'dul lo/ /gzhog go/ /rab tu 'god do/ /myi 'jigs pa bzhi la yang dag par ston ①te/ /yang dag par skul lo/ /yang dag par gzeng stod do/ /yang dag par dga' bar byed do/ /'dul lo/ /gzhog go//rab tu 'god do/ /so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi la yang dag par ston to/ /yang dag par skul lo/ /yang dag par gzeng stod do/ /yang dag par dga' bar byed do/ /'dul lo/ /gzhog go/ /rab tu 'god do/ /byams pa chen po la yang dag par ston to/ /yang dag par skul lo/ /yang dag par gzeng stod do/ /yang dag par dga' bar byed do/ /'dul lo/ /gzhog go//rab tu 'god do/ /snying rje chen po la yang dag par ston to/ /yang dag par skul lo/ /yang dag par gzeng stod do/ /yang dag par dga' bar byed do/ /'dul lo/ /gzhog go/ /rab tu 'god do/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa brtswa brgyad la yang dag par ston to/ /yang dag par skul lo/ /yang dag par gzeng stod do/ /yang dag par dga' bar byed do/ /'dul lo/ /gzhog go/ /rab tu 'god do/ /de zag pa myed pa'i chos gzugs myed pa bstan du myed pa thogs pa myed pa de dag gis gang rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu don du gnyer ba de dag rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu la rab tu 'god do/ /25—28

gang ①lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu don du gnyer ba de dag lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu la rab tu 'god do/ /gang phyir myi 'ong ②ba'i 'bras bu don du gnyer ba de dudag phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu la rab tu 'god do/ /gang dgra bcom pa nyid don du gnyer ba de dag dgra bcom pa nyid la rab tu 'god do/ /gang rang byang chub don du gnyer ba de dag rang byang chub la rab tu 'god do/ /gang bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub don du gnyer ba de dag la rjobyang chub kyi lam brjod ⑤cing ston to/ /yang dag par skul lo/ /yang dag par gzeng stod do/ /yang dag par dga' dubar byed do/ /'dul lo/ /gzhog go/ /rab tu 'god do/ /rab 'byor de ltar na ༅byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/chos thams cad rmi lam lta bu dang / sgra brnyan lta bu dang chu zla lta bu dang nimyig yor lta bu dang / sgyu ma lta bu dang / snyig rgyu lta bu dang / sprul pa lta bu stekhya/dngos po myed pa dang / dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid dang / rang gi mtshan nyid kyis stong pa la rnam par dgod 0par byed do/ /de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor kyis bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das de ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di la spyod pa'i tshe/ chos thams cad dngos po ma mchis pa'i ngo bo nyid dang / chos thams cad mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang / thog ma dang tha ma ma humachis pa stong pa nyid la 'di dag ni dge ba'i chos so/ /'di dag ni myi dge ba'i chos so/ /'di dag ni 'jig rten pa'i chos so/ /'di dag ni 'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos so/ /'di 25—29

dag ni kha na ma tho ba dang bcas pa'i chos so/ /'di dag ni kha na ma tho ba myed pa'i chos so/ /'di dag ni zag pa dang bcas pa'i chos so/ /'di dag ni zag pa myed pa'i chos so/ /'di dag ni 'dus byas kyi chos so/ /'di dag ni 'dus ma byas kyi chos so/ /'di dag ①ni rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mngon du bya ba'i rgyur 'gyur ba'o/ /'di dag ni lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu mngon du bya ba'i rgyur 'gyur ba'o/ /'di dag ni phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu mngon du bya ba'i rgyur 'gyur ba'o/ /'di dag ni dgra bcom pa'i 'bras bu mngon du bya ba'i rgyur 'gyur ba'o/ /'di dag ni rang byang chub kyi rgyur 'gyur ba'o/ /'di dag ni bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi rgyur 'gyur ba'o/ /zhes bgyi bar rnam par dgod par ②bgyid pa ni ngo mtshar te/ rmad du byung ba'i chos so/ /de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rab 'byor de de bzhin no de de bzhin te/ de ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di nyid dul spyod pa'i tshe/ chos thams cad dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid dang / chos thams cad mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang / thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid la 'di dag ni dge ba'i chos so/ /'di dag ni myi dge ba'i chos so/ /'di dag ni 'jig rten pa'i chos so/ /'di dag ni 'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos so/ /'di dag ni kha na ma tho ba dang bcas pa'i chos so/ /'di dag ni kha na ma tho ba skyed pa'i chos so 'di dag ni zag pa dang bcas pa'i chos so/ /'di dag ni zag pa skyed pa'i chos so//'di dag ni 'dus byas kyi chos so/ /'di dag ni 'dus ma byas kyi chos so/ /25—30

'di dag ni rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mngon du bya ba'i rgyur 'gyur ba'o/ /'di dag ni lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu mngon du bya ba'i rgyur 'gyur ba'o/ /'di dag ni phyir mi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu mngon du bya ba'i rgyur 'gyur ba'o/ /'di dag ni dgra bcom pa'i 'bras bu mngon du bya ba'i rgyur 'gyur ba'o/ /'di dag ni rang byang chub kyi rgyur 'gyur ba'o/ /'di dag ni bla na myed pa yang dag ①par rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi rgyur 'gyur ba'o/ /zhes bya bar rnam par dgod pa byed pa de ni ngo mtshar te/ rmad du byung ba'i chos so/ /rab 'byor gal te khyod kyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang gi ②ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos de nishes kyang nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyis ④byang chub ⑤sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de la slar phan gdags par bya ba sla ba ma yin te/ khyed cag thams cad kyis kyang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i chos de zil gyis gnan 0par myi nus so/ /rab 'byor kyis gsol pa/bcom ldan 'das nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad la ma mchis pa'i ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po la mchis pa gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis ⑦bka' stsal pa/ ⑧rab 'byor de'i phyir shin tu legs par nyon la yid la gyis shig dang bshad par bya'o/ /rab 'byor 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam par ⑨srin pa las byung ba'i pha rol tu phyin pa drug la gnas/ rnam par smin pa las byung ba'i stong pa nyid thams cad la gnas / rnam par smin pa las byung ba'i byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu ⑩rtsa bdun la gnas/ rnam par smin pa las byung ba'i 'phags pa'i bden pa 25—31

bzhi la gnas/ rnam par smin pa las byung ba'i bsam gtan bzhi la gnas/rnam par smin pa las byung ba'i tshad skyed pa bzhi la gnas/ rnam par smin pa las byung ba'i gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa bzhi la gnas/ rnam par smin pa las byung ba'i rnam par thar pa brgyad ①la gnas/ rnam par min pa las byung ba'i mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu la gnas/ rnam par smin pa las byung ba'i rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa la gnas/ rnam par smin pa las byung ba'i mngon par shes pa lnga ②la gnas/ rnam par smin pa las byung ba'i ting nge 'dzin rnams dul gnas/ rnam par smin pa las byung ba'i gzungs ④kyi sgo rnams la gnas/ rnam par smin pa las byung ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu la gnas/ rnam par smin pa las byung ba'i myi 'jigs ⑤pa bzhi la gnas/rnam par sbyin pa las byung ba'i so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi la gnas/ rnam par smin pa las byung ba'i byams pa chen po la gnas/ rnam par smin pa las byung ba'i snying rje chen po la gnas/ rnam par smin pa las byung ba'i sangs rgyas kyi 0chos ma 'dres pa ba'o brgyad la gnas shing / phyogs dang phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams dag tu song zhing / sems can gang la sbyin pas phan gdags par bya ba de dag la ni sbyin pas phan 'dogs so/ /sems can gang la tshul khrims kyis phan gdags par bya ba de dag la ni tshul khrims kyis phan 'dogs so/ /sems can gang la bzod pas phan gdags par bya ba de dag la ni bzod pas phan 'dogs so/ /sems can gang la brtson 'grus kyis phan gdags par bya ba de dag la ni brtson 'grus kyis phan 'dogs so/ /sems 25—32

can gang la ting nge 'dzin gyis phan gdags par bya ba de dag la ni ting nge 'dzin gyis phan 'dogs so/ /sems can gang la shes rab kyis ①phan gdags par bya ba de dag la ni shes rab kyis ②phan 'dogs so/ /sems can gang la bsam gtan dang pos phan gdags par bya ba de dag la ②ni bsam gtan dang pos phan 'dogs so/ /sems can gang la bsam gtan gnyis pas phan gdags par bya ba de dag la ni bsam gtan gnyis pas phan 'dogs so/ /sems can gang la bsam gtan gsum pas phan gdags par dubya ba de dag la ni bsam gtan gsum pas phan 'dogs so/ /sems can gang la bsam gtan bzhi pas phan gdags ⑤par bya ba de dag la ni bsam gtan bzhi pas phan 'dogs so/ /sems can gang la nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched kyi snyoms par 'jug pas phan gdags par bya ba de dag la ni nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched kyi snyoms par 'jug pas phan 'dogs so/ /sems can gang la rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched kyi snyoms par 'jug pas phan gdags par bya ba de dag la ni/ rnam shes mtha' dulas skye mched kyi snyoms par 'jug pas phan 'dogs so/ /sems can gang la chung zad myed pa'i skye mched kyi ⑦stoms par 'jug pas niphan gdags par bya ba de dag la ni/ chung zad skyed pa'i skye mched kyi snyoms par 'jug ⑨pas phan 'dogs so/ /sems can gang la 'du shes myed 'du shes myed myin skye mched kyi snyoms par 'jug pas phan gdags par bya ba de dag la ni/ 'du shes myed 'du shes myed myin skye mched kyi snyoms par 'jug pas phan 'dogs so/ /sems can gang la byams pas phan gdags par bya ba de dag la ni byams pas phan 'dogs so/ /sems can gang la snying 25—33

rjes phan gdags par bya ba de dag la ni snying rjes phan 'dogs so/ /sems can gang la dga' bas phan gdags par bya ba de dag la ni dga' bas phan 'dogs so/ /sems can gang la btang snyoms kyis phan gdags par bya ba de dag la ni btang snyoms kyis ①phan 'dogs so/ /sems can gang la dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhis phan gdags par bya ba de dag la ni/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhis phan 'dogs so/ /sems can gang la yang dag par spong ba bzhis phan gdags par bya ba de dag la ni/ yang dag par spong ba bzhis phan 'dogs so/ /sems can gang la rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhis phan gdags par bya ba de dag la ni/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhis phan 'dogs so/ /sems can gang la dbang po lngas phan gdags par bya ba de dag la ni dbang po lngas phan 'dogs so/ /sems can gang la stobs lngas phan gdags par bya ba de dag la ni stobs lngas phan 'dogs so/ /sems can gang la byang chub kyi yan lag bdun gyis phan gdags par bya ba de dag la ni/ byang chub kyi yan lag bdun gyis phan 'dogs so/ /sems can gang la 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pas phan gdags par bya ba de dag la ni/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pas phan 'dogs so/ /sems can gang la 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhis ②phan gdags par bya ba de dag la ni/ 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams kyis ②phan 'dogs so/ /④sems can gang la rnam par thar pa ⑤brgyad kyis phan gdags par bya ba de dag la ni/ rnam par thar pa brgyad kyis phan 'dogs so/ /sems can gang la mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgus phan gdags par bya ba de dag la ni/ mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa 25—34

dgus phan 'dogs so/ /sems can gang la stong pa nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin gyis phan gdags par bya ba de dag la ni/ stong pa nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin gyis phan 'dogs so/ /sems can gang la mtshan ma myed pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyis phan gdags par bya ba de dag la ni/ mtshan ma myed pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyis phan 'dogs so/ /sems can gang la smon pa myed pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyis phan gdags par bya ba de dag la ni/ smon pa myed pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyis phan 'dogs so/ /sems can gang la mngon par shes pa rnams kyis ①phan gdags par bya ba de dag la ni/ mngon par shes pa rnams kyis ②phan 'dogs so/ /sems can gang la ④ting nge 'dzin dang / gzungs kyi sgo rnams kyis phan gdags par bya ba de dag la ni/ ting nge 'dzin dang / gzungs kyi sgo rnams kyis phan 'dogs so/ /sems can gang la de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcus phan gdags par bya ba de dag la ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcus phan 'dogs ④so/ /sems can gang la myi 'jigs pa bzhis phan gdags rjopar bya ba de dag la ni/ myi 'jigs pa bzhis phan 'dogs so/ /sems can gang la so so yang dag par rig pa bzhis phan gdags par bya ba de dag la ni/so so yang dag par rig pa bzhis phan 'dogs so/ /sems can gang la sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa ba'o brgyad kyis phan gdags par bya ba de dag la ni/sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bca brgyad kyis phan 'dogs so/ /sems can gang la snying rje 0chen pos phan gdags par bya ba de dag la ni snying rje chen pos phan 'dogs so/ /sems can gang la thams cad shes pa nyid kyis phan gdags par bya ba de dag la ni/ thams cad shes pa nyid kyis phan 'dogs so//25—35

sems can gang la lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid kyis phan gdags par bya ba de dag la ni/ lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid kyis phan 'dogs so/ /sems can gang la rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyis phan gdags par bya ba de dag la ni/rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyis ①phan 'dogs ②so/ /rab 'byor kyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ji ltar na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dusbyin pas sems can rnams la sman du'adogs pa lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ zas 'dod pa rnams la zas/ skom 'dod pa rnams la skom/ bzhon ⑤pa 'dod pa rnams la bzhon 0pa/ phreng ba 'dod pa rnams la phreng ba/ spos 'dod pa rnams la spos/ byug pa 'dod pa rnams la byug pa/ gos 'dod pa rnams la gos/ mal cha 'dod pa rnams la mal ⑦cha/ gnas 'dod pa rnams la gnas/ nor bu dang / mu tig dang / bee ḍūrya dudang / dung dang /man shel dang / byi ①ru dang / gser ⑩dang / dngul 'dod pa rnams la/nor bu dang / mu tig dang / bai ḍūrya dang / dung dang / man shel dang / byi 0ru dang / gser dang / dngul gyi sbyin pa yongs su gtong ba nas/ myi'i yo byad gang yang rung ba'i bar du yongs su gtong ste/ ji ltar de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams la dbul ⑩zhing yongs su gtong ba dang / ji ltar rang sangs rgyas rnams dang /dgra bcom pa rnams dang / phyir myi 'ong ba rnams dang / lan cig phyir 'ong ba rnams dang / rgyun tu zhugs pa rnams dang / yang dag par spong 4)ba 25—36

rnams dang / yang dag par zhugs pa rnams la yongs su gtong ba de bzhin du/myir gyur pa rnams dang / de bzhin du byol song gi skye gnas su gtogs pa'i sems can thams cad la yang tha dad du bya ba myed pa'i 'du shes nye bar bzhag ①cing sbyin pa yongs su gtong ngo / /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar chos thams cad ni tha dad du bya ba myed pa ste/ des tha dad du bya ba myed pa'i sbyin pa byin pas/ tha dad du bya ba skyed pa'i chos 'di lta ste/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob par 'gyur ro/ /rab 'byor gal te byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos byol song gi skye gnas su gtogs pa'i srog chags sbyin pa'i gnas ma yin par ②mthong nas/ 'di snyam du③/ bdag gi sbyin gnas ni yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas te/ byol song gi skye gnas su gtogs pa ma yin no snyam na/ byang chub sems dpa'i chos ma yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos ni byang chub tu sems bskyed dunas/ 'di ltar bdag gis sems can 'di ⑤dag la ni dusbyin pas phan gdags par bya'o/ /'di dag la ni phan gdags par myi bya'o/ /zhes bya bar bla na skyed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yang dag par gzhugs pa ma yin te/ de dag sbyin pas phan btags dunas/ rgyal rigs che zhing mtho ba'i rigs su skye/ bram ze che zhing mtho ba'i rigs su skye/ khyim bdag che zhing mtho ba'i rigs su skye bar 'gyur te/ sbyin pa de 0nyid kyis 0phan btags pa de dag theg pa gsum gyis 0rim gyis phung po ma lus pa'i mya ngan las 8'das pa'i dbyings su yongs su mya ngan las 0'das par 'gyur ro/ /gal te byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po la skye bo'i tshogs thams cad kyis gsad par 25—37

gsol ba btab na/ de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos sbyin no snyam 'amadzoste/ myi sbyin no snyam pa'i sems gzhan bskyed par myi bya'i②/'khrug pa myed pa'i sems kyis skye bo'i tshogs de dag la sbyin par bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar de ni sems can thams cad kyi don du bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yang dag par zhugs pa'i phyir/ gal te de ltar nirnam par rtog na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag dang / rang sangs rgyas rnams dang / dgra bcom pa rnams dang / slob pa rnams dang / lha dang / myi dang lha ma yin du bcas pa'i 'jig rten kyis smad ④par 'gyur te/ de la thog mar sems can thams cad kyi mgon gyis shig ce'amadu/ gnas dang /skyabs dang / dpung gnyen gyis shig ces sus gsol ba btab btab 0ces smad ⑦par 'gyur tel/ rab 'byor gzhan yang gal te byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i drung du myir gyur pa'amal/ myi ma yin par gyur pa dag 'ongs ⑩nas/ bdag ni slong yimo pa'o zhes yan lag dang / nying lag gcad ⑫par gsol ba btab na/ de'i tshe des sbyin nam myi sbyin snyam pa'i sems gnyis su bskyed par myi bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po des tho)sems can rnams kyi don du ched du bsams te4ste/lus 'dis bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi don 8bya'o zhes lus yongs su bzung bas na/ des 'di snyam du bdag gis ⑩sems can 'di dag gi don du lus yongs su bzung bzung 0bas de dag bslang myi dgos pas 0khyer zhing dengs tu shig ces sems bskyed par byas te bu/ rab 'byor de ltar byang chub sems 25—38

dpa' sems dpa' chen pos shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la ①bslab par bya'o//rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos slongs ②mo pa mthong na 'di snyam du chos 'di dag thams cad kyi rang bzhin dmyigs su myed na/ 'di la su zhig ni sbyin pa yongs su gtong ②/ su la ni dusbyin par bya/ci zhig ni sbyin par bya zhes sems bskyed par bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar chos de dag ni mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid kyis stong pa ste/ stong pa nyid la ni ⑤gang la duyang yongs su gtong ba'am/ gang las kyang 'phrogs ⑦pa myed do⑤/ /rab 'byor de ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ⑨shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / 'di lta ste/ nang stong pa nyid dam/ phyi stong pa nyid dam/ phyi nang stong pa nyid dam/ stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dam/chen po stong pa nyid dam/ don ⑩dam pa stong pa nyid dam/ 'dus byas stong pa nyid dam/ 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dam/ mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dam / thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid dam/ dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid dam/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid dam/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid dam/ rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dam/ myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid dam/ dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid dam/ ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dam/ dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid la bslab par bya'o/ /de stong pa nyid de dag la gnas shing /sbyin pa gtong na/ de'i tunyesbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa rtag 8tu rgyun myi 'chad par yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur te/ de sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs pa des / phyi dang nang gi chos la gcad cing gtubs kyang / bdag la su yang gtub pa'amatshu/ gcad ④do/ /snyam 8pa'i sems myi 'byung ngo // //25—39

shes rab kyi pha rold tu phyind pa stong phrag brgya pa/ bam po gnyis ①pa/ rab 'byor ngas 'di nas sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis 'jig rten la rnam par gzigs na/ shar phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i ②klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dag ched du bsams ③te/sems can dmyal ba chen po dag tu dong zhing / sems can dmyal ba chen po'i sdug bsngal ༷zhi bar byas nas/ rdzu 'phrul gyi cho 'phrul dang / yongs su bstan pa'i cho 'phrul dang / rjes su bstan pa'i cho 'phrul dang / cho 'phrul gsum po de dag gis ②sems can dmyal ba pa'i sems can de dag la chos ston cing / rdzu 'phrul gyi cho 'phrul gyis sems can dmyal ba chen po'i sdug bsngal de dag zhi bar byas te0/ yongs su bstan pa'i cho 'phrul dang / rjes su bstan pa'i cho 'phrul gyis chos ston pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag byams pa chen po dang / snying rje chen po dang / dga' ba chen po dang / btang stisnyoms chen pos chos ⑤ston te/ des sems can dmyal ba pa'i sems can de dag byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag la sems mos par byas shing / sems can dmyal ba chen po de dag nas rnam par ldang ba dang / de dag sems can dmyal ba chen po de dag nas rnam par langs nas/ lha dang myi dag dang skal ba mnyam par skyes shing / rim gyis theg pa gsum gyis sdug bsngal mthar 'byin pa mthong ngo / /rab 'byord ngas 'di nas sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis 'jig rten la rnam par gzigs na/ lho 0phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dag ched du bsams te/ sems can dmyal ba chen po 25—40

dag tu dong zhing /① sems can dmyal ba chen po'i sdug bsngal zhi bar byas nas②/ rdzu 'phrul gyi cho 'phrul dang / yongs su bstan pa'i cho 'phrul dang /rjes su bstan pa'i cho ③'phrul dang / cho 'phrul gsum po de dag gis sems can dmyal ba pa'i sems can de dag la chos ston cing / rdzu 'phrul gyi cho 'phrul gyis sems can dmyal ba chen po'i dusdug bsngal de dag zhi bar byas te/yongs su bstan pa'i cho 'phrul dang / rjes su bstan pa'i cho 'phrul gyis chos ston pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag byams ⑤pa chen po rjodang / snying rje chen po dang / dga' ba chen po dang / btang snyoms chen pos chos ston te⑦/ des sems can dmyal ba pa'i sems can de dag byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag la sems mos par byas shing / sems can dmyal ba chen po de dag nas rnam par ldang ba dang / de dag sems can dmyal ba chen po de dag nas rnam par langs nas/ lha dang myi dag dang skal ⑧ba mnyam par skyes shing / rim gyis theg pa gsum gyis sdug bsngal mthar 'byin pa mthong ngo / /rab 'byor ngas 'di nas sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis 'jig rten la rnam par gzigs na/ nub phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dag ched du bsams te/ sems can dmyal ba chen po dag tu dong ⑨zhing sems can dmyal ba chen po'i sdug bsngal zhi bar byas nas/ rdzu 'phrul gyi cho 'phrul dang / yongs su bstan pa'i cho 'phrul dang / rjes su bstan pa'i cho 'phrul dang / cho 'phrul gsum po de dag gis sems can dmyal ba pa'i sems can de dag la chos ston cing / rdzu 'phrul gyi cho 'phrul gyis sems can dmyal ba 25—41

na / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sems can yi dgas ①kyi yul pa rnams kyi/ yi dgas kyi yul de dag na/ sdug bsngal ji snyed cig yod pa de dag thams cad rab tu 'jil zhing ser sna spang ba'i phyir chos ston pa dang /de dag na sems can yi dgas kyi yul pa de dag byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag la byams pa'i sems bskyed ②cing / yi dgas kyi skye gnas de dag nas rnam par ldang ba dang / de dag yi dgas kyi skye gnas de dag nas rnam par langs nas/ dge ba'i rtsa ba de nyid kyis lha'i 'jig rten dang myi'i 'jig rten du skyes te②/ phung po ma lus pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings su yongs su mya ngan las 'das kyi bar du sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams dang / nam yang 'bral bar myi 'gyur ba dag mthong ngo / /rab 'byor ngas 'di nas sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis 'jig rten la rnam par gzigs na/ lho phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sems can yi dgas kyi yul pa rnams 0yi dgas kyi yul de dag na sdug bsngal ji snyed cig yod pa de dag thams cad rab tu 'jil zhing ser sna spang ba'i phyir chos ston pa dang / de dag na sems can yi dgas kyi yul pa de dag byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag la byams pa'i sems bskyed ducing / yi dgas kyi skye gnas de dag nas rnam par ldang ba dang / de dag yi dgas kyi skye gnas de dag nas/ rnam par langs nas dge ba'i rtsa ba de nyid kyis lha'i 'jig rten dang / myi'i 'jig rten du skyes te duphung po ma lus pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings su yongs su mya ngan las 'das kyi bar du sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams dang nam yang 'bral bar 25—63

mi 'gyur ba dag mthong ngo / /rab 'byor ngas 'di nas sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis 'jig rten la rnam par gzigs na/ nub phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sems can yi dgas kyi yul pa rnams kyi yi dgas kyi yul de dag na/ sdug bsngal ji snyed cig yod pa de dag thams cad rab tu 'jil zhing ser sna spang ba'i phyir chos ston pa dang / de dag na sems can yi dgas kyi yul pa de dag byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag la byams pa'i sems bskyed ①cing /yi dgas kyi skye gnas de dag nas rnam par ldang ba dang / de dag yi dgas kyi skye gnas de dag nas rnam par langs nas/ dge ba'i rtsa ba de nyid kyis ②lha'i 'jig rten dang / myi'i 'jig rten du skyes te/ phung po ma lus pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings su yongs su mya ngan las 'das kyi bar du/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams dang / nam yang 'bral bar myi 'gyur ba dag mthong ngo / /rab 'byor ngas 'di nas sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis ③'jig rten la rnam par gzigs na/ byang phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sems can yi dgas kyi yul pa rnams kyi yi dgas kyi yul de dag na sdug bsngal ji snyed cig yod pa de dag thams cad rab tu 'jil zhing ser sna spang ba'i phyir chos ston pa dang /de dag na sems can yi dgas kyi yul pa de dag byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag la byams pa'i sems bskyed 0cing / yi dgas kyi skye gnas de dag ⑤nas/ rnam par ldang ba dang / de dag yi dgas kyi skye gnas de dag nas rnam par langs nas/ dge ba'i rtsa ba 0de nyid kyis lha'i 'jig rten 25—64

dang / myi'i 'jig rten du skyes te/ phung po ma lus pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings su yongs su mya ngan las 'das kyi bar du sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams dang nam yang 'bral bar myi 'gyur ba dag mthong ngo rab 'byor ngas 'di nas sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis 'jig rten la rnam par gzigs na/byang shar gyi phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sems can yi dgas kyi yul pa rnams kyi yi dgas kyi yul de dag na sdug bsngal ji snyed cig yod pa de dag thams cad rab tu 'jil zhing ser sna spang ba'i phyir chos ston pa dang / de dag na sems can yi dgas kyi yul pa de dag byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag la byams pa'i sems bskyed ①cing / yi dgas kyi skye gnas de dag nas rnam par ldang ba dang / de dag yi dgas kyi skye gnas de dag nas rnam par langs nas/ dge ba'i rtsa ba de nyid kyis lha'i 'jig rten dang /myi'i 'jig rten du skyes te/ phung po ma lus pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings su yongs su mya ngan las 'das kyi bar du/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams dang / nam yang 'bral bar myi 'gyur ba dag mthong ngo / /rab 'byor ngas 'di nas sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis 'jig rten la rnam par gzigs na/shar lho'i phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sems can yi dgas kyi yul pa rnams kyi yi dgas kyi yul de dag na sdug bsngal ji snyed cig yod pa de dag thams cad rab tu 'jil zhing ser sna spang ba'i phyir chos ston pa dang / de dag na sems can yi dgas kyi yul pa de dag byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' 25—65

chen po de dag la byams pa'i sems bskyed ①cing / yi dgas kyi skye gnas de dag nas rnam par ldang ba dang / de dag yi dgas kyi skye ②gnas de dag nas rnam par langs nas/ dge ba'i rtsa ba de nyid kyis lha'i 'jig rten dang /myi'i 'jig rten du skyes te/ phung po ma lus pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i ①dbyings su yongs su mya ngan las 'das kyi bar du/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams dang nam yang 'bral bar myi 'gyur ba dag mthong ngo / /rab 'byord ngas 'di nas sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis 'jig rten la rnam par gzigs na/lho nub kyi phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag rjon / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sems can yi dgas kyi yul pa rnams kyi yi dgas kyi yul de dag na sdug bsngal ji snyed cig yod pa de dag thams cad rab tu 'jil zhing ser sna spang ba'i phyir chos ston pa dang / de dag na sems can yi dgas kyi yul pa de dag byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag la byams pa'i sems bskyed ⑤cing / yi dgas kyi skye gnas de dag nas rnam par ldang ba dang / de dag yi dgas kyi skye gnas de dag nas/rnam par langs nas/ dge ba'i rtsa ba de nyid kyis lha'i 'jig rten dang /myi'i 'jig rten du skyes te/ phung po ma lus pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings su yongs su mya ngan las 'das kyi bar du sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams dang / nam yang 'bral bar myi 'gyur ba dag mthong ngo rab 'byor ngas 'di nas sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis 'jig rten la rnam dupar gzigs na/nub byang gi phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sems can yi dgas kyi yul 25—66

pa rnams kyi yi dgas kyi yul ①de dag na sdug bsngal ji snyed cig yod pa de dag thams cad rab tu 'jil zhing ser sna spang ba'i phyir chos ston pa dang / de dag na ②sems can yi dgas kyi yul pa de dag byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag la byams pa'i sems bskyed ①cing / yi dgas kyi skye gnas de dag nas rnam par ldang ba dang / de dag yi dgas kyi skye gnas de dag nas rnam par langs nas/ dge ba'i rtsa ba de nyid kyis lha'i 'jig rten dang /myi'i 'jig rten du skyes te/ phung po ma lus pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings su yongs su mya ngan las 'das kyi bar du/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams dang nam yang 'bral bar myi 'gyur ba dag mthong ngo / /rab 'byor ngas 'di nas sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis 'jig rten la rnam par gzigs na/'og gi phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sems can yi dgas kyi yul pa rnams kyi yi dgas kyi yul de dag na sdug bsngal ji bsnyed cig duyod pa de dag thams cad rab tu 'jil zhing ser sna spang ba'i phyir chos ston pa dang / de dag na sems can yi dgas kyi yul pa de dag byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag la byams pa'i sems bskyed ༅cing / yi dgas kyi skye gnas de dag nas/rnam par ldang ba dang / de dag yi dgas kyi skye gnas de dag nas rnam par langs nas/ dge ba'i rtsa ba de nyid kyis lha'i 'jig rten dang / myi'i 'jig rten du skyes te/ phung po ma lus pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings su yongs su mya ngan las 'das kyi bar du sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams dang /nam yang 'bral bar myi 'gyur ba dag mthong ngo / /rab 'byor ngas 'di nas 25—67

sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis 'jig rten la rnam par gzigs na/ steng gi phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sems can yi dgas kyi yul pa rnams kyi yi dgas ①kyi yul de dag na sdug bsngal ji snyed cig yod pa de dag thams cad rab tu 'jil zhing /ser sna yongs su ②spang ba'i phyir chos ston pa dang / de dag na nisems can yi dgas kyi yul pa dude dag ⑤byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag la byams pa'i sems bskyed 0cing / yi dgas kyi skye gnas de dag nas rnam par ldang ba dang / de dag yi dgas kyi skye gnas de dag nas rnam par langs nas/ dge ba'i rtsa ba de nyid kyis lha'i 'jig rten dang / myi'i 'jig rten du skyes te/ phung po ma lus pa'i mya ngan las ⑦'das pa'i dbyings su yongs su mya ngan las du'adas kyi bar du/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams dang nam yang 'bral bar myi 'gyur ba dag mthong ngo / /rab 'byor ngas yang 'di nas sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis 'jig rten la rnam par gzigs na/ shar phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rgyal chen bzhi'i ris kyi lha rnams la chos ston pa dang /sum cu rtsa gsum dang / mtshe ma dang / dga' ldan dang / 'phrul dga' dang / gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lha rnams la chos ston pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag las lha'i bu de dag gis ①chos de thos nas/ theg pa gsum pos rim gyis yongs su mya ngan las 'das par gyur pa dang / yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba dang / yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar 'gyur ba mthong ste/ rab 'byor de la lha'i bu gang 'dod pa'i yon tan 25—68

lngas shas ①cher myos pa de dag la gzhal myed khang de dag 'bar bar snang bar byas shing / de dag skyo bar gyur par shes nas 'di skad du grogs po dag 'du byed thams cad ni myi rtag pa 'du byed thams cad ni sdug bsngal ba/ 'du byed thams cad ni bdag myed pa 'du byed thams cad ni myi brtan pa/ 'du byed thams cad ni yid brtan du myi rung ba/ 'du byed thams cad ni rnam par 'gyur ba'i chos can yin na/ 'du byed rnams la lta su zhig yid phebs par gnas shes chos ston to/ /rab 'byor ngas yang 'di nas sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis 'jig rten la rnam par gzigs na/ lho phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rgyal chen bzhi'i ris kyi lha rnams la chos ston pa dang / sum cu rtsa gsum dang /mtshe ma dang / dga' ldan dang / 'phrul dga' dang / gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lha rnams la chos ston pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag las lha'i bu de dag gis chos de thos nas theg pa gsum pos rim gyis yongs su mya ngan las 'das par gyur pa dang / yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba dang / yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar 'gyur ba mthong ste/rab 'byor de la lha'i bu gang 'dod pa'i yon tan lngas shas ②cher myos pa de dag la/ gzhal skyed khang de dag 'bar bar snang bar byas shing / de dag skyo bar gyur par shes nas/ 'di skad du grogs po dag 'du byed thams cad ni myi rtag pa/ 'du byed thams cad ni sdug bsngal ba/ 'du byed thams cad ni bdag myed pa/ 'du byed thams cad ni myi brtan pa/ 'du byed thams cad ni yid brtan du myi rung ba/ 'du byed thams cad ni rnam par 'gyur ba'i chos 25—69

can yin na/ 'du byed rnams la lta su zhig yid phebs par gnas shes chos ston to/ /rab 'byor ngas yang 'di nas sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis 'jig rten la rnam par gzigs na/ nub phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rgyal chen bzhi'i ris kyi lha rnams la chos ston pa dang / sum cu rtsa gsum dang / mtshe ma dang /dga' ldan dang / 'phrul dga' dang / gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lha rnams la chos ston pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag las lha'i bu de dag gis chos de thos nas/ theg pa gsum pos rim gyis yongs su mya ngan las 'das par gyur pa dang / yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba dang / yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar 'gyur ba mthong ste/ rab 'byor de la lha'i bu gang 'dod pa'i yon tan lngas shas ①cher myos pa de dag la/gzhal myed khang de dag 'bar bar snang bar byas shing / de dag skyo ②bar gyur par shes nas/ 'di skad du grogs po dag 'du byed thams cad ni mi rtag pa/'du byed thams cad ni sdug bsngal ba/ 'du byed thams cad ni bdag myed pa/'du byed thams cad ni myi brtan pa/ 'du byed thams cad ni yid brtan du myi rung bzhu/ 'du byed thams cad ni rnam par 'gyur ba'i chos can yin na④/'du byed rnams la ⑤lta su zhig yid phebs par gnas shes chos ston to/ /rab 'byor ngas yang 'di nas sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis 'jig rten la rnam par gzigs na/ byang duphyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rgyal chen bzhi'i ris kyi lha rnams la chos ston pa dang / sum cu rtsa gsum dang / mtshe ma dang /25—70

dga' ldan dang / 'phrul dga' dang / gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lha rnams la chos ston pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag las ②lha'i bu de dag gis chos de thos nas/ theg pa gsum pos rim gyis yongs su mya ngan las 'das par gyur pa dang / yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba dang / yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar 'gyur ba mthong ste/ rab 'byor de la lha'i bu gang 'dod pa'i yon tan lngas shas cher myos pa de dag la/ gzhal myed khang de dag 'bar bar snang bar byas shing de dag skyo bar gyur par shes nas/'di skad du grogs po dag 'du byed thams cad ni myi rtag pa/ 'du byed thams cad ni sdug bsngal ba/ 'du byed thams cad ni bdag myed pa/ 'du byed thams cad ni myi brtan pa/ 'du byed thams cad ni yid brtan du myi rung ba/'du byed thams cad ni rnam par 'gyur ba'i chos can yin na/ 'du byed rnams la lta su zhig yid phebs par gnas shes chos ston to/ /rab 'byor ngas yang 'di nas sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis 'jig rten la rnam par gzigs na/byang shar kyi phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rgyal chen bzhi'i ris kyi lha rnams la chos ston pa dang / sum cu rtsa gsum dang / mtshe ma dang /dga' ldan dang / 'phrul dga' dang / gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lha rnams la chos ston pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag las lha'i bu de dag gis ②chos de thos nas/ theg pa gsum pos rim gyis yongs su mya ngan las 'das par ①gyur pa dang / yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba dang / yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar 'gyur ba mthong ste/ rab 'byor 25—71

mthong ste/ rab 'byor de ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams snying rje chen po la gnas shing / sems can rnams la chos ston to/ /rab 'byor de ni ngo mtshar che ste/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi rmad du byung ba'i chos so/ /rab 'byor ngas yang 'di nas sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis 'jig rten la rnam par gzigs na/ steng gi phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams sems can gang tshangs pa'i lta ba la mngon par zhen pa de dag la/ kye grogs po dag chos thams cad stong pa la ci zhig lta ba skyed/chos thams cad gsog dang gsob sha stag la ci zhig lta ba skyed ces lta ba'i rnam pa de dag dang bral bar byed pa mthong ste/ rab 'byor de ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams snying rje chen po ①la gnas shing / sems can rnams la chos ston to②/ /rab 'byor de ni ngo mtshar che ste/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi rmad du byung ba'i chos so rab 'byor ngas yang 'di nas sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis du'ajig rten tshul rnam par gzigs na/ shar phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dag myi rnams bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhis sdud pa mthong ste/ bzhi gang zhe na/ sbyin pa dang / tshig snyan pa dang / don spyad ⑤pa dang / don mthun 0pa'o/ /rab 'byor ngas yang 'di nas sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis 'jig rten la rnam par gzigs na/ lho phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dag myi rnams bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhis sdud 25—80

pa mthong ste/ bzhi gang zhe na/ sbyin pa dang / tshig snyan pa dang / don spyad pa dang / don mthun pa'o/ /rab 'byor ngas yang ①'di nas sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis ②'jig rten la rnam par gzigs na/ nub phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dag myi rnams bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhis sdud pa mthong ste/ bzhi gang zhe na/ sbyin pa dang / tshig snyan pa dang / don spyad pa dang / don mthun pa'o/ /rab 'byor ngas yang ②'di nas sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis 'jig rten la rnam par gzigs na/ byang phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dudag myi rnams bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhis sdud ⑤pa mthong ste/ bzhi gang zhe na/ sbyin pa dang / tshig snyan pa dang / don spyad pa dang / don mthun pa'o/ /rab 'byor ngas yang 'di nas sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis 'jig rten la rnam par gzigs na/ byang shar gyi phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dag myi rnams bsdu rjoba'i dngos po bzhis sdud pa mthong ste/ bzhi gang zhe na/ sbyin pa dang /tshig snyan pa dang / don spyad pa dang / don mthun pa'o/ rab 'byor ngas yang 'di nas sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis 'jig rten la rnam par gzigs na/shar lho'i phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dag myi rnams bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhis sdud pa mthong ste/ bzhi gang zhe na/ sbyin pa dang / tshig snyan pa dang /don spyad pa dang / don mthun pa'o/ /rab 'byor ngas yang 'di nas sangs 25—81
