rgyas kyi spyan gyis ①'jig rten la rnam par gzigs na/ lho nub kyi phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dag myi rnams bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhis sdud pa mthong ste/ bzhi gang zhe na/ sbyin pa dang / tshig snyan pa dang / don spyad pa dang / don mthun pa'o/ /rab 'byor ngas yang 'di nas sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis ②'jig rten la rnam par gzigs na/ nub byang gi phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dag /myi rnams bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhis sdud pa mthong ste/bzhi gang zhe na/ sbyin pa dang / tshig snyan pa dang / don spyad pa dang / don mthun pa'o/ /rab 'byor ngas yang 'di nas sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis ①'jig rten la rnam par gzigs na/ 'og gi phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dag myi rnams bsdu ④ba'i dngos po bzhis sdud pa mthong ste/ bzhi gang zhe na/ sbyin pa dang /tshig snyan pa dang / don spyad pa dang / don mthun pa'o/ /rab 'byor ngas yang 'di nas sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis 'jig rten la rnam par gzigs na/steng gi phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dag myi rnams bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhis sdud pa mthong ste/ bzhi gang zhe na/ sbyin pa dang / tshig snyan pa dang / don spyad pa dang / don mthun pa'o// //shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa/ bam po bzhi ⑤pa/rab 'byor ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sbyin pas 25—82

sems can rnams sdud pa yin zhe na/ rab 'byor 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sbyin pa gnyis kyis sems can rnams sdud de/ gnyis gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ zang zing ①sbyin pa dang / chos ②sbyin pa'o/ /rab 'byor ji ltar na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po zang zing gi sbyin pas sems can rnams sdud pa yin zhe na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ gser ram/ dngul lamadu/ nor bu'am/ mu tig gam/ bee ḍūrya 'am/dung ngam/ man shel lam/ byu ⑤ru 'am/ sa le sbram mam⑤/ zas sam/skom mamadu/ gdugs sam/ gos sam/ spos sam/ 'phreng ⑦ba'am/byug pa'am/ mal cha'am/ stan nam/ 'tsho ba'am/ bud myed dam/skyes pa'am/ rta'am/ glang po'amal/ bdag po ⑨yongs su gtong na/'di skad du kye sems can dag tshur shegatsu )/ bdag nyid kyi dang 'dra bar bslang myi dgos par khyer cig /long tsol dengs ④shig ces brjod de/ sbyin pa 4)des sbyin pa tunyebyin nas/ sangs rgyas la skyabs su gtong ngo / /chos la skyabs su gtong ngo / /dge 'dun la skyabs su gtong ngo / /la la ni bslab pa'i gnas lnga 8'dzin tu 'dzud do/ /la la ni yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i nye bar gnas pa la nye bar gnas par byed do/ /la la ni dge ba bcu'i las kyi ⑩lam rnams la 'god do/ /la la ni bsam gtan dang po la 'god do/ /la la ni bsam gtan gnyis pa la 'god do/ /la la ni bsam gtan gsum pa la 'god do/ /la la ni bsam gtan bzhi pa la 'god do/ /la la ni byams pa la 'god do/ /la la ni snying rje la 'god do/ /la la ni dga' ba la 'god do/ /25—83

la la ni ①btang snyoms la 'god do/ /la la ni nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched la 'god do/ /la la ni rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched la 'god do/ /la la ni chung zad myed pa'i skye mched la 'god do/ /la la ni 'du shes myed 'du shes myed myin skye mched la 'god do/ /la la ni sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa la yang dag par skul lo/ /la la ni chos rjes su dran pa la yang dag par skul lo/ /la la ni dge 'dun rjes su dran pa la yang dag par skul lo/ /la la ni tshul khrims rjes su dran pa la yang dag par skul lo/ /la la ni gtong ba rjes su dran pa la yang dag par skul lo/ /la la ni lha ②rjes su dran pa la yang dag par skul lo/ /la la ni lus la myi gtsang ③ba las stsogs ④pa'i 'du shes ⑤so sor brtag 0pa la yang dag par skul lo/ /la la ni rnam par dag pa la yang dag par skul lo/ /la la ni dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi la yang dag par skul lo/ /la la ni yang dag par spong ba bzhi la yang dag par skul lo/ /la la ni rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi la yang dag par skul lo/ /la la ni dbang po lnga la yang dag par skul lo/ /la la ni stobs lnga la yang dag par skul lo/ /la la ni byang chub kyi yan lag bdun la yang dag par skul lo/ /la la ni 'phags pa'i lam yan ⑦lag brgyad pa la yang dag par skul lo/ /la la ni stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa'i ting nge 'dzin la yang dag par skul lo/ /la la ni rnam par thar pa brgyad la yang dag par skul lo/ /la la ni mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu la yang dag par skul ⑧lo/ /la la ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu la yang dag par skul lo/ /la la ni myi 'jigs ⑨pa bzhi la yang dag par skul 0lo/ /la la ni so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi la 25—84

yang dag par skul lo/ /la la ni byams pa chen po la yang dag par skul ༅lo/ /la la ni snying rje chen po la yang dag par skul ②lo/ /la la ni sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bca brgyad la yang dag par skul lo/ /la la ni myi chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis yongs su grub par bya ba la yang dag par skul lo/ /la la ni dpe ②byad bzang po brgyad cu la yang dag par skul lo/ /la la ni rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu la yang dag par skul lo/ /la la ni lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu la yang dag par skul lo/ /la la ni phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu la yang dag par skul lo/ /la la ni dgra bcom pa nyid la yang dag par skul lo/ /la la ni rang byang duchub la yang dag par skul lo/ /la la ni lam gyi rnam pa ⑤shes pa nyid la duyang dag par skul ⑦mo/ /la la ni rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la yang dag par skul lo/ /rab 'byor de ltar na ⑧byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ sems can rnams la zang zing gi sbyin pa yongs su gtong 0zhing thabs mkhas pas bla na myed pa'i (sprebade ba dang ldan par 'god de/ rab 'byor de ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i ngo mtshar dang rmad du byung ba'i chos so rab 'byor ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ chos kyi sbyin pas sems can rnams sdud pa yin zhe na/rab 'byor gnyis po 'di dag ni chos kyi sbyin pa ste/ 'jig rten pa dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'o/ /rab 'byor 'jig rten pa'i chos kyi sbyin pa gang zhe na/'jig rten pa'i chos rnams brjod pa dang / bshad pa dang / ma nor bar ⑪bstan pa ste/ 'di ltar myi gtsang ba'i rnam pa dang / bsam gtan bzhi dang /25—85

tshangs pa'i rnam par spyod pa bzhi dang / gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa bzhi dang / mngon par shes pa lnga dang / gzhan yang 'jig rten pa'i chos byis pa so so'i skye bo dag ①dang / thun mong du gyur pa rnams te/ rab 'byor de ni 'jig rten pa'i chos kyi sbyin pa'o/ /rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po des 'jig rten pa'i ②chos kyi sbyin pa de btang nas/rnam grangs du mas 'jig rten gyi ①chos ma nor bar blangs ④pa de las bskyod de de las ⑤bskyod nas/ thabs mkhas pas 'phags pa'i chos rnams dang /'phags pa'i chos rnams ⑥kyi 'bras bu dag la rab tu 'god do/ /de la 'phags pa'i chos rnams ni gang / 'phags pa'i chos rnams kyi 'bras bu ni gang zhe na/ 'phags pa'i chos shes bya ba ni/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi dang / yang dag par spong ba bzhi dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi dang /dbang po lnga dang / stobs lnga dang / byang chub kyi yan lag bdun dang /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa dang / rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa rnams so/ /'phags pa'i chos rnams kyi 'bras bu ni rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu dang / lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu dang / phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu dang / dgra bcom pa nyid de/ rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i 'phags pa'i chos ni/ rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu shes pa'o/ /lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu shes pa'o/ /phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu shes pa'o/ /dgra bcom pa nyid shes pa'o/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa shes pa'o/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa shes pa'o/ /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa shes pa'o/ /brtson 25—86

'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa shes pa'o/ /bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa shes pa'o / /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa shes pa'o/ /nang stong pa nyid shes pa'o//phyi stong pa nyid shes pa'o/ /phyi nang stong pa nyid shes pa'o/ /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid shes pa'o/ /chen po stong pa nyid shes pa'o/ /don dam pa stong pa nyid shes pa'o/ /'dus byas stong pa nyid shes pa'o/ /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid shes pa'o/ /mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid shes pa'o①/ /thog ma dang tha ma skyed pa stong pa nyid shes pa'o/ /dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid shes pa'o/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid shes pa'o/ /chos thams cad stong pa nyid shes pa'o/ /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid shes pa'o/ /myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid shes pa'o//dngos po myed pa stong pa ②nyid shes pa'o/ /ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid shes pa'o/ /dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid shes pa'o/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi shes pa'o/ /yang dag par duspong ba bzhi shes pa'o/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi shes pa'o/ /dbang po lnga shes pa'o/ /stobs lnga shes pa'o/ /byang chub kyi yan lag bdun shes pa'o/ /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa shes pa'o//'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi shes pa'o/ /bsam gtan bzhi shes pa'o/ /tshad myed pa bzhi shes pa'o/ /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa bzhi shes pa'o//rnam par thar pa brgyad shes pa'o/ /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu shes pa'o/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa shes pa'o/ /mngon par shes pa rnams shes pa'o/ /ting nge 'dzin rnams shes pa'o/ /gzungs kyi sgo rnams shes pa'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu shes pa'o/ /myi 'jigs pa bzhi shes pa'o/ /so so 25—87

yang dag par rig pa bzhi shes pa'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa brtswa brgyad shes pa'o/ /byams pa chen po shes pa'o/ /snying rje chen po shes pa'o/ /dga' ba chen po shes pa'o①/ /btang snyoms chen po shes pa'o/ /gzhan yang 'jig rten pa dang / 'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos rnams dang / zag pa dang bcas pa dang / zag pa myed pa'i chos rnams dang / 'dus byas dang /'dus ma byas kyi chos rnams shes pa ste/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi ye shes ma gtogs ②par/ de dag byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i 'phags pa'i chos rnams 0so/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i 'phags pa'i chos rnams kyi 'bras bu gang zhe na/ bag chags kyi mtshams sbyor ba'i nyon mongs pa thams cad spong ba ste/ 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i 'phags pa'i chos rnams kyi 'bras bu'o/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor kyis rtsibacom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid 'thob ⑤par 'gyur ram/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de de bzhin no/ /de de bzhin te/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po duni rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob par 'gyur ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das gal te byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos ⑦rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob par 'gyur na / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dang / de bzhin gshegs pa la bye brag ci zhig mchis/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ bye brag yod do/ /gsol pa/ bye brag ji lta bu zhig mchis/ bcom ldan 'das kyis 25—88

bka' stsal pa/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ①ni rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob par 'gyur ba'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa ni ye shes brnyes pa zhes bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ gang la gnas shing / chos thams cad ② mun pa myed pa thob ④pa la/ byang chub sems dpa'i sems kyang gzhan la / de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi thugs kyang gzhan zhes bya ba myed do/ /rab 'byor de ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i 'jig rten pa'i chos kyi sbyin pa ste/ de la brten ④pas 'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos kyi sbyin pa 'byung ngo / /rab 'byor de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sems can rnams 'jig rten pa'i chos kyi sbyin pa la sbyor zhing thabs mkhas pas 'phags pa'i chos 'jig rten las 'das pa'i sbyin 3pa la bkod nas/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi bar la 'god pa yin no/ /rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i 'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos kyi sbyin pa byis 'upa so so'i skye bo thams cad dang thun mong ma yin pa gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi dang / yang dag par spong ba bzhi dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi dang /dbang po lnga dang / stobs lnga dang / byang chub kyi yan lag bdun dang /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa dang / tshad myed pa bzhi dang /⑦ rnam par thar pa'i sgo gsum dang / rnam par thar pa brgyad dang / mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu dang / zomatha' dag gi skye mched bcu dang / zil gyis gnon pa'i skye mched brgyad dang / nyon mongs pa myed pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang / smon nas khyamakhyen pa dang / mngon par shes pa drug 25—89

dang / rnam pa thams cad du yongs su dag pa bzhi dang / dbang bcu dang /malade bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu dang / myi 'jigs pa bzhi dang / so so ②yang dag par rig pa bzhi dang / bsrung du myed pa gsum dang / dran pa nye bar gzhag pa gsum dang / bsnyel ba myi mnga' ba'i chos nyid dang / bag chags yang dag par bcom pa dang / byams pa chen po dang / snying rje chen po dang /(ge sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa ba'o brgyad dang / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ④dang / myi chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis dang /dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu dang / gzungs kyi sgo lnga brgya dang / ting nge 'dzin kyi sgo rnams te/ 'di ni 'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos kyi sbyin pa zhes bya'o / /rab 'byor de la dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/nang gi lus dang / phyi'i lus dang / phyi nang gi lus la lus kyi rjes su lta zhing /brtson 'grus can shes bzhin dang ldan pa/ dran pa dang ldan pas/ 'jig rten gyi chags sems dang / yid myi bde ba rnam par bstsal ⑤cing rnam par spyod do/ / lus la kun 'byung ba'i rjes su lta zhing rnam par spyod do/ /yilus la zad pa'i rjes su lta zhing rnam par spyod do/ /lus la kun 'byung ba dang /zad pa'i rjes su lta zhing rnam par spyod do/ /lus la myi gnas par rnam par spyod cing / 'jig rten du gang yang nye bar len pa myed do/ /nang gi tshor ba dang / phyi'i tshor ba dang / phyi nang gi tshor ba la tshor ba'i rjes su lta zhing /brtson 'grus can shes bzhin dang ldan pa/ dran pa dang ldan pas/ 'jig rtene gyi chags sems dang / yid myi bde ba rnam par bstsal ⑦cing rnam par spyod do/ /tshor ba la kun du (she'abyung ba'i rjes su lta zhing rnam par spyod do/ /25wa 90

tshor ba la zad pa'i rjes su lta zhing rnam par spyod do/ /tshor ba la kun 'byung ba dang / zad pa'i rjes su lta zhing rnam par spyod do/ /tshor ba la myi gnas par rnam par ①spyod cing / 'jig rten du gang yang nye bar len pa skyed do/ /nang gi sems dang / phyi'i sems dang / phyi ②nang gi sems la ①sems kyi rjes su lta zhing / brtson 'grus can shes bzhin dang ldan pa/ dran pa dang ldan pas 'jig rten gyi chags sems dang / yid myi bde ba rnam par bstsal rjocing rnam par spyod do/ /sems la kun 'byung ba'i rjes su lta zhing rnam par spyod do / /sems la zad pa'i rjes su lta zhing rnam par spyod do/ /sems la kun 'byung ba dang / zad pa'i rjes su lta zhing rnam par spyod do/ /sems la myi gnas par rnam par spyod cing / 'jig rten tu gang yang nye bar len pa myed do//nang gi chos dang / phyi'i chos dang / phyi nang gi chos la ⑤chos kyi rjes su lta zhing brtson 'grus can shes bzhin dang ldan pa/ dran pa dang ldan pas 'jig rten gyi chags sems dang / yid myi bde ba rnam par bstsal 0cing rnam par spyod do/ / chos la kun 'byung ba'i rjes su lta zhing rnam par spyod do/ /chos la zad pa'i rjes su lta zhing rnam par spyod do/ /④chos la kun 'byung ba dang /zad pa'i rjes su lta zhing rnam par spyod do/ /chos la myi gnas par rnam par spyod cing / 'jig rten du gang yang nye bar len pa myed do/ /rab 'byor yang dag par spong ba bzhi gang zhe na/ sdig to myi dge ba'i chos ma skyes pa rnams myi skyed pa'i phyir mos pa skyed pa dang / skyes pa rnams spong ⑧ba'i phyir rtsol ba dang / dge ba'i chos ma skyes pa rnams bskyed pa'i phyir mos pa skyed cing brtson 'grus rtsom pa dang / skyes pa rnams 'phel zhing / shin tu rgyas par bya 25—91

ba dang / bsgom 17pa yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir mos pa skyed pa'o/ /rab 'byor rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi gang zhe na/ mos pa'i ting nge 'dzin spong ba'i 'du byed dang ldan pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa dang / sems kyi ting nge 'dzin spong ba'i 'du byed dang ldan pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa dang / brtson 'grus kyi ting nge 'dzin spong ba'i 'du byed dang ldan pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa deng /dpyod pa'i ting nge 'dzin spong ba'i 'du byed dang ldan pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa'o//dbang po lnga gang zhe na/ dad pa'i dbang po dang / brtson 'grus kyi dbang po dang / dran pa'i dbang po dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang po dang / shes rab kyi dbang po ste/ de dag ni dbang po lnga zhes bya'o/ /stobs lnga gang zhe na/dad pa'i stobs dang / brtson 'grus kyi stobs dang / dran pa'i stobs dang /ting nge 'dzin gyi stobs dang / shes rab kyi stobs tezhu/ de dag ni stobs lnga zhes bya'o/ /rab 'byor byang chub kyi yan lag bdun gang zhe na/ dran pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag dang / chos rnam par 'byed pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag dang / brtson 'grus yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag dang / dga' ba 5yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag dang / shin tu byang ba thuyang dag byang chub kyi yan lag dang / ting nge 'dzin yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag dang /btang snyoms yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag ste de dag ni byang chub kyi yan lag bdun zhes bya'o/ /rab 'byor 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa gang zhe na/'di lta ste/ yang dag pa'i lta ba dang / yang dag pa'i ⑤rtog pa dang / yang dag pa'i ngag dang / yang dag pa'i las kyi mtha' dang / yang dag pa'i 'tsho ba dang / yang dag pa'i rtsol ba dang / yang dag pa'i dran pa dang / yang 25—92

dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin te/ de dag ni 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa zhes bya'o/ /de la ting nge 'dzin gsum gang zhe na/ stong pa nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin dang / mtshan ma skyed pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang / smon pa myed pa'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /stong pa nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ stong pa'i rnam pa dang / dben pa'i rnam par sems rtse gcig pa ste/ de ni stong pa nyid kyi ①ting nge 'dzin ces bya'o/ /mtshan ma myed pa'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ zhi ba'i rnam pa dang / mtshan ma myed pa'i rnam par sems rtse gcig pa ste/ de ni mtshan ma myed pa'i ting nge 'dzin ces bya'o/ /smon pa myed pa'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ myi rtag pa'i rnam pa dang / sdug bsngal gyi rnam par sems rtse gcig pa ste/ de ni smon pa myed pa'i ting nge 'dzin ces bya'o/ /rnam par thar pa brgyad gang zhe na/ gzugs can gyis gzugs rnams mthong ba 'di ni rnam par thar pa dang po'o/ /nang gzugs myed pa'i 'du shes dang ldan pas/phyi rol gyi gzugs rnams mthong ba 'di ni rnam par thar pa gnyis pa'o/ /bzang bar mos pa 'di ni rnam par thar pa gsum pa'o/ /nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas pa 'di ni rnam par thar pa bzhi pa'o/ /rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas pa 'di ni rnam par thar pa lnga pa'o/ /chung zad myed pa'i skye mched la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas pa 'di ni rnam par thar pa drug pa'o/ /'du shes skyed 'du shes myed myin skye mched la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas pa 'di ni rnam par thar pa bdun pa'o/ 'du shes dang / tshor ba 'gog pa la ②nye bar bsgrubs te gnas pa 'di ni rnam par thar pa brgyad pa ste/ de dag ni rnam par thar pa brgyad ces bya'o/ /mthar kyis 25—93

gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu gang zhe na/ 'di la la la 'dod pas dben sdig to hu)myi dge ba'i chos kyis (gyidaben pa/ rtog pa dang bcas pal/dpyod pa dang bcas pa dben pa las skyes pa'i dga' ba dang / bde ba ducan bsam gtan dang po la (nyenye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /de ⑨rnam par rtog pa dang / rnam (bepar dpyod pa nye bar zhi nas/ nang niyongs su dang ste/sems kyi rgyud gcig 1)tu gyur pas/ rtog pa myed pa tu )dpyod pa myed btsunye/ting nge 'dzin las skyes pa'i dga' ba dang bde ba 8can bsam gtan gnyis pa la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /de dga' ba las 'dod chags dang bral bas dran pa dang ldan zhing / shes bzhin du btang snyoms su gnas te/ bde ba lus kyis myong la nyuge'aphags pa rnams kyis de la dran pa dang ldan pa/ bde ba la rnam par spyod pa/ btang snyoms pa'o zhes brjod pa ste/ dga' ba myed pa'i bsam gtan gsum pa la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /de bde ba yang spangs sdug bsngal yang spangs shing / yid bde ba dang yid myi bde ba snga nas kyang nub pas bde ba yang myed sdug bsngal ba 8yang myed pa/ btang 0snyoms dang dran pas 9yongs su dag pa/ bsam gtan bzhi pa la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /de rnam pa thams cad du gzugs kyi 'du shes las yang dag par 'das te/thogs pa'i 'du shes rnams nub par gyur cing / sna tshogs kyi 'du shes yid la myi byed pas nam mkha' mtha' yas so zhes te/ nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /de rnam pa thams cad du nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched las tsoyang dag par 'das te/ rnam par shes pa mtha' yas so zhes tenyushe/ rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas 25—94

sol/ /de rnam pa thams cad du rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched las yang dag par 'das te/ chung zad ma yod do zhes chung zad myed pa'i skye mched la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /de rnam pa thams cad du chung zad myed pa'i skye mched las yang dag par 'das te/ 'du shes myed 'du shes myed myin skye mched la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /de rnam pa thams cad du 'du shes myed 'du shes myed myin skye mched las yang dag par 'das te/ 'du shes dang tshor ba 'gog pa la nye bar bsgrubs shing tshiganas te/ 'di ni mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu zhes bya'o/ /de la mtha' dag gi skye mched bcu gang zhe na/mtha' dag sa dang / mtha' dag chu dang / mtha' dag mye dang / mtha' dag rlung dang / mtha' dag sngon po dang / mtha' dag ser po dang /mtha' dag dmar po dang / mtha' dag dkar po dang / mtha' dag rnam par shes pa dang / mtha' dag nam mkha' ste/ de dag ni mtha' dag gi skye mched bcu zhes bya'o/ /de la zil gyis gnon ②pa'i skye mched brgyad gang zhe na/nang gzugs su 'du shes shing / phyi rol gyi gzugs phra mo dang / kha dog sdug gu chadang / kha dog myi sdug pa mthong yang gzugs de dag zil kyis mnan te shes/ zil kyis mnan te mthong zhing / de ltar 'du shes pa de ni zil kyis gnon pa'i skye mched dang po'o/ /nang gzugs su 'du shes shing phyi rol gyi gzugs rags pa dang / kha dog sdug pa dang / kha dog myi sdug pa mthong yang gzugs de dag zil kyis mnan te shes/ zil kyis mnan te mthong zhing de ltar 'du shes pa de ni zil gyis gnon pa'i skye mched gnyis pa'o/ /nang gzugs myed par 'du shes shing / phyi rol gyi gzugs phra ba ④dang / kha dog 25—95

sdug gu ①dang / kha dog myi sdug pa mthong yang gzugs de dag zil kyis mnan te shes/ zil kyis mnan te mthong zhing de ltar 'du shes pa de ni zil kyis gnon ②pa'i skye mched gsum pa'o/ /nang gzugs myed par 'du shes shing /phyi rol gyi gzugs rags pa dang / kha dog sdug pa ②dang / kha dog myi sdug pa mthong yang gzugs de dag zil kyis mnan te shes/ zil kyis mnan te mthong zhing de ltar 'du shes pa de 0ni zil kyis gnon pa'i skye mched bzhi pa'o/ /nang gzugs myed par 'du shes shing phyi rol gyi gzugs sngon po/ kha dog sngon po/ sngon por dusnang ba/ mdog 0sngon po 'di lta ste/ dper na me tog o ma ka lta bu'am/ yul ba ra na ser ④byas pa'i gos ltar sngo bani/ kha dog sngo ba / sngo bar snang ba/ mdog khyasngo bar mthong yang gzugs de dag zil kyis mnan te shes/ zil kyis mnan te mthong zhing / de ltar 'du shes pa 'di ni zil kyis gnon pa'i skye mched lnga pa'o/ /nang gzugs myed par 'du shes shing /phyi rol gyi gzugs ser po/ kha dog ser po/ ser por snang ba/ mdog ser po 'di lta ste/ dper na shing kur shi ka ri'i ()me tog lta bu'am/yul ba ra na ser yibyas pa'i gos ltar ser ba kha dog ser ba/ ser bar 8snang ba/ mdog ser bar mthong yang gzugs tu)de dag zil kyis mnan te shes/zil kyis mnan te mthong zhing / de ltar 'du shes pa 'di ni zil kyis gnon pa'i skye mched drug pa'o/ /nang gzugs myed par 'du shes shing / phyi rol gyi gzugs dmar po/ kha dog dmar po/ dmar por tsosnang ba/ mdog dmar po 'di lta ste/ dper na ban du dzī (nyeb ku'i me tog lta bu'am/yul ba ra na ser tsobyas pa'i gos ltar dmar ba/ kha dog dmar ba dmar bar 25—96

snang ba mdog dmar bar mthong yang gzugs de dag zil kyis mnan te shes/zil kyis mnan te mthong zhing de ltar 'du shes pa 'di ni zil kyis gnon pa'i skye mched bdun pa'o/ /nang gzugs med par 'du shes shing / phyi rol gyi gzugs dkar po/ kha dog dkar po dkar por ①snang ba/ mdog dkar po 'di lta ste/ dper na skar ma pa ba sangs kyi 'od lta bu'am/ yul ba ra na ser ②byas pa'i gos ltar dkar ba/ kha dog dkar ba dkar bar snang ba/mdog dkar bar mthong yang gzugs de dag zil gyis ⑤mnan te shes/ zil kyis mnan te bumathong zhing / de ltar 'du shes pa 'di ni zil kyis gnon pa'i skye mched brgyad pa'o/ /de la nyon mongs pa myed pa gang zhe na/ bsam gtan la gnas nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i rnam par spyod pa/sems can pha rol dang / gang zag pha rol gyi nyon mongs pa myi skye ba'i mthu yod pa ⑤ting nge 'dzin gang gis 'grub 0pa de ni nyon mongs pa myed pa zhes bya'o// de la ⑤smon lam gyi shes pa gang zhe na/ bsam gtan la gnas te/ 'di shes par bya'o zhes byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dus gsum gyi shes pa'am/ shes pa gang dang gang 'dod par gyur pa de la yid kyis nismon pa byed de/ de ting nge 'dzin de las langs nas de'i smon lam de yongs su grub par gyur cig⑨ /shes bya de yang shes pa de ni smon lam gyi shes pa zhes bya'o/ /de la mngon par shes pa drug gang zhe na/ rdzu 'phrul gyi mngon par shes pa dang /lha'i myig gi mngon par shes pa dang / lha'i rna ba'i mngon par shes pa dang /pha rol gyi sems shes pa'i mngon par shes pa dang / sngon gyi ciganas rjes su dran pa'i mngon par shes pa dang / zag pa zad pa shes pa'i mngon par shes pa ste/25—97

drug po de dag go/ /de la yongs su dag pa bzhi gang zhe na/ lus yongs su dag pa dang / dmyigs pa yongs su dag pa dang / sems yongs su dag pa dang / ye shes yongs su dag pa ste/ bzhi po de dag go/ /de la dbang bcu gang zhe na/ tshe la dbang ba dang / sems la dbang ba dang / yo byad la dbang ba dang / las la dbang ba ①dang / skye ba la dbang ba dang / mos pa la dbang ba dang / smon lam la dbang ba dang / rdzu 'phrul la dbang ba dang / ye shes la dbang ba dang / chos la dbang ba ste/ bcu po de dag go//rab 'byor de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu gang zhe na/ rab 'byor 'di la de bzhin gshegs pa ni (geganas la yang gnas su yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu mkhyen to/ /gnas ma yin pa la yang gnas ma yin par yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu mkhyen to/ /'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i las dang / las yongs su blangs pa'i rnam par smin pa gnas kyi rnam pa dang / rgyu'i rnam par yang dag pa (0ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu mkhyen to/ /khams sna tshogs can dang / khams du ma can gyi 'jig rten yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu gamakhyen to/ /sems can gzhan dang gang zag gzhan gyis ⑤mos pa sna tshogs dang / mos pa du ma yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu mkhyen to/ /sems can gzhan dang gang zag gzhan gyi dbang po rab dang /tha ma shes par bya ba yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu mkhyen to/ /kun tu 'gro ba'i lam yang dag pa yiji lta ba bzhin du rab tu mkhyen to/ /dbang po dang / stobs dang / byang chub kyi yan lag dang / bsam gtan dang /rnam par thar pa dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / snyoms par 'jug pa dang /25—98

kun nas nyon mongs pa dang / rnam par byang ba rnam par dgod ①pa yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu mkhyen to/ /rnam pa du mar sngon gyi gnas rjes su dgongs te/ tshe rabs gcig kyang rjes su dgongs pa nas/ tshe rabs brgya dang / tshe rabs stong dang / tshe rabs brgya stong dang /① tshe rabs (7bye ba khrag khrig brgya phrag stong gi bar du yang rjes su dgongs so/ /bskal pa gcig kyang rjes su dgongs pa nas/ bskal pa brgya'i bar dang / bskal pa brgya phrag du ma dang / bskal pa stong phyag du ma dang / bskal pa brgya stong phrag ④du ma dang / bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag ⑤du ma'i bar dag kyang rjes su dgongs te/ bdag ni 'di lta bu zhig na 'dug 'dug go/ /mying ni 'di zhes bya bar gyur to/ /rigs ni ⑥'di zhes bya bar gyur to/ /rus ni 'di zhes bya bar gyur to/ /zas ni 'di za za'o/ /yun ni 'di srid cig tu gnas gnas so/ /che'i mtha' ⑦ni 'di tsam zhig tu gyur te/ bdag de nas shi 'phos nas che ge mo zhig tu skyes so zhes bya ba nas/ de nas shi 'phos nas kyang 'dir skyes so zhes bya ba'i bar du rnam pa dang bcas/ sa mal dang bcas/gtan tshigs dang bcas par rnam pa du mar sngon gyi gnas rjes su dgongs so/ /lha'i myig rnam par dag pa myi las 'das pas sems can 'chi 'pho ba dang / skye ba dag kyang gzigs so/ /kha dog sdug pa dang / myi sdug pa dang / bzang ba dang ngan pa dang / bde 'gro na 'khod pa dang / ngan song na 'khod pa dang / las ji lta ba bzhin du nye bar 'dong ba'i 9)sems can rnams rab tu mkhyen te⑨/ sems can 'di dag ni lus kyis ngan du spyod pa dang ldan pa/ )/ngag gis ngan du spyod pa dang ldan pa/ yid kyis ngan du spyod pa dang ldan pa7/25—99

'phags pa la skur pa 'debs pa/ log par lta ba dag ste/ de'i rgyu de'i rkyen kyis lus zhig nas ngan song log par lhung ba sems can dmyal bar skye'o/ /sems can 'di dag ni lus kyis ①legs par spyod pa dang ldan pa/ ngag gis legs par spyod pa dang ldan pa/ yid kyis legs par spyod pa dang ldan pa/'phags pa la ②skur pa nimyi 'debs pa yang dag par lta ba dag ste/ de'i rgyu de'i rkyen kyis lus zhig nas bde 'gro mtho ris kyi 'jig rten lha'i nang du skye'o zhes bya bar rab tu mkhyen to/ /zag pa rnams zad pa'i phyir sems rnam par grol ba dang / shes rab rnam par grol ba dang du/ zag pa myed pa yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu mkhyen te⑤/ bcu po de dag ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs so/ /rab 'byor de bzhin gshegs pa'i myi 'jigs pa bzhi gang zhe na / bdag gis yang dag par rdzogs pa'i yisangs rgyas so zhes dam bcas na⑦/de la chos 'di rnams mngon par sangs ma rgyas soni/ /zhes bya bar ⑨bdag la dge sbyong ngam/ bram ze'am/ lha'am/ bdud dam/ tshangs pa'am/ skye dgu'i 0tshogs gzhan su yang rung ste/ 'jig rten na chos dang ldan par rgol bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes bya ba'i rgyu yang ⑩yang dag par rjes su myi mthong ste/ rgyu yang dag par rjes su ma mthong bas/ de la tunyebadag bde ba thob pa dang /bag tsha ba myed pa thob pa dang / myi 'jigs pa thob par rnam par spyod de/khyu mchog rlabs po che'i gnas su dam bca'o/ /'khor gyi nang du seng ge'i sgra bsgrag 8go/ /tshangs pa'i 'khor lo 'jig rten na dge sbyong ngam/ bram ze'am lha'am / bdud dam tshangs pa'am/ gzhan sus kyang rung ste/ chos dang ldan par bskor bar myi nus pa bdag gis ④rab tu bskor bar bya'o/ /bdag 25—100

zag pa zad do zhes dam bcas na/ de la zag pa 'di rnams yongs su zad par ma gyur to zhes bya bar bdag la dge sbyong ngam/ bram ze'am lha'am/ bdud dam/ tshangs pa'am/ skye dgu'i ①tshogs gzhan su'ang rgyarung ste/ 'jig rten na chos dang ldan par rgol bar 'gyur ro zhes bya ba'i rgyu yang yang dag par rjes su myi mthong ste/ rgyu yang dag par rjes su ma mthong bas/ de la bdag bde ba thob ③pa dang / bag tsha ba myed pa thob pa dang / myi 'jigs pa thob pa 0rnam par spyod de/ khyu mchog rlabs po che'i gnas su dam bca'o/ /'khor gyi nang du seng ge'i sgra bsgrag ②go/ /tshangs pa'i 'khor lo 'jig rten na dge sbyong ngam/ bram ze'am/ lha'am/ bdud dam/ tshangs pa'am/gzhan sus kyang rung ste/ chos dang ldan par bskor bar myi nus pa bdag gis rab tu bskor bar bya'o/ /gang yang bdag dugis bar chad kyi chos ⑦bu bsten ⑧pa de dag la bsten ⑨na/ bar chad kyi chos su myi 'gyur ro/ /zhes dge sbyong ngam / bram ze'am/ lha'am/ bdud dam/ tshangs pa'am/ skye dgu'i ⑫tshogs gzhan su'ang tsunyerung ste/ 'jig rten na chos dang ldan par rgol bar 'gyur ro zhes bya ba'i rgyu yang yang dag par rjes su myi mthong ste/ rgyu yang dag par rjes su ma ⑩mthong bas/ de la bdag bde ba thob pa dang / bag tsha ba myed pa thob pa dang / myi 'jigs pa thob pa 8rnam par spyod de/ khyu mchog rlabs ④po che'i gnas su dam bca'o/ /'khor gyi nang du seng ge'i sgra bsgrag 'go//tshangs pa'i 'khor lo 'jig rten na dge sbyong ngam/ bram ze'am/ lha'am/bdud dam/ tshangs pa'am/ gzhan sus kyang rung ste/ chos dang ldan par bskor bar myi nus pa bdag gis rab tu bskor bar bya'o/ /gang yang bdag 25—101

gis lam 'phags pa'i 'byung ba rtogs par 'gyur ba de byed pa'i sdug bsngal yang dag par zad par 'gyur bar bstan pa de dag la nan tan byas na/ sdug bsngal yang dag par zad par 'gyur ba (1)myi 'byung ngo zhes/ dge sbyong ngam/bram ze'am/ lha'am/ bdud dam/ tshangs pa'am/ skye dgu'i zhutshogs gzhan su'ang sa rung ste/ 'jig rten na ④chos dang ldan par rgol bar 'gyur ro//zhes bya ba'i rgyu yang yang dag par rjes su myi mthong ste/ rgyu yang dag par rjes su ma mthong bas/ de la bdag ⑤bde ba thob pa (pedang / bag tsha ba myed pa thob pa dang / myi 'jigs par thob par (7)rnam par spyod de/ khyu mchog rlabs rinadapo che'i gnas su dam bca'o/ /'khor gyi nang du seng ge'i sgra bsgrag khyago//tshangs pa'i 'khor lo 'jig rten na dge sbyong ngam/ bram ze'am/ lha'am/bdud dam/ tshangs pa'am/ gzhan sus kyang tsorung ste/ chos dang ldan par bskor bar myi nus pa bdag gis nyunyerab tu bskor bar bya'o zhes bya ba ste/bzhi po de dag ni myi 'jigs pa'o/ /8de bzhin gshegs pa'i so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ don so so tsoyang dag par rig pa dang / chos so so yang dag par rig pa dang / nges pa'i tshig so so yang dag par rig pa dang / spobs pa so so yang dag par rig pa ste/ de dag kyang gang zhe na/ don la dmyigs pa dang / chos la dmyigs pa dang / nges pa'i tshig la dmyigs pa dang / spobs pa la dmyigs pa'o/ /rab 'byor de bzhin gshegs pa'i bsrung ba myed pa gsum gang zhe na/ de bzhin gshegs pa ni sku'i spyod pa yongs su dag pa dang ldan pa ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa la sku'i spyod pa yongs su ma dag pa myi mnga' bas/ la las shes su 'ong ④zhes gang yang bcab bla25—102

par dgongs pa de bzhin gshegs pa la myi mnga' ste/ 'di ni bsrung ba myed pa dang po'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa ni gsung gi spyod pa yongs su dag pa dang ldan pa ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa la gsung gi spyod pa yongs su ma dag pa myi mnga' bas / la las shes su 'ong zhes gang yang bcab 1)par dgongs pa de bzhin gshegs pa la myi mnga' ste/ 'di ni bsrung ba myed pa gnyis pa'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa ni thugs kyi spyod pa yongs su dag pa dang ldan pa ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa la thugs kyi spyod pa yongs su ma dag pa (gyisri mnga' bas/ la las shes su 'ong zhes gang yang bcab ②par dgongs pa de bzhin gshegs pa la myi mnga' ste/ 'di ni bsrung ba myed pa gsum pa'o/ /de la de bzhin gshegs pa'i dgongs pa nye bar gzhag pa gsum gang zhe na/ de bzhin gshegs pa chos ston pa'i tsheX/ la la ⑤rna ⑥btud de rim gror nyan cing bka' nyan (7pa'i sems nye bar gzhog ⑧pa dang / chos dang gnyer ba'i chos la nan tan du byed na/yang des de bzhin gshegs pa dgyes par myi 'gyur/ yid bde bar myi 'gyur/thugs yeng yeng por myi 'gyur te/ 'di ni dgongs pa nye bar gzhag pa dang po'ol/ /la la rna yidabatud de/ rim gror nyan cing / bka' nyan 91 )pa'i sems nye bar gzhog pa myed pa dang / chos dang gnyer ba'i chos la nan tan du myi byed na hunyeyang des de bzhin gshegs pa'i thugs khro bar myi 'gyur/ myi bzod par myi 'gyur/ thugs myi ches 8par myi 'gyur te/ 'di ni dgongs pa nye bar gzhag pa gnyes pa'o/ /la la rna (/—nyebatud de rim gror bonyan cing bka' nyan 8pa'i sems nye bar gzhog la/ chos dang gnyer ba'i chos la nan tan du byed/la la rna hu)btud de rim gror myi nyan cing / bka' nyan 4)pa'i sems nye bar 25—103

gzhog pa myed de/ chos dang gnyer ba'i chos la nan tan du myi byed kyang /des de bzhin gshegs pa dgyes pa'am/ thugs khro ba gnyis su myi 'gyur te/thams cad du dgongs pa dang ldan zhing mkhyen par ①btang snyoms su rnam par spyod pa 'di ni dgongs pa nye bar gzhag pa gsum pa'o/ /de la de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigenyams pa myed pa'i chos nyid gang zhe na/ gang gis sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams don yod pa'i chos ston pa'i phyir sems can thams cad kyi don mdzad pa la dus las myi 'da' ba ste/ de ni nyams pa myed pa'i chos nyid ces bya'o/ /de la de bzhin gshegs pa'i bag chags kyi sgrib pa rab tu spangs pa gang zhe na/ nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad ni nyon mongs pa spangs kyang de dag la lus kyi 'gyur ①ba yod kyi/ de bzhin gshegs pa la ni de lta bu yang myi mnga' ④ste/ de ni bag chags kyi sgrib pa rab tu spangs pa zhes bya'o/ /de la de bzhin gshegs pa'i thugs rje chen po gang zhe na/ de bzhin gshegs pa ⑤thugs rje chen po gang dang ldan pas/ 'jig rten gyi brda dunye bar bzung ste/ dge ba'i rtsa ba gzigs ⑦pa'i phyir dus thams cad du 'jig rten la nyin lan gsum mtshan lan gsum du rtog pa mdzad ces bya ste/dngos su na sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi thugs rje chen po/ /sems can mtha' yas pa yongs su min par bya ba la ⑧gzigs pa rtag ⑨par 'byung ste/de ni thugs rje chen po zhes bya'o/ /rab 'byor de bzhin gshegs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa brtswa brgyad gang zhe na/ de bzhin gshegs pa la 'khrul pa myi mnga'o⑩/ /ca co myi mnga'o/ /dgongs pa nyams pa myi mnga'o/ /'du shes sna tshogs yimyi mnga'o/ /thugs mnyam par ma bzhag ⑩pa myi mnga'o/ /ma 25—104

brtags pa'i btang snyoms myi mnga'o/ /mos pa yongs su nyams pa myi mnga'o/ /brtson 'grus yongs su nyams pa myi mnga'o/ /dgongs pa yongs su nyams pa myi mnga'o / /ting nge 'dzin yongs su nyams pa myi mnga'o/ /shes rab yongs su nyams pa myi mnga'o/ /rnam par grol ba yongs su nyams pa myi mnga'o/ /rnam par grol ba'i ye shes gzigs pa yongs su nyams pa myi mnga'o/ /sku'i 'phrin ①las thams cad ye shes sngon du 'gro ba ②ste/ ye shes kyi rjes su 'brang ngo / /gsung gi phrin ③las thams cad ye shes dusngon du 'gro ba ste/ ye shes kyi rjes su 'brang ngo / /thugs kyi phrin dulas thams cad ye shes sngon du 'gro ba ①ste/ ye shes kyi rjes su 'brang ngo / /'das pa'i dus la ma chags ma thogs pa'i ye shes gzigs pa 'jug go/ /ma 'ongs pa'i dus la ma chags ma thogs pa'i ye shes gzigs pa 'jug go⑦/ /da ltar byung ba'i dus la ma chags ma thogs pa'i ye shes gzigs pa 'jug pa ⑧ste/ de dag ni sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams so/ /rab 'byor de bzhin gshegs pa'i rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid gang zhe na/ gang la dmyigs pa myed pa dang ⑨/ dran pas dbang sgyur ⑩ba/zhi ba'i rnam pa dang ldan pa(spre/ mtshan nyid myed pa'i mtshan nyid ni ⑩rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ces bya'o/ /de la de bzhin gshegs pa'i myi chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis gang zhe na/ phyag dang zhabs 'khor lo'i mtshan dang ldan pa dang / zhabs shin tu gnas pa dang / phyag dang zhabs dra bar tunye'abrel pa dang / phyag dang zhabs gzhon zhing 'jam pa dang / bdun shin tu mtho ba dang sor mo ring ba dang / rting pa yangs pa dang / sku che zhing drang ba dang / zhabs legs par mtho ba dang / yan lag gi spu gyen du 'khyil pa 25—105

dang / ri dgas e na nyu7ya'i byin pa lta bu dang / phyag brla drang por slebs ②pa dang / gsang ba'i gnas spubs su nub pa dang / gser gyi kha dog dang /mdog shin tu 'jam pa dang / spu re re nas g.yas phyogs su 'khyil pa dang /zhal mdzod spus brgyan pa dang / seng ge'i ro stod lta bu dang / phrag pa'i lhun mdzes par grub pa dang / phrag so shin tu rgyas pa dang / ro bro ba'i mchog dang ldan pa dang dugyi/ shing n+ya gro da ④ltar chu zheng gab pa dang / dbu spyi gtsug dang ldan pa dang / ljags shin tu yangs pa dang / tshangs pa'i dbyangs dang / seng ge'i 'gram pa lta bu rgyadang / tshems shin tu dkar ba dang / tshems (yemanyam pa dang / tshems thags bzang ba dang / tshems mnyam zhing bzhi bcu tshang ba dang / spyan dkar nag me'abyes pa dang / ba'i rdzi ma lta bu ste/ de la de bzhin gshegs pa'i phyag dang zhabs kyi mthil la 'khor lo'i (8)ribs stong dang ldan pa/ mu khyud can lte ba dang bcas pa rnam pa thams cad du nyu༄yongs su rdzogs pa 'di lta ste/ rus pa'am ba so la gzugs brkos ⑨ pa dang 'dra ba mnga' bas phyag dang zhabs 'khor lo'i mtshan dang ldan pa'o/ /zhabs kyi 17mthil gnyis mnyam par sa la 'jog cing / zhabs zhum pa myed pas/zhabs shin tu gnas pa'o/ /ngang pa'i rgyal po ltar phyag dang zhabs kyi sor mo dra bar 'brel pas nyugephyag dang zhabs dra bar nyunye'abrel pa'o/ /shing bal gyi le'u hunyeltar shin tu 'jam zhing gzhon pas phyag dang zhabs gzhon zhing 'jam pa'o /phyag dang zhabs dang mgur gyi phogelhun dang ltag pa'i phyogs na hunyeshin tu mtho bas bdun shin tu mtho ba'o/ /phyag dang zhabs kyi sor mo ring bas 0sor mo ring ba'o / /rting pa ring bas rting pa yangs pa'o/ /sku lag pa mdun (nyedu 25wa 106

'phags la drang bas sku che zhing drang ba'o①/ /pus mo'i ②lha nga dang / long bu mdzes par nub pas zhabs legs par mtho ba'o/ /spu gyen du g.yas phyogs su 'khyil pas/ yan lag gi spu gyen du 'khyil pa'o/ /ri dgas e na ②ya'i byin pa dang / rtsig ma dang ldum ④bu dar ba ⑤ltar drang zhing ma nyams stil rim gyis ⑦gzhol bar grub cing / byin pa zlum pas ri dgas e na (sheya'i byin pa lta bu'o/ /brla drang por bzhag ste ma btud 0kyang / phyag gi mthil gnyis kyis 0pus mo'i lha nga la reg pas/ phyag brla drang por slebs hu)pa'o/ /glang po dang rta cang shes ltar gsang ba'i gnas shin tu mdzes par sbubs su nub pas/ gsang ba'i gnas sbubs su nub pa'o/ /shin tu sbyangs pa'i gser gyi kha dog lta bu dang ldan pas gser gyi kha dog go/ /gser dang dngul shin tu sbyangs pa ltar 'jam zhing snyoms pa'i mdog tu 'dug tshil sku la rdul myi 'go bas mdog shin tu 'jam pa'o//shin tu rnam par phye ba'i spu re rer skyes shing gnyis su myed pasaphonye/ spu re re nas g.yas phyogs su 'khyil ba'o/ /me tog kun da dang zla ba dang / 'o ma dang / ba mo'i mdog ltar 'dug la/ nyi ma dang zla ba brgya rshastelas kyang 'phags par 'od gsal ba'i mdzod spus smin mtshams shin tu brgyan pas/ zhal mdzod spus brgyan pa'o/ /ro stod che bas seng ge'i ro stod do/ /mgur dang rgyud legs par 'brel cing lhun zlum pas/ phrag pa'i lhun mdzes par tunyegrub pa'o/ /gser gyi gtan pa shin tu phyis ⑩pa ltar phrag so legs par grub pas phrag so shin tu rgyas pa'o/ /rlung dang / mkhris 8pa dang / bad kun gyis ma nyams shing rnam par shes pa 'dra ba myed pas/ ro bro ba'i mchog go/ /sku chu zheng phri/'dom 7du mnyam pas shing n+ya gro da zhu ltar chu zheng gab pa'o/ /spyi 25—107

gtsug skum zhing legs la g.yas phyogs su 'khyil pa dang ldan pa'i dbu mnyam zhing ①legs par grub la mdzes pa mnga' bas dbu spyi gtsug dang ldan pa'o/ /mye tog ud pa la dmar po'i 'dab ②ma'i kha dog lta bur ②'dug cing shin tu yangs pas ljags shin tu yangs shing srab pa'o/ /tshangs pa dang bya ka la ping ka lta bu'i gsung mnga' bas/ tshangs pa'i dbyangs so/ /'gram pa mye long gi dkyil 'khor ltar legs par grub cing mdzes par skyes te/ yid du 'ong bas seng ge'i 'gram pa lta bu'o/ /mye tog kun da dang dung gi bcag 'phro ltar shin tu dkar ba'i tshems mnga' bas tshems shin du dkar ba'o/ /tshems la mtho dudaman myed pas 8tshems mnyam pa'o/ /tshems la dumatshams ma dod ⑦pas tshems thags bzang ba'o/ /bla 'og tu gye gu ⑤skyed pas tshems mnyam zhing bzhi bcu tshang ba'o/ /dkar dag gi cha ma 'dres la shin 0tu rnam par dag cing mdog dmar pos ma yogs ⑩pas spyan dkar nag ⑩'byes pa'o/ /rdzi ma bla 'og shin tu legs par gnas la ma 'dzings pas ba'i rdzi ma lta bu'o/ /de la bla ma'i bsu bskyal 8dang / chos mnyan pa la sdod pa dang / gtsug lag khang dang mchod rten rjes su sgrub tsunyepa la stsogs pa la phu dud du tunyebyas pas phyag (snyedang zhabs 'khor lo'i mtshan dang ldan pa ste/ de ni 'khor shin tu mang ba'i snga ltas so/ /yi dam la brtan pas zhabs shin tu gnas pa ste/ de ni myi g.yo ⑩zhing shin tu brtan pa'i snga ltas so/ /sbyin pa dang / ngag snyan pa dang / don spyod ⑩pa dang / don mthun pa'i bsdu 8ba rnam bzhi goms par byas pas phyag dang zhabs dra bar tha'abrel pa ste/ de ni myur du 'du 0ba'i snga ltas so/ /bza' ba dang / bca' ba dang / btung ba zhim zhing nyams su bde ba byin pas phyag 25—108

dang zhabs gzhon zhing / 'jam pa dang / bdun shin tu mtho ba ste/ de gnyis ni bza' ba dang bca' ba dang btung ba shin tu ①zhim zhing nyams su bde ba thob ②pa'i snga ltas so/ /bcings pa bkrol ba dang / srog gi rim gro byas pa dang /ni srog gcod pa spangs pas sor mo ring ba dang / snying pa yangs pa dang / sku che zhing drang ba ste/ de ni sku tshe ring ba'i snga ltas so/ /dge ba'i chos yang dag par blangs pa dang / bzung ba mngon par spel zhing ༷'grib par ma byas pas zhabs kyi gong mtho ba dang / yan lag gi spu gyen du 'khyil pa ste/ de ni myi nyam ⑤pa'i chos dang ldan pa'i snga ltas so/ /rig pa dang bzo'i las rim gror byas shing gzhan 0byin pa dang / bdag gis blangs pas ri dgas e na ⑦pa'i byin pa lta bu ste/ de ni myur du 'dzin pa'i snga ltas so/ /bdog cing yod pa'i nor la bslangs dun myi 'gong bar gtong zhing myed ces ma byas pas phyag brla drang por slebs ⑨pa ste/ de ni yo byad la mnga' ba dang dul ba'i snga ltas so/ /grogs tunyepo dang mdza' bshes dang gnyen ma bye 4)ba dang /bye bar gyur pa'i sems can rnams bsdums pa dang /8 tshangs pa'i spyod pa la yang dag par bskul 6)ba dang / gsang ba'i tshig yongs su bsrungs pas8/gsang ba'i gnas sbubs su nub pa ste/ de ni bu mang ba'i 6)snga ltas so/ /stan dang / gos dang / khang pa dang / gzhal myed khang dang / gnas bzang po byin pas gser gyi kha dog dang mdog shin tu 'jam pa ste/ de gnyis ni gdan dang na bza' dang / khang pa dang / gzhal med khang dang /gnas bzang po thob ⑩pa'i snga ltas so/ /'du 'dzi spangs pa dang / mkhan po dang / slob dpon dang / pha ma dang phu nu la stsogs pa bla ma rnams la tshul 25—109

dang 'dra bar rim gror hu)byas pa dang / btsun par byas pa dang / bcol pa rna la ma gzan pas spu re re nas g.yas phyogs su ②'khyil pa dang / zhal mdzod spus brgyan pa ste/ de ni mnyam pa myed pa'i snga ltas so/ /myi snyan par myi zer zhing myi ri cismod la snyan par smra zhing / legs par bshad pa mthun par 'dzin pas seng ge'i ro stod lta bu dang / phrag pa'i lhun mdzes par grub pa ste/ de ni thub pa myed pa'i ( kyisnga ltas so/ /na nib rnams la rtsi dang / rim gro dang /sman cadang nyams su phan pa'i zas byin pa dang / rim gro (7)byas pas phrag so shin tu rgyas pa dang / ro bro ba'i mchog ste/ de ni nad nyung ba'i snga ltas so/ /skyed mos tshal ( nodang / 'khor dang / btung ba dang / rdzing bu dang /rgal dka' ba'i zam pa dang / kha zas dang / 'phreng ⑨ba'i gnas dang /stegs dang / gtsug lag khang bya ba la stsogs pa la gzhan mos par bya ba sngon du gtong zhing / bdag gis gzhan byin pas shing n+ya gro da ⑩ltar chu zheng gab pa dang / dbu spyi gtsug mdang ldan pa ste/ de ni mnga' tsochen po mnga' ba'i snga ltas so/ /yun ring por tshig snyan cing 'jam pa dang / nyams su bde bar smras pas ljags shin tu yangs shing srab pa dang / tshangs 4)pa'i dbyangs te(ste/de gnyis ni yan lag lnga dang ldan pa'i gsung mnga' 8ba'i snga ltas so/ /gsung yan lag lnga dang ldan pa zhes bya ba ni yongs su shes shing / rnam pa ra shes par 'gyur ba dang / mnyan na dga' zhing myi mthun pa myed pa dang / zab ⑩cing dbyangs rjes su 'byung ba dang / gtang tsophyi bra zhing rnar snyan pa dang / ma 'khrugs shing gsal ba'o/ /yun ring po nas tshig kyal tunyepa spangs shing /dus su smra smra bas seng ge'i 'gram pa lta bu ste/ de ni tshig kun gyis mnyan pa'i 25—110

snga ltas so/ /rim gror bya ba dang brnyas pa myed pa gnyis kyis ①'tsho ba yongs su dag pas/ tshems shin tu dkar ba dang mnyam pa ste/ de ni 'khor snga nas bstsags ②pa'i snga ltas so/ /yun ring po nas bden zhing phra ma myed pa'i tshig ①smra smra bas 0tshems thags ⑤bzang ba dang / tshems mnyam zhing bzhi bcu yitshang ba ste/ de ni 'khor dbyer myi phyed pa'i snga ltas so/ /pang gis mkhyud ⑦pa bzhin du nyes par bsam (nyepa myed la/ ma chags myi sngang ⑨ba dang / rmongs pa myed pa'i myig gis lta lta bas/ ⑩ spyan dkar nag lho)'byis pa dang / ba'i rdzi ma lta bu ste/ de ni kun nas mdzes pa'i snga ltas so/ /rab 'byor de dag ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i tsomatshan sum cu rtsa gnyis so/ /de la de bzhin gshegs pa'i dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni hu mngon par 'du bya ba thams cad las dben pa ste/sen mo zangs hustekyi mdog ltar 'dug pa yin/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni gnyen bshes byams pa dang 'dra bar sems can la phan pa dang bde ba'i thugs mnga' ba ste/ sen mo'i mdog snum pa yin/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni rigs nyusnyedang rgyud mthon por byung rka/stob ste/ sen mo mtho ba yin/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni tshul la 6)kha na ma tho ba myi mnga' ba 8ste/ sor mo zlum pa yin/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni dge ba'i rtsa ba shin tu tshogs pa ste/ sor mo rgyas pa yin/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das (7rnams ni dge ba'i rtsa ba rim gyis grub pa ste/ sor mo rim gyis gzhol du )ba yin/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das khunyernams ni thugs dang /gsung dang sku'i 'phrin sbyo rtelas dang 'tsho ba shin tu dben pa ste/ rtsa mi mngon pa 25—111

yin / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni nyon mongs pa'i mdud pa 'grel 〉pa ste/ rtsa la mdud pa myed pa yin/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni shin tu dben pa'i chos mnga' ba ste/ long bu mi mngon pa yin/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni myi mnyam pa thams cad las thusgrol ba ste zhabs myi mnyam pa myed pa yin/ sangs ⑧rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni pyi'i seng ge ste/ seng ge'i 'gros su bzhud pa yin/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni pyi'i glang po ste/ glang po'i 'gros su bzhud pa yin/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni ngang pa'i rgyal po ltar nam mkha' la ④bzhud pa ste/ngang pa'i stabs su bzhud pa yin/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni myi'i khyu mchog ste/ khyu mchog gi stabs su bzhud pa yin/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni mthun pa'i lam mnga' ba ste/ g.yas phyogs su bzhud pa yin/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni blta na mdzes pa ste/ mdzes par bzhud pa yin/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni rtag tu thugs yon po myi mnga' ba ste ma yo bar bzhud pa yin/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni tshul rnam par dag pa'i yon tan ston pa ste/ sku shin tu legs pa yin/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni sdig pa'i chos rnams shin tu sbyangs pa ste/sku shin tu sbyangs pa yin/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni/ chos rim gyis ston pa ste/ sku rim gyis gzhol ba yin/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni/ sku dang / gsung dang / thugs gtsang ma dang ldan pa ste/sku shin tu gtsang ba yin/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni rang bzhin gyis thugs 'jam pa dang ldan pa ste/ sku shin tu 'jam pa yin/ sangs rgyas 25—112

bcom ldan 'das rnams ni rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa'i thugs mnga' ba ste/sku shin tu rnam par dag pa yin/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni chos dang 'dul ba shin tu rdzogs pa ste/ dpe byad shin tu rdzogs pa yin/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni yon tan yangs shing bzang ba ston pa ste/ sku che zhing mdzes pa yin/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni sems can thams cad la mnyam pa'i thugs mnga' ba ste/ sku legs par mnyam pa yin/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni mchog tu 'jam pa'i chos ston pa ste/sku ①shin tu gzhon pa yin/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni rtag tu zhum pa skyed pa'i thugs mnga' ba ste/ sku zhum pa myed pa yin/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni myi dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad byang ba ste/ sku shin tu rgyas pa yin/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni yang 'byung ba shin tu bcom zhing zad pa ste/ sku shin tu mkhregs ②pa yin/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba'i yan lag dang / nying lag legs par ston pa ste/ yan lag dang nying lag spa bar mdzes pa yin/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni gzigs pa shin tu rnam par dag pa ste/snang ba rab rib myed cing rnam par dag pa yin/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni tshul dang ldan pa'i slob ma mnga' ba ste/ phyal skum pa yin/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni 'khor ba'i nyes pa thams cad shin tu sbyangs pa ste/ phyal shin tu byang ba dang ldan pa yin/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni nga rgyal gyi de'u bcom pa ste/ phyal ma zhom ③pa yin/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni chos zad ①pa rnam par zlog ⑤pa ste/ phyal phyam 25—113

mer 'dug pa yin/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni chos zab mo shin tu thugs su chud pa 11ste/ lte ba zab pa yin/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni mthun par 'dzin pa'i slob ma mnga' ba ste/ lte ba g.yas phyogs su 'khyil pa yin/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni slob ma kun nas mdzes pa'i dge 'dun mnga' ba ste/ kun nas mdzes pa yin/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni thugs shin tu gtsang ma ②dang ldan pa ste/ kun spyod pa shin tu gtsang ba yin/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni chos nag po bstan pa dang bral ba'i chos dang 'dul ba mnga' ba ②ste/ sku la sme ba dang gnag bag 0skyed pa yin/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni shing bal ltar yang ba rab tu thob (snyepa'i chos ston pa ste/ phyag shing bal ltar shin tu 'jam pa yin/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni rang gi skye bo dang /skye bo (bepal la byams pas dge sbyong tsochen po brnyes pa ste/ phyag gi ri mo snum pa yin / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni shin tu zab cing brtan par bzhugs pa ste/ phyag gi ri mo zab pa yin/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni (8༄bzod pa'i chos yangs pa ston pa ste/ phyag gi ri mo ring ba yin/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni bslab pa'i gnas ha cang yang myi ⑨ring bar 'cha' ba ste/ zhal ha cang yang hu )myi ring ba yin/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni gzugs brnyan 'jig rten thams cad du bkye tunyeb ste/zhal la nyugegazugs kyi gzugs brnyan snang ba yin/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni 'jam pa sngon du btang zhing 'dul ba ste/ ljags shin tu 'jam pa yin/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni yon tan phra ba'i tshogs 25—114

dang ldan pa ste/ ljags shin tu srab pa yin/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni byis pa'i stiskye bo 'dod chags pa (snyernams kyi ①chos dang 'dul ba gting dpag par rjodaka' ba ste/ ljags shin tu dmar ba yin/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni glang po'i ⑤sgra dang du'abrug gi sgra lta bus ⑦bsnyengs pa myi mnga' ba ste/ glang po'i nga ro dang 'brug gi dbyangs dang ldan pa yin/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni snyan cing 'jam pa dang / nyams su bde bar smra duba'i slob ma mnga' ba ste/ snyan cing 'jam pa dang / nyams su bde ba'i gsung dang ldan pa yin/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni srid pa kun tu sbyor ba las 'das pa ste/ tshems mche ba shin tu zlum pa yin/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni skye bo rno ba rnams 'dul ba ste/ tshems mche ba rno ba dang ldan pa yin/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni chos dang 'dul ba shin tu dkar ba ste/ tshems mche ba shin tu dkar ba yin/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni sa'i phyogs mnyam pa la bzhugs pa ste/⑨mche ba mnyam pa dang ldan pa yin/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni rim gyis mngon par rtogs pa'i chos ston pa ste/ tshems mche ba rim gyis gzhol ba yin/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ⑨ ni shes rab kyi ri bo hunyemathon po la bzhugs pa ste/ shangs legs par mtho ba dang ldan pa yin/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni 'dul ba'i skye bo gtsang ma mnga' ba ste/shangs shin tu gtsang ba yin/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni sangs rgyas kyi chos phul du yangs pa mnga' ba ste/ spyan ring hunyeb dang ldan pa yin/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni gzigs pa shin tu rnam par dag pa ste 25—115

spyan rnam par dag pa yin/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni sems can gyi tshogs shin tu bstsags ①pa ste/ rdzi ma stug pa yin/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni lha dang lha ma yin dang / skyes bu dang / na chung mchog ②myig dkar nag ①'byes shing pad mo'i 'dab dum ltar 'dug pa rnams kyis mngon par dga' bar byas pa ①ste/ spyan dkar nag du'abyes shing pad mo'i 'dab ⑦ma ltar 'dug pa yin/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni rtag tu yangs pa gzigs pa ste/ phyin ma ring ba dang ldan pa yin/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni 'jam par 'dul ba la mkhas pa ste/ sbyin ma 'jam pa dang ldan pa yin/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni skyon thams cad mkhyen pa ste/ spyin ma'i spu mnyam pa dang ldan pa yin/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni dge ba'i rtsa ba'i snum gyis sems snum par gyur pa'i skye bo 'dul ba ste/ sbyin ma snum pa dang ldan pa yin/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni chos mchog tu yangs shing don dang ldan pa mnga' ba ste/ snyan legs shing snyan shal ring ba yin/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni nyon mongs pa'i rgyud las rnam par rgyal ba ste/ snyan mnyam pa yin/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni sems can bsam pa ma nyams pa 'dul ba ste/snyan gyi dbang po ma nyams pa dang ldan pa yin/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni lta ba'i rnam pa thams cad yongs su byang ba ste/ zhal 'phral ba legs par grub pa dang ldan pa yin/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni phas kyi ⑤rgol ba shin tu 'dul ba ste/ zhal 'phral ba yangs pa ⑨dang ldan pa yin/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni smon (sprelam dam pa shin tu rdzogs pa ste/25—116

dbu shin tu rgyas pa yin/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni yul gyi bung ba ①rnam par zlog ②pa ste/ dbu bung ba ltar gnag pa dang ldan pa yin/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni mthong ba dang bsgom pas spang snoba'i bag la nyal ba zad par byas pa ste/ dbu 4rgyastug pa yin/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni thugs 'jam pas bstan pa'i snying po thugs su chud pa ste/dbu 'jam pa yin/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni rtag tu ma 'khrugs pa'i thugs dang ldan pa ste/ dbu myi 'dzings pa ④yin/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni brlang ba'i gsung dang yongs su bral ba ste/ dbu myi rtsub pa yin/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni byang chub kyi yan lag spos kyi mye tog gis skye bo mthun par 'ubasgrubs pa ste/ dbu dri zhim pa yin/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni phyag dang zhabs dpal gyi be'u dang / bkra shis dang / dga' ba 'khyil pas brgyan pa yinamu/ rab 'byor de dag ni de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'o/ /rab 'byor de ltar de lta bu'i chos kyi rnam pa de dag gzhan la bshad pa dang / bstan pa dang / yang dag par bstan pa de ni 'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos kyi sbyin pa zhes bya ste/ rab 'byor de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ sems can rnams zang zing gi sbyin pa dang chos kyi sbyin pas sdud pa yin te/ rab 'byor de ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi ngo mtshar dang durmad du byung ba'i chos so spushes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa/ hu )bam po lnga 67pa/rab 'byor ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 8tshig snyan pas 25—117

sems can rnams sdud pa yin zhe na/ rab 'byor 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po pha rol tu phyin pa drug gis sems can rnams ༅sdud pa yin te/ 'di ltar sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang / tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang / brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / pha rol tu phyin pa drug po de dag gis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po snyan par smra bas sems can rnams sdud do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar pha rol tu phyin pa drug po de dag gis dge ba'i chos thams cad ma 'dus (kyepa myed de / rab 'byor dude ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po tshig snyan par smra bas sems can rnams sdud do/ /rab 'byor ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po don bya bas sems can rnams (desdud pa yin zhe na/ rab 'byor 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po pha rol tu phyin pa drug po de dag gis yidon bya bas sems can rnams sdud do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar pha rol tu phyin pa drug po de dag gis dge ba'i chos thams cad ma 'dus ④pa myed de/ rab 'byor de ltar na (8༄byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po don bya bas sems can rnams sdud do/ /rab 'byor ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po don mthun pas sems can rnams sdud pa yin zhe na/ rab 'byor 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po pha rol tu phyin pa drug po de dag gis don mthun pas sems can rnams sdud do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na / 'di ltar pha rol tu phyin pa drug po de dag gis dge ba'i chos thams cad ma 25—118

'dus ①pa med de/ rab 'byor de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po don mthun pas sems can rnams ④sdud do/ /rab 'byor de yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi ngo mtshar dang / rmad du byung ba'i chos so/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gzhan dag la 'di skad du 'dems (mishing 'di skad ston to/ /rigs kyi bu khyed tshur sheg④ /yi ge mngon par bsgrub (snyepa la mkhas par gyis shig /yi ge gcig la mkhas par gyis shig /yi ge gnyis nas yi ge bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis kyi bar la mkhas par gyis shig /yi ge gcig gis byang ba'i rang bzhin thams cad shes par gyis shig /yi ge gnyis kyis byang ba'i rang bzhin thams cad shes par gyis shig /yi ge bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis kyi bar gyis byang ba'i rang bzhin thams cad shes par gyis shig /yi ge gcig tu yi ge bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis 'dus par sgoms shig /yi ge bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis su yi ge gcig 'dus par sgoms shig ces ston to/ /rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de yang yi ge gcig la mkhas pa yin/ yi ge bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis kyi bar la mkhas pa yin/ yi ge gcig gi nang du yi ge bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis 'dus par bsgom (nyapa la mkhas pa yin/ yi ge bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis su yi ge gcig 'dus par bsgom ⑦pa la mkhas pa yin te/ de de ltar yi ge mngon par bsgrub ⑧pa la ⑨mkhas par byas nas/ la ⑩la goms shing yi ge myed pa mngon par bsgrub naspepa la mkhas pa yin no/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ni turtechos la mkhas pa dang /25—119

yi ge la mkhas pa yin te/ de ①chos la mkhas pa dang / yi ge la mkhas pas yi ge mang pos yi ge myed pa'i chos ston kyang / rab 'byor chos de yi ge'i rnam pa dang 'bral ②ba yang ma yin te/ rab 'byor de yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi ngo mtshar dang rmad du byung ba'i chos te/ gang nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad dang thun mong ma yin no/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor gyis bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to//bcom ldan 'das gal te mtha' las 'das pa dang thog ma dang tha ma myed pa ③stong pa nyid nye bar bzung ste/ sems can yang shin tu myi dmyigs/ chos kyang myi dmyigs/ chos kyi dngos po yang myi dmyigs pa lags na/ bcom ldan 'das ji ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang / tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa rjodang /bsam gtan bzhi dang / tshad myed pa bzhi dang / gzugs skyed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa bzhi la spyod pa dang / byang chub kyi phyogs kyi ⑤chos sum cu rtsa bdun la spyod pa dang / stong pa nyid dubacu ⑦bzhi la spyod pa dang / stong pa nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin dang / mtshan ma myed pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang / smonapa myed pa'i ting nge 'dzin la spyod pa dang / rnam par thar pa brgyad la spyod pa dang / mthar kyis ⑧gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu dang / myi 'jigs pa bzhi dang / so so yang dag par ⑨rig pa bzhi dang / byams pa chen po dang / snying rje chen po dang /25—120

sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bca brgyad dang / myi chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis dang / dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu la spyod cing / rnam par smin pa las byung ba'i mngon par shes pa drug la gnas nas sems can rnams la chos ston par 'gyur/ de la ni sems can myi dmyigs te/ sems can du gdags pa yang myi dmyigs so/ /sems can myi dmyigs pas gzugs dmyigs su ma mchis so/ /sems can myi dmyigs pas tshor ba dmyigs su ma mchis so/ /sems can myi dmyigs pas 'du shes dmyigs su ma mchis so/ /sems can myi dmyigs pas 'du byed dmyigs su ma mchis so/ /sems can myi dmyigs pas rnam par shes pa dmyigs su ma mchis so/ /sems can myi dmyigs pas myig dmyigs su ma mchis so/ /sems can myi dmyigs pas/ rna ba dmyigs su ma mchis so/ /sems can myi dmyigs pas/ sna dmyigs su ma mchis so/ /sems can myi dmyigs pas/ lce dmyigs su ma mchis so/ /sems can myi dmyigs pas/ lus dmyigs su ma mchis so/ /sems can myi dmyigs pas/yid dmyigs su ma mchis so/ /sems can myi dmyigs pas/ gzugs dmyigs su ma mchis so/ /sems can myi dmyigs pas/ sgra dmyigs su ma mchis so/ /sems can myi dmyigs pas/ dri dmyigs su ma mchis so/ /sems can myi dmyigs pas/ ro dmyigs su ma mchis so/ /sems can myi dmyigs pas/ reg dmyigs su ma mchis so/ /sems can myi dmyigs pas/chos dmyigs su ma mchis so/ /sems can myi dmyigs pas/ myig gi rnam par shes pa dmyigs su ma mchis so/ /sems can myi dmyigs pas/ rna ba'i rnam par shes pa dmyigs su ma mchis so/ /sems can myi dmyigs pas/25—121

sna'i rnam par shes pa dmyigs su ma mchis so/ /sems can myi dmyigs pas/lce'i rnam par shes pa dmyigs su ma mchis so/ /sems can myi dmyigs pas/lus kyi rnam par shes pa dmyigs su ma mchis so/ /sems can myi dmyigs pas/yid kyi rnam par shes pa dmyigs su ma mchis so/ /sems can myi dmyigs pas/myig gi 'dus te reg pa dmyigs su ma mchis so/ /sems can myi dmyigs pas/rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa dmyigs su ma mchis so/ /sems can myi dmyigs pas/sna'i 'dus te reg pa dmyigs su ma ①mchis so/ /sems can myi dmyigs pas/lce'i 'dus te reg pa dmyigs su ma mchis so/ /sems can myi dmyigs pas/lus kyi 'dus te reg pa dmyigs su ma mchis so/ /sems can myi dmyigs pas/yid kyi 'dus te reg pa dmyigs su ma mchis so/ /sems can myi dmyigs pas/myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba dmyigs su ma mchis so/ /sems can myi dmyigs pas/ rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba dmyigs su ma mchis so/ /sems can myi dmyigs pas/ sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba dmyigs su ma mchis so/ /sems can myi dmyigs pas/ lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba dmyigs su ma mchis so/ /sems can myi dmyigs pas/ lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba dmyigs su ma mchis so/ /sems can myi dmyigs pas/ yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba dmyigs su ma mchis so/ /sems can myi dmyigs pas/ sa'i khams midamyigs su ma mchis so/ /sems can myi dmyigs pas/ chu'i khams dmyigs su ma mchis so/ /sems can myi dmyigs pas/ mye'i khams dmyigs su ma mchis so/ /sems can myi dmyigs pas rlung gi khams dmyigs su ma 25—122

mchis so/ /sems can myi dmyigs pas/ nam mkha'i khams dmyigs su ma mchis so/ /sems can myi dmyigs pas/ rnam par shes pa'i khams dmyigs su stim mchis so/ /sems can myi dmyigs pas/ ma rig pa dmyigs su ma mchis so/ /sems can myi dmyigs pas/ 'du byed dmyigs su ma mchis so/ /sems can myi dmyigs pas/ rnam par shes pa dmyigs su ma mchis so/ /sems can myi dmyigs pas/ mying dang gzugs dmyigs su ma mchis so /sems can myi dmyigs pas/ skye mched drug dmyigs su ma mchis so/ /sems can myi dmyigs pas/ reg pa dmyigs su ma mchis so sems can myi dmyigs pas/ tshor ba dmyigs su ma mchis so/ /sems can myi dmyigs pas / sred pa dmyigs su ma mchis so/ /sems can myi dmyigs pas/len pa dmyigs su ma mchis (7so/ /sems can myi dmyigs pas/ srid pa dmyigs su ma mchis so/ /sems can myi dmyigs pas/ skye ba dmyigs su ②ma mchis so/ /sems can myi dmyigs pas/ rga shi dmyigs su ma mchis so/ /sems can myi dmyigs pas/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dmyigs su ma mchis so / /sems can myi dmyigs pas/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dmyigs su ma mchis so/ /sems can myi dmyigs pas/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dmyigs su ma mchis so/ /sems can myi dmyigs pas/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dmyigs su ma mchis so/ /sems can myi dmyigs pas / bsam gtan gyi ④pa rol tu phyin pa dmyigs su ma mchis so/ /sems can myi dmyigs pas/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dmyigs su ma mchis so/ /sems can myi dmyigs pas/ nang stong pa nyid dmyigs su ma mchis so/ /25—123

sems can myi dmyigs pas/ phyi stong pa nyid dmyigs su ma mchis so/ /sems can myi dmyigs pas/ phyi nang stong pa nyid dmyigs su ma mchis so /sems can myi dmyigs pas/ stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dmyigs su ma mchis so//sems can myi dmyigs pas/ chen po stong pa nyid dmyigs su ma mchis so/ /sems can myi dmyigs pas/ don dam pa stong pa nyid dmyigs su ma mchis so//sems can myi dmyigs pas/ 'dus byas stong pa nyid dmyigs su ma mchis so/ /sems can myi dmyigs pas/ 'dus ma byas nyustong pa nyid dmyigs su ma mchis so / /sems can myi dmyigs pas/ mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dmyigs su ma mchis so/ /sems can myi dmyigs pas/ thog ma dang tha ma skyed pa stong pa nyid dmyigs su ma mchis so/ /sems can myi dmyigs pas/dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid dmyigs su ma mchis so/ /sems can myi dmyigs pas/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid dmyigs su ma mchis so/ /sems can myi dmyigs pas/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid dmyigs su ma mchis so /sems can myi dmyigs pas/ rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid ②dmyigs su ma mchis so/ /sems can myi dmyigs pas/ myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid dmyigs su ma mchis so/ /sems can myi dmyigs pas/ dngos po skyed pa stong pa nyid dmyigs su ma mchis so/ /sems can myi dmyigs pas/ ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dmyigs su ma mchis so/ /sems can myi dmyigs pas dngos po skyed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dmyigs su ma mchis so/ /sems can myi dmyigs pas/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa dmyigs su ma mchis so/ /sems can myi dmyigs pas/ yang dag par spong ba dmyigs su ma mchis so/ /25—124

sems can myi dmyigs pas/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa dmyigs su ma mchis so/ /sems can myi dmyigs pas/ dbang po lnga dmyigs su ma mchis so sems can myi dmyigs pas/ stobs lnga ①dmyigs su ma mchis so/ /sems can myi dmyigs pas/ byang chub kyi yan lag bdun dmyigs su ma mchis so/ /sems can myi dmyigs pas/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa dmyigs su ma mchis so/ /sems can myi dmyigs pas/ 'phags pa'i bden pa dmyigs su ma mchis so/ /sems can myi dmyigs pas/ bsam gtan dmyigs su ma mchis so/ /sems can myi dmyigs pas/ tshad myed pa dmyigs su ma mchis so/ /sems can myi dmyigs pas/ gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dmyigs su ma mchis so/ /sems can myi dmyigs pas/ rnam par thar pa brgyad dmyigs su ma mchis so/ /sems can myi dmyigs pas/ mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu dmyigs su ma mchis so/ /sems can myi dmyigs pas/ stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma skyed pa dmyigs su ma mchis so//sems can myi dmyigs pas/ smon pa myed pa dmyigs su ma mchis so /sems can myi dmyigs pas/ mngon par shes pa dmyigs su ma mchis so /sems can myi dmyigs pas/ ting nge 'dzin dmyigs su ma mchis so/ /sems can myi dmyigs pas/ gzungs kyi sgo dmyigs su ma mchis so/ /sems can myi dmyigs pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu dmyigs su ma mchis so/ /sems can myi dmyigs pas/ myi 'jigs pa bzhi dmyigs su ma mchis so/ /sems can myi dmyigs pas so so yang dag par rig ②pa bzhi dmyigs su ma mchis so/ /sems can myi dmyigs pas/ byams pa chen po 25—125

dmyigs su ma mchis so/ /sems can myi dmyigs pas/ snying rje chen po dmyigs su ma mchis so/ /sems can myi dmyigs pas/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa brtswa brgyad dmyigs su ma mchis so/ /sems can myi dmyigs pas/rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu dmyigs su ma mchis so/ /sems can myi dmyigs pas / lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu dmyigs su ma mchis so sems can myi dmyigs pas/ phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu dmyigs su ma mchis so/ /sems can myi dmyigs pas/ dgra bcom pa nyid dmyigs su ma mchis so/ /sems can myi dmyigs pas/ rang byang chub dmyigs su ma mchis so/ /sems can myi dmyigs pas/ lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid dmyigs su ma mchis sol/ /sems can mi dmyigs pas/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dmyigs su ma mchis so/ /sems can myi dmyigs pas/ myi chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis dmyigs su ma mchis so/ /sems can myi dmyigs pas/dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu dmyigs su ma mchis so/ /sems can dmyigs su ma mchis pa la ni/ sems can ma mchis so/ /gzugs ma mchis so tshor ba ma mchis so/ /'du shes ma mchis so/ /'du byed ma mchis so/ /rnam par shes pa ma mchis so/ /myig ma mchis so/ /rna ba ma mchis so/ /sna ma mchis so/ /lce ma mchis so/ /lus ma mchis so/ /yid ma mchis so/ /gzugs ma mchis so/ /sgra ma mchis so/ /dri ma mchis so ro ma mchis so /reg ma mchis so/ /chos ma mchis so/ /myig gi rnam par shes pa ma mchis so//rna ba'i rnam par shes pa ma mchis so/ /sna'i rnam par shes pa ma mchis so/ /lce'i rnam par shes pa ma mchis so/ /lus kyi rnam par shes pa ma mchis so/ /25—126

yid kyi rnam par shes pa ma mchis so/ /myig gi 'dus te reg pa ma mchis so/ /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa ma mchis so/ /sna'i 'dus te reg pa ma mchis so /lce'i 'dus te reg pa ma mchis so/ /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa ma mchis so /yid kyi 'dus te reg pa ma mchis so/ /myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba ma mchis so/ /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba ma mchis so//sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba ma mchis so/ /lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba ma mchis so/ /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba ma mchis so/ /yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba ma mchis so sa'i khams ma mchis so/ /chu'i khams ma mchis so/ /mye'i khams ma mchis so/ /rlung gi khams ma mchis so/ /nam mkha'i khams ma mchis so/ /rnam par shes pa'i khams ma mchis so/ /ma rig pa ma mchis so/ /'du 0)byed ma mchis so /rnam par shes pa ma mchis so/ /mying dang gzugs ma mchis so/ /skye mched drug ma mchis so/ /reg pa ma mchis so tshor ba ma mchis so/ /sred pa ma mchis so/ /len pa ma mchis so/ /srid pa ma mchis so/ /skye ba ma mchis so//rga shi ma mchis so/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa ma mchis so/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma mchis so/ /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa ma mchis so/ /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma mchis so/ /bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma mchis so/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma mchis so/ /nang stong pa nyid ma mchis so/ /phyi stong pa nyid ma mchis so/ /phyi nang stong pa nyid ma mchis so/ /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid ma mchis so/ /chen po stong pa nyid ma mchis so/ /don dam pa stong pa nyid ma mchis so/ /'dus byas stong pa nyid 25—127

ma mchis so/ /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid ma mchis so/ /mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid ma mchis so/ /thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid ma mchis so//dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid ma mchis so/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid ma mchis so//chos thams cad stong pa nyid ma mchis so/ /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid ma mchis so/ /myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid ①ma mchis so/ /dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid ma mchis so/ /ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid ma mchis so/ /dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid ma mchis so/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams ma mchis so/ /yang dag par spong ba rnams ma mchis so/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams ma mchis so/ /dbang po rnams ②ma mchis so/ /stobs rnams dum mchis so/ /byang chub kyi yan lag bdun ma mchis so/ /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa ma mchis so/ /'phags pa'i bden pa rnams ma mchis so/ /bsam gtan rnams ma mchis so/ /tshad myed pa rnams ma mchis so/ /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams ma mchis so/ /rnam par thar pa brgyad ma mchis so/ /mthar kyis duganas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu ma mchis so/ /⑤stong pa nyid ma mchis so/ /mtshan ma myed pa ma mchis so/ /smon pa myed pa ma mchis so/ /mngon par shes pa rnams ma mchis so/ /ting nge 'dzin rnams ma mchis so/ /gzungs kyi sgo rnams ma mchis so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu ma mchis so/ /myi 'jigs pa bzhi ma mchis so/ /so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi ma mchis so/ /byams pa chen po ma mchis so/ /snying rje chen po ma mchis so/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa ba'o brgyad ma mchis so/ /rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu ma mchis so/ /lan cig phyir 'ong 25—128

ba'i 'bras bu ma mchis so/ /phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu ma mchis so/ /dgra bcom pa nyid ma mchis so/ /rang byang chub ma mchis so/ /lam gyi rnam pa ①shes pa nyid ma mchis so/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ma mchis so/ /myi chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis ma mchis so/ /dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu ma mchis so/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das de ni 'di ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ byang chub sems dpa' nyid kyang myi dmyigs na/ byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos rnams la dmyigs par 'gyur ba lta ②ga las mchisani/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal bdu/ rab 'byor de de bzhin no/ /de de bzhin te/ ji skad du smras pa bzhin no/ /rab 'byor de 0ltar sems can myi dmyigs pas ⑦nang stong pa nyid du rig par bya'o/ /phyi stong pa nyid du rig par bya'o/ /phyi nang stong pa nyid du rig par bya'o/ /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid du rig par bya'o//chen po stong pa nyid du rig par bya'o/ /don dam pa stong pa nyid du rig par bya'o/ /'dus byas stong pa nyid du rig par bya'o/ /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid du rig par bya'o/ /mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid du rig par bya'o/ /thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid du rig par bya'o/ /dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid du rig par bya'o/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid du rig par bya'o/ /chos thams cad stong pa nyid du rig par bya'o/ /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid du rig par bya'o/ /myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid du rig par bya'o/ /dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid du rig par bya'o/ /ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid du rig par bya'o//dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid du rig par bya'o/ /phung po stong pa 25—129

nyid du rig par bya'o/ /khams stong pa nyid du rig par bya'o/ /skye mched stong pa nyid du rig par bya'o/ /rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba stong pa ①nyid du rig par bya'o/ /bden pa stong pa nyid du rig par bya'o/ /bdag stong pa nyid du rig par bya'o/ /sems can stong pa nyid du rig par bya'o/ /srog stong pa nyid du rig par bya'o/ /'gro ba stong pa nyid du rig par bya'o/ /gso thu ba stong pa nyid du rig par bya'o/ /skyes bu stong pa nyid du rig par bya'o/ /gang zag stong pa nyid du rig par bya'o/ /shed can stong pa nyid du rig par bya'o//shed bdag stong pa nyid du rig par bya'o/ /byed pa po stong pa nyid du rig par bya'o / /byed du 'jug pa po stong pa nyid du rig par bya'o/ /slong ba po stong pa nyid du rig par bya'o/ /kun nas slong ba po stong pa nyid du rig par bya'o/ /tshor ba po stong pa nyid du rig par bya'o/ /tshor bar byed pa po stong pa nyid du rig par bya'o/ /shes pa po stong pa nyid du rig par bya'o/ /mthong ba po stong pa nyid du rig par bya'o/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa stong pa nyid du rig par bya'o / /yang dag par spong ba stong pa nyid du rig par bya'o/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa stong pa nyid du rig par bya'o/ /dbang po stong pa nyid du rig par bya'o/ /stobs stong pa nyid du rig par bya'o/ /byang chub kyi yan lag stong pa nyid du rig par bya'o/ /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa stong pa nyid du rig par bya'o / /'phags pa'i bden pa stong pa nyid du rig par bya'o/ /bsam gtan stong pa nyid du rig par bya'o/ /tshad myed pa stong pa nyid du rig par bya'o//gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa stong pa nyid du rig par bya'o/ /rnam par thar pa brgyad stong pa nyid du rig par bya'o/ /mthar kyis gnas pa'i 25—130

snyoms par 'jug pa dgu stong pa nyid du rig par bya'o/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa stong pa nyid du rig par bya'o/ / she)de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu stong pa nyid du rig par bya'o/ /myi 'jigs pa 37bzhi stong pa nyid du rig par bya'o/ /so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi stong pa nyid du rig par bya'o/ /byams pa chen po stong pa nyid du rig par bya'o/ /snying rje chen po stong pa nyid du rig par bya'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa ba'o brgyad stong pa nyid du rig par bya'o/ /rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu stong pa nyid du rig par bya'o/ / lan cig /phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu stong pa nyid du rig par bya'o/ /phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu stong pa nyid du rig par bya'o/ /dgra bcom pa nyid stong pa nyid du rig par bya'o/ /rang byang chub stong pa nyid du rig par bya'o/ /lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid stong pa nyid chodu rig par bya'o/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen ltapa nyid stong pa nyid du rig par bya'o / /sangs rgyas kyi zhing stong pa nyid du rig par bya'o/ /sangs rgyas stong pa nyid du rig par bya'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' stong pa nyid du rig par bya'o//rab 'byor de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ chos de dag thams cad stong par mthong nas/phyin ci log tu gyur pa'i gyesems can rnams la chos ston to/ /ji skyeltar stong pa nyid 3)de dag la yang myi 'jug pa de ltar ston to/ /des de ltar mthong nas chos thams cad sgrib pa myed par shes te/ chos gang yang 'khrug par myi byed/gnyis su myi byed do/ /yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du yang ston pa byed do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i 37sprul pa ni/ sprul 25—131
