ba ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /'du shes ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /'du byed ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /rnam par shes pa ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo //rab 'byor myig ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /rna ba ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo //sna ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /lce ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /lus ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /yid ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /rab 'byor gzugs ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /sgra ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /dri ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /ro ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /rig ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /chos ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /rab 'byor myig gi rnam par shes pa ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /rna ba'i rnam par shes pa ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /sna'i rnam par shes pa ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /lce'i rnam par shes pa ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /lus kyi rnam par shes pa ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /yid kyi rnam par shes pa ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo //rab 'byor myig gi 'dus te reg pa ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /sna'i 'dus te reg pa ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /lce'i 'dus te reg ①pa ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /yid kyi 'dus te reg pa ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /rab 'byor myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba ni rang 25—282

bzhin gyis stong ngo / /yid kyi 'dus te reg ①pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /rab 'byor sa'i khams ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /chu'i khams ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /mye'i khams ④ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /rlung gi khams ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /nam mkha'i khams ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /rnam par shes pa'i khams ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /rab 'byor ma rig pa ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /'du byed ni rang bzhin ②gyis stong ngo / /rnam par shes pa ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /mying dang gzugs ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /skye mched drug ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo //reg pa ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /tshor ba ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /sred pa ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /len pa ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /srid pa ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /skye ba ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /rga shi ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /rab 'byor sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /bsam gtan gyi ④pa rol tu phyin pa ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /rab 'byor nang stong pa nyid ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /phyi stong pa nyid ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /phyi nang stong pa nyid ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo //chen po stong pa nyid ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /don dam pa stong pa nyid ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /'dus byas stong pa nyid ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo //25—283

'dus ma byas stong pa nyid ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /rang bzhin stong pa nyid ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /chos thams cad stong pa nyid ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /rab 'byor dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /yang dag par spong ba rnams ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /dbang po rnams ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /stobs rnams ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /byang chub kyi yan lag rnams ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /'phags pa'i bden pa rnams ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /bsam gtan rnams ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /tshad myed pa rnams ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /rnam par thar pa rnams ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /mngon par shes pa rnams ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /ting 25—284

nge 'dzin rnams ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /gzungs kyi sgo rnams ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /myi 'jigs pa rnams ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /so so yang dag par rig pa rnams ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /byams pa chen po ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /snying rje chen po ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /dga' ba chen po ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /btang snyoms chen po ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /myi chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /dpe byad bzang po ①brgyad cu ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /dgra bcom pa nyid ②ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /rang byang chub ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /de bas na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/phung po lnga ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar chos stond to/ /skye mched bcu gnyis ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar chos ston to/ /khams brtswa brgyad ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar chos ston to/ /rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar chos ston to/ /pha rol tu phyin pa thams cad ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar chos ston to/ /stong pa nyid thams cad ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar chos ston to/ /dran 25—285

pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar chos ston to/ /yang dag par spong ba bzhi ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar chos ston to/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar chos ston to/ /dbang po lnga ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar chos ston to/ /stobs lnga ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar chos ston to/ /byang chub kyi yan lag bdun ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar chos ston to/ /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar chos ston to/ / 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar chos ston to/ /①bsam gtan bzhi ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar chos ston to/ /tshad myed pa bzhi ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar chos ston to/ /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa bzhi ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar chos ston to//rnam par thar pa brgyad ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar chos ston to/ /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar chos stond to/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang smon pa myed pa ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar chos ston to/ /mngon par shes pa lnga ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar chos ston to/ /ting nge 'dzin thams cad ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar chos ston to/ /gzungs kyi sgo thams cad ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar chos ston to/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar chos ston to/ /myi 'jigs pa bzhi ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar chos ston to//so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar chos ston 25—286

to/ /byams pa chen po ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo ①zhes bya bar chos ston to/ /snying rje chen po ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar chos ston to/ /dga' ba chen po ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar chos ston to/ /btang snyoms chen po ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar chos ston to/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bco brgyad ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar chos ston to/ /myi chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar chos ston to / /dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar chos ston to/ /rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar chos ston to/ /lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar chos ston to/ /phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar chos ston to/ /dgra bcom pa nyid ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar chos ston to/ /rang byang chub ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar chos ston to/ /lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar chos ston to/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar chos ston to/ /bag chags kyi mtshams sbyor ba thams cad spong ba ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar chos ston to/ /rab 'byor gal te nang stong pa nyid rang bzhin gyis stong pa ma yin na ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos kyang chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar chos bstan ②par myi 'gyur ro/ /gal te phyi stong pa nyid rang bzhin gyis stong pa ma yin na ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos kyang chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar chos bstan par myi 'gyur ro/ /gal 25—287

te phyi nang stong pa nyid rang bzhin gyis stong pa ma yin na ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos kyang chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar chos bstan par myi 'gyur ro/ /gal te stong pa nyid stong pa nyid rang bzhin gyis stong pa ma yin na ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos kyang chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar chos bstan par myi 'gyur ro/ /gal te chen po stong pa nyid rang bzhin gyis stong pa ma yin na ni/byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos kyang chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar chos bstan par myi 'gyur ro/ /gal te don dam pa stong pa nyid rang bzhin gyis stong pa ma yin na ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos kyang chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar chos bstan par myi 'gyur ro/ /gal te 'dus byas stong pa nyid ①rang bzhin gyis stong pa ma yin na ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos kyang chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar chos bstan par myi 'gyur ro//gal te 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid rang bzhin gyis ②stong pa ma yin na ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos kyang chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar chos bstan par myi 'gyur ro/ /gal te mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid rang bzhin gyis stong pa ma yin na ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos kyang chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar chos bstan par myi 'gyur ro/ /gal te thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid rang bzhin gyis stong pa ma yin na ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos kyang chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar chos bstan 25—288

par myi 'gyur ro/ /gal te dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid rang bzhin gyis stong pa ma yin na ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos kyang chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar chos bstan par myi 'gyur ro/ /gal te rang bzhin stong pa nyid rang bzhin gyis stong pa ma yin na ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos kyang chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar chos bstan par myi 'gyur ro/ /gal te chos thams cad stong pa nyid rang bzhin gyis stong pa ma yin na ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos kyang chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar chos bstan par myi 'gyur ro/ /gal te rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid rang bzhin gyis stong pa ma yin na ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos kyang chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar chos bstan par myi 'gyur ro/ /gal te myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid rang bzhin gyis stong pa ma yin na ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos kyang chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar chos bstan par myi 'gyur ro/ /gal te dngos po myed pa (7stong pa nyid rang bzhin gyis stong pa ma yin na ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos kyang chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar chos bstan par myi 'gyur ro/ /gal te ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid rang bzhin gyis stong pa ma yin na ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos kyang chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar chos bstan par myi 'gyur ro/ /gal te dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid rang bzhin gyis stong pa ma yin na ni/byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos kyang chos thams cad rang bzhin 25—289

gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar chos bstan par myi 'gyur te/ de'i ①phyir ②rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang bshig par 'gyur na/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid ni 'jig par myi 'gyur rtag pa ma yin te/ phyis myed par 'gro ba yang ma yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni yul na gamyi gnas/ phyogs na ④spyi gnas pa ste/ de ni gang nas kyang 'ong ba yang ⑤ma yin/ gang du 'gro ba ⑥yang ma yin te/ de ni chos gnas pa nyid do/ /de la ni chos gang yang ⑦'phel bar dudamyigs pa'am/'grib 6)pa dmyigs pa'am/ 'gong ba ⑩dmyigs pa 'am/ skye ba dmyigs pa 'am / 'byung ba dmyigs pa 'am/ 'gag pa dmyigs pa 'am/ kun nas nyon mongs pa dmyigs hunyepa'am/ rnam par byang ba dmyigs pa myed do/ /de ni chos rnams kyi rang bzhin te de la gnas shing byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams/ bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yang dag par 'jug ste/ chos gang yang 'jug pa 'am/ myi 'jug par mthong ba myed do/ /chos thams cad ni 'jug pa myed cing gnas pa myed pa ste/ de ni chos rnams kyi chos gnas pa'o/ /de bas na byang chub hunyesems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyind pa la (nyespyod pa'i tshe/ chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis stong par hunyemathong nas/ bla na skyed pa 8yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir myi ldog go/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar des sgrib pa'i chos gang yang yang dag par rjes su myi mthong ste/ chos thams cad ni sgrib pa myed par yang dag par rjes su ⑩mthong ngo / /de ni 'di ltar rang bzhin stong pa nyid la bdag myi dmyigs/ bdag tu gdags ⑩pa yang myi dmyigs/ sems can 3)myi dmyigs/ sems can du gdags pa yang myi 25—290

dmyigasal/ srog myi dmyigs/ srog tu gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ 'gro ba'ang myi dmyigs/ 'gro bar gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ gso ba yang myi dmyigs / gso bar gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ skyes bu ①yang myi dmyigs/skyes bur gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ gang zag kyang myi dmyigs/ gang zag tu gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ shed can yang myi dmyigs/ shed can du gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ shed bdag kyang myi dmyigs/ shed bdag tu gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ byed pa po yang myi dmyigs/ byed pa por gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ tshor ba po yang myi dmyigs/ tshor ba por gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ tshor bar byed pa yang myi dmyigs/ tshor bar byed par gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ slong ba ⑤yang myi dmyigs/ slong bar gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ kun nas slong ba ①yang myi dmyigs/ kun nas slong bar gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ shes pa po yang myi dmyigs/shes pa por gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ mthong ba po yang myi dmyigs/mthong ba por gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ gzugs kyang myi dmyigs/gzugs su gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ tshor ba yang myi dmyigs/ tshor bar gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ 'du shes kyang myi dmyigs/ 'du shes su gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ 'du byed kyang myi dmyigs/ 'du byed du gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ rnam par shes pa yang myi dmyigs/ rnam par shes par gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ myig kyang myi dmyigs/ myig tu gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ rna ba yang myi dmyigs/ rna bar gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ sna yang myi dmyigs/ snar gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/25—291

lce yang myi dmyigs/ lcer gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ lus kyang myi dmyigs/lus su gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ yid kyang myi dmyigs/ yid du gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ gzugs kyang myi dmyigs/ gzugs su gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ sgra yang myi dmyigs/ sgrar gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ dri yang myi dmyigs/ drir gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ ro yang myi dmyigs/ror gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ reg kyang myi dmyigs/ reg tu gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ chos kyang myi dmyigs/ chos su gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/myig gi rnam par shes pa yang myi dmyigs/ myig gi rnam par shes par gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ rna ba'i rnam par shes pa yang myi dmyigs/ rna ba'i rnam par shes par gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ sna'i rnam par shes pa yang myi dmyigs / sna'i rnam par shes par gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ lce'i rnam par shes pa yang myi dmyigs/ lce'i rnam par shes par gdags pa yang myi dmyigs / lus kyi rnam par shes pa yang myi dmyigs/ lus kyi rnam par shes par / gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ yid kyi rnam par shes pa yang myi dmyigs / yid kyi rnam par shes par/ gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/myig gi 'dus te reg pa yang myi dmyigs/ myig gi 'dus te reg par gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa yang myi dmyigs/ rna ba'i 'dus te reg par gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ sna'i 'dus te reg pa yang myi dmyigs / sna'i 'dus te reg par gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ lce'i 'dus te reg pa yang myi dmyigs/ lce'i 'dus te reg par gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/lus kyi 'dus te reg pa yang myi dmyigs/ lus kyi 'dus te reg par gdags 25—292

pa yang myi dmyigs/ yid kyi 'dus te reg pa yang myi dmyigs/ yid kyi 'dus te reg par gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba yang myi dmyigs/ myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor bar gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba yang myi dmyigs/ rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor bar gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba yang myi dmyigs/sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor bar gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba yang myi dmyigs/ lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor bar gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba yang myi dmyigs/ lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor bar gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba yang myi dmyigs/ yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor bar gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ sa'i khams kyang myi dmyigs/ sa'i khams su gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ chu'i khams kyang myi dmyigs/ chu'i khams su gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ mye'i khams kyang myi dmyigs/ mye'i khams su gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ rlung gi khams kyang myi dmyigs/ rlung gi khams su gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ nam mkha'i khams kyang myi dmyigs/ nam mkha'i khams su gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ rnam par shes pa'i khams kyang myi dmyigs/rnam par shes pa'i khams su gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ ma rig pa yang myi dmyigs / ma rig par gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ 'du byed kyang myi dmyigs / 'du byed du gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ rnam par shes pa yang 25—293

myi dmyigs/ rnam par shes par gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ mying dang gzugs kyang myi dmyigs/ mying dang gzugs su gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/skye mched drug kyang myi dmyigs/ skye mched drug tu gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/reg pa yang myi dmyigs/ reg par gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ tshor ba yang myi dmyigs/ tshor bar gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ sred pa yang myi dmyigs / sred par gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ len pa yang myi dmyigs/len par gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ srid pa yang myi dmyigs/ srid par gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ skye ba yang myi dmyigs/ skye bar gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ rga shi yang myi dmyigs/ rga shir gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yang myi dmyigs/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin par gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang myi dmyigs/tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin par gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yang myi dmyigs/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin par gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang myi dmyigs/brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin par gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ bsam gtan kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang myi dmyigs/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyind par gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang myi dmyigs/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin par gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ nang stong pa nyid kyang myi dmyigs/ nang stong pa nyid du gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ phyi stong pa nyid kyang myi dmyigs/ phyi stong pa nyid du gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ phyi nang stong pa nyid kyang myi dmyigs/ phyi nang stong pa nyid du gdags pa yang myi 25—294

dmyigs / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid kyang myi dmyigs/ stong pa nyid stong pa nyid du gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ chen po stong pa nyid kyang myi dmyigs/chen po stong pa nyid du gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ don dam pa stong pa nyid kyang myi dmyigs/ don dam pa stong pa nyid du gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/'dus byas stong pa nyid kyang myi dmyigs/ 'dus byas stong pa nyid du gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid kyang myi dmyigs/ 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid du gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid kyang myi dmyigs/ mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid du gdags pa yang myi dmyigs / thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid kyang myi dmyigs/ thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid du gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid kyang myi dmyigs/ dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid du gdags pa yang myi dmyigasal/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang myi dmyigs/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid du gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid kyang myi dmyigs / chos thams cad stong pa nyid du gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid kyang myi dmyigs/ rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid du gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid kyang myi dmyigs/myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid du gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid kyang myi dmyigs/ dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid du gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyang myi dmyigs/ ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid du gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyang myi dmyigs/ dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid du gdags pa yang myi 25—295

dmyigasal/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams kyang myi dmyigs/ dran pa nye bar gzhag par gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ yang dag par spong ba rnams kyang myi dmyigs / yang dag par spong bar gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams kyang myi dmyigs/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang par gdags pa yang myi dmyigs / dbang po rnams kyang myi dmyigs/ dbang por gdags pa yang myi dmyigs / stobs rnams kyang myi dmyigs/ stobs su gdags pa yang myi dmyigasal/ byang chub kyi yan lag rnams kyang myi dmyigs/ byang chub kyi yan lag tu gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa yang myi dmyigs/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad par gdags pa yang myi dmyigs / 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams kyang myi dmyigs/ 'phags pa'i bden par gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ bsam gtan rnams kyang myi dmyigs/bsam gtan du gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ tshad myed pa rnams kyang myi dmyigs / tshad myed par gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyang myi dmyigs/ gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug par gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ rnam par thar pa rnams kyang myi dmyigs / rnam par thar par gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyang myi dmyigs/ mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug par gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa yang myi dmyigs/rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed par gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ mngon par shes pa rnams kyang myi 25—296

dmyigs / mngon par shes par gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ ting nge 'dzin rnams kyang myi dmyigs/ ting nge 'dzin du gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/gzungs kyi sgo rnams kyang myi dmyigs/ gzungs kyi sgor gdags pa yang myi dmyigs / de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams kyang myi dmyigs/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs su gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ myi 'jigs pa rnams kyang myi dmyigs/ myi 'jigs par gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ so so yang dag par rig pa rnams kyang myi dmyigs/ so so yang dag par rig par gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ byams pa chen po yang myi dmyigs/ byams pe chen por gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ snying rje chen po yang myi dmyigs/ snying rje chen por gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa ba'o brgyad kyang myi dmyigs/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa ba'o brgyad du gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu yang myi dmyigs/ rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bur gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu yang myi dmyigs/ lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bur gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu yang myi dmyigs/ phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bur gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ dgra bcom pa nyid kyang myi dmyigs/dgra bcom pa nyid du gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ rang byang chub kyang myi dmyigs / rang byang chub tu gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid kyang myi dmyigs/ lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid du gdags pa yang myi dmyigs / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyang myi dmyigs/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du gdags pa yang myi dmyigasasti/ myi chen po'i mtshan 25—297

sum cu rtsa gnyis kyang 0)myi dmyigs/ myi chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis su gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu yang myi dmyigs/dpe byad bzang po brgyad (bcur gdags pa yang myi dmyigs na bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub la the tshom ②za bar 'gyur ba lta ga las 'ong /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ de bzhin gshegs pas 8sprul pa'i dge slong ngam / dge slong ma 'am/ dge bsnyen nam/ dge bsnyen ma la bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong / du mar rgyun tu/ chos bstan na/ rab 'byor de ji snyam du sems/ sprul pa de dag la rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu rjes su thob par 'gyur ba'i skal ba lta yod dam⑤/ lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu'am/phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu'am/ dgra bcom pa nyid dam/ rang byang chub bam/bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par 'gyur ba'i skal ba yod dam / gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de ni ma lags te/ de ci'i slad du zhe na/ 'di ltar de dag la dngos po ma mchis so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de de bzhin no/ /de de bzhin te/ chos thams cad la dngos po myed na sems can gang zhig byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu'am/ lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu'am/ phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu'am/ dgra bcom pa ༅nyid dam/rang byang chub bam/ bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu dgod par bya ste da/ gzhan du na phyin ci log gis yongs su 'khris (kyepa'i skye dgu ⑨dag phyin ci log myed pa la gzhog go/ /'dul lo/ /rab tu 'god do/ /phyin ci log gang yin pa de yang rtog pa'i rgyu las byung ba'i phyir/ phyin ci log 25—298

ma yin pa ste/ rnam par rtog ①pa myed pa (5)ni phyin ci log ma yin pa'o/ /gang la phyin ci log myed pa de la bdag myed do/ /sems can myed do/ /srog myed do/ /'gro ba myed do/ /gso ba myed do/ /skyes 90bu myed do/ /gang zag skyed do/ /shed can myed do/ /shed bdag skyed do/ /byed pa po myed do//tshor ba po myed do/ /shes pa po myed do/ /mthong ba po myed do/ /de la gzugs skyed do/ /tshor ba myed do/ /'du shes skyed do/ /'du byed myed do/ /rnam par shes pa myed do/ /de la myig myed do/ /rna ba myed do/ /sna myed do/ /lce myed do/ /lus myed do/ /yid myed do/ /de la gzugs myed do/ /sgra myed do/ /dri myed do/ /ro myed do/ /reg myed do/ /chos skyed do/ /de la myig gi rnam par shes pa myed do/ /rna ba'i rnam par shes pa myed do/ /sna'i rnam par shes pa myed do/ /lce'i rnam par shes pa myed do/ /lus kyi rnam par shes pa myed do/ /yid kyi rnam par shes pa myed do/ /de la myig gi 'dus te reg pa myed do/ /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa myed do/ /sna'i 'dus te reg pa myed do/ /lce'i 'dus te reg pa myed do/ /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa myed do/ /yid kyi 'dus te reg pa myed do/ /de la myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba myed do/ /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba myed do/ /sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba myed do/ /lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba myed do/ /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba myed do/ /yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba myed do/ /de la sa'i khams myed do/ /chu'i khams myed do/ /mye'i khams myed do/ /rlung gi khams myed do/ /nam mkha'i khams myed do/ /rnam par shes pa'i khams myed do/ /de la ma rig pa 25—299

myed do/ /'du byed myed do/ /rnam par shes pa myed do/ /mying dang gzugs myed do/ /skye mched drug myed do/ /reg pa myed do/ /tshor ba myed do / /sred pa myed do/ /len pa myed do/ /srid pa myed do/ /skye ba myed do//rga shi myed do/ /de la sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa myed do/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rold tu phyind pa myed do/ /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa myed do/ /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed do/ /bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed do//shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed do/ /de la nang stong pa nyid myed do/ /phyi stong pa nyid myed do/ /phyi nang stong pa nyid myed do/ /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid myed do/ /chen po stong pa nyid myed do/ /don dam pa stong pa nyid myed do/ /'dus byas stong pa nyid myed do/ /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid myed do/ /mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid myed do/ /thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid myed do/ /dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid myed do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid skyed do/ /chos thams cad stong pa nyid myed do/ /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid myed do/ /myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid myed do/ /dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid myed do/ /ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid myed do/ /dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid myed do/ /de la dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams myed do/ /yang dag par nyaspong ba rnams skyed do/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams myed do/ /dbang po rnams myed do/ /stobs rnams myed do/ /byang chub kyi yan lag rnams myed do/ /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa myed do/ /de la 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams myed do/ /bsam gtan rnams myed do/ /tshad myed pa (gyirnams myed do/ /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams myed do//25—300

de la rnam par thar pa rnams myed do/ /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams myed do/ /rnam par thar 3)pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa myed do/ /mngon par shes pa rnams myed do//ting nge 'dzin rnams myed do/ / gzungs kyi sgo rnams myed do/ /(kye de la (kyede bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams myed do/ /lamyi 'jigs pa rnams myed do/ /so so yang dag par rig pa rnams myed do/ /byams pa chen po myed do/ /snying rje chen po myed do/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa brtswa brgyad myed do/ /de la rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu myed do/ /lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu myed do / /phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu myed do/ /dgra bcom pa nyid myed do/ /rang byang chub myed do/ /⑤de la lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid myed do/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid myed do// //shes rab kyi pha rold tu phyind pa stong phrag brgya pa/ bam po bcu (nyapa/gang la gzugs myed pa dang / tshor ba myed pa dang / 'du shes myed pa dang /'du byed ⑦skyed pa dang / rnam par shes pa myed pa dang / gang la myig myed pa dang / rna ba myed pa dang / sna myed pa dang / lce myed pa dang / lus myed pa dang / yid myed pa dang / gang la gzugs myed pa dang / sgra med pa dang / dri myed pa dang / ro myed pa dang / reg myed pa dang / chos myed pa dang / gang la myig gi rnam par shes pa myed pa dang / rna ba'i rnam par shes pa myed pa dang / sna'i rnam par shes pa myed pa dang / lce'i rnam par shes pa myed pa dang / lus kyi rnam par shes pa myed pa dang / yid kyi rnam par shes pa myed pa dang / gang la myig gi 'dus te reg pa myed pa dang /25—301

rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa myed pa dang / sna'i 'dus te reg pa myed pa dang /lce'i 'dus te reg pa myed pa dang / lus kyi 'dus te reg pa myed pa dang /yid kyi 'dus te reg pa myed pa dang / gang la myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba myed pa dang / rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba myed pa dang / sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba myed pa dang / lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba myed pa dang / lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba myed pa dang / yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba myed pa dang / gang la sa'i khams myed pa dang / chu'i khams myed pa dang / mye'i khams myed pa dang / rlung gi khams myed pa dang / nam mkha'i khams myed pa dang / rnam par shes pa'i khams myed pa dang / gang la ma rig pa myed pa dang / 'du byed myed pa dang / rnam par shes pa myed pa dang / mying dang gzugs myed pa dang / skye mched drug myed pa dang / reg pa myed pa dang /tshor ba myed pa dang / sred pa myed pa dang / len pa myed pa dang / srid pa myed pa dang / skye ba myed pa dang / rga shi myed pa dang / gang la sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa myed pa dang / tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed pa dang /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa myed pa dang / brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed pa dang / bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed pa dang / gang la nang stong pa nyid myed pa dang / phyi stong pa nyid myed pa dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid myed pa dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid myed pa dang / chen po stong pa nyid myed pa dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid myed pa dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid skyed pa dang / 'dus ma 25—302

byas stong pa nyid skyed pa dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid myed pa dang /thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid myed pa dang / dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid myed pa dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid myed pa dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid myed pa dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid myed pa dang / myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid myed pa dang / dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid skyed pa dang / ngo bo nyid stong ①pa nyid myed pa dang / dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid myed pa dang / gang la dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams skyed pa dang /yang dag par spong ba rnams skyed pa dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams myed pa dang / dbang po rnams skyed pa dang / stobs rnams skyed pa dang / byang chub kyi yan lag rnams myed pa dang / 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa myed pa dang / gang la 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams myed pa dang / bsam gtan rnams myed pa dang / tshad myed pa rnams myed pa dang / gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams myed pa dang / gang la rnam par thar pa brgyad ②myed pa dang / mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams ②skyed pa dang / rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang /smon pa myed pa myed pa ④dang / mngon par shes pa rnams myed pa dang /ting nge 'dzin rnams skyed pa dang / gzungs kyi sgo rnams skyed pa dang / gang la de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams myed pa dang / myi 'jigs pa rnams myed pa dang / so so yang dag par rig pa rnams myed pa dang / byams pa chen po skyed pa dang / snying rje chen po myed pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bca brgyad myed pa dang / gang la rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu myed pa 25—303

dang / lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu myed pa dang / phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu myed pa dang / dgra bcom pa nyid myed pa dang / rang byang chub myed pa dang / nyalam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid myed pa dang / bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub myed pa de ni rang bzhin stong pa nyid de/ de la gnas shing byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod de②/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing / sems can phyin ci log tu gyur pa rnams sems can gyi 'du shes las 'grel te②/gzugs kyi 'du shes las 'grel to/ /gzugs myed pa'i 'du shes las 'grel to//zag pa dang bcas pa'i chos ④thams cad kyi bar las 'grel to/ /gang zag pa myed pa'i chos 'di lta ste/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi dang / yang dag par spong ba bzhi dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi dang / dbang po lnga dang /stobs lnga dang / byang chub kyi yan lag bdun dang / 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa dang / rnam par thar pa'i sgo gsum dang / 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi dang / ⑤rnam par thar pa brgyad dang / mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu dang / ting nge 'dzin thams cad dang /gzungs kyi sgo thams cad dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu dang /myi 'jigs pa bzhi dang / so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi dang / byams pa chen po dang / snying rje chen po dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa ba'o brgyad po de dag kyang de la don dam pa'i rnam pa gang yin pa de lta bu ma yin te/'di ltar 'dus ma byas pa dang / ma skyes pa dang / dngos po myed pa dang /'byung ba myed pa 'di ni rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /de duni sangs rgyas bcom 25—304

ldan 'das rnams kyi byang chub ste/ de la bdag myed do/ /sems can myed do/ /srog myed do/ /skye ba po ②skyed do/ /gso ba ②skyed do/ /skyes bu myed do/ /gang zag myed do/ /shed can myed do/ /shed bdag myed do/ /byed pa po myed do/ /tshor ba po myed do/ /shes pa po myed do/ /mthong ba po myed do/ /gzugs myed do/ /tshor ba skyed do/ /'du shes myed do/ /'du byed myed do/ /rnam par shes pa myed do/ /myig myed do/ /rna ba myed do/ /sna myed do/ /lce myed do/ /lus myed do/ /yid myed do/ /gzugs myed do/ /sgra myed do//dri myed do/ /ro gyed do/ /reg myed do/ /chos myed do/ /myig gi rnam par shes pa myed do/ /rna ba'i rnam par shes pa myed do/ /sna'i rnam par shes pa myed do/ /lce'i rnam par shes pa myed do/ /lus kyi rnam par shes pa myed do/ /yid kyi rnam par shes pa myed do/ /myig gi 'dus te reg pa myed do/ /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa myed do/ /sna'i 'dus te reg pa myed do/ /lce'i 'dus te reg pa myed do/ /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa myed do/ /yid kyi ②'dus te reg pa myed do/ /myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba myed do/ /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba myed do/ /sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba myed do/ /lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba myed do/ /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba myed do/ /yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba myed do/ /sa'i khams myed do/ /chu'i khams myed do/ /mye'i khams myed do/ /rlung gi khams myed do/ /nam mkha'i khams myed do/ /rnam par shes pa'i khams myed do/ /ma rig pa myed do/ ci /'du byed skyed do/ /rnam par shes pa myed do/ /mying dang gzugs myed do/ /skye mched drug myed do//25—305

reg pa myed do/ /tshor ba myed do/ /sred pa myed do/ /len pa myed do/ /srid pa myed do/ /skye ba myed do/ /rga shi myed do/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa myed do/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed do/ /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyind pa myed do/ /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed do/ /bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed do/ /nang stong pa nyid myed do/ /phyi stong pa nyid myed do/ /phyi nang stong pa nyid myed do / /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid myed do/ /chen po stong pa nyid myed do/ /don dam pa stong pa nyid myed do/ /'dus byas stong pa nyid myed do/ /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid myed do/ /mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid myed do/ /thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid myed do/ /dor ba myed pa ②stong pa nyid myed do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid myed do/ /chos thams cad stong pa nyid myed do/ /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid myed do/ /myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid myed do/ /dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid myed do/ /ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid myed do/ /dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid skyed do/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams skyed do/ /yang dag par spong ba rnams myed do/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams skyed do/ /dbang po rnams myed do/ /stobs rnams myed do/ /byang chub kyi yan lag rnams myed do/ /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa myed do/ /'phags pa'i bden pa rnams myed do/ /bsam gtan rnams myed do/ /tshad skyed pa rnams myed do/ /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams skyed do/ /rnam par thar pa brgyad skyed do/ /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu myed do/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang /25—306

mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa myed do/ /mngon par shes pa rnams myed do/ /ting nge 'dzin rnams myed do/ /gzungs kyi sgo rnams myed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu ༷myed do/ /myi 'jigs pa bzhi ②skyed do/ /so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi myed do/ /byams pa chen po myed do/ /snying rje chen po myed do/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa ba'o brgyad myed do/ /myi chen po'i mtshan sum ③cu rtsa gnyis skyed do/ /dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu myed do/ /rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu myed do/ /lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu myed do/ /phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu myed do/ /dgra bcom pa nyid myed do// rang byang chub myed do/ /④lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid myed do/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid myed do/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de ni gzhan du na/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid yongs su shes pa las lam gyi don du/ bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu 'jug pa myed dephyi/rang bzhin stong pa nyid de yang snga nas kyang rang bzhin ༅stong pa nyid phyin chad ⑦kyang rang bzhin dustong pa nyid bar du yang rang bzhin ⑨stong pa nyid de/ de nam yang rang bzhin gyis myi stong pa ma yin no/ /de bas na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po yang rang bzhin gyis 0stong pa nyid kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing / sems can du 'du shes pa'i sems can rnams kyi 0sems can gyi 'du shes yongs 7su dgrol ba'i phyir lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid la spyod do//de 4)lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid la spyod pa'i tshe/ 'di lta ste/ nyan thos kyi lam dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi lam dang / byang chub sems dpa'i lam dang /lam thams cad la spyod de8/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de 25—307

lam thams cad yongs su rdzogs par byas/ sems can ①yongs su smin par byas / sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag par byas nas/ tshe'i ②'du byed byin gyis brlabs te/ bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya'o/ /de bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par ⑤rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas/ 'di lta ste/ sangs rgyas kyi tshul rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi ①rgyun myi gcod do/ /de ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi tshul te/ 'das pa'i dus kyi sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang ji snyed cig byung ba de dag gi sangs rgyas kyi tshul yang 'di lta ste/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /ma 'ongs pa'i dus na sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang ji snyed cig ⑤'byung bar 'gyur ba de dag gi sangs rgyas kyi tshul yang 'di lta ste/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /da 0ltar phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi kham sa na sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang ji snyed cigatso /bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ba de dag gi 6)sangs rgyas kyi tshul yang 'di lta ste/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid dol/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid ⑩ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ma gtogs par gzhan las 'jig rten du 'byung bar myi 'gyur ro/ /de bas na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyad par bya ste/ de la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid las yongs su nyam ⑪par myi 'gyur ro/ /rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi chos thams cad la spyod cing / gzugs kyang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa 25—308

nyid kyang gzhan no/ /tshor ba yang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /'du shes kyang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no//'du byed kyang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /rnam par shes pa yang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /myig kyang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /rna ba yang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /sna yang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /lce yang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /lus kyang gzhan no/ /1skarang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan ②rna/ /yid kyang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /gzugs kyang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /sgra yang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /dri yang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /ro yang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /reg kyang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /chos kyang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /myig gi rnam par shes pa yang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /rna ba'i rnam par shes pa yang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /sna'i rnam par shes pa yang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /lce'i rnam par shes pa yang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /lus kyi rnam par shes pa yang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no//yid kyi rnam par shes pa yang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no//myig gi 'dus te reg pa yang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no//25—309

rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa yang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no//sna'i 'dus te reg pa yang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /lce'i 'dus te reg pa yang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa yang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no//yid kyi 'dus te reg pa yang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no//myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba yang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba yang gzhan no//rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba yang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba yang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan rnal/ /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba yang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba yang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /sa'i khams kyang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /chu'i khams kyang gzhan rnal/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /mye'i khams kyang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /rlung gi khams kyang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /nam mkha'i khams kyang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /rnam par shes pa'i khams kyang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /ma rig pa yang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /'du byed kyang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /rnam par shes pa yang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin 25—310

stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /mying dang gzugs kyang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /skye mched drug kyang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /reg pa yang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /tshor ba yang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /sred pa yang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /len pa yang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /srid pa yang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /skye ba yang gzhan no//rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /rga shi yang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin ①stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /bsam gtan kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /nang stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /phyi stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /phyi nang stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no//rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /chen po stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /don dam pa stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no//25—311

rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /'dus byas stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no//rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /thog ma dang tha ma skyed pa stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no//dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong rme nyid kyang gzhan no/ / rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /3)chos thams cad stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no / /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /dngos po myed nga stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /lnge bo nyid stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no / /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams kyang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /yang dag par spong ba rnams kyang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams kyang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /dbang po rnams kyang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /stobs rnams kyang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /byang chub kyi yan lag rnams kyang gzhan no//rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa 25—312

yang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /'phags pa'i ①bden pa rnams kyang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /bsam gtan rnams kyang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /tshad myed pa rnams kyang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /rnam par thar pa brgyad kyang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu ②yang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa yang gzhan no//rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /mngon par shes pa rnams kyang gzhan no / /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /ting nge 'dzin rnams kyang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /gzungs kyi sgo rnams kyang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu yang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /myi 'jigs pa bzhi yang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi yang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /byams pa chen po yang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /snying rje chen po yang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa brtswa brgyad kyang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu yang gzhan no//rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu yang 25—313

gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu yang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /dgra bcom pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /rang byang chub kyang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /lam kyi rnam pa shes pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /zhes bgyi bar rang bzhin stong pa nyid rnam par 'khrug ①par myi bgyid (2nyekyi gzugs nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzugs so/ /tshor ba nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang tshor ba'o/ /'du shes nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do / /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang 'du shes so/ /'du byed nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang 'du byed do/ /rnam par shes pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang rnam par shes pa'o/ /myig nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang myig go/ /rna ba nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do①/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang rna ba'o/ /sna nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang sna'o/ /lce nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang lce'o/ /lus nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang lus so/ /yid nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do//rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang yid do/ /gzugs nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzugs so/ /sgra nyid kyang rang bzhin 25—314

stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang sgra'o/ /dri nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang dri'o/ /ro nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang ro'o/ /reg nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang reg go/ /chos nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang chos so//myig gi rnam par shes pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang myig gi rnam par shes pa'o/ /rna ba'i rnam par shes pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang rna ba'i rnam par shes pa'o / /sna'i rnam par shes pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang sna'i rnam par shes pa'o/ /lce'i rnam par shes pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang lce'i rnam par shes pa'o/ /lus kyi rnam par shes pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang lus kyi rnam par shes pa'o/ /yid kyi rnam par shes pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang yid kyi rnam par shes pa'o/ /myig gi 'dus te reg pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do / /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang myig gi 'dus te reg pa'o/ /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'o/ /sna'i 'dus te reg pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang sna'i 'dus te reg pa'o/ /lce'i 'dus te reg pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang lce'i 'dus te reg pa'o/ /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa nyid kyang rang 25—315

bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'o//yid kyi 'dus te reg pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'o/ /myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'o/ /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'o/ /sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'o/ /lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba nyid kyang rang bzhin ②stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'o/ /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'o/ /yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'o/ /sa'i khams nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang sa'i khams so/ /chu'i khams nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang chu'i khams sol/ /skye'i khams nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang mye'i khams so/ /rlung gi khams nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang rlung gi khams so/ /nam mkha'i khams nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang nam mkha'i khams so//25—316

rnam par shes pa'i khams nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang rnam par shes pa'i khams so/ /ma rig pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang ma rig pa'o/ /'du byed nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang 'du byed do/ /rnam par shes pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang rnam par shes pa'o/ /mying dang gzugs nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do / /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang mying dang gzugs so/ /skye mched drug nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang skye mched drug go/ /reg pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang reg pa'o/ /tshor ba nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang tshor ba'o/ /sred pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do//rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang sred pa'o/ /len pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang len pa'o/ /srid pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang srid pa'o/ /skye ba nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang skye ba'o/ /rga shi nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang rga shi'o/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin 25—317

pa'o / /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do//rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /nang stong pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do//rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang nang stong pa nyid do/ /phyi stong pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang phyi stong pa nyid do/ /phyi nang stong pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang phyi nang stong pa nyid do/ /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do / /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang stong pa nyid stong pa nyid do/ /chen po stong pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang chen po stong pa nyid do/ /don dam pa stong pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang don dam pa stong pa nyid do/ /'dus byas stong pa cinyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang 'dus byas stong pa nyid do/ /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid do/ /mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid do/ /thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid do/ /dor ba skyed pa stong pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa 25—318

nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang dor ba skyed pa stong pa nyid do/ / rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /①chos thams cad stong pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang chos thams cad stong pa nyid do/ /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid do/ /myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid do/ /dngos po myed pa ②stong pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid do//ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang ngo bo nyid stong pa ③nyid do/ /dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid do/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams so/ /yang dag par spong ba nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang yang dag par spong ba rnams so/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams so/ /dbang po nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang dbang po rnams so/ /stobs nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang stobs rnams so/ /byang chub kyi rjoyan lag nyid ①kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang 25—319

byang chub kyi yan lag rnams so/ /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa'o/ /'phags pa'i bden pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams so/ /bsam gtan nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang bsam gtan rnams so/ /tshad myed pa nyid 0)kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do / /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang tshad myed pa rnams so/ /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams so/ /rnam par thar pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang rnam par thar pa rnams so/ /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams so/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang /mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ / rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa'o/ /mngon par shes pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang mngon par shes pa rnams so/ /ting nge 'dzin nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang ting nge 'dzin rnams so/ /gzungs kyi sgo nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do / /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzungs kyi sgo rnams so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa 25—320

nyid kyang de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams so/ /myi 'jigs pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang myi 'jigs pa rnams so / /so so yang dag par rig pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang so so yang dag par rig pa rnams so/ /byams pa chen po nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang byams pa chen po'o/ /snying rje chen po nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang snying rje chen po'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams so/ /rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu'o / /lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do//rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu'o/ /phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu'o/ /dgra bcom pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang dgra bcom pa nyid do/ /rang byang chub nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang rang byang ②chub bo/ /lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do//rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid do/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid do/ /zhes bgyi 9 bar spyod pa ngo mtshar che'o / /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de de bzhin no/ /25—321

de de bzhin te/ ji skad du smras pa yo)bzhin te/ rab 'byor gal te gzugs kyang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ tshor ba yang gzhan la/rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ 'du shes kyang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ 'du byed kyang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ rnam par shes pa yang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan / myig kyang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ rna ba yang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ sna yang gzhan la/rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ lce yang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ lus kyang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/yid kyang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ gzugs kyang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ sgra yang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ dri yang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ ro yang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ reg kyang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ chos kyang gzhan la/rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ myig gi rnam par shes pa yang gzhan la/rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ rna ba'i rnam par shes pa yang gzhan la/rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ sna'i rnam par shes pa yang gzhan la/rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ lce'i rnam par shes pa yang gzhan la/rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ lus kyi rnam par shes pa yang gzhan la/rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ yid kyi rnam par shes pa yang gzhan la/rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ myig gi 'dus te reg pa yang gzhan la/25—322

rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa yang gzhan la/rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ sna'i 'dus te reg pa yang gzhan la/rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ rtse'i 'dus te reg pa yang gzhan la/rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ lus kyi 'dus te reg pa yang gzhan la/rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ yid kyi 'dus te reg pa yang gzhan la/rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba yang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba yang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba yang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba yang gzhan la/rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba yang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba yang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/sa'i khams kyang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ chu'i khams kyang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ mye'i khams kyang gzhan la / rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ rlung gi khams kyang gzhan la/rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ nam mkha'i khams kyang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ rnam par shes pa'i khams kyang gzhan la/rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ ma rig pa yang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ 'du byed kyang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ rnam par shes pa yang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang 25—323

gzhan / mying dang gzugs kyang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan / skye mched drug kyang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/reg pa yang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ tshor ba yang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ sred pa yang gzhan la/rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ len pa yang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ srid pa yang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ skye ba yang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/rga shi yang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan / brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang gzhan la/rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ nang stong pa nyid kyang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ phyi stong pa nyid kyang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ phyi nang stong pa nyid kyang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ stong pa nyid stong pa nyid kyang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ chen po stong pa nyid kyang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ don dam pa stong pa nyid kyang gzhan la/rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ 'dus byas stong pa nyid kyang gzhan la/25—324

rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid kyang gzhan la/rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan①/ mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid kyang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid kyang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid kyang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/(gyichos thams cad stong pa nyid kyang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid kyang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan / myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid kyang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid kyang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyang gzhan la/rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhanas/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams kyang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ yang dag par spong ba rnams kyang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams kyang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ dbang po rnams kyang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ stobs rnams kyang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ byang chub kyi yan lag rnams kyang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa yang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/'phags pa'i bden pa rnams kyang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang 25—325

gzhan/ bsam gtan rnams kyang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ tshad myed pa rnams kyang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan / gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ rnam par thar pa brgyad kyang gzhan la/rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu yang ①gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa yang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ mngon par shes pa rnams kyang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ ting nge 'dzin rnams kyang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ gzungs kyi sgo rnams kyang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams kyang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ myi 'jigs pa rnams kyang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ so so yang dag par rig pa rnams kyang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan / byams pa chen po yang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan / snying rje chen po yang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa brtswa brgyad kyang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu yang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu yang gzhan la/rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu yang gzhan la / rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ dgra bcom pa nyid kyang gzhan la/25—326

rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ rang byang chub kyang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid kyang gzhan la/rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan ①te/ gal te chagazugs rang bzhin gyis stong pa zhig ③ma yin na ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po yang bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang myi rgya ste/ rab 'byor gang gi phyir gzugs rang bzhin gyis stong pas na/ de'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gzugs rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar khong du chud par byas shing / bla na skyed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya'o/ /gal te tshor ba rang bzhin gyis stong pa zhig ma yin na ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po yang bla na skyed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang myi rgya ste/ rab 'byor gang gi phyir tshor ba rang bzhin gyis stong pas na/ de'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po tshor ba rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar khong du chud par byas shing / bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya'o/ /gal te 'du shes rang bzhin gyis stong pa zhig ma yin na ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po yang bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang myi rgya ste/ rab 'byor gang gi phyir 'du shes rang bzhin gyis stong pas na/ de'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'du shes rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar khong du chud par byas shing /25—327

bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya'o/ /gal te 'du byed rang bzhin gyis stong pa zhig ma yin na ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po yang bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang myi rgya ste/ rab 'byor gang gi phyir 'du byed rang bzhin gyis stong pas na/ de'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'du byed rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar khong du chud par byas shing / bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya'o/ /gal te rnam par shes pa rang bzhin gyis stong pa zhig ma yin na ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po yang bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang myi rgya ste/rab 'byor gang gi phyir rnam par shes pa rang bzhin gyis stong pas na/ de'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnam par shes pa rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar khong du chud par byas shing / bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya'o/ /gal te myig rang bzhin gyis stong pa zhig ma yin na ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po yang bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang myi rgya ste/ rab 'byor gang gi phyir myig rang bzhin gyis stong pas na/ de'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po myig rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar khong du chud par byas shing / bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya'o/ /gal te rna ba rang bzhin gyis stong pa zhig ma yin na ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems 25—328

dpa' chen po yang bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang myi rgya ste/ rab 'byor gang gi phyir rna ba rang bzhin gyis stong pas na/ de'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rna ba rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar khong du chud par byas shing / bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya'o/ /gal te sna rang bzhin gyis stong pa zhig ma yin na ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po yang bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang myi rgya ste/ rab 'byor gang gi phyir sna rang bzhin gyis stong pas na/ de'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sna rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar khong du chud par byas shing / bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya'o/ /gal te lce rang bzhin gyis stong pa zhig ma yin na ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po yang bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang myi rgya ste/ rab 'byor gang gi phyir lce rang bzhin gyis stong pas na/ de'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po lce rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar khong du chud par byas shing / bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya'o/ /gal te lus rang bzhin gyis stong pa zhig ma yin na ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po yang bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang myi rgya ste/ rab 'byor gang gi phyir lus rang bzhin gyis stong pas na/ de'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po lus rang bzhin 25—329

gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar khong du chud par byas shing / bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya'o/ /gal te yid rang bzhin gyis stong pa zhig ma yin na ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po yang bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang myi rgya ste4)/ rab 'byor gang gi phyir yid rang bzhin gyis stong pas na/ de'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po yid rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar khong du chud par byas shing / bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya'o/ /gal te gzugs rang bzhin gyis stong pa zhig ma yin na ②ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ③bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang myi rgya ste/ rab 'byor gang gi phyir gzugs rang bzhin gyis stong pas na/ de'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gzugs rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar khong du chud par byas shing / bla na skyed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya'o/ /gal te sgra rang bzhin gyis stong pa zhig ma yin na ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po yang bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang myi rgya ste④/ rab 'byor gang gi phyir sgra rang bzhin gyis stong pas na/ de'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sgra rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar khong du chud par byas shing / bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'a/tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya'o/ /gal te dri rang bzhin gyis stong pa zhig ma yin na ni/ byang chub sems dpa' 25—330
