bsam gtan rnams sam/ tshad myed pa rnams sam/ gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams sam/ rnam par thar pa rnams sam/ ting nge 'dzin rnams sam/ mthar kyis ①gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams sam/de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams sam myi 'jigs pa rnams sam/ so so yang dag par rig pa rnams sam/ ②sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams sam/nyan thos kyi chos sam/ rang sangs rgyas kyi chos sam/ byang chub sems dpa'i chos sam/ sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams ②kyis sems can gyi 0don byed cing / sems can de dag gi ⑤bya ba byed de/ de la sems can ser sna can gang ji snyed pa de dag la 'di skad du chos ston tedu/ sbyin pa byin cig / phongs pa ni sdug bsngal ba ste/⑦ thongs pas ni bdag gi don kyang bya bar myi nus na/ gzhan gyi don lta ci smos kyisal/ de ltar khyed kyis sbyin pa byin la/bdag cag kyang bde bar gyis shig /gzhan yang bde bar gyis shig /phongs pas zil kyis non cing nying sha nying gis zos te/ ngan song gsum las myi thar bar gyur ta re zhes chos ston to/ /sems can tshul khrims ngan pa can gang ji snyed pa de dag la 'di skad du chos ston te/ kye skyes bu dag tshul khrims ngan pa ni sdug bsngal ba ste/ tshul khrims ngan pas ni bdag gi 0don kyang bya bar myi nus na/ gzhan gyi ⑩don lta ci smos te/ gang tshul khrims ngan pa'i rnam par spyin pa ni/ sems can dmyal ba'am/ byol song gi skye gnas sam/ gshin rje'i 'jig rten 7yin te/ de ltar khyed ngan song gsum du ltung tin/ bdag cag kyang gdon par myi nus na/ gzhan gdon par lta ci smos te⑩/ de'i phyir khyed kyis tshul khrims ngan pa'i sems 'ga' tsam gyi 0go skabs kyang myi dbye'o//25—676

phyis 'gyod pa can du gyur ta re zhes chos ston to/ /sems can phan tshun gnod sems su gyur pa gang ji snyed pa de dag la 'di skad du chos ston te/ de ltar khyed gcig ①la gcig gnod sems su ma byed cig /sems 'khrugs ②par gyur pa la dge ba'i chos gang yang skye ③bar myi 'gyur te/ de lta bas na khyed phan tshun sems 'khrug 0par gyur nadu/ sems can dmyal bar skye ba'am/byol song gi skye gnas su skye ba'am/ gshin rje'i 'jig rten du skye ba'i gnas yod kyisaX/ de bas na khyed kyis 'khrug ⑦pa'i sems 'ga' tsam gyi go skabs kyang myi dbye'o/ /phyis 'gyod pa can du gyur ta re zhes chos ston to/ /sems can le lo can gang ji snyed pa de dag la 'di skad du chos ston te/ kye skyes bu dag le lo ni sdug bsngal ba ste/ le los ni bdag gi don kyang bya bar myi nus na/gzhan gyi don lta ci smos te/ le lo'i rnam par sbyin pa ni sems can dmyal ba'am/ byol song gi skye gnas sam/ gshin rje'i 'jig rten yin te/ de ltar khyed ngan song gsum du lhung na/ bdag cag kyang gdon par myi nus na/gzhan gdon par lta ci smos kyisani/ de'i phyir khyed kyis 7le lo'i sems 'ga' tsam gyi go skabs kyang myi dbye'o/ /phyis 'gyod pa can du gyur ta re zhes chos ston to/ /sems can sems g.yeng ba gang ji snyed pa de dag la 'di skad du chos ston te/ kye skyes bu dag sems g.yeng ba ni sdug bsngal ba ⑩ste/ gang sems g.yeng ba'i rnam par sbyin pa ni sems can dmyal ba'am/ byol song gi skye gnas sam/ gshin rje'i 'jig rten yin te/ de ltar khyed ngan song gsum du lhung na/ bdag cag kyang gdon par myi nus na/ gzhan gdon par lta ci smos kyisayi/ de'i phyir khyed kyis g.yeng ba'i sems 'ga' tsam gyi 8go 25—677

skabs kyang myi dbye'o/ /phyis 'gyod pa can du gyur ta ①re zhes chos ston to/ /sems can shes rab 'chal pa can gang ji snyed pa de dag la 'di skad du chos ston te/ kye skyes bu dag shes rab 'chal pa ni sdug bsngal ba te②/ shes rab 'chal pas ni bdag gi don ①kyang bya bar myi nus na/ gzhan gyi don dulta ci smos te/ shes rab 'chal pa'i rnam par spyin pa ni/ sems can dmyal ba'am/byol song gi skye gnas sam/ gshin rje'i 'jig rten yin te/ de ltar khyed kyis ⑤shes rab 'chal pa'i sems 'ga' tsam gyi go skabs kyang myi dbye'o/ /phyis 'gyod pa can du gyur ta re zhes chos ston to/ /'dod chags kyi spyod pa can gang ji snyed pa de dag myi sdug pa la sbyor ro/ /zhe snang gi spyod pa can gang ji snyed pa de dag byams pa la sbyor ro/ /gti mug gi spyod pa can gang ji snyed pa de dag rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba la sbyor ro/ /lam ngan par zhugs pa dugang ji snyed pa de dag yang dag pa'i lam la sbyor te/ nyan thos kyi lam mam/rang sangs rgyas kyi lam mam/ sangs rgyas kyi lam la sbyor zhing de dag la 'di skad du chos ston te/ khyed chos gang la mngon par zhen par gyur pa'i ④chos de dag ni ngo bo nyid kyis stong ste/ ngo bo nyid kyis stong pa'i chos rnams la ni mngon par zhen par myi nus te/ stong pa nyid la mngon par zhen pa myed do zhes chos ston to/ /⑧rab 'byor de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ mngon par shes pa rnams la gnas shing / sems can rnams kyi 'don byed pa yin no// //shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyind pa stong phrag brgya pa/ /bam po nyi shu gnyis pabo / de lha'i myig rnam par dag pa myi las ⑩'das pa de nyid kyis/ steng 25—678

gi phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad mthong ste de de dag tu rdzu 'phrul gyis song zhing / sbyin pa 'am/ tshul khrims sam/ bzod pa 'am/ brtson 'grus sam/ bsam gtan nam/ shes rab bam/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams sam/ yang dag par spong ba rnams sam/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams sam / dbang po rnams sam/ stobs rnams sam/ byang chub kyi yan lag rnams sam/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa'am/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa 'am/bsam gtan rnams sam/ tshad myed pa rnams sam/ gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams sam/ rnam par thar pa rnams sam/ ting nge 'dzin rnams sam/ mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams sam/de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams sam/ myi 'jigs pa rnams sam/ so so yang dag par rig pa rnams sam/ ①sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams sam/nyan thos kyi chos sam/ rang sangs rgyas kyi chos sam/ byang chub sems dpa'i chos sam/ sangs rgyas kyi chos kyis sems can rnams kyi don byed cing /sems can de dag gi bya ba byed de/ de la sems can ser sna can gang ji snyed pa de dag la 'di skad du chos ston te/ sbyin pa byin cig /phongs pa ni sdug bsngal ba ste/ phongs pas ni bdag gi ②don kyang bya bar myi nus na/ gzhan gyi ①don lta ci smos kyisadu/ de ltar khyed kyis sbyin pa byin la bdag cag kyang bde bar gyis shig /gzhan yang bde bar gyis shig /phongs pas zil kyis non cing nying sha nying gis zos te/ ngan song gsum las myi thar bar gyur ta re zhes chos ston to/ /sems can tshul khrims ngan pa can gang ji snyed pa de dag 25—679

la 'di skad du chos ston te/ kye skyes bu dag tshul khrims ngan pa ni sdug bsngal ba ste/ tshul khrims ngan pas ni bdag gi ①don kyang bya bar myi nus na/gzhan gyi ②don lta ci smos te/ tshul khrims ngan pa'i rnam par sbyin pa ni/sems can dmyal ba 'am/ byol song gi skye gnas sam/ gshin rje'i 'jig rten yin te/ de ltar khyed ngan song gsum du ltung dun/ bdag cag kyang gdon par myi nus na/ gzhan gdon par lta ci smos kyisaX/ de'i phyir khyed kyis tshul khrims ngan pa'i sems 'ga' tsam gyi khrugo skabs kyang myi dbye'o/ /phyis 'gyod pa can du gyur ta re zhes chos ston to/ /sems can phan tshun gnod sems su gyur pa gang 0ji snyed pa de dag la 'di skad du chos ston te/ de ltar khyed gcig ⑦la gcig gnod sems su ma byed cig /sems 'khrugs ⑧par gyur pa la dge ba'i chos gang yang skye bar myi 'gyur te/ de lta bas na khyed phan tshun sems 'khrug ⑨par gyur na/ sems can dmyal bar skye ba'am/ byol song gi skye gnas su skye ba 'am/ gshin rje'i 'jig rten du skye ba'i gnas yod kyis0rka/ de bas na khyod kyis 'khrug ⑩pa'i sems 'ga' tsam gyi go skabs kyang myi dbye'o/ /phyis 'gyod pa can du gyur ta re zhes chos ston to/ /sems can le lo can gang ji snyed pa de dag la 'di skad du chos ston te/ kye skyes bu dag le lo ni sdug bsngal ba ste/ le los ni bdag gi don kyang bya bar myi nus na/gzhan gyi don lta ci smos te/ le lo'i rnam par sbyin pa ni/ sems can dmyal ba'am/ byol song gi skye gnas sam/ gshin rje'i 'jig rten yin te/ de ltar khyed ngan song gsum du lhung na/ bdag cag kyang gdon par myi nus na/gzhan gdon par lta ci smos kyis8/ de'i phyir khyod kyis le lo'i sems 'ga' 25—680

tsam gyi go skabs kyang myi dbye'o/ /phyis 'gyod pa can du gyur ta re zhes chos ston to①/ / sems can sems g.yeng ba gang ji snyed pa de dag la 'di skad du chos ston te/② kyi skyes bu dag sems g.yeng ba ni sdug bsngal ba ste / gang sems g.yeng ba'i rnam par sbyin pa ni sems can dmyal ba 'am/ byol song gi skye gnas sam/ gshin rje'i 'jig rten yin te/ de ltar khyed byangan song gsum du ltung ⑤na/ bdag cag kyang gdon par myi nus na/ gzhan gdon par lta ci smos kyisaX/ de'i phyir khyod ⑦kyis g.yeng ba'i sems 'ga' tsam gyi go skabs kyang myi dbye'o/ /phyis 'gyod pa can du gyur ta re zhes chos ston to/ /sems can shes rab 'chal pa can gang ji snyed pa de dag la 'di skad du chos ston te/ kye skyes bu dag shes rab 'chal pa ni sdug bsngal ba stedu/ shes rab 'chal pas ni bdag gi don kyang bya bar myi nus na/ gzhan gyi don lta ci smos te/gang shes rab 'chal pa'i rnam par sbyin pa ①ni/ sems can dmyal ba 'am/byol song gi skye gnas sam/ gshin rje'i 'jig rten yin te/ de ltar khyed kyis shes rab 'chal pa'i sems 'ga' tsam gyi go skabs kyang myi dbye'o/ /phyis 'gyod pa can du gyur ta re zhes chos ston to/ /'dod chags kyi spyod pa can gang ji snyed pa de dag ni myi sdug pa la sbyor ro/ /zhe snang gi spyod pa can gang ji snyed pa ⑩de dag ni byams pa la sbyor ro/ /gti mug gi spyod pa can gang ji snyed pa de dag ni rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba la 0sbyor ro/ /lam ngan par zhugs pa gang ji snyed pa de dag ni 8yang dag pa'i lam la sbyor te/ nyan thos kyi lam mam/ rang sangs rgyas kyi lam mam/ sangs rgyas kyi lam la sbyor zhing de dag la 'di skad du chos ston te/ khyed chog gang la mngon par zhen par gyur 25—681

pa'i chos de dag ni ngo bo nyid kyis stong ste/ ngo bo nyid kyis stong pa'i chos rnams la ①ni mngon par zhen par myi nus te②/ stong pa nyid la mngon par zhen pa med do zhes chos ston to/ /rab 'byor de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ mngon par shes pa rnams la gnas shing / sems can rnams kyi don byed pa yin no/ /rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos ni/ mngon par shes pa rnams la ma zhuganas par ④sems can rnams la chos bstan par myi nus te/lam gol bar zhugs pa'i sems can rnams kyang lam du gzud par ⑤phyi nus so//rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ bya 'dab stim myed pas ni/ nam mkha' la ⑦'gro bar myi nus so/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos kyang mngon par shes pa rnams la ma brten par sems can rnams la chos bstan dupar myi nus so/ /rab 'byor de lta bas na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos 0shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe / mngon par shes pa rnams mngon par bsgrub par bya ste/ de mngon par shes pa mngon par bsgrubs ⑩pa de dag gis/ sems can rnams kyi don ci bya bar dga' ba de bde bar byed do/ /des lha'i yimyig gis shar phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung 0gi bye ma snyed mthong ste/ de dag tu sems can gang ji snyed cig skyes pa de dag kyang mthong ngo / /de ltar mthong nas kyang rdzu 'phrul gyis de dag tu song zhing / sems can de dag gi sems sems kyis khong du chud par byas nas/ de dang mthun par sbyin pa'i gtam mam/ tshul khrims kyi gtam mam/ bzod pa'i gtam mam/ brtson 'grus kyi gtam mam/25—682

bsam gtan gyi gtam mam/ shes rab kyi gtam mam/ 'phags pa'i bden pa'i gtam mam/ 'byung ba'i gtam gyi bar du chos ston to/ /des lha'i myig gis lho phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed mthong ste/ de dag tu sems can gang ji snyed cig skyes pa de dag kyang mthong ngo / /de ltar mthong nas kyang rdzu 'phrul gyis de dag tu song zhing sems can de dag gi sems sems kyis khong du chud par byas nas༅/ de dang mthun par sbyin pa'i gtam mam / tshul khrims kyi gtam mam/ bzod pa'i gtam mam/ brtson 'grus kyi gtam mam/ bsam gtan gyi gtam mam/ shes rab kyi gtam mam/'phags pa'i bden pa'i gtam mam/ 'byung ba'i gtam gyi bar du chos ston to//des lha'i myig gis nub phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams/ gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed mthong ste/ de dag tu sems can gang ji snyed cig skyes pa de dag kyang mthong ngo / /de ltar mthong nas kyang rdzu 'phrul gyis de dag tu song zhing /sems can de dag gi ②sems sems kyis khong du chud par byas nas/ de dang mthun par sbyin pa'i gtam mam/ tshul khrims kyi chagatam mam/ bzod pa'i gtam mam/ brtson 'grus kyi gtam mam/ bsam gtan gyi gtam mam/shes rab kyi gtam mam/ 'phags pa'i bden pa'i gtam mam/ 'byung ba'i gtam gyi bar du chos ston to/ /des lha'i myig gis byang phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed mthong ste/ de dag tu sems can gang ji snyed cig skyes pa de dag kyang mthong ngo / /de ltar mthong nas kyang rdzu 'phrul gyis de dag tu song zhing / sems can de dag gi sems sems kyis khong du chud par byas nas/ de dang mthun par sbyin pa'i gtam mam/ tshul khrims kyi dugatam 25—683

mam / bzod pa'i gtam mam/ brtson 'grus kyi gtam mam/ bsam gtan gyi gtam mam/ shes rab kyi gtam mam/ 'phags pa'i bden pa'i gtam mam/ 'byung ba'i gtam gyi bar du chos ston to/ /des lha'i myig gis byang shar gyi phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed mthong ste/ de dag tu sems can gang ji snyed cig skyes pa de dag kyang mthong ngo //de ltar mthong nas kyang rdzu 'phrul gyis ①de dag tu song zhing / sems can de dag gi sems sems kyis khong du chud par byas nas/ de dang mthun par sbyin pa'i gtam mam/ tshul khrims kyi gtam mam/ bzod pa'i gtam mam/brtson 'grus kyi gtam mam/ bsam gtan gyi gtam mam/ shes rab kyi gtam mam/ 'phags pa'i bden pa'i gtam mam/ 'byung ba'i gtam gyi bar du chos ston to/ /des lha'i myig gis shar lho'i phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed mthong ste/ de dag tu sems can gang ji snyed cig skyes pa de dag kyang mthong ngo / /de ltar mthong nas kyang rdzu 'phrul gyis de dag tu song zhing / sems can de dag gi sems sems kyis khong du chud par byas nas/ de dang mthun par sbyin pa'i gtam mam/ tshul khrims kyi gtam mam/ bzod pa'i gtam mam/ brtson 'grus kyi gtam mam/bsam gtan gyi gtam mam/ shes rab kyi gtam mam/ 'phags pa'i bden pa'i gtam mam/ 'byung ba'i gtam gyi bar du chos ston to/ /des lha'i myig gis lho nub kyi phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed mthong ste/ de dag tu sems can gang ji snyed cig skyes pa de dag kyang mthong ngo //de ltar mthong nas kyang rdzu 'phrul gyis de dag tu song zhing / sems can de dag 25—684

gis ①sems sems kyis khong du chud par byas nas/ de dang mthun par sbyin pa'i gtam mam/ tshul khrims kyi gtam mam/ bzod pa'i gtam mam/brtson 'grus kyi gtam mam/ bsam gtan gyi gtam mam/ shes rab kyi gtam mam/ 'phags pa'i bden pa'i gtam mam/ 'byung ba'i gtam gyi bar du chos ston to/ /des lha'i myig gis nub byang gi phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed mthong ste/ de dag tu sems can gang ji snyed cig skyes pa de dag kyang mthong ngo / /de ltar mthong nas kyang rdzu 'phrul gyis de dag tu song zhing / sems can de dag gi sems sems kyis khong du chud par byas nas/ de dang mthun par sbyin pa'i gtam mam/ tshul khrims kyi gtam mam/ bzod pa'i gtam mam/ brtson 'grus kyi gtam mam/bsam gtan gyi gtam mam/ shes rab kyi gtam mam/ 'phags pa'i bden pa'i gtam mam/ 'byung ba'i gtam gyi bar du chos ston to/ /des lha'i myig gis ②'og gi niphyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed mthong ste/de dag tu sems can gang ji snyed cig skyes pa de dag kyang mthong ngo / /de ltar mthong nas kyang rdzu 'phrul gyis de dag tu song zhing / sems can de dag gi sems sems kyis khong du chud par byas nas/ de dang mthun par sbyin pa'i gtam mam/ tshul khrims kyi gtam mam/ bzod pa'i gtam mam/ brtson 'grus kyi dugatam mam/ bsam gtan gyi gtam mam/ shes rab kyi gtam mam/ 'phags pa'i bden pa'i gtam mam/ 'byung ba'i gtam gyi bar du chos ston to/ /des lha'i myig gis steng gi phyogs kyi 'jig ⑤ten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed mthong ste/ de dag tu sems can gang ji snyed cig skyes 25—685

pa de dag kyang mthong ngo / /de ltar mthong nas kyang rdzu 'phrul gyis de dag tu song zhing / sems can de dag gi sems sems kyis khong du chud par byas nas/de dang mthun par sbyin pa'i gtam mam/ tshul khrims kyi gtam mam/ bzod pa'i gtam mam/ brtson 'grus kyi gtam mam/ bsam gtan gyi gtam mam/ shes rab kyi gtam mam/① 'phags pa'i bden pa'i gtam mam/ 'byung ba'i gtam gyi bar du chos ston to/ /de ②lha'i rna ba'i khams kyis 'di lta ste/lha dang myi gnyis ku'i sgra yang thos te/ de shar phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang ji snyed cig chos ston pa de dag gi chos lha'i rna bas nyan te/ thos nas kyang de bzhin nyid du 'dzin to/ /de bzhin nyid du bzung nas/② de bzhin nyid du sems can rnams la chos ston torjo/ /sbyin pa'i gtam mam/ tshul khrims kyi gtam mam / bzod pa'i gtam mam/ brtson 'grus kyi gtam mam/ bsam gtan gyi gtam mam/ shes rab kyi gtam mam/ 'phags pa'i bden pa'i gtam mam/ 'byung ba'i gtam gyi bar du chos ston to/ /de lho phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang ji snyed cig chos ston pa de dag gi chos lha'i rna bas nyan te⑤/ thos nas kyang de bzhin nyid du 'dzin to/ /de bzhin nyid du bzung nas/ de bzhin nyid du sems can rnams la chos ston te/ sbyin pa'i gtam mam/tshul khrims kyi gtam mam/ bzod pa'i gtam mam/ brtson 'grus kyi gtam mam / bsam gtan gyi gtam mam/ shes rab kyi gtam mam/ 'phags pa'i bden pa'i gtam mam/ 'byung ba'i gtam gyi bar du chos ston to/ /de 25—686

nub phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang ji snyed cig chos ston pa de dag gi 0)chos lha'i rna bas nyan te/ thos nas kyang de bzhin nyid du 'dzin to/ /de bzhin nyid du bzung nas / de bzhin nyid du sems can rnams la chos ston te/ sbyin pa'i gtam mam / tshul khrims kyi gtam mam/ bzod pa'i gtam mam/ brtson 'grus kyi gtam mam/ bsam gtan gyi gtam mam/ shes rab kyi gtam mam/'phags pa'i bden pa'i gtam mam/ 'byung ba'i gtam ②gyi bar du chos ston to / /de byang phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang ji snyed cig chos ston pa de dag gi chos lha'i rna bas nyan te/ thos nas kyang de bzhin nyid du 'dzin to/ /de bzhin nyid du bzung nas/ de bzhin nyid du sems can rnams la chos ston te/ sbyin pa'i gtam mam/ tshul khrims kyi gtam mam/ bzod pa'i gtam mam/ brtson 'grus kyi gtam mam/ bsam gtan gyi gtam mam/ shes rab kyi gtam mam/'phags pa'i bden pa'i gtam mam/ 'byung ba'i gtam gyi (kyebar du chos ston to / /de ④byang shar gyi phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang ji snyed cig chos ston pa de dag gi chos lha'i rna bas nyan te(1/ thos nas kyang de bzhin nyid du 'dzin to//de bzhin nyid du bzung nas/ de bzhin nyid du sems can rnams la chos ston te / sbyin pa'i gtam mam/ tshul khrims kyi gtam mam/ bzod pa'i gtam mam/ brtson 'grus kyi gtam mam/ bsam gtan gyi gtam mam/shes rab kyi gtam mam/ 'phags pa'i bden pa'i gtam mam/ 'byung ba'i 25—687

gtam gyi bar du chos ston to/ /de ①shar lho'i phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang ji snyed cig chos ston pa de dag gi chos lha'i rna bas nyan te/ thos nas kyang de bzhin nyid du 'dzin to/ /de bzhin nyid du bzung nas/ de bzhin nyid du sems can rnams la chos ston te/ sbyin pa'i gtam mam/ tshul khrims kyi gtam mam/ bzod pa'i gtam mam/② brtson 'grus kyi gtam mam/bsam gtan gyi gtam mam/ shes rab kyi gtam mam/ 'phags pa'i bden pa'i gtam mam/ 'byung ba'i gtam gyi bar du chos ston to/ /de dulho nub kyi phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang ji snyed cig chos ston pa de dag gis 0chos lha'i rna bas nyan te⑤/ thos nas kyang de bzhin nyid du 'dzin to/ /de bzhin nyid du bzung nas/ de bzhin nyid du sems can rnams la chos ston te/sbyin pa'i gtam mam/ tshul khrims kyi gtam mam/ bzod pa'i gtam mam/brtson 'grus kyi gtam mam/ bsam gtan gyi gtam mam/ shes rab kyi gtam mam/ 'phags pa'i bden pa'i gtam mam/ 'byung ba'i gtam gyi bar du chos ston to/ /de nub byang gi phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang ji snyed cig chos ston pa de dag gi chos lha'i rna bas nyan te/ thos nas kyang de bzhin nyid du 'dzin to/ /de bzhin nyid du bzung nas/ de bzhin nyid du sems can rnams la chos ston te/ sbyin pa'i gtam mam/ tshul khrims kyi gtam mam/bzod pa'i gtam mam/ brtson 'grus kyi gtam mam/ bsam gtan gyi 25—688

gtam mamanyu/ shes rab kyi gtam mam/ 'phags pa'i bden pa'i gtam mam/'byung ba'i gtam gyi bar du chos ②ston to/ /de 'og ①gi phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang ji snyed cig chos ston pa de dag gi chos lha'i rna bas nyan te/ thos nas kyang de bzhin nyid du 'dzin to/ /de bzhin nyid du bzung nas/ de bzhin nyid du sems can rnams la chos ston te④/ sbyin pa'i gtam mam/ tshul khrims kyi gtam mam/ bzod pa'i gtam mam/ brtson 'grus kyi gtam mam/bsam gtan gyi gtam mam/ shes rab kyi gtam mam/ 'phags pa'i bden pa'i gtam mam/ 'byung ba'i gtam gyi bar du chos ston to/ /de steng gi phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang ji snyed cig chos ston pa de dag gi chos lha'i rna bas nyan te/thos nas kyang de bzhin nyid du 'dzin to/ /de bzhin nyid du bzung nas/ de bzhin nyid du sems can rnams la chos ston te0/ sbyin pa'i gtam mam/tshul khrims kyi gtam mam/ bzod pa'i gtam mam/ brtson 'grus kyi gtam mam/ bsam gtan gyi gtam mam/ shes rab kyi gtam mam/ 'phags pa'i bden pa'i gtam mam/ 'byung ba'i gtam gyi bar du chos ston to/ /de sems kyi rnam grangs shes pa shin tu rnam par dag pa dang ldan pa yin te/ de sems kyi rnam grangs shes pa rjodes sems can rnams kyi sems shes par byas shing / de dag la de bzhin nyid du chos ston te⑦/ ca sbyin pa'i gtam mam/tshul khrims kyi gtam mam/ bzod pa'i gtam mam/ brtson 'grus kyi gtam mam/ bsam gtan gyi gtam mam/ shes rab kyi gtam mam/ 'phags 25—689

pa'i bden pa'i gtam mam/ 'byung ba'i gtam gyi bar du chos ston to/ /de bdag gam gzhan gyi sngon gyi gnas rnam pa du mar ②rjes su dran te/ sngon gyi gnas rjes su dran pa'i shes pa des/ sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mtshan ②'di zhes bya ba nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa byung ngo zhes bya bar yang shes te/ sems can sngon gyi gnas rjes su dran pa la mos pa gang ji snyed pa de dag la yang dag pa ②nyid du chos ston te④/ sbyin pa'i gtam mam/ tshul khrims kyi gtam mam/ /bzod pa'i gtam mam/ brtson 'grus kyi gtam mam/ bsam gtan gyi gtam mam/shes rab kyi gtam mam/ 'phags pa'i bden pa'i gtam mam/ 'byung ba'i gtam gyi bar du chos ston to/ /de ༅rdzu 'phrul gyis phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag tu song zhing / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la bsnyen bkur byed de/ bsnyen bkur byas nas/ mngon par shes pa'i ye shes kyis sems can ⑨rnams la chos ston te/ sbyin pa'i gtam mam/tshul khrims kyi gtam mam/ bzod pa'i gtam mam/ brtson 'grus kyi gtam mam / bsam gtan gyi gtam mam/ shes rab kyi gtam mam/ 'phags pa'i bden pa'i gtam mam/ 'byung ba'i gtam gyi bar du chos ston to/ /de zag pa myed pa mngon du bya ba'i shes pa shin tu rnam par dag pa dang ldan pa yin te / de zag pa myed pa mngon du bya ba'i shes pa shin tu rig pa des sems can rnams la chos ston te/ sbyin pa'i gtam mam/ tshul khrims kyi gtam mam/bzod pa'i gtam mam/ brtson 'grus kyi gtam mam/ bsam gtan gyi gtam mam/ shes rab kyi gtam mam/ 'phags pa'i bden pa'i gtam mam/25—690

'byung ba'i gtam gyi bar du chos ston to/ /rab 'byor de ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/mngon par shes pa rnams mngon par bsgrub par bya ste༅/ de mngon ②par shes pa shin tu 'dris pa de dag gis lus ci dang ci (kyelta bu yongs su gzung babar 'dod pa de dang de lta bu'i lus yongs su gzung ⑤zhing mos pa ji lta ba bzhin du sems can rnams kyi don byed cing ⑥bde ba'am/ sdug bsngal ba ⑦de dag gis gos par myi 'gyur ro/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dudaper na/ de bzhin gshegs pas 0sprul pa'i skyes bu ni/ dgos pa thams cad byed kyang bde ba'am/sdug bsngal ba ⑩des gos par 'gyur ba myed do/ /rab 'byor rshatshede bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la gnas shing / mngon par shes pas rnam par rtse zhing phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag tu mos pa ji lta ba bzhin du chos ston kyang bde ba'am/ sdug bsngal ba hunyedes srogs phonyepar myi 'gyur ro/ /rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ de ltar mngon par shes pas/ rnam par brtse ④bar bya ste0/ci nas kyang sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag par 'gyur ba dang / sems can yongs su sbyin par 'gyur ba de ltar brtse ⑩bar bya sten tsho/ rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos ni/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag par ma byas8/ sems can 7yongs su sbyin par ma byas par/ bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ( )bar myi nus so/ /rab 'byor de ci'i phyir zhe na/ lam gyi yan lag dang myi ldan pa'i 25—691

byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po la/ bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub myed do/ /rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po lam gyi yan lag yongs su rdzogs par bgyis shing / bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ①bar 'gyur ba'i lam gyi yan lag ②de dag gang lags / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor dge ba'i chos thams cad ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i lam gyi yan lag go/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das lam gyi yan lag gang gis③/ bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par du'atshang rgya bar 'gyur ba'i lam gyi yan lag rjodage ba'i chos de dag gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sems dang po bskyed pa nas nye bar bzung ste/dge ba'i chos sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod kyang / de la myi rtog cing de yongs su gtong ba'i tshe/ ngo bo nyid kyis ༷stong pa nyid kyi ⑦phyir 'di ni sbyin pa'o / /'di la yongs su gtang dubar bya'o/ /bdag gis ①sbyin par bya'o zhes gsum po de dag la myi rtog pa ste sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa gang gis bdag kyang 'khor ba las sgrol zhing / gzhan yang sgrol ba 'di ni lam gyi yan lag dge ba'i chos so/ /sems dang po bskyed pa nas nye bar bzung ste/ dge ba'i chos tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod kyang de la myi rtog cing / de tho)tshul khrims srung ba'i 0tshe/ ngo bo nyid kyis 8stong pa nyid kyi phyir 'di ni tshul khrims sol/ /bdag gis 4)tshul khrims bsrung yingo / /'di'i don du tshul khrims bsrung ngo / /zhes gsum po de dag la myi rtog pa ste/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu 25—692

phyin pa gang gis bdag kyang 'khor ba las sgrol zhing / gzhan yang sgrol ba 'di ni lam gyi yan lag dge ba'i chos so/ /sems dang po bskyed pa nas nye bar bzung ste/ dge ba'i chos bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod kyang de la myi rtog cing ①/ ②bzod pa sgom pa'i tshe/ ngo bo nyid kyis ③stong pa nyid kyi phyir 'di ni bzod pa'o/ /bdag gis dubazod pa bsgom dumo/ /'di'i don du bzod pa bsgom 0par bya'o/ /zhes gsum po de dag la myi rtog pa ste/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa gang gis bdag kyang 'khor ba las sgrol zhing / gzhan yang sgrol ba 'di ni lam gyi yan lag dge ba'i chos so/ /sems dang po bskyed pa nas nye bar bzung ste/ dge ba'i chos brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod kyang de la myi rtog cing / dubartson 'grus rtsom ⑧pa'i tshe/ ngo bo nyid kyis ⑨stong pa nyid kyi phyir 'di ni brtson 'grus so/ /bdag gis brtson 'grus brtsam mo/ /'di'i don du brtson 'grus brtsam par bya'otu nye/ /zhes gsum po de dag la myi rtog pa ⑩ste/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gang gis bdag kyang 'khor ba las sgrol zhing / gzhan yang sgrol ba 'di ni lam gyi yan lag dge ba'i chos so/ /sems dang po bskyed pa nas nye bar bzung ste/ dge ba'i chos bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod kyang de la myi rtog cing / de bsam gtan la mnyam par gzhog pa'i tshe/ ngo bo nyid kyis phonyestong pa nyid kyi phyir/'di ni bsam gtan no/ /8bdag gis bsam gtan la mnyam par gzhag go/ /'di'i don du bsam gtan la mnyam par gzhag go zhes gsum po de dag la myi rtog pa ste/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa gang gis ④bdag kyang 'khor ba las sgrol zhing / gzhan yang sgrol ba 'di ni lam gyi yan lag dge ba'i chos so/ /25—693

sems dang po bskyed pa nas nye bar bzung ste/ dge ba'i chos ①shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod kyang / de la myi rtog cing de ②shis rab sgom ②pa'i tshe/ngo bo nyid kyis ④stong pa nyid kyi phyir 'di ni shes rab bo/ /bdag gis ni ⑤shes rab bsgom ⑥me/ /'di'i don du shes rab bsgom ⑦mo zhes gsum po de dag la myi rtog pa ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gang gis bdag kyang 'khor ba las sgrol zhing / gzhan yang sgrol ba 'di ni lam gyi yan lag dge ba'i chos so/ /sems dang po bskyed pa nas nye bar bzung ste/ dge ba'i chos nang stong pa nyid la spyod kyang de la myi rtog cing / nang stong pa nyid sgom pa'i tshe/ ngo bo nyid kyis ②stong pa nyid kyi phyir 'di ni nang stong pa nyid do/ /bdag gis nang stong pa nyid bsgom par bya'o/ /'di'i don du nang stong pa nyid bsgom mo zhes gsum po de dag la myi rtog pa ste/ nang stong pa nyid gang gis bdag kyang 'khor ba las sgrol zhing / gzhan yang sgrol ba 'di ni lam gyi yan lag dge ba'i chos so/ /sems dang po bskyed pa nas nye bar bzung ste/ dge ba'i chos phyi stong pa nyid la spyod kyang de la myi rtog cing / phyi stong pa nyid sgom pa'i tshe/ ngo bo nyid kyis ⑨stong pa nyid kyi phyir 'di ni phyi stong pa nyid do/ /bdag gis phyi stong pa nyid bsgom par bya'o/ /'di'i don du phyi stong pa nyid bsgom mo zhes gsum po de dag la myi rtog pa ste/ phyi stong pa nyid gang gis bdag kyang 'khor ba las sgrol zhing /gzhan yang sgrol ba 'di ni lam gyi yan lag dge ba'i chos so/ /sems dang po bskyed pa nas nye bar bzung ste/ dge ba'i chos phyi nang stong pa nyid la spyod kyang de mel myi rtog cing / phyi nang stong pa nyid sgom pa'i tshe/ ngo bo nyid kyis 7stong pa nyid kyi phyir 'di ni phyi nang stong pa nyid do/ /bdag gis tsophyi nang stong pa 25—694

nyid bsgom par bya'o/ /'di'i don du phyi nang stong pa nyid bsgom mo zhes gsum po de dag la myi rtog pa ste/ phyi nang stong pa nyid gang gis bdag kyang 'khor ba las sgrol zhing / gzhan yang sgrol ba 'di ni lam gyi yan lag dge ba'i chos so/ /sems dang po bskyed ①pa nas nye bar bzung ste/ dge ba'i chos stong pa nyid stong pa nyid ②la spyod kyang de la myi rtog cing / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid 0sgom pa'i tshe/ ngo bo nyid kyis ④stong pa nyid kyi phyir 'di ni stong pa nyid stong pa nyid ⑤do / /bdag gis stong pa nyid stong pa nyid bsgom par bya'o/ /⑥'di'i don du stong pa nyid stong pa nyid bsgom mo/ /zhes gsum po de dag la myi rtog pa ste/stong pa nyid stong pa nyid gang gis bdag kyang 'khor ba las sgrol zhing / gzhan yang sgrol ba 'di ni lam gyi yan lag dge ba'i chos so/ /sems dang po bskyed pa nas nye bar bzung ste/ dge ba'i chos chen po stong pa nyid la spyod kyang de la myi rtog cing / chen po stong pa nyid sgom pa'i tshe/ ngo bo nyid kyis ⑦stong pa nyid kyi phyir 'di ni chen po stong pa nyid do/ /bdag gis chen po stong pa nyid bsgom par bya'o/ /'di'i don du chen po stong pa nyid bsgom mo zhes gsum po de dag la myi rtog pa ste/ chen po stong pa nyid gang gis bdag kyang la'akhor ba las sgrol zhing / gzhan yang sgrol ba 'di ni lam gyi yan lag dge ba'i chos so/ /sems dang po bskyed ⑨pa nas nye bar bzung ste/ dge ba'i chos don dam pa stong pa nyid la spyod kyang de la myi rtog cing / don dam pa stong pa nyid bsgom ⑫pa'i tshe/ ngo bo nyid kyis hunyestong pa nyid kyi phyir/ 'di ni don dam pa stong pa nyid do/ /bdag gis don dam pa stong pa nyid bsgom 8par bya'o/ /'di'i don du don dam pa stong pa nyid bsgom mo zhes gsum po de dag la myi rtog pa ste/25—695

don dam pa stong pa nyid gang gis bdag kyang 'khor ba las sgrol zhing / gzhan yang sgrol ba 'di ni lam gyi yan lag dge ba'i chos so/ /sems dang po bskyed pa nas nye bar bzung ste/ dge ba'i chos 'dus byas stong pa nyid la spyod kyang de la myi rtog cing / 'dus byas stong pa nyid sgom pa'i tshe/ ngo bo nyid kyis nyustong pa nyid kyi phyir 'di ni 'dus byas stong pa nyid do/ /bdag gis 'dus byas stong pa nyid bsgom par bya'o/ /'di'i don du 'dus byas stong pa nyid bsgom mo zhes gsum po de dag la myi rtog pa ste/ 'dus byas stong pa nyid gang gis bdag kyang 'khor ba las sgrol zhing / gzhan yang sgrol ba 'di ni lam gyi yan lag dge ba'i chos so/ /sems dang po bskyed pa nas nye bar bzung ste/ dge ba'i chos 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid la spyod kyang / de la myi rtog cing / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid sgom pa'i tshe/ ngo bo nyid kyis ②stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ 'di ni 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid do/ /bdag gis ②'dus ma byas stong pa nyid bsgom par bya'o/ /'di'i don du 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid sgom 0mo zhes gsum po de dag la myi rtog pa ste/ 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid gang gis bdag kyang 'khor ba las sgrol zhing / gzhan yang sgrol ba 'di ni lam gyi duyan lag dge ba'i chos so//sems dang po dubaskyed pa nas nye bar bzung ste/ dge ba'i chos mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid la spyod kyang de la myi rtog cing / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid sgom pa'i tshe/ ngo bo nyid kyis ⑦stong pa nyid kyi phyir 'di ni mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid do/ /bdag gis ⑧mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid bsgom par bya'o/ /'di'i don du mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid bsgom mo zhes gsum po de dag la myi rtog pa ⑨ste/ mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid/25—696

gang gis bdag kyang 'khor ba las sgrol zhing gzhan yang sgrol ba 'di ni lam gyi yan lag dge ba'i chos so/ /sems dang po bskyed pa nas nye bar bzung ste/dge ba'i chos thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid la spyod kyang / de la myi rtog cing / thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid bsgom ①pa'i tshe/ ngo bo nyid kyis ②stong pa nyid kyi phyir 'di ni thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid do/ /bdag gis thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid bsgom ①par bya'o/ /'di'i don du thog ma dang tha ma skyed pa stong pa nyid bsgom mo zhes gsum po de dag la myi rtog pa 0ste/ thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid gang gis bdag ༅kyang 'khor ba las sgrol zhing / gzhan yang sgrol ba 'di ni lam gyi yan lag dge ba'i chos so/ /sems dang po bskyed pa nas nye bar bzung ste/ dge ba'i chos dor ba skyed pa stong pa dunyid la spyod kyang de la myi rtog cing / dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid bsgom ⑦pa'i tshe/ ngo bo nyid kyis 0stong pa nyid kyi khyaphyir/ 'di ni dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid do/ /bdag gis dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid bsgom par bya'o/ /'di'i don du dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid bsgom mo zhes gsum po de dag la myi rtog pa ⑩ste/ dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid gang gis bdag kyang 'khor ba las sgrol zhing / gzhan yang sgrol ba 'di ni lam gyi yan lag dge ba'i chos so//sems dang po bskyed pa nas nye bar bzung ste/ dge ba'i chos rang bzhin stong pa nyid la spyod kyang / de la myi rtog cing / rang bzhin stong pa nyid sgom tunyepa'i tshe/ ngo bo nyid kyis 8stong pa nyid kyi phyir 'di ni rang bzhin stong pa nyid do//bdag gis rang bzhin stong pa nyid bsgom par bya'o/ /'di'i don du rang bzhin stong pa nyid bsgom mo zhes gsum po de dag la myi rtog pa ste/ rang bzhin 25—697

stong pa nyid gang gis bdag kyang 'khor ba las sgrol zhing / gzhan yang sgrol ba 'di ni lam gyi yan lag drage ba'i chos so/ /sems dang po bskyed pa nas nye bar bzung ste/ dge ba'i chos chos ①thams cad stong pa nyid la spyod kyang de la myi rtog cing / chos thams cad stong pa nyid sgom ②pa'i tshe/ ngo bo nyid kyis ②stong pa nyid kyi phyir 'di ni chos thams cad stong pa nyid do/ /bdag gis mechos thams cad stong pa nyid bsgom ⑤par bya'o/ /'di'i don du chos thams cad stong pa nyid bsgom stimo zhes gsum po de ⑦dag la myi rtog pa ⑧ste/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid gang gis bdag kyang 'khor ba las sgrol zhing / gzhan yang sgrol ba 'di ni lam gyi yan lag dge ba'i chos so/ /sems dang po bskyed pa nas nye bar bzung ste/ dge ba'i chos rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid la spyod kyang / de la myi rtog cing / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid sgom ⑨pa'i tshe/ngo bo nyid kyis 0stong pa nyid kyi phyir 'di ni rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid do/ /bdag gis rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid bsgom par bya'o/ /'di'i don du rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid bsgom mo zhes gsum po de dag la myi rtog pa ste/rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid gang gis bdag kyang 'khor ba las sgrol zhing /gzhan yang sgrol ba 'di ni lam gyi yan lag dge ba'i chos so/ /sems dang po bskyed pa nas nye bar bzung ste/ dge ba'i chos myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid la spyod kyang / de la myi rtog cing / myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid sgom 7pa'i tshe/ngo bo nyid kyis hunyestong pa nyid kyi phyir 'di ni myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid do/ /bdag gis myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid bsgom 0par bya'o/ /'di'i don du myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid bsgom mo zhes gsum po de dag la myi rtog pa ste/ myi 25—698

dmyigs pa stong pa nyid gang gis bdag kyang 'khor ba las sgrol zhing / gzhan yang sgrol ba 'di ni lam ①gyi yan lag dge ba'i chos so/ /sems dang po bskyed pa nas nye bar bzung ste/ dge ba'i chos dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid la spyod kyang de la myi rtog cing / dngos po myed pa ②stong pa nyid sgom zhupa'i tshe ngo bo nyid kyis dustong pa nyid kyi phyir/ 'di ni dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid do/ /bdag gis dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid bsgom par bya'o/ /'di'i don du dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid bsgom mo zhes gsum po de dag la myi rtog pa ste/dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid gang gis bdag kyang 'khor ba las sgrol zhing /gzhan yang sgrol ba 'di ni lam gyi yan lag dge ba'i chos so/ /sems dang po bskyed pa nas nye bar bzung ste/ dge ba'i chos ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid la spyod kyang de la myi rtog cing / ngo bo nyid ⑤stong pa nyid sgom pa'i tshe/ ngo bo nyid kyis ༅stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ 'di ni ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid do/ /bdag gis ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid bsgom ⑦par bya'o/ /'di'i don du ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid bsgom mo zhes gsum po de dag la myi rtog ⑧pa ste/ ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid gang gis bdag kyang 'khor ba las sgrol zhing / gzhan yang sgrol ba 'di ni lam gyi yan lag dge ba'i chos so/ /sems dang po bskyed pa nas nye bar bzung ste/dge ba'i chos dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid la spyod kyang de la myi rtog cing / dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid sgom pa'i tshe/ ngo bo nyid kyis ⑨stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ 'di ni dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid do//bdag gis dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid bsgom rkyu )par bya'o/ /'di'i don du dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid bsgom 0mo zhes gsum po 25—699

de dag la myi rtog pa ①ste/ dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid gang gis bdag kyang 'khor ba las sgrol zhing / gzhan yang sgrol ba 'di ni lam gyi yan lag dge ba'i chos so/ /sems dang po bskyed pa nas nye bar bzung ste/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i dge ba'i chos dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi la spyod kyang de la myi rtog cing / dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams sgom ②pa'i tshe/ ngo bo nyid kyis ②stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ 'di dag ni dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams so/ /bdag gis dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams bsgom par bya'o / /'di'i don du dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams bsgom mo zhes gsum po de dag la myi rtog pa ste/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa gang gis bdag kyang 'khor ba las sgrol zhing / gzhan yang sgrol ba 'di ni lam gyi yan lag dge ba'i chos so//sems dang po bskyed pa nas nye bar bzung ste/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i ④dge ba'i chos yang dag par spong ba bzhi la spyod kyang de la myi rtog cing yang dag par spong ba rnams sgom dupa'i tshe/ ngo bo nyid kyis dustong pa nyid kyi phyir/ 'di dag ni yang dag par spong ba rnams so/ /bdag gis yang dag par spong ba rnams bsgom par bya'o/ /'di'i don du yang dag par spong ba rnams bsgom ༅mo zhes gsum po de dag la myi rtog pa ste/ yang dag par spong ba gang gis bdag kyang 'khor ba las sgrol zhing / gzhan yang sgrol ba 'di ni lam gyi yan lag dge ba'i chos so/ /sems dang po bskyed pa nas nye bar bzung ste/byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i dge ba'i chos rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi la spyod kyang / de la myi rtog cing / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi sgom ⑧pa'i tshe / ngo bo nyid kyis ⑨stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ 'di dag ni rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa 25—700

rnams so/ /bdag gis rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams bsgom par bya'o/ /'di'i don du rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams bsgom mo zhes gsum po de dag la myi rtog pa ste/rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa gang gis bdag kyang 'khor ba las sgrol zhing / gzhan yang sgrol ba 'di ni lam gyi yan lag dge ba'i chos so/ /sems dang po bskyed pa nas nye bar bzung ste/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i dge ba'i chos dbang po lnga la spyod kyang de la myi rtog cing / dbang po lnga sgom ①pa'i tshe/ngo bo nyid kyis ②stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ 'di dag ni dbang po rnams so/ /bdag gis dbang po rnams bsgom par bya'o/ /'di'i don du dbang po rnams bsgom mo zhes gsum po de dag la myi rtog pa ste/ dbang po gang gis bdag kyang 'khor ba las sgrol zhing / gzhan yang sgrol ba 'di ni lam gyi yan lag dge ba'i chos so/ /sems dang po bskyed pa nas nye bar bzung ste/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i dge ba'i chos stobs lnga la spyod kyang / de la myi rtog cing / stobs rnams sgom ②pa'i tshe/ ngo bo nyid kyis stong pa ༷nyid kyi phyir/ 'di dag ni stobs rnams so/ /bdag gis stobs rnams bsgom par bya'o/ /'di'i don du stobs rnams bsgom dumo zhes gsum po de dag la myi rtog pa ste/ stobs gang gis bdag kyang 'khor ba las sgrol zhing / gzhan yang sgrol ba 'di ni lam gyi yan lag dge ba'i chos so/ /sems dang po bskyed pa dunas nye bar bzung ste/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i dge ba'i chos byang chub kyi yan lag bdun la spyod kyang / de la ciphyi rtog cing /byang chub kyi yan lag rnams sgom ⑦pa'i tshe/ ngo bo nyid kyis ༷stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ 'di dag ni byang chub kyi yan lag rnams so/ /bdag gis byang chub 25—701

kyi yan lag rnams bsgom par bya'o/ /'di'i don du byang chub kyi yan lag rnams bsgom mo zhes gsum po de dag la myi rtog pa ste/ byang chub kyi yan lag gang gis bdag kyang 'khor ba las sgrol zhing gzhan yang sgrol ba 'di ni lam gyi yan lag dge ba'i chos so/ /sems dang po bskyed pa nas nye bar bzung ste/byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i dge ba'i chos 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa la spyod kyang / de la myi rtog cing 'phags pa'i lam ①yan lag brgyad pa sgom ②pa'i tshe/ ngo bo nyid kyis ②stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ 'di ni 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa'o/ /bdag gis du'aphags pa'i lam yan lag (gebargyad pa bsgom par bya'o/ /'di'i don du 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa bsgom mo zhes gsum po de dag la myi rtog pa ste/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa gang gis bdag kyang 'khor ba las sgrol zhing / gzhan yang sgrol ba 'di ni lam gyi yan lag dge ba'i chos so/ /sems dang po bskyed pa nas nye bar bzung ste/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i dge ba'i chos (nya'aphags pa'i bden pa bzhi la spyod kyang de la myi rtog cing / 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams sgom pa'i tshe/ ngo bo nyid kyis ⑦stong pa nyid kyi phyir/'di dag ni 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams so/ /bdag gis 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams bsgom par bya'o/ /'di'i don du 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams bsgom mo zhes gsum po de dag la myi rtog pa ste/ 'phags pa'i bden pa gang gis bdag kyang 'khor ba las sgrol zhing / gzhan yang sgrol ba 'di ni lam gyi yan lag dge ba'i chos so/ /sems dang po bskyed pa nas nye bar bzung ste/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i dge ba'i chos bsam gtan bzhi la spyod 25—702

kyang de la myi rtog cing / bsam gtan rnams sgom ①pa'i tshe/ ngo bo nyid kyis ②stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ 'di dag ni bsam gtan rnams so/ /bdag gis bsam gtan rnams bsgom ②par bya'o/ /'di'i don du bsam gtan rnams bsgom mo/ /zhes gsum po de dag la myi rtog pa ste/ bsam gtan gang gis bdag kyang 'khor ba las sgrol zhing / gzhan yang sgrol ba 'di ni lam gyi yan lag dge ba'i chos so/ /sems dang po bskyed pa nas nye bar bzung ste/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i dge ba'i chos tshad skyed pa bzhi la spyod kyang de la myi rtog cing / tshad myed pa rnams sgom ④pa'i tshe/ ngo bo nyid kyis ⑤stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ 'di dag ni tshad myed pa rnams so/ /bdag gis tshad myed pa rnams bsgom par bya'o/ /'di'i don du tshad myed pa rnams bsgom mo zhes gsum po de dag la myi rtog pa ste/ tshad myed pa gang gis bdag kyang 'khor ba las sgrol zhing / gzhan yang sgrol ba 'di ni lam gyi yan lag dge ba'i chos so /sems dang po bskyed pa nas nye bar bzung ste/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i dge ba'i chos gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa bzhi la spyod kyang / de la myi rtog cing / gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams sgom ⑥pa'i tshe/ ngo bo nyid kyis ⑦stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ 'di dag ni gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams so/ /bdag gis gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams bsgom par bya'o/ /'di'i don du gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams bsgom mo zhes gsum po de dag la myi rtog pa ste/gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa gang gis bdag kyang 'khor ba las sgrol zhing / gzhan yang sgrol ba 'di ni lam ④gyi yan lag dge ba'i chos so/ /25—703

sems dang po bskyed pa nas nye bar bzung ste/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i dge ba'i chos rnam ①par thar pa brgyad la spyod kyang / de la myi rtog cing / rnam par thar pa brgyad sgom ②pa'i tshe/ ngo bo nyid kyis ③stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ 'di dag ni rnam par thar pa brgyad do/ /bdag gis rnam par thar pa brgyad bsgom par bya'o/ /'di'i don du rnam par thar pa brgyad bsgom mo zhes gsum po de dag la myi rtog pa ste/ rnam par thar pa brgyad gang gis bdag kyang 'khor ba las sgrol zhing / gzhan yang sgrol ba 'di ni lam gyi yan lag dge ba'i chos so/ /sems dang po bskyed pa nas nye bar bzung ste/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i dge ba'i chos mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu la spyod kyang de la myi rtog cing / mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams sgom 0pa'i tshe/ ngo bo nyid kyis ⑤stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ 'di dag 0ni mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams so/ /bdag gis mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams bsgom ⑦par bya'o//'di'i don du mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams bsgom dumo zhes gsum po de dag la myi rtog pa ste/ mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa gang gis bdag kyang 'khor ba las sgrol zhing / gzhan yang sgrol ba 'di ni lam gyi yan lag dge ba'i chos so/ /sems dang po bskyed pa nas nye bar bzung ste/byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i dge ba'i chos rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa la spyod kyang de la myi rtog cing / rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa sgom pa'i tshe/ ngo bo nyid kyis ⑨stong pa nyid kyi phyir/25—704

'di dag ①ni rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang /smon pa myed pa'o/ /bdag gis rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang /mtshan ma skyed pa dang / smon pa myed pa bsgom par bya'o/ /'di'i don du rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa skyed pa bsgom mo zhes gsum po de dag la myi rtog pa ste/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa gang gis bdag kyang 'khor ba las sgrol zhing / gzhan yang sgrol ba 'di ni lam gyi yan lag dge ba'i chos so/ /sems dang po bskyed pa nas nye bar bzung ste/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i dge ba'i chos mngon par shes pa rnams la spyod kyang de la myi rtog cing / mngon par shes pa rnams sgom ②pa'i tshe ngo bo nyid kyis ②stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ 'di dag ni mngon par shes pa rnams so/ /bdag gis mngon par shes pa rnams bsgom par bya'o/ /'di'i don du mngon par shes pa rnams bsgom mo zhes gsum po de dag la myi rtog pa ste/ mngon par shes pa gang gis bdag kyang 'khor ba las sgrol zhing / gzhan yang sgrol ba 'di ni lam gyi yan lag dge ba'i chos so/ /sems dang po bskyed pa nas nye bar bzung ste/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i dge ba'i chos ting nge 'dzin rnams la spyod kyang de la myi rtog cing / ting nge 'dzin rnams sgom ④pa'i tshe / ngo bo nyid kyis ⑤stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ 'di dag ni ting nge 'dzin rnams so/ /bdag gis ting nge 'dzin rnams bsgom par bya'o/ /'di'i don du ting nge 'dzin rnams bsgom mo zhes gsum po de dag la myi rtog pa ste/ ting nge 'dzin gang gis bdag kyang 'khor ba las sgrol zhing / gzhan yang sgrol ba 25—705

'di ni lam gyi yan lag dge ba'i chos so/ /sems dang po bskyed pa nas nye bar bzung ste/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i dge ba'i chos gzungs kyi sgo rnams la spyod kyang de la myi rtog cing / gzungs kyi sgo rnams bsgom ①pa'i tshe/ ngo bo nyid kyis (0stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ 'di dag ni gzungs kyi sgo rnams so/ /bdag gis gzungs kyi sgo rnams bsgom par bya'o/ /'di'i ②don du gzungs kyi sgo rnams bsgom mo zhes gsum po de dag la myi rtog pa ste/gzungs kyi sgo gang gis bdag kyang 'khor ba las sgrol zhing / gzhan yang sgrol ba 'di ni lam gyi yan lag dge ba'i chos so/ /sems dang po bskyed pa nas nye bar bzung ste/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i dge ba'i chos de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu la spyod kyang ④de la myi rtog cing / de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu sgom (shepa'i tshe/ ngo bo nyid kyis stistong pa nyid kyi phyir/'di dag ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams so/ /bdag gis de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu bsgom par bya'o/ /'di'i don du de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu bsgom mo zhes gsum po de dag la myi rtog pa ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs gang gis bdag kyang 'khor ba las sgrol zhing gzhan yang sgrol ba 'di ni lam gyi yan lag dge ba'i chos so/ /sems dang po bskyed pa nas nye bar bzung ste/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i dge ba'i chos myi 'jigs pa rnams la spyod kyang de (77la myi rtog cing / myi 'jigs pa rnams sgom ⑤pa'i tshe/ ngo bo nyid kyis (1)stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ 'di dag ni myi 'jigs pa rnams so/ /bdag gis myi 'jigs pa rnams bsgom par bya'o/ /'di'i don du myi 'jigs pa rnams bsgom mo zhes gsum po de dag la myi rtog pa ste/ myi 25—706

'jigs pa gang gis bdag kyang 'khor ba las sgrol zhing / gzhan yang sgrol ba 'di ni lam gyi yan lag dge ba'i chos so/ /sems dang po bskyed pa nas nye bar bzung ste/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i dge ba'i chos so so yang dag par rig pa rnams la spyod kyang / de la myi rtog cing / so so yang dag par rig pa rnams sgom nyu7pa'i tshe/ ngo bo nyid kyis 87stong pa nyid kyi phyir/'di dag ni so so yang dag par rig pa rnams so/ /bdag gis so so yang dag par rig pa rnams bsgom par bya'o/ /'di'i don du so so yang dag par rig pa rnams bsgom mo zhes gsum po de dag la myi rtog pa ste/ so so yang dag par rig pa gang gis bdag kyang 'khor ba las sgrol zhing / gzhan yang sgrol ba 'di ni lam gyi yan lag dge ba'i chos so/ / dusems dang po bskyed pa nas nye bar bzung ste/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i dge ba'i chos snying rje chen po la spyod kyang de la myi rtog cing / snying rje chen po sgom chopa'i tshe ngo bo nyid kyis ⑤stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ 'di ni snying rje chen po'o/ /bdag gis snying rje chen po bsgom par bya'o/ /'di'i don du snying rje chen po bsgom mo zhes gsum po de dag la myi rtog pa ste/ snying rje chen po gang gis ⑥bdag kyang 'khor ba las sgrol zhing / gzhan yang sgrol ba 'di ni lam gyi yan lag dge ba'i chos so/ /sems dang po bskyed pa nas nye bar bzung ste/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i dge ba'i chos sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa brtswa brgyad la spyod kyang de la myi rtog cing / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa brtswa brgyad sgom ⑦pa'i tshe / ngo bo nyid kyis dustong pa nyid kyi phyir/ 'di dag ni sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams so/ /bdag gis sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams 25—707

bsgom par bya'o/ /'di'i don du sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams bsgom ①mo zhes gsum po de dag la myi rtog pa ste/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa gang gis bdag kyang 'khor ba las sgrol zhing / gzhan yang sgrol ba 'di ni lam gyi yan lag dge ba'i chos so/ /rab 'byor dge ba'i chos de dag ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi lam ste/ lam des 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar gyi byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams sems can tshad myed pa ded de②/'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las rgal ③bar gyur pa dang / rgal ④ba dang / rgal bar 'gyur ba ste/ lam de yongs su rdzogs par byas shing / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob par byed do/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob par byas nas chos kyi 'khor lo skor rodu/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor te/ sems can rnams kyi don byed do/ /shes rab kyi pha rold tu phyind pa stong phrag brgya pa las/ le'u drug cu brgyad do①// //de nas tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor kyis/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das gal te chos de dag byang chub sems dpa'i chos lags na/ sangs rgyas kyi chos gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor gang 'di ⑦skad du gal te chos de ⑧dag nga chub sems dpa'i chos yin na/ sangs rgyas kyi chos gang yin zhes zer b.rab 'byor sangs rgyas kyi chos kyang chos de dag nyid rnam pa thams cad 7du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar zad de/ de rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa 25—708

nyid thob nas/ bag chags kyi mtshams sbyor ba thams cad yongs su spong ①ngo / /de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ni chos thams cad skad cig gcig dang ldan pa'i shes rab kyis mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa zhes bya ba'i grangs su 'gro ste/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dang / de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la khyad par de yod do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ zhugs pa yang gzhan la/'bras bu la gnas pa yang gzhan te/ de gnyis ka yang 'phags pa'i gang zag ma yin zhes myi ②bya'o/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni bar chad myed pa'i lam du zhugs pa yin/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ni chos thams cad la sgrib pa myed pa'i ye shes brnyes ①pa ste/ rab 'byor de ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dang / de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi khyad par ro/ /rab 'byor kyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das gal te chos thams cad rang gi mtshan nyid kyis ④stong pa ⑤lags na/rang gi mtshan nyid kyis stong pa'i chos de dag la ni ⑥'di ni sems can dmyal ba pa'o/ /'di ni byol song gi skye gnas pa'o/ /'di ni gshin rje'i 'jig rten pa'o/ /'di ni lha'o/ /'di ni bya'o/ /'di ni rigs kyi sa'o/ /'di ni brgyad pa'o/ /'di ni rgyun tu zhugs pa'o/ /'di ni lan cig phyir 'ong ⑦ba'o//'di ni phyir myi 'ong ba'o/ /'di ni dgra bcom pa'o/ /'di ni rang sangs 25—709

rgyas so/ /'di ni byang chub sems dpa'o/ /'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas so zhes bgyi ①bar khyad par dang /rnam par dbye bar ji ltar 'gyur/ bcom ldan 'das ji ltar gang zag de dag dmyigs su ma mchis pa de bzhin du las kyang dmyigs su ma mchis las ji ltar dmyigs su ma mchis pa de bzhin du las kyi rnam par sbyin pa ④yang dmyigs su ma mchis so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de de bzhin tedu/ de de bzhin no'u/ /ji skad ⑤smras pa de bzhin te/ sgros thams cad rang gi mtshan nyid kyis yostong pa la/ las dang las kyi rnam ⑦par sbyin pa 'phomyi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor gang gis mirang gi mtshan nyid kyis stong pa'i chos thams cad de ltar ma shes pa de dag ni ngan ⑩par ༅spyad pa'am/ legs par ⑫spyad pa 'am/ myi g.yo ba'i las mngon par 'du byed de/ de dag ngan par spyad pa'i las kyis ngan song gsum du ltung hunyengo / /legs par spyad pa'i las kyis skyelha dang phyir skye'o/ /nyams pa myed pa'i las kyis 8gzugs kyi khams sam/gzugs myed pa'i khams su skye'o/ /de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la spyad/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyad/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la spyad/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyad/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyad/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyad/ nang stong pa nyid la spyad/ phyi stong pa nyid la spyad/phyi nang stong pa nyid la spyad/ stong pa nyid stong pa nyid la spyad/ chen po stong pa nyid la spyad/ don dam pa stong pa nyid la spyad/ 'dus byas stong pa nyid la spyadawi/ 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid la spyad/ mtha' las 'das pa stong pa 25—710

nyid la spyad/ thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid la spyad/ dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid la spyad/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid la spyad/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid la spyad/ rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid la spyad/ myi dmyigs pa hu7stong pa nyid la spyad/ dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid la spyad/ ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid la spyad/ dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid la spyad/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams khul spyad/ yang dag par spong ba rnams la spyad/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa 6rnams la spyad/ dbang po rnams la spyad/ stobs rnams la spyad / byang chub kyi yan lag rnams la spyad/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa la spyad/ 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams la spyad/ bsam gtan rnams la spyad/ tshad myed pa rnams la spyad/ gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams la spyad/ rnam par thar pa rnams la spyad/ mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams la spyad/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang ④/ mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa la spyad/ mngon par shes pa rnams la spyad/ ting nge 'dzin rnams la spyad/ gzungs kyi sgo rnams la spyad/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams la spyad/ myi 'jigs pa rnams la spyad/ so so yang dag par rig pa rnams la spyad/ byams pa chen po la spyad / du snying rje chen po skyol spyad/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa brtswa brgyad la spyad de/ nyams pa myed pa'i spyod pas byang chub kyi lam ⑦bskyed nas/rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin byang chub kyi yan lag gi 'khor dang ldan pa la mnyam par gzhag cing / bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ste/ mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas/

sems can rnams kyi don byed de①/ don byas nas ci nas kyang phyis chud ma zos shing ②/ rgyud lnga'i 'khor bar myi ltung ba ③de ltar don byed do/ /gsol pa / bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis dubla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas/rgyud lnga'i 'khor ba ⑤gzigs sam/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/rab 'byor ma yin no/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ de bzhin gshegs pas chos nag yipo'am dkar po'am gnag pa'am④/ dkar ba 'am/ myi gnag ⑤gyi dkar ba dmyigs ⑨lags sam/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' 455 pa/ ma yin no/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de ste ma ⑩dmyigs na/ sems can dmyal ba 'am/ byol song gi skye gnas sam/gshin rje'i 'jig rten du ji ltar gdags pa mdzad/ lha dang myir ji ltar gdags pa mdzad/ rgyun tu zhugs par ji ltar gdags pa mdzad/ lan cig phyir 'ong bar ji ltar gdags pa mdzad/ phyir myi 'ong bar ji ltar gdags pa mdzad / dgra bcom par ji ltar gdags pa mdzad/ rang sangs rgyas su ji ltar gdags pa skyemadzad/ byang chub sems dpar 'ji ltar gdags pa tsomadzad/de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas su ji ltar gdags pa ④mdzad/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor ci sems can 'di dag chos rnams rang gi mtshan nyid kyis stong par shes sam / gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das tsom lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa rab 'byor gal te sems can de yidag 'di ltar chos rnams rang gi mtshan nyid kyis stong ngo zhes bya bar shes na ni/ byang chub sems dpa' 25—712

sems dpa' chen po yang bla na myed pa yang ①dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu myi 'jug ②ste/ bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu ma zhugs na/sems can rnams kyang ngan song gsum dang / 'khor ba'i rgyud rnams nas myi 'grol te/ rab 'byor sems can de dag chos rnams rang gi mtshan nyid kyis stong par myi shes la②/ myi shes pas rgyud lnga'i 'khor ba las yongs su myi 'grol bsal/ de'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po yang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag las chos thams cad rang gi mtshan nyid kyis stong par thos nas/ sems can rnams kyi don du bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu 'jug ste/ chos 'di dag ni ji ltar byis pa so so'i skye bo rnams kyis mngon par chags par bya ba de ltar yod pa ma yin na/ de dag ni myed cing yang dag pa ma yin pa'i chos rnams la yod par brtags shing / sems can myed pa la sems can du 'du shes/ gzugs myed pa la gzugs su 'du shes / tshor ba myed pa la tshor bar 'du shes/ 'du shes myed pa la 'du shes su 'du shes/ 'du byed myed pa la 'du byed du 'du shes/ rnam par shes pa myed pa la rnam par shes par 'du shes/ myig myed pa la myig tu 'du shes/rna ba myed pa la rna bar 'du shes/ sna myed pa la snar 'du shes/ lce myed pa la lcer 'du shes/ lus myed pa la lus su 'du shes/ yid myed pa la yid du 'du shes/ gzugs myed pa la gzugs su 'du shes/ sgra myed pa la sgrar 'du shes / dri myed pa la drir ④'du shes/ ro myed pa la ror 'du shes/ reg myed pa la reg tu 'du shes/ chos myed pa la chos su 'du shes/ myig gi rnam par shes pa myed pa la myig gi rnam par shes par ⑤'du shes/ rna ba'i rnam par 25—713

shes pa myed pa la rna ba'i rnam par shes par 'du shes/ sna'i rnam par shes pa myed pa la sna'i rnam par shes par 'du shes/ lce'i rnam par shes pa myed pa la lce'i rnam par shes par 'du shes/ lus kyi rnam par shes pa myed pa la lus kyi rnam par shes par 'du shes/ yid kyi rnam par shes pa myed pa la yid kyi rnam par shes par 'du shes/ myig gi 'dus te reg pa myed pa la myig gi 'dus te reg par 'du shes/ rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa myed pa la rna ba'i 'dus te reg par 'du shes/ sna'i 'dus te reg pa myed pa la sna'i 'dus te reg par 'du shes/ lce'i 'dus te reg pa myed pa la lce'i 'dus te reg par 'du shes/lus kyi ①'dus te reg pa myed pa la lus kyi 'dus te reg par 'du shes/ yid kyi ②'dus te reg pa myed pa la yid kyi 'dus te reg par 'du shes/ myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba myed pa la myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor bar 'du shes/ rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba myed pa la rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor bar 'du shes/ sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba myed pa la sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor bar 'du ②shes / lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba myed pa la lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor bar 'du shes/ lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba myed pa la lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis ④tshor bar 'du shes/ yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba myed pa la yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor bar 'du shes/ sa'i khams myed pa la sa'i khams su 'du shes/chu'i khams myed pa la chu'i khams su 'du shes/ mye'i khams myed pa la mye'i khams su 'du shes/ rlung gi khams myed pa la rlung gi khams su 'du shes/25—714

nam mkha'i khams myed pa la nam mkha'i khams su 'du shes/ rnam par shes pa'i khams myed pa la rnam par shes pa'i khams su 'du shes/ ma rig pa myed pa la ma rig par 'du shes/ 'du byed myed pa la 'du byed du 'du shes/ rnam par shes pa myed pa la rnam par shes par 'du shes/ mying dang gzugs myed pa la mying dang gzugs su 'du shes/ skye mched drug myed pa la skye mched drug tu 'du shes/ reg pa myed pa la reg par 'du shes/ tshor ba myed pa la tshor bar 'du shes/ srid pa myed pa la sred par 'du shes/ len pa myed pa la len par 'du shes/ srid pa myed pa la srid par 'du shes/ skye ba myed pa la skye bar 'du shes/ rga shi myed pa la rga shir 'du shes/ 'jig rten pa'i chos myed pa la 'jig rten pa'i chos su 'du shes/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos myed pa la 'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos su 'du shes/ zag pa dang bcas pa'i chos myed pa la zag pa dang bcas pa'i chos su 'du shes/ zag pa myed pa'i chos myed pa la zag pa myed pa'i chos su 'du shes/ 'dus byas kyi chos myed pa la 'dus byas kyi chos su 'du shes/ 'dus ma byas kyi chos myed pa la 'dus ma byas kyi chos su 'du shes nas/ yod pa ma yin pa'i phyin ci log gis/ phyin ci log tu gyur pa'i sems dang ldan pa rnams/ lus dang ngag dang yid kyi las mngon par 'du byed pa de dag rgyud lnga'i 'khor ba las yongs su myi ①'grol ba'i phyiral/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin par dge ba'i chos thams cad 'dus par byas te/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod cing / bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya'o/ /mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas/ rgyud lnga'i 25—715

'khor ba las sems can rnams yongs su 'grel to// //shes rab kyi pha rold tu phyind pa stong phrag brgya pa/ bam po nyi shu gsum pa①/ rab 'byor kyis gsol pa/ gal te chos thams cad rang gi mtshan nyid kyis stong pa lags na/ ji ltar ②byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas te/ rgyud lnga'i 'khor ba las sems can rnams yongs su 'grel zhub lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas te/ sdug bsngal ④dang /sdug bsngal kun 'byung ba dang/ sdug bsngal 'gog pa dang / sdug bsngal 'gog par 'gro ba'i lam sems can rnams la ston to/ /'chad do/ /'jog go / /'god do⑤/ /'grel to/ /rnam par 'grel to/ /gsal bar byed do//yang dag par rjod do/ /'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi po 'dir dge ba'i chos byang chub kyi phyogs gang ji snyed pa gang gis dkon mchog gsum rnam khyapar 'god ⑦pa de thams cad yongs su 'dus te/ sangs rgyas dkon mchog dang / chos dkon mchog dang / dge 'dun dkon mchog dugasum 'jig rten du byung ⑨bas/sems can rnams lam rgyud lnga'i 'khor ba las yongs su dgrol lo0/ /rab 'byor kyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das sdug bsngal 'tshal bas yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar 'gyur ram/ 'on te sdug bsngal gyis mya ngan las 'da' bar 'gyur/ kun 'byung ba 'tshal bas/ yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar 'gyur ram/ 'on te kun 'byung bas mya ngan las 'da' bar 'gyur/25—716

sdug bsngal 'gog pa ①'tshal bas yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar 'gyur ram/'on te sdug bsngal 'gog ②pas mya ngan las 'da' bar 'gyur/ lam 'tshal bas yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar 'gyur ram/ 'on te lam gyis ②mya ngan las 'da' bar 'gyur/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor sdug bsngal shes pas yongs su mya ngan las myi 'da' ste/ sdug bsngal gyis kyang ma yin no/ /kun 'byung ba shes pas yongs su mya ngan las myi 'da' ste/kun 'byung bas kyang ma yin no/ /sdug bsngal 'gog pa shes pas/ yongs su mya ngan las myi 'da' ste/ sdug bsngal 'gog pas kyang ma yin no/ /lam shes pas yongs su mya ngan las myi 'da' ste/ lam gyis kyang ma yin no/ /rab 'byor 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi po de dag mnyam pa nyid gang yin pa de ni mya ngan las 'da' bar ngas gsungs te/ sdug bsngal shes pas yongs su mya ngan las ④'da' ba ma yin noskye/ /sdug bsngal gyis kyang ma yin no/ /kun 'byung ba shes pas yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba ma yin no'u/ / kun 'byung bas kyang ma yin no/ /④sdug bsngal 'gog pa shes pas duyongs su 0mya ngan las 'da' ba ma yin⑩/ sdug bsngal 'gog pas kyang ma yin no/ /lam shes pas yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba ma yin7/ lam gyis kyang ma yin no/ /gsol pa / bcom ldan 'das gang la sdug bsngal yang ma mchis/ byug bsngal 'tshal ba yang ma mchis/ kun 'byung ba yang ma mchis/ kun 'byung ba 'tshal ba yang ma mchis/ 'gog pa yang ma mchis/ 'gog pa 'tshal ba yang ma mchis lam yang ma mchis lam 'tshal ba yang ma mchis pa'i 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi mnyam pa nyid ces bgyi ba de gang lags/ bcom ldan

'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de ni 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi po de dag gi ①de bzhin nyid dang / ma nor ba de bzhin nyid dang / gzhan ma yin pa de bzhin nyid dang ②/ chos nyid dang / chos kyi dbyings dang / chos kyi gnas nyid dang / chos skyon myed pa nyid dudang / yang dag pa'i mtha' ④de bzhin gshegs pa rnams byung yang rung / de bzhin gshegs pa rnams ma byung yang rung ste/ de bzhin gnas ⑤pa'i dbyings/ chos kyi dbyings myi nyamatho/myi 'grib par 'dug pa ste/ de'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ bden pa khong du chud par ⑦ji ltar bya ba dubazhin du/ bden pa khong du chud par bya ba'i don du spyod do/ /rab 'byor kyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la ⑨ji ltar spyod na/ bden pa rtogs pa'i don du spyod pa lags/ ji ltar spyod na bden pa rtogs shing 'tshal te / khong du chud nas nyan thos kyi sa 'am/ rang sangs rgyas kyi sar myi ltung zhing byang chub sems dpa'i skyon ma mchis par 'jug pa lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ chos de dag ci nas kyang chos gang yang dmyigs su myed pa de ltar mthong ste/ chos thams cad ma chadamyigs pas bden par gtogs 7pa'am/ bden par ma gtogs 8pa'i chos thams cad stong par mthong ste/ des de ltar mthong bas skyon myed par ⑫chud pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rigs kyi sa la gnas par 'gyur hu9te/ byang chub sems dpa' de tsorigs kyi sa la gnas par gyur nas/25—718

spyi bor ltung bar myi 'gyur te/ de la nyan thos kyi sa'am/ rang sangs rgyas kyi sar ltung ba'i spyi bor ༅ltung ba myed do/ /de byang chub sems dpa'i rigs kyi sa de la gnas shing / bsam gtan bzhi sgrub bo/ /tshad myed pa bzhi sgrub bo/ /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa bzhi sgrub bo/ /de lhag mthong gis po)de la gnas shing / chos thams cad rab tu shes par byed de/ 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi khong du chud par byed do/ /de sdug bsngal yongs su shes kyang sdug bsngal la dmyigs pa'i sems myi skyed do/ /kun 'byung ba rab tu spangs kyang ṭwā/kun 'byung ba la dmyigs pa'i sems myi skyed khudo/ /'gog pa mngon du byed kyang 'gog pa la dmyigs pa'i sems myi skyed gyedo/ /lam sgom yang lam la dmigs pa'i sems myi skyed do༅/ /gzhan du na byang chub la gzhol ba'i sems kyis chos thams cad yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du skyemathong bar byed do/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das chos thams cad kyi yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin zhes bgyi dub de gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ stong pa nyid do/ /gsol pa/ stong pa nyid gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid de/ rnam pa de lta bu'i lhag mthong gis chos thams cad stong pa'o zhes bya bar lta ste/ ngo bo nyid gang la gnas shing byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar bya ba de lta bu'i ngo bo nyid chos gang la yang ngo bo nyid yod par myi tso)mthong ngo / /dngos po myed pa ni byang chub ste/ de ni sangs rgyas kyis ma mdzadatshu/ rang sangs rgyas kyis ma byas / dgra bcom pas ma byas/ phyir myi 'ong bas ma byas/ lan cig phyir 'ong bas ma byas/ rgyun tu zhugs pas ma byas/ de dag la zhugs pas kyang ma 25—719

byas / gang byang chub 'di la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag gis kyang ①ma byas te/ gzhan du na yang dag pa ji lta ba de sems can rnams kyis myi shes myi mthong bas de'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing / thabs mkhas pas sems can rnams la chos ston to/ /shes rab kyi pha rold tu phyind pa stong phrag brgya pa las/ le'u drug cu dgu'o②// //de nas tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor kyis bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das gal te chos thams cad dngos po ma mchis te/de dag sangs rgyas kyis kyang ma mdzad/ rang sangs rgyas kyis kyang ma bgyis/dgra bcom pas kyang ma bgyis/ phyir myi 'ong bas kyang ma bgyis/ lan cig phyir 'ong bas kyang ma bgyis/ rgyun tu zhugs pas kyang ma bgyis/ de dag la zhugs pas kyang ma bgyis/ gang byang chub 'di la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag gis kyang ma bgyis na/ chos de dag la 'di dag ni sems can dmyal ba pa'odu/ /'di dag ni byol song gi skye gnas pa'o/ /'di dag ni gshin rje'i 'jig rten pa'o/ /'di dag ni lha'o/ /'di dag ni ④pyi'o / /las 'dis ni sems can dmyal ba pa dang ⑤/ byol song gi skye gnas pa dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten par 'gyur ro/ /las 'dis ni myir 'gyur ro/ /las 'dis ni rgyal chen bzhi'i ris kyi lhar 'gyur ro/ /las 'dis ni sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lhar ⑥'gyur ro/ /las 'dis ni mtshe ma'i lhar ⑦'gyur ro/ /las 'dis ni dga' ldan gyi lhar 'gyur ro/ /las 'dis ni 25—720

'phrul dga'i lhar 'gyur ro/ /las 'dis ni gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lhar 'gyur ro/ /las 'dis ni tshangs ris kyi lhar 'gyur ro/ /las 'dis ni tshangs lha nye phan gyi lhar 'gyur ro/ /las 'dis ni tshangs pa kun 'khor gyi lhar 'gyur ro/ /las 'dis ni tshangs chen gyi she7lhar 'gyur ro/ /las 'dis ni snang ba'i lhar 'gyur ro/ /las 'dis ni chung snang gi ②lhar 'gyur ro/ /las 'dis ni tshad myed snang ba'i lhar 'gyur ro/ /las 'dis ni kun snang dang ba'i lhar 'gyur ro/ /las 'dis ni dge ba'i lhar 'gyur ro/ / las 'dis ni chung dge'i lhar 'gyur ro/ /dulas 'dis ni tshad myed dge ba'i lhar 'gyur ro/ /las 'dis ni dge rgyas kyi lhar 'gyur ro/ /las 'dis ni che ba'i lhar 'gyur ro//las 'dis ni chung che'i lhar 'gyur ro/ /las 'dis ni tshad myed che ba'i lhar 'gyur ro/ /las 'dis ni 'bras bu che ba'i lhar 'gyur ro/ /las 'dis ni myi che ba'i lhar 'gyur ro/ /las 'dis ni myi gdung ba'i lhar 'gyur ro/ /las 'dis ni shin tu mthong ba'i lhar 'gyur ro/ /las 'dis ni gya rnam snang rnguba'i lhar 'gyur ro/ /las 'dis ni 'og myin gyi rgyalhar 'gyur ro/ /las 'dis ni nam mkha' mtha' yas ༅skye mched kyi lhar 'gyur ro/ /las 'dis ni rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched kyi lhar 'gyur ro/ /las 'dis ni chung zad myed pa'i skye mched kyi lhar 'gyur ro/ /las 'di ⑦ni 'du shes myed 'du shes myed dumyin skye mched kyi lhar 'gyur ro/ /las 'dis ni rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bur 'gyur ro/ /las 'dis ni lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bur 'gyur ro/ /las 'dis ni phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bur 'gyur ro/ / las 'dis ni dgra bcom pa nyid du 'gyur ro/ /⑨las 'dis ni rang sangs rgyas su 'gyur ro/ /25—721

las 'dis ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen por 'gyur ro/ /las 'dis ni de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas su 'gyur ro zhes bgyi bar tha dad du dbye ba'am/ rnam par dgod pa ①yang ji ltar 'gyur/ bcom ldan 'das dngos po ma mchis pa la ni bgyi ba gang yang ma mchis te/ bgyi ba gang gis sems can dmyal bar mchi ba'amal/byol song gi skye gnas su mchi ba'amadu / gshin rje'i 'jig rten du mchi ④ba'am/myir skye ba'am/ rgyal chen bzhi'i ris kyi lhar skye ba'am/ sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lhar skye ba 'am/ mtshe ma'i lhar skye ba'am/ dga' ldan gyi lhar skye ba'am/'phrul dga'i lhar skye ba'am/ gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lhar skye ba'am/tshangs ris kyi (5)lhar skye ba'am/ tshangs lha nye phan gyi lhar skye ba'am/ tshangs pa kun 'khor gyi lhar skye ba'am/ tshangs chen gyi lhar skye ba'am/ snang ba'i lhar skye ba'am/ chung snang gi lhar skye ba'am/yi tshad myed snang ba'i lhar skye ba'am / kun snang dang ba'i lhar skye ba'am/ dge ba'i lhar skye ba'am/ chung dge'i tsho kyilhar skye ba'am/ tshad myed dge ba'i lhar skye ba 'am/ dge rgyas kyi lhar skye ba'am / che ba'i lhar skye ba'am/ chung che'i lhar skye ba'am/ tshad myed che ba'i lhar skye ba'am/ 'bras bu che ba'i lhar skye ba'am/ myi che ba'i lhar skye ba'am/ myi gdung ba'i lhar skye ba'am/ shin tu mthong ba'i lhar skye ba 'am/ gya rnam snang ba'i lhar skye ba'am/ 'og myin gyi lhar skye ba 'am/ nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched kyi lhar skye ba'am/ rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched kyi lhar skye ba'am/chung zad myed pa'i skye mched kyi lhar skye ba'am/ 'du shes myed 'du shes myed myin skye mched kyi lhar skye ba'am/ rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu thob par 'gyur ba 'am/25—722

lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu thob par 'gyur ba'am/ phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu thob par 'gyur ba'am/ dgra bcom pa nyid thob par 'gyur ba'am/rang byang chub thob par 'gyur ba'am/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i lam la spyod par 'gyur ba'am/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob par 'gyur ba'am/ thob par gyur nas sems can rnams 'khor ba las yongs su dgrol bar 'gyur ro zhes bya 1ba de lta bu gang yang ma mchis so/ /de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rab 'byor de de bzhin no/ /de de bzhin te /ji skad du smras pa — bzhin te/ rab 'byor dngos po myed pa la ni las kyang myed/bya ba yang myed/ 'bras bu yang myed na/ 'on kyang byis pa so so'i skye bo/'phags pa'i chos la myi mkhas pa rnams kyis chos rnams dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid du myi shes te/ phyin ci log las byung ba'i sems kyis las sna tshogs mngon par 'du byed pas/ de dag gi lus rnam pa de bzhin du mngon par 'grub ste/sems can dmyal ba'am/ byol song gi skye gnas sam/ gshin rje'i 'jig rten nam/ myi'am/ rgyal chen bzhi'i ris kyi lha'am/ sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lha'am / mtshe ma'i lha'am/ dga' ldan gyi lha'am/ 'phrul dga'i lha'am/gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lha'am/ tshangs ris kyi lha'am/ tshangs lha nye phan gyi lha'am/ tshangs pa kun 'khor gyi lha'am/ tshangs chen gyi lha'am/ snang ba'i lha'am/ chung snang gi lha'am/ tshad myed snang ba'i lha'am/ kun snang dang ba'i lha'am/ dge ba'i lha'am/ chung dge'i rilha'am/ tshad myed dge ba'i lha'am/ dge rgyas kyi lha'am/ che ba'i lha'am/ chung che'i lha'am/25—723

tshad myed che ba'i lha'am/ 'bras bu che ba'i lha'am/ myi che ba'i lha'am/ myi gdung ba'i lha'am/ shin tu mthong ba'i lha'am/ gya rnam snang ba'i lha'am/'og pyin gyi lha'am/ nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched kyi lha'am/ rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched kyi lha'am/ chung zad myed pa'i skye mched kyi lha'am/'du shes myed 'du shes myed pyin skye mched kyi lha'i nang du lus mngon par 'grub ste / dngos po myed pa la ni las sam/ bya ba'am/ 'bras bu myed de/dngos po myed pa gang yin pa de ni dngos po myed pa nyid do/ /rab 'byor de la 'di skad du dngos po myed pa la ni bya ba gang yang myed de/ bya ba gang gis sems can dmyal bar 'gro ba'am/ byol song gi skye gnas su 'gro ba'am/gshin rje'i 'jig rten du 'gro ba'am/ myir skye ba'am/ rgyal chen bzhi'i ris kyi lhar skye ba'am/ sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lhar skye ba'am/ mtshe ma'i lhar skye ba'am / dga' ldan gyi lhar skye ba'am/ 'phrul dga'i lhar skye ba'am/gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lhar skye ba'am/ tshangs ris kyi lhar skye ba'am/tshangs lha nye phan gyi ⑩lhar skye ba'am/ tshangs pa kun 'khor gyi lhar skye ba'am/tshangs chen gyi lhar skye ba'am/ snang ba'i lhar skye ba'am/ chung snang gi lhar skye ba'am / tshad myed snang ba'i lhar skye ba'am/ kun snang dang ba'i lhar skye ba'am / dge ba'i lhar skye ba'am/ chung dge'i ②lhar skye ba'am/ tshad myed dge ba'i lhar skye ba'am/ dge rgyas kyi lhar skye ba'am/ che ba'i lhar skye ba'am/chung che'i ②lhar skye ba'am/ tshad myed che ba'i lhar skye ba'am/ 'bras bu che ba'i lhar skye ba'am/ myi che ba'i lhar skye ba'am/ myi gdung ba'i lhar skye ba'am/shin tu mthong ba'i lhar skye ba'am/ gya nom snang ba'i lhar skye ba'am/ 'og 25—724

myin gyi ②lhar skye ba'am/ nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched kyi lhar skye ba'am/rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched kyi lhar skye ba'am/ chung zad myed pa'i skye mched kyi lhar skye ba'am/ 'du shes myed 'du shes myed myin skye mched kyi lhar skye ba'am/rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu thob par 'gyur ba'am/ lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu thob par 'gyur ba'am/ phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu thob par 'gyur ba'am / dgra bcom pa nyid thob par 'gyur ba'am/ rang byang chub thob par 'gyur ba'am/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i lam la ②spyod pa'am/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob par 'gyur ba'am/ de thob nas ②sems can rnams 'khor ba las yongs su dgrol bar 'gyur ba de lta bu'i bya ba gang yang myed do zhes zer ba ni/ rab 'byor de ji snyam du sems/lam dngos po myed pa ma yin nam/ rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu dngos po ④myed pa ma yin nam/ lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu dngos po myed pa ma yin nam/ phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu dngos po myed pa ma yin nam/ dgra bcom pa nyid dngos po myed pa ma yin nam/ rang byang chub dngos po myed pa ma yin nam/ lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid dngos po myed pa ma yin nam/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dngos po myed pa ma yin nam/ gsol pa/bcom ldan 'das lam ni dngos po ma mchis pa'o/ /rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu ni dngos po ⑤ma mchis pa'o/ /lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu ni dngos po ma mchis pa'o/ /phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu ni dngos po ma mchis pa'o/ /dgra bcom pa nyid ni dngos po ma mchis pa'o/ /rang byang chub ni dngos po ma mchis pa'o/ /lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid ni dngos po ma mchis pa'o/ /rnam 25—725
