yod par mngon nam/ mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams yod par mngon nam/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa yod par mngon nam/ mngon par shes pa rnams yod par mngon nam/ ting nge 'dzin rnams yod par mngon nam/ gzungs kyi sgo rnams yod par mngon nam/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams yod par mngon nam/ myi 'jigs pa rnams yod par mngon nam/ so so yang dag par rig pa rnams yod par mngon nam/ byams pa chen po yod par mngon nam/snying rje chen po yod par mngon nam/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams yod par mngon nam/ myi chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis yod par mngon nam/dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu yod par mngon nam/ sangs rgyas dkon mchog yod par mngon nam/ chos dkon mchog yod par mngon nam/ dge 'dun dkon mchog yod par mngon nam/ nyan thos kyi theg pa yod par mngon nam/rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa yod par mngon nam/ sangs rgyas kyi theg pa yod par mngon nam/ theg pa chen po yod par mngon nam/ dad pa'i rjes su 'brang ba yod par mngon nam/ chos kyi rjes su 'brang ba yod par mngon nam/brgyad pa yod par mngon nam/ rgyun tu zhugs pa yod par mngon nam/lan cig phyir 'ong ba yod par mngon nam/ phyir myi 'ong ba yod par mngon nam / dgra bcom pa yod par mngon nam/ rang sangs rgyas yod par mngon nam/ byang chub sems dpa' yod par mngon nam/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas yod par mngon nam / gsold pa/ bcom ldan 'das chos de dag thams cad ni ①25—775

mchis par mngon par myi ①'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsald pa / rab 'byord de lta bas na/ de ltar chos thams cad khyamanyam pa nyid las kyang myi g.yo la/ chos rnams rnam par dgod pa tshimadzad pa ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i mthu'o// //shes rab kyi pha rold tu phyind pa stong phrag brgya pa/ bam po nyi shu lnga pa④/gsold pa/ bcom ldan 'das ji ltar de bzhin gshegs pa chos mnyam pa nyid las myi g.yo ba de bzhin du/ so so'i skye bo rnams kyang chos mnyam pa nyid las myi g.yo ba lags sam/ de bzhin du dad pa'i rjes su 'brang ba rnams kyang chos mnyam pa nyid las myi g.yo ba lags sam/ de bzhin du chos kyi rjes su 'brang ba rnams kyang chos mnyam pa nyid las myi g.yo ba lags sam/ de bzhin du brgyad pa yang chos mnyam pa nyid las myi g.yo ba lags sam/ de bzhin du rgyun tu zhugs pa rnams kyang chos mnyam pa nyid las myi g.yo ba lags sam/ de bzhin du lan cig phyir 'ong ba rnams kyang chos mnyam pa nyid las myi g.yo ba lags sam/de bzhin du phyir myi 'ong ba rnams kyang chos mnyam pa nyid las myi g.yo ba lags sam / de bzhin du dgra bcom pa rnams kyang chos mnyam pa nyid las myi g.yo ba lags sam/ de bzhin du rang sangs rgyas rnams khukyang chos mnyam pa nyid las myi g.yo ba lags sam/ de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' yang chos mnyam pa nyid las myi g.yo ba lags sam/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/rab 'byor de de bzhin no/ /de de bzhin te/ rab 'byor chos thams cad ni chos 'umanyam pa nyid las myi g.yo'o/ /chos mnyam pa nyid las myi 'da'o/ /rab 'byor de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom 25—776

pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi de bzhin nyid dang / ma nor ba de bzhin nyid dang / gzhan ma yin pa de bzhin nyid dang / chos nyid dang / chos kyi dbyings dang / chos kyi gnas nyid dang / chos skyon myed pa nyid dang / yang dag pa'i mtha' gang yin pa de nyid nishemo/ so so'i skye bo rnams kyi de bzhin nyid dang / ma nor ba de bzhin nyid dang / gzhan ma yin pa de bzhin nyid dang / chos nyid dang /khu chos kyi dbyings dang /chos kyi gnas nyid dang / chos skyon myed pa nyid dang / yang dag pa'i mtha' ste / de snonyid ni dad pa'i rjes su 'brang ba rnams kyi de bzhin nyid dang /ma nor ba de bzhin nyid dang / gzhan ma yin pa de bzhin nyid dang / chos nyid dang / chos kyi dbyings dang / chos kyi gnas nyid dang / chos skyon myed pa nyid dang / yang dag pa'i mtha'obya/ /de nyid ni chos kyi rjes su 'brang ba rnams kyi de bzhin nyid dang / ma nor ba de bzhin nyid dang / gzhan ma yin pa de bzhin nyid dang / chos nyid dang / chos kyi dbyings dang / chos kyi gnas nyid dang / chos skyon myed pa nyid dang / yang dag pa'i mtha'o/ /de nyid ni brgyad pa rnams kyi de bzhin nyid dang / ma nor ba de bzhin nyid dang / gzhan ma yin pa de bzhin nyid dang / chos nyid dang / chos kyi dbyings dang / chos kyi gnas nyid dang / chos skyon myed pa nyid dang /yang dag pa'i mtha'o/ /de nyid ni rgyun tu zhugs pa rnams kyi de bzhin nyid dang /ma nor ba de bzhin nyid dang / gzhan ma yin pa de bzhin nyid dang / chos nyid dang / chos kyi dbyings dang / chos kyi gnas nyid dang / chos skyon myed pa nyid dang / yang dag pa'i mtha'o/ /de nyid ni lan cig phyir 'ong ba 25—777

rnams kyi de bzhin nyid dang / ma nor ba de bzhin nyid dang / gzhan ma yin pa de bzhin nyid dang / chos nyid dang / chos kyi dbyings dang / chos kyi gnas nyid dang / chos skyon myed pa nyid dang / yang dag pa'i mtha'o/ /de nyid ni phyir myi 'ong ba spyinams kyi de bzhin nyid dang / ma nor ba de bzhin nyid dang / gzhan ma yin pa de bzhin nyid dang / chos nyid dang / chos kyi dbyings dang / chos kyi gnas nyid dang / chos skyon myed pa nyid dang /yang dag pa'i mtha'o 37/ /de nyid ni dgra bcom pa rnams kyi de bzhin nyid dang /ma nor ba de bzhin nyid dang / gzhan ma yin pa ri de bzhin nyid dang / chos nyid dang / chos kyi dbyings dang / chos kyi gnas nyid dang / chos skyon myed pa nyid dang / yang dag pa'i mtha'o/ /de nyid ni rang sangs rgyas rnams kyi de bzhin nyid dang / ma nor ba de bzhin nyid dang / gzhan ma yin pa de bzhin nyid dang / chos nyid dang / chos kyi dbyings dang / chos kyi gnas nyid dang / chos skyon myed pa nyid dang / yang dag pa'i mtha'o de nyid ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi de bzhin nyid dang /ma nor ba de bzhin nyid dang / gzhan ma yin pa de bzhin nyid dang / chos nyid dang / chos kyi dbyings dang / chos kyi gnas nyid dang / chos skyon myed pa nyid dang / yang dag pa'i mtha' 0ste/ de dag thams cad ni chos mnyam pa nyid de de phyalas rnam par gumyi 'da'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de dag gi chos nyid dang / chos kyi dbyings dang / chos kyi gnas nyid dang /chos skyon myed pa nyid dang / de bzhin nyid dang / ma nor ba de bzhin nyid dang / gzhan ma ⑦yin pa de bzhin nyid dang / yang dag pa'i mtha' ni de 25—778

nyid yin ①te/ de dag las chos mnyam pa nyid ces bya ba gzhan gang yang myed do / /rab 'byord kyis gsold pa/ bcom ldan 'das gal te de ltar so so'i skye bo rnams kyi chos mnyam pa nyid gang lags pa de genyid/ dad pa'i rjes su 'brang ba rnams kyi chos mnyam pa nyid/ de nyid chos kyi rjes su 'brang ba rnams kyi chos mnyam pa nyid/ de nyid brgyad pa rnams kyi chos mnyam pa nyid/de nyid rgyun tu zhugs pa rnams kyi chos mnyam pa nyid/ de nyid lan cig phyir 'ong ba rnams kyi chos mnyam pa nyid/ de nyid phyir myi 'ong ba rnams kyi chos mnyam pa nyid/ de nyid dgra bcom pa rnams kyi chos mnyam pa nyid/ de nyid rang sangs rgyas rnams gekyi chos mnyam pa nyid/ de nyid byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi chos mnyam pa nyid / de nyid de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi chos mnyam pa nyid lags na/ bcom ldan 'das mtshan nyid myi 'dra ba'i chos 'di lta ste/gzugs dang / tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed dang / rnam par shes pa dang / myig dang / rna ba dang / sna dang / lce dang / lus dang / yid dang / gzugs dang / sgra dang / dri dang / ro dang /reg dang / chos dang / myig gi rnam par shes pa dang / myig gi 'dus te reg pa dang / myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba dang / rna ba'i rnam par shes pa dang / rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa dang / rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba dang / sna'i rnam par shes pa dang / sna'i 'dus te reg pa dang / sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba dang / lce'i rnam par shes pa dang / lce'i 'dus te reg pa dang / lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i 25—779

rkyen kyis tshor ba dang / lus kyi rnam par shes pa dang / lus kyi 'dus te reg pa dang / lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba dang / yid kyi rnam par shes pa dang / yid kyi 'dus te reg pa dang / yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba dang / sa'i khams dang / chu'i khams dang /mye'i khams dang / rlung gi khams dang / nam mkha'i khams dang / rnam par shes pa'i khams dang / rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba dang /hu rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i yan lag dang / 'dod chags dang / zhe sdang dang / gti mug dang / lta ba'i rnam pa thams cad dang / bsam gtan dang / tshad myed pa dang / gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams dang / sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang / tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang / brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / thabs mkhas pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang / smon lam gyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / stobs kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / ye shes kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i sa bcu dang / dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams dang / yang dag par spong ba rnams dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams dang / dbang po rnams dang / stobs rnams dang / byang chub kyi yan lag rnams dang / 'phags ②pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa dang /'phags pa'i bden pa rnams dang / rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang /mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa dang / nang stong pa nyid dang / phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang /25—780

chen po stong pa nyid dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang / thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid dang / dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dang / myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid dang / dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang /dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang / rnam par thar pa brgyad dang /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu dang / mngon par shes pa lnga dang / ting nge 'dzin thams cad dang / gzungs kyi sgo thams cad dang /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu dang / myi 'jigs pa bzhi dang / so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi dang / byams pa chen po dang / snying rje chen po dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa brtswa brgyad dang / myi chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis dang / dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu dang / 'dus byas kyi khams dang / 'dus ma byas kyi khams te/ bcom ldan 'das chos de dag ni kun ①kyang gcig dang gcig 3tu myi 'dra ba/ gcig las gcig 'das pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das de duci'i slad du zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar gzugs kyi chos nyid kyang gzhan la/ tshor ba'i chos nyid kyang gzhan/ 'du shes kyi chos nyid kyang gzhan / 'du byed kyi chos nyid kyang gzhan/ rnam par shes pa'i chos nyid kyang gzhan te④/ myig gi chos nyid kyang gzhan/ rna ba'i chos nyid kyang gzhan/sna'i chos nyid kyang gzhan/ lce'i chos nyid kyang gzhan/ lus kyi chos nyid kyang gzhan/ yid kyi chos nyid kyang gzhan/ gzugs kyi chos nyid kyang gzhan/25—781

sgra'i chos nyid kyang gzhan/ dri'i chos nyid kyang gzhan/ ro'i chos nyid kyang gzhan / reg gi chos nyid kyang gzhan/ chos kyi chos nyid kyang gzhan/myig gi rnam par shes pa'i chos nyid kyang gzhan/ rna ba'i rnam par shes pa'i chos nyid kyang gzhan/ sna'i rnam par shes pa'i chos nyid kyang gzhan/ lce'i rnam par shes pa'i chos nyid kyang gzhan/ lus kyi rnam par shes pa'i chos nyid kyang gzhan/ yid kyi rnam par shes pa'i chos nyid kyang gzhan/ myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i chos nyid kyang gzhan27/ rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i chos nyid kyang gzhan/ sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i chos nyid kyang gzhan/ lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i chos nyid kyang gzhan/ lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i chos nyid kyang gzhan / yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i chos nyid kyang gzhan/ myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i chos nyid kyang gzhan/ rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i chos nyid kyang gzhanas/ sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i chos nyid kyang gzhan/ lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i chos nyid kyang gzhan/ lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i chos nyid kyang gzhan/ yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i chos nyid kyang gzhan/sa'i khams kyi chos nyid kyang gzhan/ chu'i khams kyi chos nyid kyang gzhan/mye'i khams kyi chos nyid kyang gzhan/ rlung gi khams kyi chos nyid kyang gzhan/nam mkha'i khams kyi chos nyid kyang gzhan/ rnam par shes pa'i khams kyi chos nyid kyang gzhan/ ma rig pa'i chos nyid kyang gzhan/ 'du byed kyi chos nyid kyang gzhan/ rnam par shes pa'i duchos nyid kyang gzhan/ mying dang gzugs kyi chos nyid kyang gzhan/ skye mched drug gi chos nyid kyang gzhan/ reg pa'i 25—782

chos nyid kyang gzhan/ tshor ba'i chos nyid kyang gzhan/ sred pa'i chos nyid kyang gzhan/ len pa'i chos nyid kyang gzhan/ srid pa'i chos nyid kyang gzhan/skye ba'i chos nyid kyang gzhan/ rga shi'i chos nyid kyang gzhan/ 'dod chags kyi chos nyid kyang gzhan/ zhe sdang gi chos nyid kyang gzhan/ gti mug gi chos nyid kyang gzhan/ lta ba'i rnam pa'i chos nyid kyang gzhan/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i 3chos nyid kyang gzhan/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i chos nyid kyang gzhan/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i chos nyid kyang gzhan/brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i chos nyid kyang gzhan/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i chos nyid kyang gzhan/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i chos nyid kyang gzhan/ nang stong pa nyid kyi chos nyid kyang gzhan/ phyi stong pa nyid kyi chos nyid kyang gzhan/ phyi nang stong pa nyid kyi chos nyid kyang gzhan/ stong pa nyid stong pa nyid kyi chos nyid kyang gzhan/ chen po stong pa nyid kyi 2chos nyid kyang gzhan/ don dam pa stong pa nyid kyi chos nyid kyang gzhan/ 'dus byas stong pa nyid kyi chos nyid kyang gzhan/ 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid kyi chos nyid kyang gzhan/ mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid kyi chos nyid kyang gzhan/thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid kyi chos nyid kyang gzhan/ dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid kyi chos nyid kyang gzhan/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi chos nyid kyang gzhan / chos thams cad stong pa nyid kyi 5chos nyid kyang gzhan/ rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid kyi chos nyid kyang gzhan/ myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid kyi chos nyid kyang gzhan/ dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid kyi chos nyid kyang gzhan/ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi chos nyid kyang gzhan/ dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid 25—783

stong pa nyid kyi chos nyid kyang gzhan/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams kyi chos nyid kyang gzhan/ yang dag par spong ba rnams kyi chos nyid kyang gzhan/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams kyi chos nyid kyang gzhan/ dbang po rnams kyi chos nyid kyang gzhan/ stobs rnams kyi chos nyid kyang gzhan/ byang chub kyi yan lag rnams kyi chos nyid kyang gzhan/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa'i chos nyid kyang gzhan/ 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams kyi chos nyid kyang gzhan/bsam gtan rnams kyi chos nyid kyang gzhan/ tshad myed pa rnams kyi chos nyid kyang gzhan/ gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyi chos nyid kyang gzhan / rnam par thar pa rnams kyi chos nyid kyang gzhan/ mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyi chos nyid kyang gzhan/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa'i chos nyid kyang gzhan/ mngon par shes pa rnams kyi chos nyid kyang gzhan/ ting nge 'dzin rnams kyi chos nyid kyang gzhan/ gzungs kyi sgo rnams kyi chos nyid kyang gzhan/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams kyi chos nyid kyang gzhan/myi 'jigs pa rnams kyi chos nyid kyang gzhan/ so so yang dag par rig pa rnams kyi chos nyid kyang gzhan/ byams pa chen po'i chos nyid kyang gzhan/snying rje chen po'i chos nyid kyang gzhan/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams kyi chos nyid kyang gzhan/ myi chen po'i mtshan rnams kyi chos nyid kyang gzhan/dpe byad bzang po rnams kyi chos nyid kyang gzhan/ 'dus byas kyi khams kyi chos nyid kyang gzhan/ 'dus ma byas kyi khams kyi chos nyid kyang gzhan na①/bcom ldan 'das ji ltar mtshan nyid myi 'dra ba'i chos rnams kyi chos nyid ②mtshan 25—784

nyid gcig par 'gyur ba lags/ chos rnam par dgod ①par ni ji ltar 'gyur/byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ gang la gnas shing chos rnams tha dad du bgyid pa lags/chos rnams tha dad du ma bgyis par ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos kyang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyind pa la spyod par myi nus na/ ji ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ sa nas sar 'phar duzhing skyon myed par 'jug pa lags / ji ltar skyon myed par zhugs nas/ nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi sa las 'das te/ mngon par shes pa snyeyongs su rdzogs par bgyid pa lags / ji ltar mngon par shes pas rnam par rtse byazhing sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par bgyi ba dang / tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par bgyi ba dang / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par bgyi ba rgyadang / brtson 'grus kyi pha rold tu phyind pa yongs su rdzogs par bgyi ba dang / bsam gtan gyi pha rold tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par bgyi ba dang / shes rab kyi pha rold tu phyind pa yongs su rdzogs par bgyi ba dang ⑥/ de dag la rnam par rtse 3 bas/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing du mchi ba lags/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la bsnyen bkur bgyid pa lags/ de dag tu yang dge ba'i rtsa ba skyed pa lags/dge ba'i rtsa ba des sems can rnams yongs su phyin par bgyid pa lags/sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su 'dzin pa lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byord gang 'di skad du de ste/ chos thams cad kyi chos 25—785

mnyam pa nyid gang yin pa de nyid so so'i skye bo rnams kyi chos mnyam pa nyid de/de nyid dad pa'i rjes su 'brang ba rnams kyi chos mnyam pa nyid/ de nyid chos kyi rjes su 'brang ba rnams kyi chos mnyam pa nyid/she) de nyid brgyad pa rnams kyi chos mnyam pa nyid/ de nyid rgyun tu zhugs pa rnams kyi chos mnyam pa nyid/de nyid lan cig phyir 'ong ba rnams kyi chos mnyam pa nyid/ de nyid phyir myi 'ong ba rnams kyi mchos mnyam pa nyid/ de nyid dgra bcom pa rnams kyi duchos mnyam pa nyid/ de nyid rang sangs rgyas rnams kyi chos mnyam pa nyid/ de nyid byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi chos mnyam pa nyid/ de nyid de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi chos mnyam pa nyid yin na/ mtshan nyid myi 'dra ba'i chos rnams kyi byamanyam pa nyid ji ltar mtshan nyid gcig sapar 'gyur zhes zer ba ni/ rab 'byor de ji snyam du sems/ gzugs kyi chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ tshor ba'i chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/'du shes kyi chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ 'du byed kyi chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ rnam par shes pa'i chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ myig gi chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ rna ba'i chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ sna'i chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ lce'i chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ lus kyi chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ yid kyi chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ gzugs kyi chos nyid gang yin pa 25—786

de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ sgra'i chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ dri'i chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam//ro'i chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ reg gi chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ chos kyi chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ myig gi rnam par shes pa'i chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ rna ba'i rnam par shes pa'i chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ sna'i rnam par shes pa'i chos nyid gang yin pa / de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam51/ lce'i rnam par shes pa'i chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ lus kyi rnam par shes pa'i chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ yid kyi rnam par shes pa'i chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid 3snam yin nam/ myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ lce'i 'dus te reg 25—787

pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ sa'i khams kyi chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ chu'i khams kyi chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ mye'i khams kyi chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ rlung gi khams kyi chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ nam mkha'i khams kyi chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ rnam par shes pa'i khams kyi chos ①nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ ma rig pa'i chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ 'du byed kyi chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ rnam par shes pa'i chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam / mying dang gzugs kyi chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam / skye mched drug gi chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/reg pa'i chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ tshor ba'i chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ sred pa'i chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ len pa'i chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ srid pa'i chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ skye ba'i chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/rga shi'i chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ tshul 25—788

khrims kyi pha rold tu phyind pa'i chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ nang stong pa nyid kyi chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ phyi stong pa nyid kyi chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ phyi nang stong pa nyid kyi chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ stong pa nyid stong pa nyid kyi chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ chen po stong pa nyid kyi chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ don dam pa stong pa nyid kyi chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ 'dus byas stong pa nyid kyi chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid kyi chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid kyi chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid kyi chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid kyi chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid kyi chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid kyi chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ myi 25—789

dmyigs pa stong pa nyid kyi chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid kyi chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams kyi chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ yang dag par spong ba rnams kyi chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams kyi chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ dbang po rnams kyi chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ stobs rnams kyi chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ byang chub kyi yan lag rnams kyi chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa'i chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam / 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams kyi chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ bsam gtan rnams kyi chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ tshad myed pa rnams kyi chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ gzugs phyed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyi chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ rnam par thar pa rnams kyi chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyi chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam / rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang /smon pa myed pa'i chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ mngon 25—790

par shes pa rnams kyi chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ting nge 'dzin rnams kyi chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/gzungs kyi sgo rnams kyi chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams kyi chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ myi 'jigs pa rnams kyi chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ so so yang dag par rig pa rnams kyi chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ snying rje chen po'i chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams kyi chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu'i chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu'i chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu'i chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ dgra bcom pa nyid kyi chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ rang byang chub kyi chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid kyi chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ rgyun tu zhugs pa'i chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam / lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ phyir myi 'ong ba'i chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam / dgra bcom pa'i chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/rang sangs thos kyi chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ byang 25—791

chub sems dpa'i chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid ②stong pa nyid ma yin nam/gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de ni stong pa nyid do/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'o na stong pa nyid la gzugs kyi mtshan nyid dam/ tshor ba'i mtshan nyid dam/ 'du shes kyi mtshan nyid dam/ 'du byed kyi mtshan nyid dam/rnam par shes pa'i mtshan nyid dam/ myig gi mtshan nyid dam/ rna ba'i mtshan nyid dam/ sna'i mtshan nyid dam/ lce'i mtshan nyid dam/ lus kyi mtshan nyid dam/ yid kyi mtshan nyid dam/ gzugs ②kyi mtshan nyid dam/sgra'i mtshan nyid dam/ dri'i mtshan nyid dam/ ro'i mtshan nyid dam/ reg gi mtshan nyid dam/ chos kyi mtshan nyid dam/ myig gi rnam par shes pa'i mtshan nyid dam/ rna ba'i rnam par shes pa'i mtshan nyid dam/ sna'i rnam par shes pa'i mtshan nyid dam/ lce'i rnam par shes pa'i mtshan nyid dam/lus kyi rnam par shes pa'i mtshan nyid dam/ yid kyi rnam par shes pa'i mtshan nyid dam/ myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i mtshan nyid dam/ rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i mtshan nyid dam/ sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i mtshan nyid dam/ lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i mtshan nyid dam/ lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i mtshan nyid dam/yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i mtshan nyid dam/ myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyend kyis tshor ba'i mtshan nyid dam/ rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i mtshan nyid dam/ sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i mtshan nyid dam/lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i mtshan nyid dam/ lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i mtshan nyid dam/ yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen 25—792

kyis tshor ba'i mtshan nyid dam/ sa'i khams kyi mtshan nyid dam/ chu'i khams kyi mtshan nyid dam/ mye'i khams kyi mtshan nyid dam/ rlung gi khams kyi mtshan nyid dam/ nam mkha'i khams kyi mtshan nyid dam/ rnam par shes pa'i khams kyi ①mtshan nyid dam/ ma rig pa'i mtshan nyid dam/ 'du byed kyi mtshan nyid dam/ rnam par shes pa'i mtshan nyid dam/ mying dang gzugs kyi mtshan nyid dam/ skye mched drug gi mtshan nyid dam/ reg pa'i mtshan nyid dam/ tshor ba'i mtshan nyid dam/ sred pa'i mtshan nyid dam/ len pa'i mtshan nyid dam/ srid pa'i mtshan nyid dam/ skye ba'i mtshan nyid dam/rga shi'i mtshan nyid dam/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i mtshan nyid dam/tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mtshan nyid dam/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i mtshan nyid dam/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mtshan nyid dam/bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mtshan nyid dam/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mtshan nyid dam/ nang stong pa nyid kyi mtshan nyid dam/ phyi stong pa nyid kyi mtshan nyid dam/ phyi nang stong pa nyid kyi mtshan nyid dam/ stong pa nyid stong pa nyid kyi mtshan nyid dam/ chen po stong pa nyid kyi mtshan nyid dam/don dam pa stong pa nyid kyi mtshan nyid dam/ 'dus byas stong pa nyid kyi mtshan nyid dam/ 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid kyi mtshan nyid dam/ mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid kyi mtshan nyid dam/ thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid kyi mtshan nyid dam/ dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid kyi mtshan nyid dam/rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi mtshan nyid dam/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid kyi mtshan nyid dam/ rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid kyi mtshan nyid 'phodam/ myi 25—793

dmyigs pa stong pa nyid kyi mtshan nyid dam/ dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid kyi mtshan nyid dam/ ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi mtshan nyid dam/ dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid 〉stong pa nyid kyi mtshan nyid dam/ dran pa sanye bar gzhag pa rnams kyi mtshan nyid dam/ yang dag par spong ba rnams kyi mtshan nyid dam/rdzu 'phrul gyi /rkang pa rnams kyi mtshan nyid dam/ dbang po rnams kyi mtshan nyid dam/ stobs rnams kyi mtshan nyid dam/ byang chub kyi yan 'a/ga rnams kyi mtshan nyid dam/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa'i mtshan nyid dam/'phags pa'i bden pa rnams kyi mtshan nyid dam/ bsam gtan rnams kyi mtshan nyid dam/ tshad myed pa rnams kyi mtshan nyid dam/ gzugs phyed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyi mtshan nyid dam/ rnam par thar pa rnams kyi mtshan nyid dam/ mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyi mtshan nyid dam/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang /smon pa myed pa'i mtshan nyid dam/ mngon par shes pa rnams kyi mtshan nyid dam/ting nge 'dzin rnams rikyi mtshan thunyid dam/ gzungs kyi sgo rnams kyi mtshan nyid dam/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams kyi mtshan nyid dam/ myi 'jigs pa rnams kyi mtshan nyid dam/ so so yang dag par rig pa rnams kyi mtshan nyid dam/ 5snying rje chen po'i mtshan nyid dam/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams kyi mtshan nyid dam/ rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu'i mtshan nyid dam / lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu'i mtshan nyid dam/ phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu'i mtshan nyid dam/ dgra bcom pa nyid ⑦kyi mtshan nyid dam/rang byang chub kyi mtshan nyid dam/ lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid kyi mtshan nyid 25—794

dam / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi mtshan nyid dam/ rgyun tu zhugs pa'i mtshan nyid dam/ lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i mtshan nyid dam/ phyir myi 'ong ba'i mtshan nyid dam/ dgra bcom pa'i mtshan nyid dam/ rang sangs rgyas kyi mtshan nyid dam/ byang chub sems dpa'i mtshan nyid dam/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan nyid dam/ chos kyi mtshan nyid ci1tha dad par 'gyur ba de lta bu'i chos gang yang dmyigs sam/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de ni ma lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de lta bas na rnam grangs des 'di ltar rig par bya ste/ chos thams cad kyi chos nyid gang yin pa de la yang so so'i skye bo myed/ so so'i skye bo las gud na yang de myed/de la yang dad pa'i rjes su 'brang ba 2phyed/ dad pa'i rjes su 'brang ba las gud na yang de myed/ de la yang chos kyi rjes su 'brang ba myed / chos kyi rjes su 'brang ba las gud na yang de myed/ de la yang brgyad pa myed/ brgyad pa las gud na yang de myed/ de la yang rgyun tu zhugs pa myed/ rgyun tu zhugs pa las gud na yang de myed/ de la yang lan cig phyir 'ong ba myed/lan cig phyir 'ong ba las gud na yang de myed/ de la yang phyir myi 'ong ba myed/phyir myi 'ong ba las gud na yang de myed/ de la yang dgra bcom pa myed/dgra bcom pa las gud na yang de myed/ de la yang rang sangs rgyas myed/rang sangs rgyas las 5gud na yang de myed/ de la yang byang chub sems dpa' myed / byang chub sems dpa' las gud na yang de myed/ de la dzi yang de bzhin gshegs pa myed/ de bzhin gshegs pa las gud na yang de myed par rig par bya'o/ /gsol pa/ muchos nyid de 'dus bgyis pa tshonirmelags sam/25—795

'dus ma bgyis pa ①lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de ni 'dus byas kyang ma yin/ 'dus ma byas kyang ma yin te/ 'dus byas las gud na yang 'dus ma byas dmyigs su myed do/ /'dus ma byas las gud na yang 'dus byas dmyigs su myed de②/ rab 'byor de ltar ②'dus byas kyi khams gang yin pa dang / 'dus ma byas kyi khams gang yin pa'i chos de gnyis ka yang ldan pa yang ma yin/ myi ldan pa yang ma yin te/ gzugs myed pa bstan du myed pa/thogs ④pa myed pa/ mtshan nyid gcig pa ste/ 'di ltar mtshan nyid myed pa'o/ /de yang de bzhin gshegs pas 'jig rten gyi tha snyad du brjod kyi/ don dam par ni phyem yin te/ don dam pa la lus kyi 'du byed dam/ ngag gi 'du byed dam/yid kyi 'du byed myed de⑥/ lus kyi 'du byed dang / ngag gi 'du byed dang /yid kyi 'du byed las gud na yang don dam pa dmyigs su myed do/ /'on kyang 'dus byas dang / 'dus ma byas kyi chos rnams kyi chos ⑦mnyam pa nyid gang yin pa de ni don dam pa ste/ de'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ don dam pa las kyang myi g.yo la / byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa yang byed do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa las/ le'u bdun cu ⑧gcig go⑨//de nas tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor gyis/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das chos thams cad kyi mnyam pa nyid ni rang bzhin gyis stong pa ste/ de'i slad du chos gang la yang gang yang ci yang bgyid ⑩pa ma mchis na/ de ltar chos thams cad ci phonyeyang bgyid pa ma mchis shing /25—796

ci ①yang ma lags pa ci ②ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ don dam pa las kyang myi g.yo la/sbyin pa dang / tshig snyan ②pa dang / don bgyi ba tshogadang / don mthun pas kyang sems can thams cad kyi don bgyid pa lagasabya/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de de bzhin no/ /de de bzhin te/ ji skad du smras pa bzhin te/ stong pa nyid gang yin pa de ni gang la yang ci yang 7byed pa yang myed/ ci yang myi byed pa yang myed de/ gal te sems can 'di dag bdag cag nyid kyis stong pa nyid shes na ni/ de ltar stong pa nyid las kyang myi g.yo tshul/ sems can rnams kyang bdag gi 'du shes dang bral bar byed cing /bdag gi 'du shes dang phral nas/ stong pa nyid kyis 'khor ba las 'grel pa dang / sems can gyi du'adu shes dang bral bar byed cing / sems can gyi kyisna'adu shes dang phral nas/ stong pa nyid kyis nyu sna'akhor ba las 'grel pa dang /srog gi 'du shes dang bral bar byed cing / srog gi 'du shes dang phral nas/stong pa nyid kyis skye'akhor ba las 'grel pa dang / 'gro ba'i 'du shes dang bral bar byed cing / 'gro ba'i 'du shes dang phral nas/ stong pa nyid kyis nyu5'khor ba las 'grel pa dang / gso hu)ba'i 'du shes dang bral bar byed cing /gso ④ba'i 'du shes dang phral tsanas/ stong pa nyid kyis 'khor ba las 'grel pa dang / skyes tsobu'i 'du shes dang bral bar byed cing / skyes 0bu'i 'du shes dang phral nas/ stong pa nyid kyis 8'khor ba las 'grel pa dang / gang zag gi 'du shes dang bral bar byed cing / gang zag gi 'du shes dang phral nas/stong pa nyid kyis ⑩'khor ba las 'grel pa dang / shed (3 can gyi 'du shes dang 25—797

bral bar byed cing / shed can gyi 'du shes dang phral nas/ stong pa nyid kyis thu 'khor ba las 'grel pa dang / shed bdag gi 'du shes dang bral bar byed cing /shed bdag gi 'du shes dang phral nas/ stong pa nyid kyis 'khor ba las 'grel pa dang / byed pa po'i 'du shes dang bral bar byed cing / byed pa po'i 'du shes dang phral nas/ stong pa nyid kyis 'khor ba las 'grel pa dang / tshor ba po'i 'du shes dang bral bar byed cing / tshor ba po'i 'du shes dang phral nas/stong pa nyid kyis (5'khor ba las 'grel pa dang / shes pa po'i 'du shes dang bral bar byed cing / shes pa po'i 'du shes dang phral nas stong pa nyid kyis 'khor ba las 'grel pa dang / mthong ba po'i 'du shes dang bral bar byed cing /mthong ba po'i 'du shes dang phral nas/ stong pa nyid kyis zu'akhor ba las 'grel pa dang / gzugs kyi 'du shes dang bral bar byed cing / gzugs kyi 'du shes dang phral nas/ stong pa nyid kyis 'khor ba las 'grel pa dang /tshor ba'i 'du shes dang bral bar byed cing / tshor ba'i 'du shes dang phral ④nas / stong pa nyid kyis 'khor ba las 'grel pa dang / 'du shes kyi 'du shes dang bral bar byed cing / 'du shes kyi 'du shes dang phral nas/ stong pa nyid kyis 'khor ba las 'grel pa dang / 'du byed rnams kyi 'du shes dang bral bar byed cing / 'du byed rnams kyi ⑤'du shes dang phral nas/ stong pa nyid kyis 'khor ba las 'grel thopa dang / rnam par shes pa'i 'du shes dang bral bar byed cing / rnam par shes pa'i 'du shes dang phral nas/ stong pa nyid kyis kru'akhor ba las 'grel pa dang / myig gi 'du shes dang bral bar byed cing /myig gi 'du shes dang phral nas/ stong pa nyid kyis 'khor ba las 'grel pa dang /25—798

rna ba'i 'du shes dang bral bar byed cing / rna ba'i 'du shes dang phral khyanas/stong pa nyid kyis phya'akhor ba las 'grel pa dang / sna'i 'du shes dang bral bar byed cing / sna'i 'du shes dang phral nas/ stong pa nyid kyis 'khor ba las 'grel pa dang / lce'i 'du shes dang bral bar byed cing / lce'i 'du shes dang phral nas/ stong pa nyid kyis 'khor ba las 'grel 5pa dang / lus kyi 'du shes dang phral rgyabar byed cing / lus kyi 'du shes dang phral nas/ stong pa nyid kyis 'khor ba las 'grel pa dang / yid kyi 'du shes dang bral bar byed cing / yid kyi 'du shes dang phral nas/ stong pa nyid kyis 'khor ba las 'grel pa dang / gzugs kyi 'du shes dang bral bar byed cing / gzugs kyi 'du shes dang phral nas/ stong pa nyid kyis lta'akhor ba las 'grel pa dang /sgra'i 'du shes dang bral bar byed cing / sgra'i 'du shes dang phral nas/ stong pa nyid kyis 'khor ba las 'grel 5pa dang / dri'i 'du shes dang bral bar byed cing / dri'i 'du shes dang phral nas/ stong pa nyid kyis 'khor ba las 'grel 3pa dang / ro'i 'du shes dang bral bar byed cing / ro'i 'du shes dang phral nas / stong pa nyid kyis 'khor ba las 'grel pa dang / reg gi 'du shes dang bral bar byed cing / reg gi 'du shes dang phral nas/ stong pa nyid kyis 'khor ba las 'grel pa dang / chos kyi 'du shes dang bral bar byed cing /chos kyi 'du shes dang phral dunas/ stong pa nyid kyis shepho'akhor ba las 'grel pa dang / myig gi rnam par shes pa'i 'du shes dang bral bar byed cing / myig gi rnam par shes pa'i 'du shes dang phral nas/ stong pa nyid kyis 'khor ba las 'grel pa dang / rna ba'i rnam par shes pa'i 'du shes dang bral bar byed cing /25—799

rna ba'i rnam par shes pa'i 'du shes dang phral ①nas/ stong pa nyid kyis 'khor ba las 'grel pa dang / sna'i rnam par shes pa'i 'du shes dang bral bar byed cing / sna'i rnam par shes pa'i 'du shes dang phral nas/ stong pa nyid kyis 'khor ba las 'grel pa ②dang / lce'i rnam par shes pa'i 'du shes dang bral bar byed cing / lce'i rnam par shes pa'i 'du shes dang phral nas/ stong pa nyid kyis 'khor ba las 'grel pa dang / lus kyi rnam par shes pa'i 'du shes dang bral bar byed cing / lus kyi rnam par shes pa'i 'du shes dang phral nas/stong pa nyid kyis du'akhor ba las 'grel ④pa dang / yid kyi rnam par shes pa'i 'du shes dang bral bar byed cing / yid kyi rnam par shes pa'i 'du shes dang phral nas/ stong pa nyid kyis ⑤'khor ba las 'a grel pa dang / myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i 'du shes dang bral bar byed cing / myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i 'du shes dang phral nas/ stong pa nyid kyis ⑥'khor ba las 'grel pa dang / rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i 'du shes dang bral bar byed cing / rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i 'du shes dang phral nas/ stong pa nyid kyis ⑦'khor ba las 'grel pa dang / sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i 'du shes dang bral bar byed cing / sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i 'du shes dang phral nas/ stong pa nyid kyis du'akhor ba las 'grel pa dang / lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i 'du shes dang bral bar byed cing /lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i 'du shes dang phral nas/ stong pa nyid kyis spu'akhor ba las 'grel pa dang / lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i 'du shes dang bral bar byed cing / lus kyi 0 'dus te reg pa'i 'du shes dang phral nas/ stong pa nyid kyis 'khor ba las 'grel pa dang / yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i 'du shes dang 25—800

bral bar byed cing / yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i 'du shes dang phral nas/stong pa nyid kyis ①'khor ba las 'grel pa dang / myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i 'du shes dang bral bar byed cing / myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i 'du shes dang phral nas/ stong pa nyid kyis du'akhor ba las 'grel ④pa dang / rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i 'du shes dang bral bar byed cing / rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i 'du shes dang phral nas/ stong pa nyid kyis 'khor ba las 'grel pa dang /sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis ④tshor ba'i 'du shes dang bral bar byed cing /sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i 'du shes dang phral nas/ stong pa nyid kyis 'khor ba las 'grel pa dang / lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis ⑤tshor ba'i 'du shes dang bral bar byed cing / lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis ⑥tshor ba'i 'du shes dang phral nas/ stong pa nyid kyis 'khor ba las 'grel pa dang / lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis ༅tshor ba'i 'du shes dang bral bar byed cing / lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i 'du shes dang phral nas / stong pa nyid kyis 'khor ba las 'grel pa dang / yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i 'du shes dang bral bar byed cing / yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis dutshor ba'i 'du shes dang phral nas/ stong pa nyid kyis ⑨'khor ba las 'grel pa dang / sa'i khams kyi 'du shes dang bral bar byed cing /sa'i khams kyi 'du shes dang phral nas/ stong pa nyid kyis 'khor ba las 'grel pa dang / chu'i khams kyi 'du shes dang bral bar byed cing / chu'i khams kyi 'du shes dang phral nas/ stong pa nyid kyis 0 'khor ba las 'grel pa dang /25—801

mye'i khams kyi 'du shes dang bral bar byed cing / mye'i khams kyi 'du shes dang phral nas/ stong pa nyid kyis 'khor ba las 'grel pa dang / rlung gi khams kyi 'du shes dang bral bar byed cing / rlung gi khams kyi 'du shes dang phral nas/stong pa nyid kyis ①'khor ba las 'grel pa dang / nam mkha'i khams kyi 'du shes dang bral bar byed cing / nam mkha'i khams kyi 'du shes dang phral nas/stong pa nyid kyis zhu'akhor ba las 'grel pa dang / rnam par shes pa'i khams kyi 'du shes dang bral bar byed cing / rnam par shes pa'i khams kyi 'du shes dang phral nas/ stong pa nyid kyis 'khor ba las 'grel pa dang / ma rig pa'i 'du shes dang bral bar byed cing / ma rig pa'i 'du shes dang duphral nas/ stong pa nyid kyis 'khor ba las 'grel pa dang / 'du byed kyi 'du shes dang bral bar byed cing / 'du byed kyi 'du shes dang phral nas/ stong pa nyid kyis bya'akhor ba las 'grel pa dang / rnam par shes pa'i 'du shes dang bral bar byed cing /rnam par shes pa'i 'du shes dang phral nas/ stong pa nyid kyis 'khor ba las 'grel pa dang / mying dang gzugs kyi 'du shes dang bral bar byed cing /mying dang gzugs kyi 'du shes dang phral nas/ stong pa nyid kyis rgya'akhor ba las 'grel pa dang / skye mched drug gi byu'adu shes dang bral bar byed cing /skye mched drug gi 'du shes dang phral nas/ stong pa nyid kyis 'khor ba las 'grel pa dang / reg pa'i 'du shes dang bral bar byed cing / reg pa'i 'du shes dang phral nas/ stong pa nyid kyis ⑦'khor ba las 'grel pa dang / tshor ba'i 'du shes dang bral bar byed cing / tshor ba'i 'du shes dang phral nas/stong pa nyid kyis du'akhor ba las 'grel pa dang / srid pa'i 'du shes dang bral 25—802

bar byed cing / sred pa'i 'du shes dang phral nas/ stong pa nyid kyis ① 'khor ba las 'grel pa dang / len pa'i 'du shes dang bral bar byed cing /len pa'i 'du shes dang phral nas/ stong pa nyid kyis 37'khor ba las 'grel pa dang / srid pa'i 'du shes dang bral bar byed cing / srid pa'i 'du shes dang phral nas/ stong pa nyid kyis du'akhor ba las 'grel pa dang / skye ba'i 'du shes dang bral bar byed cing / skye ba'i 'du shes dang phral thunas/ stong pa nyid kyis 'khor ba las 'grel pa dang / rga shi'i 'du shes dang bral bar byed cing / rga shi'i 'du shes dang phral nas/ stong pa nyid kyis thu'akhor ba las 'grel pa dang / 'dus byas kyi khams kyi 'du shes dang bral bar byed cing /'dus byas kyi khams kyi 'du shes dang phral nas/ 'u'adus ma byas kyi dbyings stong pa tsayin yang / 'dus ma byas kyi dbyings su 'god pa yang de bzhin gshegs pa'i khyu mchog gi mthur mi 'gyur ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de cis stong pa lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 337'du shes thams cad kyis stong ste/ rab 'byor la la zhig gis sprul pa zhig sprul na mo/de la gang stong pa nyid ma yin pa de lta bu'i dngos po gang yang yod dam/gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de ni ma lags so/ /sprul pa de la gang stong pa nyid ma lags pa de lta bu'i dngos po gang yang ma mchis te⑩/ stong pa nyid gang lags pa dang / sprul pa gang lags pa'i chos de gnyis ka yang ldan pa yang ma lags / mi ldan pa yang ma lags te/ de gnyis ka yang stong pa nyid kyis stong na/ de ci'i slad du/ 'di ni stong pa nyid donyunya/ /'di ni 8sprul pa'o/ /zhes bgyi bar rnam par bcab pa hunyemadzad/ de ci'i slad du 6zhe na/ de ni 25—803

'di lta ste/ stong pa nyid dang / sprul pa gnyis ka yang stong pa nyid la dmigs su ma mchis so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor gzugs sam/ tshor ba'am/ 'du shes sam/ 'du byed dam/rnam par shes pa gang sprul pa ma yin pa de lta bu yod dam/ gang sprul pa de ni stong pa'o/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das gal te 'jig rten pa'i chos sprul pa lags kyang / 'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos 'di lta ste/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi dang / yang dag par ༅spong ba bzhi dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi dang / dbang po lnga dang / stobs lnga dang / byang chub kyi yan lag bdun dang / 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pe dang / rnam par thar pa'i sgo gsum dang / 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi dang / stong pa nyid thams cad dang / rnam par thar pa brgyad dang / mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu dang / ting nge 'dzin thams cad dang / gzungs kyi sgo thams cad dang / de bzhin gshegs ②pa'i stobs bcu dang / myi 'jigs pa bzhi dang / so so yang dag par rig ②pa bzhi dang / byams pa chen po dang /snying rje chen po dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa brtswa brgyad dang / de dag gi ༅'bras bu gang gis gang zag rgyun tu zhugs pa dang / lan cig ⑤phyir 'ong ba dang / phyir myi 'ong ba dang / dgra bcom pa dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / de bzhin gshegs ⑥pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas zhes gang zag rnam par dgod pa'i chos de dag kyang sprul pa lags sam / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor chos thams cad ni sprul pa ste/ de la ⑦la la ni nyan thos kyis 0sprul pa'o/ /la la ni rang 25—804

sangs rgyas kyis sprul pa'o/ /la la ni byang chub sems dpas sprul pa'o/ /la la ni de bzhin gshegs pas sprul pa'o/ /la la ni nyon mongs pas sprul pa'o/ /la la ni las kyis lasprul pa'o/ /rab 'byor rnam grangs des na chos thams cad ni sprul pa'o/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das gang spangs pa zhes bgyi ba②/rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu'am/ lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu'am/phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu'am/ dgra bcom pa nyid dam/ rang sangs rgyas kyi sa'am/ sangs rgyas kyi sa'am/ bag chags kyi mtshams sbyor ba thams cad spangs pa'i chos de dag thams cad dukyang sprul pa lags sam/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byord bskyed pa'am/ bkag pa'i chos gang ci yang rung ste/ de thams cad ni sprul pa'o/ /gsold pa/ bcom ldan 'das krugang ma sprul pa'i chos de gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsald pa/ chos gang la 3skye ba yang myed/ 'gag pa yang med pa de ni ma sprul pa'o/ /gsold pa/ 2de gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsald pa/ mi mnyam pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa ste/ chos de ni ma sprul pa'o/ /gsold pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyis ⑦'di skad du stong pa nyid las kyang myi g.yo la/ gnyis su yang myi dmigs te/ chos gang yang stong pa nyid ma yind pa de lta bu myed do/ /zhes bka' stsald pa ltar na/ bcom ldan 'das myi mnyam pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa yang sprul par 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsald pa/ rab 'byord de de bzhin no/ /de de bzhind te④/rab 'byord chos thams cad ni stong pa ste/ de dag ni nyan thos kyis ⑨ma byas/rang sangs rgyas kyis ma byas/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos ma 25—805

sna'i khams dang / dri'i khams dang / sna'i rnam par shes pa'i khams dang / lce'i khams dang / ro'i khams dang / lce'i rnam par shes pa'i khams dang / lus kyi khams dang / reg bya'i khams dang / lus kyi rnam par shes pa'i khams dang / yid kyi khams dang / chos kyi khams dang / yid kyi rnam par shes pa'i khams la ji ltar bslab par bgyi/ mig gi reg pa'i skye mched dang / rna ba dang / sna dang / lce dang /lus dang / yid kyi reg pa'i skye mched la ji ltar bslab par bgyi/ ma rig pa la ji ltar bslab par bgyi/'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa dang / ming dang gzugs dang / skye mched drug dang / reg pa dang / tshor ba dang / sred pa dang / len pa dang / srid pa dang / skye ba dang / rga shi la ji ltar bslab par bgyi/ sdug bsngal gyi bden pa la ji ltar bslab par bgyi/ kun 'byung ba'i bden pa dang /'gog pa'i bden pa dang / lam gyi bden pa la ji ltar bslab par bgyi/ gzugs can kyi (gyi )chos rnams la ji ltar bslab par bgyi/ gzugs can ma lags pa dang / bstan du mchis pa dang / bstan du ma mchis pa dang / thogs pa dang bcas pa dang / thogs pa ma mchis pa dang / 'dus bgyis pa dang /'dus ma bgyis pa dang / zag pa dang bcas pa dang / zag pa ma mchis pa dang / kha na ma tho ba dang bcas pa dang / kha na ma tho ba ma mchis pa dang / bstan par bgyi ba dang / bstan par bgyi ba ma lags pa dang / ngan pa dang / gya rnam pa dang / nang dang / phyi dang / mthong ba dang / thos pa dang /bye brag phyed pa dang / rnam par shes pa dang / 'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba dang /dge ba dang / mi dge ba dang / lung du ma bstan pa dang / 'dod pa dang rab tu ldan pa dang /gzugs dang rab tu ldan pa dang / gzugs med pa dang rab tu ldan pa dang / ldan pa ma lags pa dang /slob pa dang / mi slob pa dang / 'dod chags dang / khong khro ba dang / nga rgyal dang / ma rig pa dang /lta ba dang / the tshom la ji ltar bslab par bgyi/ ser sna dang / sbyin pa dang / 'chal ba'i tshul khrims dang / tshul khrims bzang po dang / gnod sems dang / bzod pa dang / le lo dang / brtson 'grus dang / rnam par g.yeng ba dang / bsam gtan dang / 'chal ba'i shes rab dang / shes rab la ji ltar bslab par bgyi/ rnam par rtog pa dang / stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma med pa dang / mtshan ma mchis pa dang / log pa'i smon lam dang / smon pa ma mchis pa dang / mi sdug pa'i chos rnams dang / mi rtag pa dang / sdug bsngal ba dang / bdag med pa rnams la ji ltar bslab par bgyi/ nyon mongs pa rnams dang / nyon mongs pa spangs pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa dang / rnam par byang ba dang / 'khor ba dang / mya ngan las 'das pa dang / byang chub dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams la ji ltar bslab par bgyi/de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' byams pa la bka' stsal pa/byams pa/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams kyi bar du ming tsam mo/ /zhes bya bar bslab par bya'o/ /de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' byams pas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams kyi ngo bo nyid dmigs pa kho nar mi 'gyur lags sam/ de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' byams pa la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /byams pa/ 'di ji snyam du sems/ gzugs zhes bya ba'i ming dang / 'du shes dang / brda dang /btags pa dang / tha snyad tsam kho na gang yin pa de la ji ga skye ba'am/ 'jig pa'am/ kun nas nyon mongs pa'am/ rnam par byang ba yod dam/ bcom ldan 'das/ de ni/ ma mchis lags so/ /bka' stsal pa/ byams pa/ 'o na khyod 'di snyam du/ gzugs kyi ngo bo nyid dmigs pa kho na'o/ /snyam du sems pa de ci las gyur/ byams pa/ 'di ji snyam du sems/ tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos zhes bya ba'i bar gyi ming dang / 'du shes dang /25—869

brda dang / btags pa dang / tha snyad tsam kho na gang yin pa de la ji ga skye ba'am/ 'jig pa'am/ kun nas nyon mongs pa'am/ rnam par byang ba yod dam/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das/ de ni/ ma mchis lags so/ /bka' stsal pa/ byams pa/ 'o na khyod 'di snyam du/ tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang /'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa dang / de bzhin du sbyar te sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams kyi bar gyi ngo bo nyid dmigs pa kho na'o/ /snyam du sems pa de ci las gyur/ de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' byams pas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das/ ci rnam pa thams cad du mtshan nyid thams cad kyis gzugs ma mchis pa kho na lags sam/ bcom ldan 'das/ ci rnam pa thams cad du mtshan nyid thams cad kyis tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang /rnam par shes pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams kyi bar du ma mchis pa kho na lags sam/ de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' byams pa la bka' stsal pa/ byams pa/rnam pa thams cad du mtshan nyid thams cad kyis gzugs med do/ /zhes nga mi smra'o/ /byams pa/ rnam pa thams cad du mtshan nyid thams cad kyis tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams kyi bar du med do/ /zhes nga mi smra'o/ /de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' byams pas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das / ji ltar na/ gzugs mchis pa lags/ bcom ldan 'das/ ji ltar na/ tshor ba dang /'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams kyi bar du mchis pa lags/ de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' byams pa la bka' stsal pa/ byams pa/ 'jig rten gyi brda dang / tha snyad kyis gzugs yod kyi/ don dam par ni/ma yin no/ /byams pa/ 'jig rten gyi brda dang / tha snyad kyis tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams kyi bar yod kyi/ don dam par ni/ma yin no/ /de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' byams pas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das/ bdag gis bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa'i don 'tshal ba ltar na/ dbyings 'di ni/ don dam par na brjod du ma mchis pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das/ gal te brjod du ma mchis pa'i dbyings don dam par mchis su lags na/ 'o na 'du byed kyi mtshan ma'i dngos po gang la gzugs zhes bgyi bar glo bur du ming du 'dogs par ji ltar 'gyur/ don dam par mchis na/ 'du byed kyi mtshan ma'i dngos po gang la tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams zhes bgyi ba'i bar du glo bur du ming du 'dogs par ji ltar 'gyur/ gal te don dam par ma mchis na ni/ 'o na brjod du ma mchis pa'i dbyings su'ang ji ltar 'gyur te/ 'du byed kyi mtshan ma'i dngos po ni/ brjod du ma mchis pa'i dbyings zhes bgyir mi rung lags so/ /de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' byams pa la bka' sbrul pa/ byams pa/25—870

de'i phyir khyod nyid la dri'i (dris)/ ji ltar bzod pa de bzhin du lan thob cig /byams pa/ 'di ji snyam du sems/ gang gi tshe brjod du med pa'i dbyings dang 'brel pa'i shes rab kyi spyod pa la gnas pa de'i tshe 'du byed kyi mtshan ma'i dngos po gang la 'di lta ste/ gzugs zhes bya ba dang / tshor ba zhes bya ba dang / 'du shes zhes bya ba dang / 'du byed rnams zhes bya ba dang / rnam par shes pa zhes bya ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams zhes bya ba'i bar du glo bur du ming du btags pa 'di khyod kyis dmigs sam/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das/ de ni/ mi dmigs lags so/ /bka' stsal pa/ byams pa/ rnam grangs 'dis 'du byed kyi mtshan ma'i dngos po gang yin pa de brjod du med pa'i dbyings kyang ma yin la/ 'du byed kyi mtshan ma'i dngos po de las brjod du med pa'i dbyings gzhan pa 'ang ma yin par rig par bya'o/ /'di lta ste/gzugs zhes bya ba dang / tshor ba zhes bya ba dang / 'du shes zhes bya ba dang / 'du byed rnams zhes bya ba dang / rnam par shes pa zhes bya ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams zhis bya ba'i bar du gang la glo bur du ming du btags pa'i 'du byed kyi mtshan ma'i dngos po de la gal te brjod du med pa'i dbyings yin du zin na/'o na ni/ byis pa so so'i skye bo thams cad kyang yongs su mya ngan las 'das par 'gyur zhing / bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas par yang 'gyur ro/ /byams pa/ gal te 'du byed kyi mtshan ma'i dngos po las brjod du med pa'i dbyings gzhan yin du zin na ni/ 'o na mtshan ma de'ang mi dmigs na/ 'di ltar brjod du med pa'i dbyings de rtogs par 'gyur ram/ byams pa/ rnam grangs 'dis kyang 'du byed kyi mtshan ma de las brjod du med pa'i dbyings gzhan pa'ang ma yin la/ 'di lta ste/gzugs zhes bya ba dang / tshor ba zhes bya ba dang / 'du shes zhes bya ba dang / 'du byed rnams zhes bya ba dang / rnam par shes pa zhes bya ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams zhes bya ba'i bar du gang la glo bur du ming du btags pa de las brjod du med pa'i dbyings gzhan ma yin pa'ang ma yin par rig par bya'o/ /de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' byams pas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das/ gal te byang chub sems dpa' brjod du ma mchis pa'i dbyings dang 'brel ba'i shes rab kyi spyod pa la gnas pa na/ 'di lta ste/ gzugs zhes bgyi ba dang / tshor ba zhes bgyi ba dang / 'du shes zhes bgyi ba dang 'du byed rnams zhes bgyi ba dang / rnam par shes pa zhes bgyi ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams zhes bgyi ba'i bar dag gang la glo bur du ming du btags pa'i 'du byed kyi mtshan ma'i dngos po de mi dmigs na/ bcom ldan 'das/ ci mchis pa mi dmigs pa lags sam/ 'o na te ma mchis pa mi dmigs lags/ de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' byams pa la bka' stsal pa/ byams pa/ 'du byed kyi mtshan ma'i dngos po de la ni/ rang dbang nyid dam/ yod pa nyid gang yang med do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ byams pa/ gang gi tshe khyod 'du byed kyi mtshan ma'i dngos po de la rnam par rtog pa de'i tshe 'du byed kyi mtshan ma'i dngos po de/ rnam par rtog pa rnams kyis gzung bar 'gyur ram/ gang gi tshe brjod du med pa'i dbyings dang 'brel pa'i shes rab kyi spyod pa la gnas te rnam par 25—871

mi rtog pa de'i tshe rnam par mi rtog par gzung bar 'gyur ram/ bcom ldan 'das/ de lta lags so/byams pa/ de lta yin na/ 'di lta ste/ 'du byed kyi mtshan ma'i dngos po gang la 'di ltar gzugs zhes bya ba dang / tshor ba zhes bya ba dang / 'du shes zhes bya ba dang / 'du byed rnams zhes bya ba dang / rnam par shes pa zhes bya ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams zhes bya ba'i bar glo bur du ming du btags pa de rnam par rtog pa tsam du ma zad dam/ rnam par rtog pa tsam nyid do/ /de de ltar rnam par mi rtog pa'i dbyings la gnas te rnam par rtog pa rnams dang bral bar gyur pa na/ 'di lta ste/ gzugs zhes bya ba dang / tshor ba zhes bya ba dang / 'du shes zhes bya ba dang / 'du byed rnams zhes bya ba dang / rnam par shes pa zhes bya ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams zhes bya ba'i bar du gang la glo bur du ming du btags pa de la yod pa gang yin gang yod pa ni/ dmigs par 'gyur ro/ /de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' byams pas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das/ byang chub sems dpa' shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa chos rab tu dbye ba mkhas pa la zhugs pas gzugs rab tu dbye ba'i btags pa rnam pa du zhig tu rtogs par bgyi/ tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang /rnam par shes pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams kyi bar du rab tu dbye ba'i btags pa rnam pa du zhig tu rtogs par bgyi lags/ de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' byams pa la bka' stsal pa/ byams pa/ byang chub sems dpa' shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa chos rab tu dbye ba mkhas pa la zhugs pas/ gzugs rab tu dbye ba'i btags pa rnam pa gsum du rtogs par bya/ tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams kyi bar du rab tu dbye ba'i btags pa rnam pa gsum du rtogs par bya ste/ 'di lta ste/ 'di ni/ kun btags (brtags )pa'i gzugs so/ /'di ni/ rnam par btags pa'i gzugs so/ /'di ni/ chos nyid kyi gzugs so/ /'di lta ste/ 'di ni/ kun btags (brtags )pa'i tshor ba'o/ /'di ni/ rnam par btags pa'i tshor ba'o/ /'di ni/ chos nyid kyi tshor ba'o/ /'di lta ste/ 'di ni/ kun btags (brtags )pa'i 'du shes so/ /'di ni/ rnam par btags pa'i 'du shes so/ /'di ni/ chos nyid kyi 'du shes so/ /'di lta ste/ 'di dag ni/ kun btags (brtags )pa'i 'du byed rnams so/ /'di dag ni/rnam par btags pa'i 'du byed rnams so/ /'di dag ni/ chos nyid kyi 'du byed rnams so/ /'di lta ste/'di ni/ kun btags (brtags )pa'i rnam par shes pa'o/ /'di ni/ rnam par btags pa'i rnam par shes pa'o/ /'di ni/ chos nyid kyi rnam par shes pa'o/ /'di lta ste/ 'di dag ni/ kun btags (brtags )pa'i sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams kyi bar dag go/ /'di dag ni/ rnam par btags (brtags )pa'i sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams so/ /'di dag ni/ chos nyid kyi sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams so/ /zhes bya ba'o/ /de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' byams pas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das/ kun btags pa'i gzugs ni/ gang lags/ rnam par 25—872

brtags (btags )pa'i gzugs ni/ gang lags/ chos nyid kyi gzugs ni/ gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das / kun btags (brtags )pa'i tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa dang / kun btags (brtags )pa'i sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams kyi bar du ni/ gang lags/rnam par btags pa'i sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams ni/ gang lags/ chos nyid kyi sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams ni/gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ byams pa/ gang 'du byed kyi mtshan ma'i dngos po de dang de la gzugs zhes bya ba'i ming dang / 'du shes dang / btags pa dang / tha snyad la brten nas gzugs kyi ngo bo nyid du yongs su rtog pa 'di ni/ kun btags (brtags )pa'i gzugs so/ /byams pa/gang 'du byed kyi mtshan ma'i dngos po de dang de la tshor ba zhes bya ba dang / 'du shes zhes bya ba dang / 'du byed rnams zhes bya ba dang / rnam par shes pa zhes bya ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams zhes bya ba'i bar gyi ming dang / 'du shes dang / btags pa dang / tha snyad la brten nas tshor ba'i ngo bo nyid dang /'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams kyi bar gyi ngo bo nyid du yongs su rtog pa 'di ni/ kun btags (brtags )pa'i tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa'o/ /'di dag ni/ kun btags (brtags )pa'i sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams kyi bar dag go/ /'du byed kyi mtshan ma'i dngos po de rnam par rtog pa tsam gyi chos nyid la gnas pa'i rnam par rtog pa la brten nas mngon par brjod de/ gang la 'di ni/ gzugs so/ /zhes bya ba dang /tshor ba'o/ /zhes bya ba dang / 'du shes so/ /zhes bya ba dang / 'du byed rnams so/ /zhes bya ba dang /rnam par shes pa'o/ /zhes bya ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams so/ /zhes bya ba'i bar gyi ming dang /'du shes dang / btags pa dang / tha snyad gang yin pa 'di ni/ rnam par btags pa'i gzugs so/ /'di ni/ rnam par btags pa'i tshor ba'o/ /'di ni/ rnam par btags pa'i 'du shes so/ /'di dag ni/rnam par btags pa'i 'du byed rnams so/ /'di ni/ rnam par btags pa'i rnam par shes pa'o/ /'di dag ni/ rnam par btags pa'i sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams kyi bar dag go/ /gang de bzhin gshegs pa rnams byung yang rung / de bzhin gshegs pa rnams ma byung yang rung ste/ chos nyid 'di ni/ gnas pa nyid dang /chos gnas pa'i dbyings dang / gang kun btags (brtags )pa'i gzugs des rnam par btags pa'i gzugs rtag pa rtag pa'i dus dang / ther zug ther zug gi dus su ngo bo nyid med pa kho na dang / chos la bdag med pa nyid dang / de bzhin nyid dang / yang dag pa'i mtha' 'di ni/ chos nyid kyi gzugs so/ /'di ni/ chos nyid kyi tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa'o/ /'di dag ni/ chos nyid kyi sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams kyi bar dag go/ /de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang /bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' byams pas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das/gzugs gsum po 'di dag las rdzas su ma mchis par blta ba'i gzugs ni/ gang lags/ rdzas su mchis par blta ba ni/ gang lags/ rdzas su ma mchis pa'ang ma lags la/ rdzas su mchis pa'ang ma lags shing 25—873

don dam pas rab tu phye bar blta ba ni/ gang lags/ tshor ba gsum po 'di dag dang / 'du shes gsum po 'di dag dang / 'du byed gsum po 'di dag dang / rnam par shes pa gsum po 'di dag dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams kyi bar du gsum po 'di dag las rdzas su ma mchis pa dag ni/ gang lags/ rdzas su mchis pa dag ni/ gang lag (lags )rdzas su ma mchis pa'ang ma lags la/ rdzas su mchis pa'ang ma lags shing don dam pas rab tu phye ba dag ni/ gang lags/ de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' byams pa la bka' sul pa/ byams pa/ gang kun btags (brtags )pa'i gzugs de ni/ rdzas su med par blta bar bya'o/ /rnam par btags pa'i gzugs gang yin pa de ni/ rnam par rtog pa rdzas su yod pa'i phyir rdzas su yod par blta bar bya ste/ rang dbang du 'byung ba'i phyir ni/ ma yin no/ /gang chos nyid kyi gzugs de ni/ rdzas su med pa'ang ma yin/ rdzas su yod pa'ang ma yin zhing don dam pas rab tu phye bar blta bar bya'o/ /gang kun btags (brtags )pa'i tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa dang / gang dag kun btags (brtags )pa'i sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams kyi bar de dag ni/ rdzas su med par blta bar bya'o/ /gang rnam par btags pa'i tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa dang / gang dag rnam par btags pa'i sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams kyi bar de dag ni/ rnam par rtog pa rdzas su yod pa'i phyir rdzas su yod par blta bar bya ste/ rang dbang du 'byung ba'i phyir ni/ ma yin no/ /byams pa/ gang chos nyid kyi tshor ba dang /'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa dang / byams pa/ gang dag chos nyid kyi sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams kyi bar de dag ni/ rdzas su med pa'ang ma yin la/ rdzas su yod pa'ang ma yin zhing don dam pas rab tu phye bar blta bar bya'o/ /de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' byams pas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das/ de ltar gzugs rab tu dbye ba'i btags pa'ang mchis la/ de ltar tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams kyi bar du rab tu dbye ba'i btags pa'ang mchis na/ 'di lta ste/gzugs zhes bya ba de ni/ gnyis su med pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /'di lta ste/ tshor ba zhes bya ba dang /'du shes zhes bya ba dang / 'du byed rnams zhes bya ba dang / rnam par shes pa zhes bya ba dang /sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams zhes bya ba'i bar 'di ni/ gnyis su med pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das kyis gang bka' sul pa de/ bcom ldan 'das kyis ci la dgongs nas 'di lta ste/ gzugs zhes bya ba de ni/ gnyis su med pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /'di lta ste/ tshor ba zhes bya ba dang / 'du shes zhes bya ba dang / 'du byed rnams zhes bya ba dang / rnam par shes pa zhes bya ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos kyi bar zhes bya ba de ni/ gnyis su med pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /zhes bka' stsal/ de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' byams pa la bka' stsal pa/ byams pa/ 'di ji snyam du sems/ kun btags (brtags )pa'i gzugs la rdzas su med pa nyid gang yin pa de gzugs yin nam/25—874

'on te ma yin/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das/ de ni/ ma lags so/ /de la gzugs zhes bya ba ming dang / 'du shes dang / btags pa dang / tha snyad tsam gang yin pa de ji ga gzugs yin nam/ gsol pa/bcom ldan 'das/ de ni/ ma lags so/ /byams pa/ rnam grangs 'dis gang kun btags pa'i gzugs de gzugs kyang ma yin/ gzugs ma yin pa'ang ma yin te/ gang gzugs kyang ma yin la/gzugs ma yin pa'ang ma yin pa de ni/ gnyis su med pa ste/ ngas 'di la dgongs nas 'di lta ste/gzugs zhes bya ba de ni/ gnyis su med pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /zhes bka' stsal par rig par bya'o/ /byams pa/ 'di ji snyam du sems/ gang la brten nas gzugs zhes bya ba'i ming dang / btags pa dang /tha snyad du 'gyur ba rnam par btags pa'i gzugs rdzas su yod pa nyid gang yin pa de ji ga gzugs ma yin pa yin nam/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das/ de ni/ ma lags so/ /byams pa/ 'di ji snyam du sems/rnam par btags pa'i gzugs de nyid la kun btags pa'i gzugs des de'i ngo bo nyid ma yin zhing / de'i mtshan nyid ma yin pa gang yin pa de gzugs yin nam/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das/ de ni/ ma lags so/ /byams pa/ rnam grangs 'dis kyang 'di ltar gang rnam par btags pa'i gzugs de'ang gzugs kyang ma yin la/ gzugs ma yin pa'ang ma yin te/ gang gzugs kyang ma yin la/ gzugs ma yin pa'ang ma yin pa de gnyis su med pa ste/ ngas de la dgongs nas 'di lta ste/ gzugs zhes bya ba de ni/ gnyis su med pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /zhes bka' stsal par rig par bya'o/ /byams pa/ 'di ji snyam du sems/gang chos nyid kyi (kyis )gzugs bdag med pas rab tu phye ba'i gzugs de ji ga gzugs yin nam/ gsol pa/bcom ldan 'das/ de ni/ ma lags so/ /chos nyid kyi gzugs de nyid kyi gzugs kyi chos nyid gang yin pa de gzugs ma yin nam/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das/ de ni/ ma lags so/ /byams pa/ rnam grangs 'dis kyang 'di ltar chos nyid kyi gzugs gang yin pa de'ang gzugs kyang ma yin la/ gzugs ma yin pa'ang ma yin te/ gang gzugs kyang ma yin la/ gzugs ma yin pa'ang ma yin pa de ni/ gnyis su med pa ste / ngas de la dgongs nas 'di lta ste/ gzugs zhes bya ba de ni/ gnyis su med pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /zhes bka' stsal par rig par bya ste/ de bzhin du tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang /rnam par shes pa rnams dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams kyi bar la'ang sbyar bar bya'o/ /de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' byams pas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das / byang chub sems dpa' shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa de ltar gzugs la gnyis su ma mchis pa'i mtshan nyid la mkhas shing / de ltar tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang /rnam par shes pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams kyi bar dag la mtshan nyid ma mchis pa la mkhas pa/mtha' gnyis spangs nas dbu ma'i lam la zhugs pa'i yongs su 'tshal ba'i mtshan nyid ni/ ji lta bu/ spong ba'i mtshan nyid ni/ ji lta bu/ mngon sum du bgyid pa'i mtshan nyid ni/ ji lta bu/ sgom pa'i mtshan nyid ni/ ji lta bur blta bar bgyi/ de skad ces gsol pa dang/ bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems 25—875

dpa' byams pa la bka' stsal pa/ byams pa/ byang chub sems dpa' shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa mtha' gnyis spangs nas 'di ltar dbu ma'i lam la zhugs pas gang gzugs yongs su shes pa'ang ma yin/yongs su mi shes pa'ang ma yin pa de nyid de'i yongs su shes pa'o/ /gang tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang /'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams kyi bar du yongs su shes pa'ang ma yin / yongs su mi shes pa'ang ma yin pa de nyid de'i yongs su shes pa'o/ /gang gzugs spong ba'ang ma yin mi spong ba'ang ma yin pa de nyid de'i spong ba'o/ /gang tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams kyi bar du spong ba'ang ma yin/ mi spong ba'ang ma yin pa de nyid de'i spong ba'o/ /gang gzugs spong (spang )ba mngon sum du'ang mi byed la/ mngon sum du mi byed pa'ang ma yin pa de nyid de'i mngon sum du byed pa'o/ /gang gzugs spong ba'i phyir lam sgom pa'ang ma yin / mi sgom pa'ang ma yin pa de nyid de'i sgom pa'o/ /de bzhin du tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang /'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams kyi bar la'ang sbyar bar bya'o/ /de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' byams pas 'di skad ces gsol to / /bcom ldan 'das/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa 'di lta bu'i yongs su 'tshal ba dang / spong ba dang / mngon sum du bgyid pa dang / sgom (bsgom )pa dang ldan pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa gang lags/ de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' byams pa la bka' 475 pa/ byams pa/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi mya ngan las 'das pa ni/ zab bo/ /mchog tu zab bo/ /de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' byams pas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das/ ci'i slad du byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi mya ngan las 'das pa 'di ltar zab pa dang / mchog tu zab pa lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ byams pa/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi mya ngan las 'das pa ni/ 'di ltar/mya ngan las 'das pa'ang ma yin/ mya ngan las mi 'das pa'ang ma yin te/ de'i phyir zab pa dang /mchog tu zab pa zhes bya'o/ /de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' byams pas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das/ ji ltar na/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi mya ngan las 'das pa ni/ mya ngan las 'das pa'ang ma lags/ mya ngan las ma 'das pa'ang ma lags/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ byams pa/ gzhan gyi don las brtsams te 'khor ba yongs su mi gtong bas mya ngan las 'das pa'ang ma yin no/ /bdag gi don las brtsams te mya ngan las 'das pa yongs su mi gtong bas/ mya ngan las ma 'das pa'ang ma yin no/ /de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' byams pas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das/ gal te byang chub sems dpa' gzhan gyi don las brtsams te 'khor ba yongs su mi gtong na/ de 'khor ba yongs su ma btang bas / 'dis ji ltar mya ngan las 'das pa yongs su btang bar mi 'gyur/ bcom ldan 'das/ gal te 25—876

byang chub sems dpa' bdag gi don las brtsams te mya ngan las 'das pa yongs su mi gtong na/ 'dis ji ltar 'khor ba yongs su btang bar mi 'gyur lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ byams pa/'di la byang chub sems dpa' shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa 'khor ba la'ang 'khor ba nyid du rnam par mi rtog /mya ngan las 'das pa la'ang mya ngan las 'das pa nyid du rnam par mi rtog ste/ de de ltar rnam par mi rtog pas/ 'di lta ste/ 'khor ba dang / mya ngan las 'das pa de dag mnyam pas mnyam par 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar de 'khor ba la 'khor ba nyid du rnam par mi rtog pas/ 'khor ba las yid 'byung (byung )bar mi 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du mya ngan las 'das pa la'ang mya ngan las 'das pa nyid du mi rtog pas/ mya ngan las 'das pa las nyams par yang mi 'gyur te/ de bzhin du 'khor ba na'ang mi nyams so/ /de ltar rnam par mi rtog pa'i dbyings la gnas pa de/ rigs pa 'dis 'khor ba'ang yongs su mi gtong la/ mya ngan las 'das pa'ang yongs su mi gtong bar rig par bya'o/ /de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' byams pas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das/'o na byang chub sems dpa' shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa/ rnam par mi rtog pa'i dbyings la gnas pas 'khor ba ji ltar ma btang ba de ltar blangs pa'ang ma mchis shing / mya ngan las 'das pa ji ltar ma btang ba de ltar blangs pa'ang ma mchis par mi 'gyur lags sam/ bcom ldan 'das/ gal te blangs pa ma mchis na / ji ltar ma btang ba lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ byams pa/ nga ni/ 'di ltar 'khor ba len to/ /zhe'am/ mi len to/ /zhes mi smra'o/ /byams pa/ 'on kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnam par mi rtog pa'i dbyings la dmigs pa'i ye shes kyis sems la dbang thob pa/ thabs la mkhas pas 'khor ba bstan pa'i phyir phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten na 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag tu yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams la 'khor ba yongs su mi gtong ba'o/ /zhes nga mi smra'o/ /stong pa nyid mi dmigs pa'i dbyings la gnas pa'i phyir mya ngan las 'das pa yongs su mi gtong ba'o/ /zhes nga smra'o/ /de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' byams pas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das/ rnam par mi rtog pa'i mtshan nyid 'dus pa ji ltar blta bar bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ byams pa/gzugs gang yin pa dang / tshor ba gang yin pa dang / 'du shes gang yin pa dang / 'du byed rnams gang yin pa dang / rnam par shes pa gang yin pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams kyi bar du gang yin pa dang /sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams kyi bar gyi stong pa nyid gang yin pa dang / chos de dag dang / stong pa nyid de'i dngos po dang / dngos po med pa/ gnyis su med pa/ spros pa med pa gang yin pa de ni/ byams pa/rnam par mi rtog pa'i mtshan nyid 'dus par blta'o/ /de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' byams pas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das/ ci nyan thos thams cad gcig tu nges par gtan du mya ngan las 'das pa la gnas pa lags sam/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' sul 25—877

pa / byams pa/ de ni/ ma yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ byams pa/ 'jig rten 'di ni/ khams sna tshogs pa/ khams du ma pa ste/ khams sna tshogs pa/ khams du ma pa'i 'jig rten de na sems can gyi rigs dang / rang bzhin mang du dmigs te/ byams pa/ gang thog ma nyid nas bzang po'i bye brag don du gnyer te/ bzang po'i bye brag nyid thob par 'gyur ba'i sems kyi rigs kyi rnam pa de lta bu'ang yod/ gang thog ma nyid nas dman pa'i bye brag don du gnyer te dman pa nyid thob la/ de nyid kyis chog par 'dzin pa'i rigs kyi rnam pa de lta bu'ang yod/ gang thog ma nyid nas dman pa'i bye brag don du gnyer te dman pa nyid thob la/dman par shes nas de tsam gyis chog par mi 'dzin gyi/ de'i gong du bzang po'i bye brag tshol zhing bzang po thob par 'gyur ba'i rigs kyi bye brag de lta bu'ang yod do/ /de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang /bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' byams pas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das/sems can rnams kyi rigs kyi rnam pa gsum po gang lags pa de/ dgra bcom pa nyid thob nas bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub don du gnyer kyang skye ba ma mchis pas ji ltar thob par 'gyur/ sgrub (bsgrub )pa nyid de'i skye ba lags par ni/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' ma stsal lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ byams pa/ de'i skye ba las dang / nyon mongs pa'i dbang gis 'gyur bar ni/nga mi 'dogs kyi/ de'i skye ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / sprul pa dang / yongs su bsngos pa'o/ /zhes nga 'dogs so/ /de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' byams pas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das/ 'di ltar thog ma nyid nas bzang po'i bye brag don du gnyer zhing bzang po'i bye brag nyid thob par 'gyur ba byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i bsam pa rlabs po che dang / che ba'i lhag pa'i bsam pa ni/ ngo mtshar lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi bsam pa rlabs po che ni/ gang lags/ che ba'i lhag pa'i bsam pa nyid ni/ gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ byams pa/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams brgya byin nyid dang / tshangs pa nyid dang /'jig rten skyong ba nyid dang / 'khor los bsgyur ba nyid thams cad dang / 'jig rten gyi phun sum tshogs pa thams cad don du gnyer ba ma yin gyi/ de dag la mi chags shing mi 'dzin pa gang yin pa 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi bsam pa rlabs po che'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams 'di lta ste/ 'du byed yongs su mi gtong bas/ de la ma chags pa'i bde ba dang / 'dzin pa med pa'i bde ba dang / mya ngan las 'das pa'i bde ba sems can thams cad dang thun mong du bya bar 'dod cing bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngo bar byed pa gang yin pa 'di ni/ de dag gi che ba nyid kyi lhag pa'i bsam par blta bar bya'o / /de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' byams pas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das/
