byang chub sems dpa'i chos rnams ni/ ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba lags so//byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa ni/ ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo byang chub sems dpa'i chos ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba rnams la slob par 'tshal bas bla 25—878

na med pa yang dag par rdzos pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed par bgyi lags so// //shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa/ bam po sum brgya gsum (gnyis )pa/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor la bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshol bar 'dod pa'i rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo des ji ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngu de ltar de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sgra dbyangs mi zad par sgrog pa'i drung na tshangs par spyad pa spyod pa des yongs su btsal ba de bzhin du shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di yongs su btsal bar bya'o/ /de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang /bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor gyis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngus shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di yongs su tshor ba na ji ltar yongs su btsal lags/ de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngu sngon shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su tshol ba na lus la ched cher mi 'dzin/ srog la mi lta/ rnyed pa dang / bkur ste dang /tshigs su bcad pa dag la mi gnas par yongs su btsal bas yongs su btsal to/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su tshol zhing 'brog dgon pa zhig tu phyin pa na bar snang las sgra thos par gyur te/ rigs kyi bu/shar phyogs su song zhig dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa thos par 'gyur gyi(gyis)/ ci nas lus ngal ba yid la byed pa mi bskyed pa dang / gnyid dang rmugs pa yid la byed pa mi bskyed pa dang / bza' ba yid la byed pa mi bskyed pa dang / btung ba yid la byed pa mi bskyed pa dang / mtshan mo yid la byed pa mi bskyed pa dang / nyin mo yid la byed pa mi bskyed pa dang / grang ba yid la byed pa mi bskyed pa dang / tsha ba yid la byed pa mi bskyed pa de ltar song zhig /nang ngam phyi rol gang la'ang sems smon par ma byed cig /rigs kyi bu/ shar dang / lhor ma lta bar song zhig /nub dang / byang dang / steng dang / 'og dang /phyogs mtshams su'ang ma lta bar song zhig /rigs kyi bu/ ci nas 'jigs tshogs las kyang ma g.yos pa dang /ci nas gzugs las kyang ma g.yos pa dang / ci nas tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang /rnam par shes pa las kyang ma g.yos pa de ltar song zhig /gang 'di las g.yos pa de ni/ rnam par nyams par 'gyur ro/ /ci las nyams par 'gyur zhe na/ sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams las nyams par 'gyur ro/ /gang sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams las nyams par 'gyur ba de ni/ 'khor ba la spyod do/ /gang 'khor ba la spyod pa de ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rjes su mi thob po/ /de skad ces smras pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu dus sgra de la 'di skad ces smras so/ /de bzhin du bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na / bdag ni/ sems can thams cad la snang ba byed par 'dod pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad sgrub par 'dod pa'i phyir ro/ /de skad ces smras pa dang / sgra des byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngu la 'di skad ces smras so/ /rtag tu ngu / legs so/ /legs so/ /de nas byang chub 25—879

sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngus yang sgra thos te 'di skad du/ rigs kyi bu/ khyod kyis stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa med pa'i chos dag la mos pa bskyed la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su btsal bar bya'o/ /khyod kyis mtshan ma yongs su spang bar bya/ dngos po yongs su spang bar bya / sems can du lta ba yongs su spang bar bya'o/ /rigs kyi bu/ khyod kyis rig pa'i grogs po dag spang bar bya'o/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen gang dag stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa med pa dang / ma byung ba dang / ma skyes pa dang / dngos po med pa dang / ma 'gag pa'i chos rnams ston pa dag la bsnyen par bya/ bsten (sten )par bya/ bsnyen bkur bya'o/ /rigs kyi bu/ khyod kyis de ltar bsgrubs na/ ring por mi thogs par shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa glegs bam du chud pa'am/ dge slong chos smra ba'i lus la yod pa thos par 'gyur te/ rigs kyi bu/ gang las shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di thos pa de la rigs kyi bu/ khyod kyis ston par 'du shes bskyed par bya zhing / khyod kyis byas pa gzo ba dang /byas pa tshor bar bya ste/ gang las shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di thos pa 'di ni/ bdag gi dge ba'i bshes gnyen yin te/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa de bdag gis thos pas myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par 'gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams la bsnyen par 'gyur zhing / sangs rgyas kyi zhing de bzhin gshegs pa dang ma bral ba rnams su skye bar 'gyur ro/ /mi khom pa rnams spong bar 'gyur ro/ /dal ba phun sum tshogs pa thob par 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu/ phan yon 'di rnams khyod kyis yongs su rtogs la dge slong chos smra ba la ston pa yin par 'du shes bskyed par bya'o/ /rigs kyi bu/ khyod kyis 'jig rten gyi zang zing dang ldan pa'i sems kyi rgyud kyis dge slong chos smra ba'i phyi bzhin 'brang bar mi bya'o/ /khyod kyis dge slong chos smra ba la chos don du gnyer ba dang / chos la gus par bya bas phyi bzhin 'brang bar bya'o/ /khyod kyis bdud kyi las rnams rtogs par bya ste/ rigs kyi bu/ bdud sdig can ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams la gzugs dang / sgra dang / dri dang / ro dang / reg pa dag bsnyen pa dang / bsten pa dang / spyad par bya ba'i phyir nye bar sgrub ste/ de dag des zil gyis mnan nas thabs la mkhas pas 'grogs shing bsten pa dang / bsnyen par byed pa'ang yod de/ rigs kyi bu/ khyod kyis chos smra ba de la mi dad pa bskyed par mi bya'o/ /gzhan du na sems 'di ltar bskyed par bya ste/ bdag ni/ thabs mkhas pa de mi shes kyi/'di ni/ thabs mkhas pa rab tu shes so/ /'di ni/ sems can gyi tshul gyis sems can rnams kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs su gzung ba'i phyir chos 'di dag la bsten cing 'grogs te bsnyen par byed kyi/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams ni/ gang la'ang chags pa'am/ sgrib pa med kyi/ skad cig de nyid la rigs kyi bu/ khyod nyid kyis yang dag pa'i tshul so so brtag par bya'o/ /rigs kyi bu/ chos rnams kyi yang dag pa'i tshul gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ chos thams cad kun nas nyon mongs pa ma yin/ rnam par byang ba ma yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ chos thams cad ni/ ngo bo nyid kyis stong pa'i phyir te/ chos 25—880

thams cad ni/ sems can med pa/ srog med pa/ gang zag med pa/ sgyu ma lta bu/ mi lam lta bu/brag ca lta bu/ mig yor lta bu ste/ rigs kyi bu/ chos rnams kyi yang dag pa'i tshul de ltar rtog cing chos smra ba'i (bar )phyir 'brang na/ ring por mi thogs par shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la nges par 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang rigs kyi bu/ khyod kyis bdud kyi las la soms shig /rigs kyi bu/ gal te chos smra ba dag shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'dod pa'i rigs kyi bu la brnyas par byed cing mi sems na/ de la rigs kyi bu/ khyod kyis phyir dgyed par mi bya ste/ gzhan du na chos don du gnyer ba nyid dang / chos la gus par byed pa nyid dang / yid mi skyo bas dge slong chos smra ba'i phyi bzhin 'brang bar bya'o/ /zhes thos so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngus sgra de las rjes su bstan pa 'di blangs nas shar phyogs ga la ba der song ba dang / ring por ma phyin par de 'di snyam du sems te/ bdag gis sgra de la ji srid du 'gro bar bya ba ma dris so/ /snyam nas de sa phyogs de nyid na ngu zhing mya ngan byed de the zhing 'dug go/ /de sa phyogs de na nyin zhag gcig 'das par byed/ nyin zhag gnyis sam/ gsum mam/ bzhi'am/lnga'am / bdun 'das kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa thos par ma gyur gyi bar du lus ngal ba yid la byed pa mi bskyed/ rmugs pa dang gnyid yid la byed pa mi bskyed/ bza' ba yid la byed pa mi bskyed/ btung ba yid la byed pa mi bskyed/ mtshan mo yid la byed pa mi bskyed/ nyin mo yid la byed pa mi bskyed/ grang ba yid la byed pa mi bskyed/ tsha ba yid la byed pa mi bskyed do/ /rab 'byor/ 'di lta ste/ dper na/skyes bu la la zhig bu gcig pa 'chi ba'i dus byas na/ sdug bsngal ba dang / yid mi bde ba chen po dang ldan par 'gyur te/ de lta bu'i mya ngan gyis bu gcig pu yid la byed pa 'byung ba ma gtogs par yid la byed pa gzhan gang yang mi 'byung ngo / /rab 'byor/ de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngu'ang de'i tshe bdag gis nam shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa thos par 'gyur snyam pa ma gtogs par yid la byed pa gzhan gang yang mi 'byung ngo / /rab 'byor/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngu de ltar gdung zhing 'dug pa'i mdun du de bzhin gshegs pa'i gzugs shig bzhugs nas legs so/ /zhes bya ba byin te/ rigs kyi bu/ khyod tshig de skad smra ba legs so/ /legs so/ /ji ltar khyod kyis de ltar yongs su btsal ba de bzhin du/ sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis kyang sngon byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa na shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su btsal to/ /rigs kyi bu/ de'i phyir khyod kyis brtson 'grus 'di dang / spro ba 'di dang / don du gnyer ba 'di dang / 'dod pa 'di lta bus rjes su 'brang zhing shar phyogs nyid du song zhig dang / rigs kyi bu/'di nas dpag tshad lnga brgya na spos ldan zhes bya ba'i grong khyer rin po che sna bdun las byas pa'i ra ba rim pa bdun gyis bskor ba/ thobs rim pa bdun dang / shing ta la'i phreng ba rim pa bdun gyis yongs su bskor ba/chur dpag tshad bcu gnyis/ zheng du dpag tshad bcu gnyis yod pa/ 'byor pa rgyas pa/ bde ba/ lo legs pa/ skye bo mang po dang mis gang ba/ grong bar dang srang mnyam zhing mtshungs pa lnga brgya dag gis ri 25—881

mor bris pa bzhin du gtams pa/ khyogs khri nyam mi nga ba dang / bar bar dag tu zam pa btags pa/grong khyer kyi (gyi )khor yug tu zhol gyi phyi ra ba rin po che sna bdun las legs par byas shing bskor ba/ rin po che sna bdun gyi ra ba de dag gi mda' yab rnams ni/ dzamu chu bo'i gser las byas pa/ mtho zhing tshad dang ldan pa/ mda' yab thams cad kyi rtse mo las kyang rin po che sna bdun gyi shing skyes te rin po che sna tshogs kyi shing thog gi 'bras bu chags pa/ mda' yab las shing skyes pa thams cad las kyang rin po che'i tha gu byung bas mda' yab gnyis pa gzhan dang 'brel ba/ grong khyer thams cad gser gyi dril bu g.yer kha'i dra bas khebs te gser gyi dril bu g.yer kha de dag la rlung gis btab na/ sgra 'jam zhing snyan pa yid du 'ong ba dag 'byung ba 'di lta ste/ dper na/ yan lag lnga dang ldan pa'i rol mo tshogs pa rol mo mkhan mkhas pas brdungs shing blangs na/ sgra 'jam zhing snyan la yid du 'ong ba dag 'byung ba de bzhin du dril bu g.yer kha de dag la rlung gis btab na/ sgra 'jam zhing snyan pa yid du 'ong ba dag 'byung ste/ sgra des sems can de dag rtse dga' zhing dga' mgur spyod do/ /grong khyer de khor yug tu thobs chu 'bab pas gang zhing / chu ha cang yang mi grang /chu ha cang yang mi dro bas gang ba dag yod do/ /chu de la sngon gyi rnam par smin pas grub pa rin po che sna bdun gyi gru dag yod de/ der sems can de dag zhugs nas rtse dga' zhing rab tu rgyu'o/ /chu de thams cad kyang me tog utpa la dang / ku mu da dang / padma dkar po dag gis khebs pa/ me tog gi rigs che zhing bzang la/dri zhim po'i ngad ldan pa gzhan dag gis kyang khebs te/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams na yod pa'i me tog gi rigs las de na med pa gang yang med do/ /grong khyer de'i nang na skyed mos tshal lnga brgya yod de/ thams cad kyang rin po che sna bdun las byas pa rnam par bkra zhing blta na sdug pa sha stag ste/ skyed mos tshal de dag re re na'ang rdzing bu kho ra yug tu rgyang grags kyi tshad tsam lnga brgya lnga brgya yod de/ rdzing bu de dag gi kho ra yug thams cad nas rin po che sna bdun gyi me tog utpa la dang / ku mu da dang / padma dkar po rnam par bkra zhing blta na sdug pa dag skyes te/ de dag gis chu de khebs shing me tog utpa la dang / ku mu da dang / padma dkar po de dag thams cad kyang chu zheng du shing rta'i 'phang lo tsam ste/ sngon po/ kha dog sngon po / sngon po lta bur ston pa/ 'od sngon po 'byung ba/ ser po/ kha dog ser po/ ser po lta bur ston pa/'od ser po 'byung ba/ dmar po/ kha dog dmar po/ dmar po lta bur ston pa/ 'od dmar po 'byung ba/dkar po/ kha dog dkar po/ dkar po lta bur ston pa/ 'od dkar po 'byung ba dag yod do/ /rdzing bu de dag thams cad na ngang ngur dang / khrung khrung dang / bya ka raṇḍa ba dang / bzhad sgra 'byin pa dag yod do / /skyed mos tshal de dag thams cad kyang nga yir bya ba med cing ris su bcad pa med de/ 'di ltar sems can dag yun ring por shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing / yun ring por chos zab mo la mos pa'i sems can de dag gi sngon gyi las kyi rnam par smin pas grub pa yin no/ /rigs kyi bu/ grong khyer de dag gi dbus kyi bzhi mdo na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags kyi khang pa rin po che sna bdun las byas pa/ kho ra yug tu dpag tshad kyi tshad tsam yod pa/ rnam par bkra zhing blta na sdug pa/ ra 25—882

ba rim pa bdun dang / ta la'i phreng ba rim pa bdun gyis yongs su bskor ba zhig yod de/ khang pa de na khang pa'i longs spyod du rtag tu rab dga' zhes bya ba'i skyed mos tshal dang / mya ngan med ces bya ba dang /mya ngan bral zhes bya ba dang / me rtog sna tshogs pa zhes bya ba'i skyed mos tshal dang skyed mos tshal bzhi yod de/skyed mos tshal de dag re re na'ang rdzing bu bzang po zhes bya ba dang / bzang mchog ces bya ba dang / dga' ba zhes bya ba dang / dga' mchog ces bya ba dang / bde ba zhes bya ba dang / bde ldan zhes bya ba dang /nges pa zhes bya ba dang / mi 'bab ces bya ba brgyad brgyad yod de/ jing bu de dag gi ngos gcig ni/gser las byas/ ngos gnyis pa ni/ dngul las byas/ ngos gsum pa ni/ bai ḍūrya las byas/ ngos bzhi pa ni/ shel las byas/ nang gi sa gzhi ni/ ke ke ru la gser gyi bye ma bdal ba ste/ rdzing bu de dag re re la'ang them skas them pa rin po che sna tshogs rnam pa tha dad pas brgyan pa brgyad brgyad yod de/ them skas de dag thams cad kyi bar nas kyang dza chu bo'i gser gyi shing sngon pa dag skyes so/ /rdzing bu de dag thams cad kyi chu ni/ me tog ku mu da dang / utpa la dang / padma dkar po sna tshogs kyis khebs shing ngang ngur dang / khrung khrung dang / bzhad rnams skad 'byin to/ /rdzing bu de dag gi kho ra yug tu me rtog gi shing rnam pa sna tshogs skyes te/ shing de dag rlung gis bskyod pa dang / me tog rnams rdzing bu'i dang du lhung bas/rdzing bu de thams cad kyi chu'ang tsandan gyi drir phyogs shing kha dog dang ldan/ dri dang ldan no/ /de na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags 'khor dang bcas pa bud med drug khri brgyad stong dang lhan cig tu 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan zhing 'byor te/ rtse dga' zhing dga' mgur spyod do/ /grong khyer de na sems can skyes pa dang / bud med gang gzhan dag 'khod pa de dag thams cad kyang skyed mos tshal lam/rdzing bu dag na rtag tu dga' zhing 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan te/ rtse dga' zhing dga' mgur spyod do/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags de 'khor rnams dang lhan cig tu rtse dga' ste/dga' mgur spyod cing / de na dus gsum du shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ston to/ /sems can gang dag grong khyer spos ldan na 'khod pa de dag kyang grong khyer gyi dbus kyi bzhi mdor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags kyi khri gser gyi rkang pa dang / dngul gyi rkang pa dang / bee ḍūrya'i rkang pa dang /shel gyi rkang pa btsugs pa/ shing bal bting ba/ stan nang tshangs can bting ba/ stan snying po can du byas pa/ ka shi na'i ras bting ba/ 'phang du rgyang grags byed yod pa bshams te/ steng gi bar snang la ras kyi bla re mu tig gis brgyan pa bres shing / de ltar chos la gus par byed pas sa phyogs de kho ra yug kyang me rtog kha dog sna lnga pa dag mngon par gtor cing / sa phyogs de'ang spos sna tshogs dang / bdug pa sna tshogs kyis shin tu bdug par byed de/ de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags 'dug nas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ston te/ rigs kyi bu/ sems can de dag ni/ de lta bur gus par byed cing /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags las shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa nyan to/ /de na gang dag nyan pa'i lha dang / mi srog chags brgya phrag mang po/ srog chags stong phrag mang po/ srog chags 25—883

'bum phrag mang po tshogs pa de dag las la la ni/ lung nod/ la la ni/ kha ton byed de/ la la ni/yi ger 'bri/ la la ni/ tshul bzhin yid la byed pas rtogs par byed de/ sems can de dag thams cad kyang log par mi snang ba'i chos can te/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog pa sha stag go/ /rigs kyi bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags de'i drung du song zhig dang / de nas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa thos par 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu/ de ni/ yun ring po nas khyod kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen yin te/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub yang dag par ston pa/ yang dag par 'dzin du 'jug pa/ yang dag par gzengs bstod pa/ yang dag par rab tu dga' bar byed pa yin no/ /rigs kyi bu/ des kyang sngon da ltar khyod ji ltar tshol ba bzhin du shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su btsal gyi/ rigs kyi bu/ khyod nyin mtshan du yid la byed pa rgyun ma bcad par song zhig dang / ring por mi thogs par shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa thos par 'gyur ro/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngus de thos nas dga' mgu yid rangs/ rab tu mgu zhing dga' ba dang / yid bde ba skyes par gyur pas/ 'di lta ste/ dper na/ skyes bu mde'u dug can zhig gis phog na/ yid la byed pa gzhan mi bskyed kyi/ gang bdag sdug bsngal 'di las thar bar byed pa/ zug rngu 'byin pa'i sman pa bdag gis nam rnyed snyam sems pa de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngu'ang gang bdag la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa thos par byed cing / chos gang thos nas bdag gi dmigs pa yid la byed pa spong bar 'gyur ba'i rigs kyi bu de bdag gis nam mthong snyam sems pa ma gtogs par chos gang yang yid la mi byed do/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngus sa phyogs de nyid du 'dug ste/ chos thams cad la mi gnas pa'i 'du shes bskyed nas de ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo du ma mngon du gyur pa 'di lta ste/ chos thams cad kyi ngo bo nyid la lta ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang /chos thams cad kyi ngo bo nyid mi dmigs pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / chos thams cad mi shes pa dang bral ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / chos thams cad 'gyur ba med par mthong ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / chos thams cad snang bar byed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / chos thams cad mun pa dang bral ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / chos thams cad mi shes pa sel ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / chos thams cad mi dmigs pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / me tog bkram pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / chos thams cad bdag gi dngos po mi sgrub pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / sgyu ma rnam par spangs pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / me long gi dkyil 'khor snang ba sgrub pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / sems can thams cad kyi sgra sgrub (bsgrub )pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / chos thams cad tha dad pa med pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / sems can thams cad mngon par dga' ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / sems can thams cad kyi sgra la mkhas pa'i rjes su song ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang /sgra dang / tshig dang / 'bru sna tshogs sgrub pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / ma khengs pa zhes bya ba'i 25—884

ting nge 'dzin dang / rang bzhin rnam par bltas pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / sgrib pa med pa'i rnam par thar pa thob pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / rdul dang bral ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang /ming dang / nges pa'i sgra dang / tshig dang / 'bru zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / chos thams cad la rnam par lta ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / chos thams cad la sgrib pa med pa'i mtha' zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / nam mkha' dang mtshungs pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / rdo rje lta bu zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / gzugs kyi rdul sel ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / rgyal ba thob pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / phyir mi sdog pa'i mig ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / chos kyi dbyings las nges par byung ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / dbugs 'byin pa sbyin pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / seṅge mngon par bsgrags pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / sems can thams cad zil gyis gnon pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / rdul med pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa med pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / padma bkod pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / rnam nur gcod pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / snying po thams cad kyi (kyis )rjes su song ba zhes bya ba'i mang nge 'dzin dang / chos thams cad las mngon par 'phags pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / mngon par shes pa dang / stobs dang /mi 'jigs pa thob pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / chos thams cad las nges par 'thags pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / chos thams cad kyi 'byor pa rgya mtsho zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / chos thams cad bye brag med par lta ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / lta bar gyur pa'i thibs po thams cad rnam par spong ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / mun pa dang bral ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / chos thams cad mtshan ma dang bral ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / chags pa thams cad las rnam par grol ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / le lo thams cad dang bral ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / chos zab mo'i 'od byed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / ri rab 'dra ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / mi 'phrog pa zhes bya ba'i mang nge 'dzin dang / bdud kyi dkyil 'khor rnam par 'joms par byed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / 'jig rten gsum la mngon par ma zhen pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / 'od zer sgrub pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / de bzhin gshegs pa mthong ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin rnams mngon du gyur te/de ting nge 'dzin de dag la gnas pas phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams rnams na sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das grangs med dpag tu med pa dag byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dag la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di rab tu ston pa dag mthong ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gis legs so/ /zhes bya ba byin nas dbugs dbyung ba mdzad de/ tshig 'di skad kyang gsung ngo / /rigs kyi bu/ nged kyis kyang byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa na shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di bzhin du btsal te/ yongs su tshol ba na'ang ting nge 'dzin 'di dag thob ste/ ting nge 'dzin 'di dag thob nas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rtogs par khong du chud par gyur te/ phyir mi ldog pa'i sangs rgyas kyi chos la gnas par gyur to/ /nged kyis ting nge 'dzin 'di 25—885

dag gi ngo bo nyid dang rang bzhin la bltas na/ gang mnyam par gzhag par bya ba'am/ ldang bar bya ba'am/byang chub tu spyad pa'am/ gang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar bya ba'i chos de gang yang yang dag par rjes su mi mthong ngo / /rigs kyi bu/ 'di ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa de yin te/ rigs kyi bu/ chos gang gis kyang zlas sems sam/ zlos sems med par mi byed pa la gnas nas nged kyis kyang 'di 'dra ba'i lus gser gyi kha dog lta bu thob ste/ skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis dang / dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu dang / 'od 'dom gang ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi ye shes dang / sangs rgyas kyi shes rab bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi ting nge 'dzin bla na med pa dang / yon tan thams cad kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rjes su thob ste/ yon tan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa de la de bzhin gshegs pa dag gis kyang tshad gzung ba'am/ mtha' bstan par mi nus na/ nyan thos dang /rang sangs rgyas dag gis lta ci smos/ rigs kyi bu/ de lta bas na/ khyod kyis chos 'di dag nyid la rab tu don du gnyer ba dang / 'dun pas gus pa mchog tu bskyed par bya ste/ rigs kyi bu/ don du gnyer ba dang / 'dun pa la ni/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub rnyed par dka' ba ma yin no/ /khyod kyis dge ba'i bshes gnyen la shin du gus pa bskyed par bya'o/ /phang bar bya'o/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis yongs su zin pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni/ myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya'o/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa de dag la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngus 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bdag gi dge ba'i bshes gnyen gang lags/ de dag gis de la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rigs kyi bu/ khyod yun ring po nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags kyis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su smin par byas shing yongs su bzung ste shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / thabs la mkhas pa la bslab bo(so)/ /rigs kyi bu/ de ni/ khyod yongs su 'dzin pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen yin gyi(gyis)/des khyod la ci bsgo ba bzhin du zungs shig (zung zhig) /rigs kyi bu/ gal te khyod kyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags la bskal pa'am/ bskal pa gnyis sam/ bskal pa brgya'am/bskal pa stong ngam/ de las lhag par yang mgo la thod bzhin du thogs shing bde ba'i yo byad thams cad kyis rim gro byas te/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams na gzugs dang / sgra dang / dri dang /ro dang / reg pa ji snyed yod pa de dag thams cad phul yang rigs kyi bu/ khyod kyis de la lan lon pa ma yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rigs kyi bu/ de'i mthus khyod kyis ting nge 'dzin 'di lta bu dag rnyed par gyur te/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / thabs la mkhas pa thos shing shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa thob par gyur to/ /de narme de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngu dbugs phyung nas mi snang bar gyur to/ /rigs kyi bu de'ang ting nge 'dzin de dag las langs te/langs nas kyang 'di snyam du sems so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gang nas byon/ de bzhin gshegs pa 25—886

de dag gang du bzhud snyam ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa de dag ma mthong bas rab tu gdung zhing mi dga' bar gyur to/ /yang de 'di snyam du sems te/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags ni/gzungs thob pa/ mngon par shes pa lnga dang ldan pa/ sngon gyi rgyal ba rnams la lhag par bya ba byas pa ste/bdag yongs su 'dzin pa/ bdag gi dge ba'i bshes gnyen/ yun ring po nas des bdag gi don byas pa yin gyi/ bdag byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags kyi drung du mngon par song ste phyin nas de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gang nas byon/ de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gang du bzhud ces don 'di nyid dri'o/ /snyam mo/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags la dga' ba dang / dad pa dang / ri mo dang / gus par bya ba nye bar bzhag ste/ nye bar bzhag nas 'di snyam du sems so/ /bdag gis ji lta bu'i bkur ste bya bas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags de'i drung du 'gro bar bya/ bdag ni/ dbul te gang gis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags la bdag gis bkur ster bya ba'i gos rin po che'am/gser ram/ nor bu'am/ mu tig gam/ bai ḍūrya'am/ dung ngam/ man shel lam/ byu ru'am/dngul lam/ sa le sbram mam/ me tog gam/ spos sam/ me tog phreng ngam/ byug pa'am/ gdugs de lta bu'ang bdag la med na/ bdag 'di bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' chos 'phags kyi drung du song na ni/bdag gis tshul ma yin pa byas par 'gyur te/ bdag dga' ba'am/ rangs pa'ang mi skye'o/ /snyam du sems so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngu de lta bu'i yon tan dag dang / bla ma la gus pa yid la byed pa dang ldan pas song nas mthar gyis grong gzhan zhig tu phyin pa dang / de'i grong bar gyi dbus su de 'di snyam du sems te/ 'di ltar bdag gis lus btsongs la de'i rin gyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags la bkur ste bya'o/ /yun ring po nas bdag i lus stong zhig cing zad de btsongs la/ 'khor ba dpag tu med pa dag na 'dod pa'i rgyus yang dang yang sems can dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal dpag tu med pa dag myong yang 'di lta bu'i chos kyi phyir ram/ 'di lta bu'i sems can chen po la bkur ste bya ba'i phyir ni/ ma yin no/ /snyam mo/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngus grong bar du 'dug ste/ mi su nyo 'dod/ mi su nyo 'dod ces sgra bsgrags shing skad kyis bos so/ /de nas bdud rig can 'di snyam du sems te/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngu 'di ni/chos 'dod pa'i phyir bdag nyid btsongs nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags la bkur sti byed cing / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la ji ltar spyad na/ myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur/ thos pa rgya mtsho rjes su thob par 'gyur/ bdud dang bdud kyi ris kyi lha dag gis mi thub par 'gyur/ yon tan thams cad kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rjes su thob par 'gyur zhes shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / thabs la mkhas pa yongs su 'dri bar 'gyur te/ der sems can mang po dag gi don byed par 'gyur/ bla na med pa yang dag 25—887

par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon pa ra rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas de dag kyang nga'i yul las 'da' bar byed/sems can gzhan dag kyang nga'i yul las 'da' bar byed par 'gyur gyi(gyis)/ bdag gis 'di la bar chad bya'o/ /snyam nas bdud sdig can gyis ci nas bram ze dang / khyim bdag de dag gis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngus mi su nyo 'dod/ su nga nyo bar 'dod ces zer ba'i sgra mi thos par 'gyur ba de lta bur yongs su bsgribs so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngu gang gi tshe bdag nyo ba ma rnyed pa de'i tshe phyogs gcig tu song nas mchi ma rgyung (byung )ste/ 'di ltar bdag gi lus btsongs la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags la bkur ste bya snyam na/ lus nyo ba'ang bdag gis ma rnyed de/ kye ma bdag ni/ rnyed pa ngan pa rnyed do/ /snyam mo/ /de nas lha'i dbang po brgya byin 'di snyam du sems te/ 'di ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngu 'di lta ste/chos 'dod pa'i phyir bdag gi lus yongs su btang bar lhag pa'i bsam pa phun sum tshogs pa yin nam ma yin pa byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngu la bdag gis bgam par bya'o/ /snyam ste/ lha'i dbang po brgya byin bram ze'i khye'u'i cha byad du mngon par sprul nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngu ga la ba der song ste phyin nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngu la 'di skad ces smras so/ /rigs kyi bu/ khyod 'di ltar yid mi dga' zhing yid gdung la mchi ma 'byung ba ci nyes/ des smras pa/ bram ze'i khye'u/ kho bo ni/ chos 'dod pa'i phyir bdag nyid btsongs te chos la mchod pa bya bar 'dod na/ lung (lus )nyo ba de kho bos ma rnyed nas de la kho bo 'di snyam du sems so/ /kye ma nga ni/bsod nams chung bas 'di ltar lus btsongs la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la mchod pa bya ba dang /'phags pa byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags la'ang bkur ste bya snyam na/ bdag gis lus nyo ba'ang ma rnyed do/ /snyam mo/ /de nas bram ze'i khye'u des byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngu la 'di skad ces smras so/ /rigs kyi bu/ kho bo la mis ni/ bya ba med kyi/ 'on kyang kho bo mchod sbyin zhig byed de/ der mi'i snying dang / khrag dang / rus pa dang / rkang dag kho bo la dgos na/de rin gyis stor byin cig ces byas pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngu 'di snyam du sems te/ gang bdag gis bram ze'i khye'u bdag gi snying dang / khrag dang / rus pa dang / rkang nyo ba rnyed pa 'di ni/ bdag gis rnyed pa'i mchog legs par rnyed do/ /bdag gi lus ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang thabs la mkhas pa rnams la yongs su rdzogs par gyur to/ /snyam ste/ de sems dga' dang /sems bde ba dang / sems rab tu dga' bar gyur nas bram ze'i khye'u la 'di skad ces smras so/ /bram ze'i khye'u/ kho bo'i lus 'di las khyod gang 'dod pa sbyin no/ /des de la 'di skad ces smras so/ /rigs kyi bu/khyod rin du ci 'dod pa sbyin no/ /zhes byas pa dang / des de la 'di skad ces smras so/ /bram ze'i khye'u/khyod kyis gang yongs su btang ba de kho bo la byin cig /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngu mtshon rnon po thogs nas lag pa g.yas pa phug ste khrag gzags so/ /brla g.yas pa sha med par 25—888

btogs nas rus pa gcog tu jig pa'i drung du song ngo / /de nas tshong dpon gyi bu mo zhig khang pa'i yang thog na 'dug pa des byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngu brla sha med par btogs nas rus pa gcog tu jig pa'i drung du song ba mthong nas de 'di snyam du sems te/ rigs kyi bu 'di ci'i phyir bdag nyid la bdag nyid 'di lta bu'i na tsha byed pa/ bdag rigs kyi bu de'i drung du song ste dri'o/ /snyam nas tshong dpon gyi bu mo de byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngu ga la ba der song ste phyin nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngu la 'di skad ces smras so/ /rigs kyi bu/ khyod ci'i phyir khyod bdag nyid la 'di lta bu'i na tsha dag byed/ khrag dang / rus pa dang / rkang 'dis ci zhig bya/ rtag tu ngus bu mo de la 'di skad ces smras so/ /bram ze'i khye'u 'di la btsongs te shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la mchod par bya'o/ /'phags pa byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags la'ang bsnyen bkur bya'o/ /de nas tshong dpon gyi bu mo des byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngu la 'di skad ces smras so/ /rigs kyi bu/ khyod 'di ltar bdag gi snying dang / khrag dang / rus pa dang / rkang yang btsongs te rigs kyi bu de la bkur ste bya bar 'dod pa khyod la yon tan gyi rnam pa ci zhig 'grub par 'gyur/ des de la smras pa/ bu mo/ rigs kyi bu de ni/ gang la kho bos bslab par bya ba'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang /thabs la mkhas pa dag ston par 'gyur te/ kho bos de la bslab (bslabs )na/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas sems can thams cad kyi rten du 'gyur/ lus gser gyi kha dog lta bu'ang thob par 'gyur/ skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis dang / 'od 'dom gang pa dang / 'od zer mtha' yas pa dang / byams pa chen po dang / snying rje chen po dang / dga' ba chen po dang / btang snyoms chen po dang / mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang / so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bco brgyad kyang thob par 'gyur/ mngon par shes pa drug dang /tshul khrims rnam par dag pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / ting nge 'dzin rnam par dag pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / shes rab rnam par dag pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu dang /bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i ye shes kyang mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur/ gang gis sems can thams cad la kun du bgo bsha' bya ba'i bla na med pa'i chos rin po che'ang rab tu thob par 'gyur ro/ /de nas tshong dpon gyi bu mo des byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngu la 'di skad ces smras so/ /rigs kyi bu/ khyod kyis 'di ltar chos rgya chen po 'di dag yongs su brjod pa ni/ ngo mtshar te/ rigs kyi bu/ chos 'di lta bu re re'i phyir yang bskal pa gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed du lus yongs su gtang bar bya ba yin na/ gcig lta ci smos te/ de tsam du khyod kyis chos 'di dag rgya cher yongs su brjod na/ rigs kyi bu/khyod gang gis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags la bkur ste bya ba'i gser ram/ nor bu'am/ mu tig gam/ bai ḍūrya'am/ dngul lam/ me tog gam/ bdug pa'am/ spos sam/ me rtog phreng ngam/ byug pa'am/ gye ma'am/ gos sam/ gdugs sam/ khyod la ci dgos pa de khyod la 25—889

sbyin gyi(gyis)/ bdag nyid la 'di lta bu'i sdug bsngal ma byed cig /bdag kyang khyod dang 'grogs te byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags ga la ba der dong la bdag kyang khyod dang lhan cig tu 'di lta ste/ de lta bu'i chos 'di dag thob par bya ba'i phyir dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed par bya'o/ /de nas lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis bram ze'i khye'u'i cha byad mi snang bar byas nas bdag nyid kyi lus su byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngu'i mdun du 'dug nas 'di skad ces smras so/ /rigs kyi bu/ khyod de ltar yi dam la brtan pa ni/ legs so/ /legs so/ /'di lta bu'i chos 'dod pas sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dag gis kyang sngon byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa na shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / thabs la mkhas pa yongs su rdzogs par mdzad de/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas so/ /rigs kyi bu/ kho bo la snying dang /khrag dang / rkang gis bya ba med kyi/ kho bo khyod sad pa'i phyir 'dir 'ongs kyi(kyis)/ rigs kyi bu/khyod kyis dam pa slongs shig /rigs kyi bu/ khyod la dam pa ji lta bu zhig sbyin par bya/ des de la smras pa/brgya byin/ sangs rgyas kyi chos bla na med pa bdag la stsol cig /brgya byin gyis smras pa/ rigs kyi bu/yul 'di kho bo'i yul du gyur pa ma yin te/ yul 'di sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi yul du gyur pa yin gyi/ dam pa gzhan slongs shig /byang chub sems dpa' rtag tu ngus smras pa/ bdag gi lus yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'i gnas 'di la ni/ lha'i dbang po brtson pa chung bar gyis shig /lha'i dbang po/ bdag nyid kyis bden pa'i byin gyi rlabs (gyis brlabs )bya'o/ /lha'i dbang po/ bden pa gang gis bdag bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogakān dro'u nga chub las phyir mi ldog par de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis lung bstan te/ bdag gis lhag pa'i bsam pa g.yo med par mkhyen ce na/bden pa de dang bden pa'i tshig des bdag gi lus sngon gyi bzhin du gyur cig ces byas pa dang / skad cig thang gcig (cig )yud tsam de nyid la sangs rgyas kyi mthu dang / lhag pa'i bsam pa yongs su dag pas/byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngu'i lus sngon gyi bzhin du gnas par gyur to/ /de nas lha'i dbang po brgya byin spobs pa med par gyur nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngu la lan glan par spobs pa ma skyes nas de nyid du mi snang bar gyur to/ /de nas tshong dpon gyi bu mo des byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngu la 'di skad ces smras so/ /rigs kyi bu tshur shog /kho mo'i khyim ga la ba der 'dong ngo / /kho mos pha ma las nor blangs te/ des shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa de'ang mchod par bya ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags de la'ang bkur ste bya ba sbyin no/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngu dang tshong dpon gyi bu mo de 'grogs nas de rang gi khyim ga la ba der dong ngo / /de nas tshong dpon gyi bu mo de bdag gi khyim du phyin nas pha ma la 'di skad ces smras so/ /yab yum/ gser dang / dngul dang / rin po che dang / nor bu dang / me rtog dang /bdug pa dang / spos dang / me tog phreng dang / byug pa dang / phye ma dang / gos dang / gdugs 25—890

dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang / rol mo'i cha byad mang po dag stsol cig /bdag kyang khyed kyis stsal ba'i g.yog mo lnga brgya 'di dag dang lhan cig dgyer gsol/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngu dang bdag cag 'grogs te byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags la mchod pa bgyi ba'i slad du mchi'o/ /de'ang bdag cag la chos ston par 'gyur ro/ /de nas bu mo de'i pha mas bu mo de la 'di skad ces smras so/ /bu mo/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngu de su zhig /bu mo/rigs kyi bu de da ltar gang na 'dug /bu mos smras pa/ rigs kyi bu de da ltar 'o skol gyi sgo drung na mchis te/rigs kyi bu de ni/ lhag pa'i bsam pas bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yang dag par zhugs pa 'di lta ste/ sems can thams cad 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal dpag tu ma mchis pa las thar bar bgyi bar 'tshal bas/ de chos 'tshal ba'i slad du bdag nyid btsongs la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la mchod pa bgyi bar 'tshal/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags la bkur sti bgyi bar 'tshal na/de'i lus nyo bar su'ang ma byung ste/ de sdug bsngal zhing yid mi bde nas mi dga' bar sems shing mchis te/des nga ni/ lus 'tshong bar 'dod na/ lus nyo ba ma rnyed do/ /zhes bgyis pa dang / brgya byin bram ze'i khye'u'i gzugs su bsgyur te de la 'di skad du/ rigs kyi bu/ khyod gang gi phyir lus 'tshong bar 'dod ces bgyis pa dang / rtag tu ngu des shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la mchod par bya ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags de la'ang bkur ster bya'o/ /nga'i sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams ni/ de la rag las pas 'di lta ste/ chos 'dod pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes bgyis pa dang / brgya byin bram ze'i khye'u'i gzugs su bsgyur bas 'di skad ces smras so/ /khyod ni/ nga mi 'dod de/ 'on kyang nga mchod sbyin zhig byed pa der mi'i snying dang / khrag dang / rus pa dang / rkang dag dgos so/ /zhes bgyis pa dang /rigs kyi bu des yi ma sad par de la 'di skad du sbyin no/ /zhes smras nas de mtshon rnon po thogs te bdag gi lag pa phug nas khrag gzags/ brla'i sha btogs te rus pa gcog tu song nas phyogs gcig tu 'dug ste rus pa dang / rkang sbyin no/ /snyam nas de khrag gzags pa bdag khang pa'i yang thog na mchis pas mthong ste/de la bdag 'di snyam du bgyid do/ /mi 'di ci'i slad du 'di lta bur bdag nyid la na tsha dag bgyid snyam ste/de'i thad du mchis nas 'di skad bgyis so/ /rigs kyi bu/ 'di ltar bdag nyid kyis lus kyi khrag gzags pa 'dis ci zhig bya zhes bgyis pa dang / de bdag la 'di skad mchi ste/ bram ze'i khye'u 'di la khrag dang /snying dang / rus pa dang / rkang sbyin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ nga ni/ dbul te/ nga la nor gzhan ci'ang med do/ /zhes mchi'o/ /bdag gis khyod la nor gyis ci zhig bya zhes bgyis pa dang / de bdag la 'di skad du 'di lta ste/ chos 'dod pa'i phyir shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mchod par bya'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags la'ang bkur sti bya'o/ /zhes mchi nas bdag gis de la 'di skad ces bgyis te/ rigs kyi bu/ des khyed la yon tan gyi rnam pa'am/ khyad par ci zhig 'byung bar 'gyur / de bdag la 'di skad du sangs rgyas kyi yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos 25—891

dpag tu med pa rnams rab tu ston par 'gyur ro/ /'di lta bu'i chos rnams de las 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes mchi ste/ sangs rgyas kyi yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa de dag thos nas bdag kyang dga' ba dang /rab tu mgu ba chen po skyes nas 'di snyam bgyid de/ rigs kyi bu/ 'di lta bu'i gnas la spro bar bgyid pa ni/shin tu dka' ba bgyid pa ste/ ngo mtshar to/ /rigs kyi bu/ 'di ni/ chos 'dod pa'i phyir bdag nyid kyang yongs su gtong na/ bdag cag la longs spyod rgya chen po dag yod la/ ci'i phyir chos la mchod pa mi bgyi / 'di lta bu'i gnas dag la smon lam ci'i phyir mi gdab snyam nas rigs kyi bu de la bdag gis 'di skad ces bgyis so/ /rigs kyi bu/ khyod bdag nyid la 'di lta bu'i na tsha dag ma byed cig /khyod 'dod pa gang gis 'phags pa byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags la bkur sti bya ba'i nor mang po de dag khyod la sbyin no/ /bdag kyang khyod nyid dang 'grogs te byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags ga la ba der mchi'o/ /bdag gis kyang rigs kyi bu de la mchod pa bgyi'o/ /gang khyod kyi yongs su brjod pa 'di lta ste/ sangs rgyas kyi chos bla na med pa dag bdag gis kyang thob par bgyi'o/ /zhes bgyis shing mchis na/ yab yum gyis dkor gyi phung po chen po bdag la stsal du gsol/ bdag gis kyang rigs kyi bu de dang lhan cig tu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags la mchod pa bgyi'o// //shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa/ bam po sum brgya bzhi (gsum )pa ste/ tha ma/ de nas bu mo de'i pha mas bu mo de la 'di skad ces smras so/ /rigs kyi bu de'i dka' ba'i gnas dag khyod kyis bstan pa las na/ chos de dag ni/ gcig tu nges par bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ 'jig rten thams cad las bye brag tu 'phags pa/ sems can thams cad bde ba thob par byed pa yin te/ rigs kyi bu/ de'i phyir de lta bu'i dka' ba'i gnas la spro bar byed na/ khyod nged kyis gnang gi/ bu mo nged kyang khyod dang lhan cig tu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags blta zhing mchod du ( nged kyang /)'gro yi(yis)/nged 'gro ba'i skabs phye zhig(shig) /de nas bu mo de byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags la mchod pa bya ba dang / bkur sti bya ba'i phyir chas te pha ma la 'di skad ces smras so/ /bdag ni/dge ba'i phyogs gang gi'ang bar chad mi bgyid do/ /de nas tshong dpon gyi bu mo des shing rta lnga brgya'ang rgyan gyis brgyan/ bu mo lnga brgya de dag kyang rgyan gyis brgyan to/ /rgyan gyis brgyan nas me tog kha dog sna tshogs thogs / bdug pa dang / spos dang / me tog phreng dang / byug pa dang / phye ma dang / gos dang /gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dag thogs/ gser dang / dngul gyi me tog dag thogs/rin po che sna tshogs rnam pa tha dad pa dag kyang thogs te/ bza' ba dang / bca' ba dang / myang ba mang po mang du bskur nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngu dang shing rta gcig tu zhugs te bu mo lnga brgya shing rta lnga brgya'i nang du zhugs pa de dag gis yongs su bskor cing mdun du bdar nas pha ma la sogs pa 'khor mang po dang shar phyogs ga la ba de logs su dong ste mthar gyis song ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngus rgyang ring mo zhig nas grong khyer spos ldan rin po che sna bdun rnam par bkra ba/25—892

blta na sdug pa las byas pa/ rin po che sna bdun gyi ra ba rim bdun gyis bskor ba/ rta babs bdun yod pa/thobs rim bdun dang / ta la'i phreng rim bdun gyis yongs su bskor ba/ chur dpag tshad bcu gnyis/zheng du dpag tshad bcu gnyis yod pa/ 'byor cing rgyas pa/ bde ba/ lo legs pa/ mi dang skye bo mang pos gang ba/ grong khyer (bar )dang srang mnyam zhing mtshungs pa lnga brgya dag gis ri mor bris pa bzhin du gtams pa/ khyogs khri nyam mi nga ba dang / bar bar dag tu zam pa btags pa legs par byas pa mthong ngo / /de'i dbus kyi bzhi mdo na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags chos kyi khri la 'dug nas 'khor brgya phrag du ma dang / stong phrag du ma dang / 'bum phrag du mas yongs su bskor cing mdun gyis bltas nas chos 'chad pa mthong ste/snyo mthong ma thag tu de dga' ba dang / bde ba thob pa 'di lta ste/dper na/ dge slong bsam gtan dang po rtse gcig tu yid la byed pas snyoms par zhugs pa bzhin no/ /de mthong nas 'di snyam du sems te/ bdag shing rta'i nang du zhugs bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags kyi drung du 'gro ba ni/ bdag gis mi cha'o/ /snyam nas de nas shing rta de las babs pa dang / tshong dpon gyi bu mo dang / bu mo lnga brgya de dag dang mnyam du shing rta de las babs so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngu tshong dpon gyi bu mo la sogs pa bu mo lnga brgyas yongs su bskor cing mdun du bdar te bkod pa tshad med pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags ga la ba der dong ngo / /de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags kyis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i khang bu brtsegs pa rin po che sna bdun las byas pa/ tsandan dmar pos brgyan cing / mu tig gi dra bas g.yogs pa zhig byed du bcug ste/ khang bu brtsegs pa de'i (der )gra bzhir nor bu rin po che bzhag par gyur te/ de dag sgron ma'i bya ba byed do/ /bdug spos kyi snod dngul las byas pa bzhi'ang phyogs bzhir btags te/ 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la mchod par bya ba'i phyir a ka ru nag po 'ba' zhig gis bdug par byed do/ /khang bu brtsegs pa de'i dbus su rin po che sna bdun gyi khri bzhi btsugs te/ de'i stong du rin po che'i sgrom bzhi bzhag nas de'i nang du shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gser gyi glegs bam la bee ḍūrya bzhu bas bris pa bcug ste/ khang bu brtsegs pa de'ang dar gyi chun po sna tshogs rnam pa tha dad pa 'phyang bas brgyan to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngu tshong dpon gyi bu mo la sogs te/ bu mo lnga brgya dang bcas pas khang bu brtsegs pa de bkod pa tshad med pas brgyan pa mthong / lha stong phrag du ma dag kyang mthong ste/ lha'i dbang po brgya byin yang lha'i me tog mas ra ba dang /lha'i tsandan gyi phye ma dang / lha'i gser gyi phye ma dang / lha'i dngul sil ma dag gis khang bu brtsegs pa de la 'thor / mngon par 'thor/ mngon par rab tu 'thor bar mthong ngo / /lha'i sil snyan dag kyang thos so /mthong zhing thos nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngus lha'i dbang po brgya byin la 'di skad ces smras so/ /lha'i dbang po/ khyod lha stong phrag du ma dag dang rin po che'i khang bu brtsegs pa 'di la ci'i phyir me tog mas ra ba dang / tsandan gyi phye ma dag gis 'thor zhing / mngon par 'thor/ mngon par 25—893

rab tu 'thor/ lha'i sil snyan 'di dag kyang lha rnams par snang la ci'i phyir rdung / de skad ces smras pa dang /lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngu la 'di skad ces smras so/ /rigs kyi bu/ 'di ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi yum dang / yongs su 'dren pa yin te/ 'di la bslab (bslabs )pas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dag yon tan thams cad kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad dang / thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyang myur du thob par 'gyur ba yin na/ khyod mi shes sam/ de skad ces smras pa dang /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngus lha'i dbang po brgya byin la 'di skad ces smras so/ /kau shi ka /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi yum dang /yongs su 'dren pa de gang na bzhugs/ brgya byin gyis smras pa/ de ni/ khang bu brtsegs pa 'di'i nang na gser gyi glegs bam la bai ḍūrya bzhu bas bris pa byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags kyis rgya rim bdun gyis btab nas bzhag ste/ kho bo cag gis khyod la bstan par dka'o/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngu tshong dpon gyi bu mo la sogs te/ bu mo lnga brgya dag dang tshogs nas de dag gis me tog dang / me tog phreng gi chun po dang / gos rin po che dang / bdug pa dang /spos dang / me tog phreng dang / byug pa dang / phye ma dang / gos dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang / gser dang / dngul gyi me tog ji snyed thogs te 'ongs pa de dag gis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la mchod pa byas te/ de dag las byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags la bkur sti bya ba'i phyir shas shas kyis bzhag go/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngus me tog dang / bdug pa dang / spos dang / me tog phreng dang / byug pa dang / phye ma dang / na bza' dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan la sogs pas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la sngar mchod pa byas nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags ga la ba der song ste phyin nas chos la mchod pa nyid kyi phyir byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags la me tog dang / bdug pa dang /spos dang / me tog phreng dang / byug pa dang / phye ma dang / chos gos dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang / tsandan gyi phye ma dang / gser dang / dngul gyi me tog gis gtor/mngon par gtor/ mngon par rab tu gtor to/ de nas me tog de dag byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags kyi spyi bo'i steng na me tog gi khang pa brtsegs pa zhig tu gyur to/ /gser dang /dngul gyi me tog dag nam mkha' la gzhal med khang 'dra bar 'dug par gyur to/ /chos gos dang / gos rin po che de dag kyang rin po che sna tshogs kyi sprin gyi dkyil 'khor 'dra bar 'dug par gyur to/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngu dang / tshong dpon gyi bu mo la sogs pa bu mo lnga brgya de dag gis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags kyi rdzu 'phrul gyi cho 'phrul de lta (ltar )bu mthong nas de dag 'di snyam du sems te ngo mtshar to/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags 'di 'di 25—894

ltar rdzu 'phrul che zhing 'di ltar mthu che/ 'di ltar gzi brjid che ste/ rigs kyi bu 'di byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa na'ang rdzu 'phrul rnam par sprul pa 'di 'du na/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i tshe ci 'dra bar 'gyur snyam mo/ /de nas tshong dpon gyi bu mo la sogs pa bu mo lnga brgya de dag gis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags la dga' ba bskyed nas de dag thams cad kyis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed de/ 'di skad du dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis bdag cag ma 'ongs pa'i dus na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas su gyur cig /byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa na'ang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags kyis chos gang thob par gyur pa 'di lta bu'i chos rnams thob par gyur cig /bdag cag byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa na'ang 'di lta bu'i chos rnams mngon sum du gyur cig /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la'ang ji ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags bkur sti byed pa 'di bzhin du shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la bkur sti byed par shog cig /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags ji ltar ston pa bzhin du bdag cag kyang skye bo mang po la ston par gyur cig /ji ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags 'di shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / thabs la mkhas pa dang ldan zhing yongs su rdzogs pa 'di bzhin du bdag cag kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang /thabs la mkhas pa dang ldan zhing yongs su rdzogs par shog cig ces smras so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngu dang / tshong dpon gyi bu mo la sogs pa bu mo lnga brgya de dag gis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la mchod pa byas shing / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags la'ang bkur ster byas te/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags kyi rkang pa la mgo bos phyag 'tshal nas zhe sa byed cing thal mo sbyar te phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /phyogs gcig tu 'dug nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngus 'di skad ces smras so / /rigs kyi bu/ 'di la bdag shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshol zhing 'brog dgon pa zhig tu phyin pa na sgra thos pa/ rigs kyi bu/ shar phyogs su song zhig dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa thos par 'gyur ro/ /zhes bdag gis sgra de thos nas shar phyogs ga la ba de logs su mchis nas 'di snyam du bsam ste/ bdag gis sgra de la ji srid cig tu mchi bar bgyi/ su las shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mnyan pa rnyed par 'gyur ba ma dris so/ /snyam te/ des bdag yid mi bde zhing shin tu gdung bar gyur nas sa phyogs de nyid du nyin mtshan bdun 'das te/ de ltar shin tu gdung bas zas la sems pa ni/ ma byung gi/ gzhan du na shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'ba' zhig yid la bgyis te ji srid du mchi bar bgyi ba dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di su las mnyan pa rnyed par 'gyur ba sgra de la ma dris so/ /snyam pa dang / de nas bdag gi mdun du de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs shig byung ste/ de 'di skad gsung ngo / /rigs kyi bu/ khyod 'di nas dpag tshad lnga brgyar song dang grong khyer spos ldan zhes bya ba de na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 25—895

'phags shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'chad pa mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs te/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs de dag las bdag gis 'di thos nas ji ltar gtams pa bzhin du shar phyogs ga la ba de logs su zhugs te mchis pa dang / rgyang ring mo zhig nas 'phags pa chos ston pa mthong ste/ mthong ma thag tu bdag la bde ba 'di lta bu skyes pa dper na/ dge slong bsam gtan dang po la zhugs pa bzhin te/ bdag dga' ba dang / rab tu dga' ba des khyab par gyur nas sa phyogs de nas ma bskyod par khyod las shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa thos so/ /de nyan pa ni ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo mang po skyes par gyur to/ /bdag de na mchis pa na phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis dbugs dbyung ba mdzad de/rigs kyi bu/ legs so/ /legs so/ /khyod kyi ting nge 'dzin 'di dag ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las skyes pa yin te/ 'di la gnas pas nged kyis kyang sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams yongs su rdzogs par byas so / /zhes de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gis bdag la shin tu legs par bstan nas mi snang bar gyur to/ /bdag kyang ting nge 'dzin de las langs nas 'di snyam du bsam ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gang nas byon/de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gang du bzhud snyam mo/ /de nas yang bdag gis 'di snyam du bsam ste/ (bsams te / ) byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa chos 'phags ni/ sngon spyo ༷trebo la bgyi ba bgyis pa/ dge ba'i rtsa ba bskrun pa/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / thabs la mkhas pa la shin tu bslab pa lags te/ de de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gang nas byon pa dang/ de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gang du bzhud pa de bdag la ston par 'gyur snyam nas rigs kyi bu/ khyod la de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gang nas byon pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gang du bzhud pa bdag zhu na/ ci nas bdag de bzhin gshegs pa de dag byon pa dang / bzhud pa 'tshal zhing de bzhin gshegs pa mthong ba dang mi 'bral bar 'gyur ba de ltar ( ba de ltar )de bzhin gshegs pa de dag byon pa dang / bzhud pa bdag la bshad du gsol/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa las rtag tu ngu'i le'u zhes bya ste/bdun cu rtsa gsum pa'o// //de skad ces smras pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags kyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngu la 'di skad ces smras so/ /rigs kyi bu/ de bzhin gshegs pa de dag ni/ gang nas kyang ma byon/ gang du'ang ma bzhud de/ de bzhin nyid las ma g.yos so/ /de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa'o/ /rigs kyi bu/ mi skye ba la 'ong ba'am 'gro ba med de / mi skye ba gang yin pa de ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa'o/ /rigs kyi bu/ yang dag pa'i mtha' la 'ong ba'am 'gro ba med de/ yang dag pa'i mtha' gang yin pa de ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa'o/ /rigs kyi bu/stong pa nyid la 'ong ba'am/ 'gro ba med de/ stong pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa'o/ /rigs kyi bu/ ji lta ba bzhin la 'ong ba'am 'gro ba med de/ ji lta ba bzhin gang yin pa de ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa'o/ /rigs kyi bu/ 'dod chags dang bral ba la 'ong ba'am 'gro ba med de/ 'dod chags dang 25—896

bral ba gang yin pa de ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa'o/ /rigs kyi bu/ 'gog pa la 'ong ba'am 'gro ba med de/'gog pa gang yin pa de ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa'o/ /rigs kyi bu/ nam mkha'i khams la 'ong ba'am/'gro ba med de/ nam mkha'i khams gang yin pa de ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa'o/ /rigs kyi bu/ chos de dag las de bzhin gshegs pa gud na med de/ rigs kyi bu/ chos 'di dag gi de bzhin nyid gang yin pa dang /de bzhin gshegs pa'i de bzhin nyid gang yin pa 'di ni/ de bzhin nyid gcig ste/ rigs kyi bu/ de bzhin nyid la gnyis su byar med do/ /rigs kyi bu/ de bzhin nyid gcig ste/ 'di lta ste/ med pa'i phyir gnyis sam gsum du bgrang ba las 'das pa'o/ /rigs kyi bu/ 'di lta ste/ dper na/ mi nyi mas gdungs pas sos ku'i zla ba tha ma la nyi ma gung gi dus la bab pa'i tshe smig rgyu g.yo ba mthong nas der chu btung ngo //zhes de dang der rgyug na/ rigs kyi bu/ 'di ji snyam du sems/ chu de gang nas 'ongs/ gang du song /chu de shar phyogs kyi rgya mtsho'am/ lho phyogs kyi rgya mtsho'am/ nub phyogs kyi rgya mtsho'am/ byang phyogs kyi rgya mtsho gang du song / rtag tu ngus smras pa/ rigs kyi bu/ smig rgyu la chu ma mchis na/ 'ong ba'am 'gro ba lta ga la mchis te/ rigs kyi bu/ mi nyi mas gdungs shing byis pa'i rang bzhin can/ shes rab 'chal pa'i rang bzhin can gyis smig rgyu mthong nas chu ma mchis pa la chur 'du shes bskyed (skyed )kyi/ de la chu ni/rang bzhin gyis ma mchis so/ /chos 'phags kyis smras pa/ rigs kyi bu/ de de bzhin no/ /de de bzhin te / de bzhin du rigs kyi bu/ gang su dag de bzhin gshegs pa la gzugs sam/ sgrar mngon par zhen par byed pa de dag ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa la byon pa'am bzhud par rtog go/ /gang de bzhin gshegs pa la byon pa'am bzhud par rtog pa de dag thams cad ni/ byis pa'i rang bzhin can/ shes rab 'chal pa'i rang bzhin can zhes bya ste/ dper na/ mi de chu med pa la chur 'du shes bskyed pa bzhin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de bzhin gshegs pa ni/ gzugs kyi skur mi blta ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa ni/ chos kyi sku'o/ /rigs kyi bu/ chos nyid ni/ 'ong ba'am/ 'gro ba med de/ rigs kyi bu/ de bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la byon pa'am bzhud pa med do/ /rigs kyi bu/ 'di lta ste/ dper na/ sgyu ma sprul pa'i glang po che'i tshogs sam/ rta'i tshogs sam/ shing rta'i tshogs sam/ dpung bu chung gi tshogs la 'ong ba'am 'gro ba med do/ /rigs kyi bu/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku la'ang byon pa'am bzhud pa med do/ /rigs kyi bu/'di lta ste/ dper na/ skyes bu gnyid kyis log pa'i mi lam du de bzhin gshegs pa gcig gam/ gnyis sam / gsum mam/ bzhi'am/ lnga'am/ bcu'am/ nyi shu'am/ sum cu'am/ bzhi bcu'am / lnga bcu'am / de las lhag pa zhig mthong ba las sad pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa gcig kyang ma mthong na/rigs kyi bu/ 'di ji snyam du sems/ de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gang nas byon/ gang du bzhud/ rtag tu dus smras pa/ rigs kyi bu/ rmi lam la chos gang yang grub pa mi gda'o/ /mi lam ni/ rdzun te/ yang dag pa ma lags pa'o/ /chos 'phags kyis smras pa/ rigs kyi bu/ de de bzhin te/ chos thams cad ni/de bzhin gshegs pas mi lam lta bu'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /rigs kyi bu/ gang su dag de bzhin gshegs 25—897

pas chos thams cad mi lam lta bur yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du bstan pa mi shes pa de dag ni/ ming mtshan gyi sku dang / gzugs kyi skur mngon par zhen par byed de/ de ltar chos nyid mi shes pas de bzhin gshegs pa la byon pa dang bzhud par rtog go/ /gang dag de bzhin gshegs pa la byon pa dang bzhud par 'dod pa'i byis pa so so'i skye bo de dag thams cad ni/ 'khor ba 'gro ba drug por dong ba/ 'dong ba/ 'dong bar 'gyur ba'o/ /de dag thams cad ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las rgyang ring du gyur pa'o/ /de dag thams cad ni/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos las rgyang ring du gyur pa'o/ /yang rigs kyi bu/ gang dag chos thams cad mi lam lta bu la de bzhin gshegs pas chos thams cad mi lam lta bu'o/ /zhes yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du bstan pa shes pa de dag ni/ chos gang la'ang 'ong ba'am/ 'gro ba'am/ skye ba'am/ 'gag par mi rtog go/ gang dag chos gang la'ang 'ong ba'am/ 'gro ba'am/ skye ba'am/ 'gag par mi rtog pa de dag byuni / de bzhin gshegs pa chos nyid du rab tu shes so/ /gang dag de bzhin gshegs pa chos nyid du rab tu shes pa de dag ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa la byon pa'am bzhud par mi rtog go/ /gang dag de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos nyid de lta bu rab tu shes pa de dag ni/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub la nye bar gyur pa ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi nyan thos de dag ni/ yul 'khor gyi bsod snyoms don yod par za ste/ de dang de dag ni/ 'jig rten gyi sbyin gnas so/ /rigs kyi bu / 'di lta ste/ dper na/ rgya mtsho chen po'i nang na rin po che dag yod pa ni/ shar phyogs nas kyang ma 'ongs/ lho dang / nub dang / byang dang / phyogs mtshams dang / steng dang / 'og dang /phyogs bcu gang nas kyang ma 'ongs mod kyi/ sems can de dag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba la brten nas rgya mtsho chen po'i nang nas rin po che dag 'byung ste/ de dag kyang rgyu med par byung ba ma yin gyi/ rgyu dang / rkyen dang /gzhi la rag las pa yin te/ brten nas byung ngo / /rin po che de dag 'gag pa'ang phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gang du'ang mi 'pho mod kyi/ rkyen de dag yod na/ rin po che de dag rab tu 'byed do/ /rkyen de dag med na / rin po che de dag rab tu dbye ba'ang med par 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu/ de bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gi sku mngon par grub pa'ang gang nas kyang ma byon/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gang du'ang ma bzhud do/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag gi sku rgyu med pa'ang ma yin te/ sngon gyi spyad pas yongs su grub pa yin pas/ rgyu dang rkyen la rag las pa/ sngon gyi 'phrin las rnam par smin pa'i rgyu las byung ba yin no/ /de dag kyang rkyen rnams yod na/ sku mngon par 'grub par 'gyur te/ rkyen dag med na/ sku mngon par 'grub pa'ang mi snang ngo / /rigs kyi bu/ 'di lta ste/ dper na/ pi wang gi sgra byung ba'ang gang nas kyang ma 'ongs/ 'gags pa'ang gang du'ang mi 'gro/ gang du'ang mi 'pho ste/ brten nas 'byung ba/ rgyu la rag las/ rkyen la rag las pa'o/ /'di lta ste/ pi wang gi khog pa la brten/ pags pa la brten/rgyud la brten/ shing bu la brten/ rgyud rten la brten/ mi de las skyes pa'i rtsol ba la brten nas pi wang de las sgra 'byung ste/ sgra de'ang pi wang gi khog pa las ma byung / pags pa las ma byung / rgyud las ma byung /25—898

shing bu las ma byung / rgyud rten las ma byung / mi de las skyes pa'i rtsol ba las sgra ma byung mod kyi/ de dag thams cad 'dus pa las kyang sgrar grag la/ sgra de 'gag pa'ang gang du'ang mi 'gro ba de bzhin du rigs kyi bu/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sku yongs su grub pa'ang rgyu la rag las pa/ rkyen la rag las pa/dge ba'i rtsa ba du mas yongs su grub pa yin te/ rgyu gcig gis ma yin/ rkyen gcig gis ma yin/ dge ba'i rtsa ba gcig gis sangs rgyas kyi rab tu dbye ba ma yin te/ rgyu med pa'ang ma yin no/ /rgyu dang rkyen mang po tshogs pa las byung ba yin te/ de ni/ gang nas kyang ma byon te/ rgyu dang rkyen tshogs pa med kyang gang du'ang mi bzhud de/ rigs kyi bu/ khyod kyis de bzhin gshegs pa de dag byon pa dang / bzhud pa de ltar blta'o / /rigs kyi bu/ chos thams cad kyi chos nyid kyang khyod kyis 'di bzhin du khong du chud par gyis shig /rigs kyi bu/ khyod gang tshun chad de ltar de bzhin gshegs pa dang chos thams cad skye ba med pa dang /'gag pa med par shes pa de tshun chad khyod bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu nges shing /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / thabs mkhas pa la nges par spyod par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa byon pa dang / bzhud pa med pa 'di bshad pa'i tshe sa g.yo ba chen po byung ste/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di thams cad rnam pa drug tu g.yos pa 'di lta ste/ g.yos/ rab tu g.yos/ kun tu rab tu g.yos/ 'gul/ rab tu 'gul/ kun tu rab tu 'gul te/ bdud kyi gnas thams cad kyang dkrogs shing spa bkong bar gyur to/ /stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams na rtswa dang / shing gel pa dang / nags tshal ji snyed yod pa de dag thams cad byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags ga la ba de logs su rab tu 'dud par gyur to/ /dus ma yin pa'i me tog dag kyang steng gi bar snang las 'thor zhing / me tog gi char dag kyang bab bo/ /lha'i dbang po brgya byin dang / rgyal po chen po bzhi dag kyang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngu la lha'i tsandan gyi phye ma dang / lha'i me tog gis 'thor / mngon par 'thor/ mngon par rab tu 'thor zhing tshig 'di skad ces rigs kyi bu/ khyod kyi mthus deng bdag cag gis kyang don dam pa las byung ba'i gtam/ 'jig rten thams cad dang mi mthun pa gang 'jig tshogs la gnas pa thams cad kyis ma yin pa bstan pa thos so/ /zhes 'dzer to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngus 'di skad ces smras so/ /rigs kyi bu/ sa g.yos pa chen po byung ba 'di'i rgyu gang lags/ rkyen gang lags/chos 'phags kyis smras pa/ rigs kyi bu/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams ma byon mi bzhud pa 'di khrod kyis dris te kho bos bstan pas srog chags brgyad stong mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa thob par gyur pa dang / srog chags khrag khrig phrag brgyad cus bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed pa dang / srog chags drug khri bzhi stong chos rnams la chos kyi mig rdul med cing dri ma dang bral ba rnam par dag par gyur pa'i phyir ro/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngu dga' ba dang / rangs pa rgya chen po dang ldan par gyur te/ bdag gis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa rnams byon 25—899

pa dang / bzhud pa med pa bstan pa 'di dris pas sems can 'di snyed kyi don byas par gyur pa ni/ bdag gis rnyed pa legs par rnyed do/ /'di nyid kyis bdag bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'grub par bya ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba mchog gis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub la phyir the tshom mi bya'o/ /bdag ni/ the tshom med par de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas su 'gyur ra / /snyam pa dang / de dga' ba dang rangs pa de dang ldan pas ta la bdun du nam mkha' la 'phags nas ta la bdun tsam na 'dug ste/ bdag nam mkha' la 'dug nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags la bkur ste bya'o/ /snyam du ( du )sems so/ /de las (nas )lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngu mngon par 'phags pa mthong nas de'i sems sems kyis shes nas de la lha'i me tog manda ra ba dag byin te 'di skad du/ rigs kyi bu/ me tog 'di dag gis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags la bkur sti gyis shig /'di ni/ ngas khyod yongs su bzung ba yin te/ rigs kyi bu/ khyod kyi mthus srog chags stong phrag mang po'i don byas te/ rigs kyi bu/gang sems can thams cad kyi phyir ji ltar khyod spro bar byed pa de lta bur bskal pa grangs med dpag tu med par spro bar byed pa'i sems can de dag ni/ rnyed par dka'o/ /zhes smras so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngus lha'i dbang po brgya byin las me tog de dag blangs te byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags la gtor/ mngon par gtor/ mngon par rab tu gtor nas bdag gi lus kyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags la mngon par bkab ste tshig 'di skad ces smras so/ /rigs kyi bu/ deng slan chad khyod kyi rim gro dang / zham ring bgyi ba'i slad du bdag gi lus khyod la 'bul lo/ /des bdag gi lus phul nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags kyi mdun du thal mo sbyar te 'dug go/ /de nas tshong dpon gyi bu mo de dang / 'khor lnga brgya de dag gis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngu la 'di skad ces smras so/ /rigs kyi bu/ bdag cag kyang khyod la lus 'bul gyi/ bdag cag kyang dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis chos de dag thob par gyur cig /khyod nyid dang lhan cig tu sangs rgyas rnams dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams la bkur ster bgyi/ de dag dang nye bar gyur par bgyi'o/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' rtag tu ngus tshong dpon gyi bu mo la sogs pa bu mo lnga brgya la 'di skad ces smras so/ /bu mo dag /khyed kho bo la lhag pa'i bsam pas gnas par byed na/ kho bo la lhag pa'i bsam pas bdag nyid byin cig dang / bu mo khyed kho bos blang ngo / /bu mo de dag gis smras pa/khyod la lhag pa'i bsam pa thag pa nas khyod kyi rjes su mthun par 'jug go/ /khyod la lhag pa'i bsam pas ci 'dod pa bya bar bdag nyid 'bul lo/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngus tshong dpon gyi bu mo la sogs pa bu mo lnga brgya de dag rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan te/ shing rta lnga brgya'ang brgyan nas thams cad byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags la phul te/ rigs kyi bu bdag ni/'khor 'di dag dang / shing rta lnga brgya 'di dag kyang yongs su longs spyad pa'i phyir khyod la 'bul lo/ /de 25—900

nas lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis rigs kyi bu de la legs so/ /zhes bya ba byin te/ rigs kyi bu/ legs so/ /legs so/ /de ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dag gis bdog pa thams cad yongs su gtang bar bya'o/ /yongs su gtong ba'i sems de lta bus myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya'o/ /de ltar na/ chos smra ba dag la mchod pa byas nas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / thabs la mkhas pa nyan nus te/ sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de dag gis kyang sngon byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa na 'di lta bu'i gtong ba la gnas nas bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub yang dag par bsgrubs te shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / thabs la mkhas pa yongs su dris so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags kyis tshong dpon gyi bu mo la sogs pa bu mo lnga brgya po de dag dang / shing rta lnga brgya po de dag byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngu'i dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs su bskang ba'i phyir blangs te blangs nas rigs kyi bu rtag tu ngu la byin no/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags stan las langs te bdag gi khyim du zhugs pa dang nyi ma nub par gyur nas de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngu 'di snyam du sems te/ 'di ltar bdag chos 'dod pa'i phyir 'ongs la/ 'dug pa'am/nyal bar byed pa ni/ bdag gis mi cha la/ 'di ni/ ma legs kyi/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags 'di lta ste/ chos ston du phyir ma byung gi bar du bdag 'greng ba dang / 'chag pa'i spyod lam gnyis kyis gnas par bya'o/ /snyam mo/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags lo bdun gyi bar du ting nge 'dzin gcig la snyoms par zhugs par gyur cing / byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin grangs med dpag tu med pa dag dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / thabs mkhas pa las byung ba la gnas par gyur te/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngu'ang lo bdun gyi bar du 'dod pa'i rtog pa ma byung / gnod sems kyi rtog pa ma byung / rnam par 'tshe ba'i rtog pa ma byung /ro la brkam pa ma skyes te/ gzhan du na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags nam ldang bar 'gyur/ bdag cag kyang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags kyi chos kyi khri gang la rigs kyi bu de 'dug nas chos ston par 'gyur ba'i chos kyi khri bshams na/ bdag gis sa phyogs 'di chag chag btab kyi(kyis)/ legs par byugs la me tog sna tshogs gtor te sa phyogs gang du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / thabs la mkhas pa rab tu ston par 'gyur ba der legs par byug par bya'o/ /snyam mo/ /tshong dpon gyi bu mo la sogs pa bu mo lnga brgya de dag kyang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngu'i rjes su slob cing / spyod lam gnyis kyis dus 'da' bar byed de/ bya ba thams cad kyang de'i rjes su 'jug go/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngus lha'i sgra thos te/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags zhag bdun na ting nge 'dzin las ldang ste/ langs nas grong khyer gyi dbus su 'dug ('jug )ste chos ston par 25—901

'gyur ro/ /zhes grag nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngu lha'i sgra de thos pa dang /dga' mgu yid (yi )rangs rab tu mgu zhing dga' ba dang / yid bde ba skyes te/ tshong dpon gyi bu mo la sogs pa bu mo lnga brgya dang sa phyogs de phyags nas chos kyi khri rin po che thams cad kyis spras pa bshams so/ /de nas bu mo de dag gis rang rang gi bla gos phud de stan gang la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags 'dug nas chos ston par 'gyur ba der bting ngo / /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngus phyogs der chag chag gdab par 'dod na/ bdud sdig can gyis chu thams cad mi snang bar byas nas ci nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngu chu ma rnyed nas yid mi dga' zhing sems sdug bsngal te sems gzhan du 'gyur ba dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba nub par 'gyur ba dang / mchod pa de'ang mi mdzes par bya ba'i phyir chu de dag mi snang bar byas nas kun tu chu btsal na chu ma rnyed do/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngu 'di snyam du sems te/ bdag gi lus phug nas khrag gis sa phyogs 'di chag chag gdab bo/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ sa phyogs 'di ni/ rdul che ste/ 'di nas ( 'di nas )rdul gyi khams ( 'di nas )byung bas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chobla rārāgo kyi lus la rdzog na mi rung gi/ bdag gi lus gdon mi za bar 'jig pa 'dis ('di )ci zhig bya/ bdag gi lus 'di lta bu'i bya ba la zhig pa ni/ bla'i/ nus pa med pa'i bya ba la 'dod pa'i phyir 'dod pa'i gzhis 'khor ba dag na bdag gi lus brgya stong mang po de lta bu'i gnas su zhig pa ni/ cir yang ma rung snyam mo/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngus mtshon rnon po blangs te bdag gi lus la kun tu phug nas rang gi khrag gis sa phyogs de kho ra khor yug tu chag chag btab bo/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngu'i rjes su slob pa tshong dpon gyi bu mo la sogs pa bu mo lnga brgya de dag thams cad kyis kyang mtshon rnon po blangs te rang rang gi lus phug nas rang rang gi khrag gis sa phyogs de chag chag btab ste/gang de dag la bdud sdig can gyis dge ba'i phyogs kyi bar chad bya ba'i glags rnyed par mi 'gyur bar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngu dang / bu mo de dag sems gzhan du gyur pa med do/ /de nas lha'i dbang po brgya byin 'di snyam du/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngu 'di/ 'di ltar chos 'dod pa dang / 'di ltar yi dam la brtan pa dang / 'di ltar go cha chen po bgos pa dang / lus dang / srog dang / longs spyod rnams la mi lta ba dang / bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par bya ba'i phyir 'di lta ste/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal dpag tu med pa las sems can thar par bya'o/ /snyam du lhag pa'i bsam pa la zhugs pa ni/ ngo mtshar to/ /snyam du sems so/ /de nas lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis khrag de dag thams cad lha'i tsandan gyi chur byin gyis brlabs te/ lha'i tsandan gyi chu de'i dri dam pa rgya che ba bsam gyis mi khyab pas sa phyogs de kho ra khor yug tu dpag tshad lnga brgya tshang bar dris khyab bo/ /de nas lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngu la 'di skad ces smras so/ /rigs kyi bu/25—902

legs so/ /legs so/ /khyod kyi brtson 'grus bsam gyis mi khyab bo/ /khyod kyi chos 'dod pa dang / chos yongs su tshol ba bla na med do/ /rigs kyi bu/ sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de dag gis kyang lhag pa'i bsam pa 'di lta bu dang / brtson 'grus 'di lta bu dang /chos 'dod pa 'di lta bus bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub yang dag par bsgrubs so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngu 'di snyam du sems te/ bdag gis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags kyi chos kyi stan ni/ bting / sa phyogs 'di phyag dar ni / byas/ chag chag ni/ btab na/ bdag gis (gi )me tog gang dag gis sa phyogs 'dir gtor bar bya ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags chos 'chad pa la gtor bar bya ba'i me tog de dag gang nas rnyed par 'gyur snyam du sems so/ /de nas lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngu la 'di skad ces smras so/ /rigs kyi bu/ lha'i me tog mas ra ba 'di dag longs (long )la khyod kyis sa phyogs 'di dag tu me tog bkram pa gyis shig /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags chos ston cing seṅge'i khri la 'dug pa la'ang gtor cig /ces des de la lha'i me tog mjo ra ba khal stong byin no/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngus me tog de dag blangs te/ me tog kha cig gis ni/ sa phyogs der me tog bkram pa byas so/ /me tog kha cig gis ni / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags la gtor to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags lo bdun 'das pa dang ting nge 'dzin de las langs te chos kyi stan gang na yod pa der 'ongs nas stan bting ba la 'dug ste/ 'khor brgya stong phrag du mas yongs su bskor cing mdun gyis bltas nas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ston to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngus byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags mthong ma thag tu 'di lta ste/dper na/ bsam gtan dang po la snyoms par zhugs pa'i dge slong rtse gcig tu yid la byed pa bzhin du bde ba de lta bu thob bo/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ston pa ni/ 'di lta ste/ chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid pas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mnyam pa nyid do/ /chos thams cad dben pa nyid pas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dben pa nyid do/ /chos thams cad g.yo ba med pa nyid pas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa g.yo ba med pa nyid do/ /chos thams cad rlom sems med pa nyid pas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zlos sems med pa nyid do/ /chos thams cad khengs pa med pa nyid pas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa khengs pa med pa nyid do/ /chos thams cad ro gcig pa nyid pas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ro gcig pa nyid do/ /chos thams cad mu med pa nyid pas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mu med pa nyid do/ /chos thams cad skye ba med pa nyid pas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa skye ba med pa nyid do/ /chos thams cad 'gag pa med pa nyid pas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'gag pa med pa nyid do/ /nam mkha' mu med pa nyid pas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mu med pa nyid do/ /rgya mtsho mu med 25—903

pa nyid pas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mu med pa nyid do/ /ri rab sna tshogs pa nyid pas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa sna tshogs nyid do/ /nam mkha' rtog pa med pa nyid pas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rtog pa med pa nyid do/ /gzugs mu med pa nyid pas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mu med pa nyid do/ /de bzhin du tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa mu med pa nyid pas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mu med pa nyid do/ /sa'i khams mu med pa nyid pas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mu med pa nyid do/ /chu'i khams dang / me'i khams dang / rlung gi khams mu med pa nyid pas shes kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mu med pa nyid do/ /nam mkha'i khams mu med pa nyid pas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mu med pa nyid do/ /rdo rje lta bu'i chos mnyam pa nyid pas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mnyam pa nyid do/ /chos thams cad ma 'dres pa nyid pas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma 'dres pa nyid do/ /chos thams cad dmigs su med pa nyid pas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dmigs su med pa nyid do/ /chos thams cad rnam par 'jig pa mnyam pa nyid pas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rnam par 'jig pa mnyam pa nyid do/ /chos thams cad byed pa med pa
