nyid pas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa byed pa med pa nyid do/ /chos thams cad bsam gyis mi khyab pa nyid pas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa nyid du rig par bya'o/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngu de ltar 'dug bzhin du de'i tshe chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin skyes par gyur to/ /chos thams cad dben pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / chos thams cad g.yo ba med pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / chos thams cad zlos sems med pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / chos thams cad khengs pa med pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / chos thams cad ro gcig pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / chos thams cad mu med pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / chos thams cad skye ba med pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / chos thams cad 'gag pa med pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / nam mkha' mu med pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / rgya mtsho mu med pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / ri rab sna tshogs zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / nam mkha' rtog pa med pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / gzugs mu med pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang /'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa mu med pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / sa'i khams mu med pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / chu'i khams dang / me'i khams dang / rlung gi khams mu med pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / nam mkha'i khams mu med pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / rdo rje lta bu zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / chos thams cad ma 'dres pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin dmigs su med pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / chos thams cad rnam par 'jig pa mnyam pa nyid ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / chos thams cad byed pa med pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / chos thams cad bsam gyis mi khyab ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin thob par gyur te/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngus de la sogs pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo 'bum phrag drug cu thob par gyur to/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu 25—904

phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa las/ chos 'phags kyi le'u zhes bya ste/ bdun cu rtsa bzhi pa'o// //rab 'byor/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngus ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo 'bum phrag drug cu thob ma thag tu shar phyogs dang / lho phyogs dang / nub phyogs dang / byang phyogs dang / phyogs mtshams dang / 'og dang / steng gi phyogs dang / phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag dge slong gi dge 'dun gyis yongs su bskor cing byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis mdun gyis bltas te tshul 'di lta bu nyid dang / ming 'di nyid dang / yi ge 'di nyid kyis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di 'chad pa mthong ngo / /'di lta ste/ dper na/da ltar nga stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di na chos ston pa/ dge slong gi dge 'dun gyi (gyis )yongs su bskor cing byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis mdun gyis bltas te tshul 'di nyid dang /ming 'di nyid dang / yi ge 'di nyid kyis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di 'chad pa bzhin no/ /de mang du thos pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / thos pa rgya mtsho lta bu dang ldan par gyur te/ gar skyes pa thams cad du'ang sangs rgyas dang mi 'bral bar 'gyur te/ skye ba thams cad du'ang gang dang gang du sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams mngon sum du 'gyur ba de dang de dag tu skye ste/ tha na mi lam na'ang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dag dang mi 'bral bar gyur to/ /des mi khom pa thams cad ni/ spangs/ dal ba phun sum tshogs pa ni/ bsgrubs so/ /rab 'byor/ rnam grangs 'dis kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes sgrub (bsgrubs )pa yin par rig par bya'o / /rab 'byor/ de lta bas na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes thob par 'dod pa dag gis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di la spyad par bya'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams yang dag par yongs su gzung ba'i phyir shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di zungs shig (zung zhig) /chongs shig /lhogs shig /kun chub par gyis shig /gzhan dag la'ang rgya cher rab tu ston cig /kun dga' bo / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dag gis mnyan par bya/gzung bar bya/ bcang bar bya/ bklag (klag )par bya/ kun chub par bya/ gdon par bya/ lung nod par bya/ bstan par bya/ kha ton du bya/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin gyi rlabs (brlabs )kyis glegs bam chen po la yi ge gsal zhing rab tu gsal ba legs par bris te me tog dang / bdug pa dang / spos dang /byug pa dang / phye ma dang / gos dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang / khor yug tu mar me'i phreng ba dang / mchod pa rnam pa mang po dag gis bkur ster bya/ bla mar bya/ ri por bya/mchod par bya/ brjed par bya/ gsol bar bya ste/ kun dga' bo/ 'di ni/ nga'i gdams ngag go/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ ( shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di las thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /)kun dga' bo/ 'di ji snyam du sems/ de bzhin gshegs pa khyod kyi ston pa yin nam/25—905

kun dga' bos gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das bdag gi ston pa lags so/ /bde bar gshegs pa bdag gi ston pa lags so/ /de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /kun dga' bo/ khyod kyi ston pa de bzhin gshegs pa la kun dga' bo khyod kyis lus kyi las byams pa yid du 'ong ba dang / ngag gi las byams pa yid du 'ong ba dang / yid kyi las byams pa yid du 'ong bas rim gro byas so/ /kun dga' bo/ de lta bas na/ da ltar nga bzhugs te 'tsho zhing gzhes pa'i sku 'di la khyod kyis phangs pa dang / dad pa dang / gus par byas pa de bzhin du nga 'das nas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di la'ang byos shig /kun dga' bo/ ci nas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di nub par mi 'gyur zhing / ci nas khyod skyes bu tha mar mi 'gyur bar khyod la lan gnyis lan gsum du yongs su gtad do/ /rjes su yongs su gtad do/ /kun dga' bo/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di 'jig rten na ji srid du spyod pa de srid du de bzhin gshegs pa bzhugs par rig par bya'o/ /kun dga' bo/ de srid du de bzhin gshegs pa chos ston par rig par bya'o/ /kun dga' bo/ gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di nyan pa dang / 'dzin pa dang / 'chang ba dang / klog pa dang / kun chub par byed pa dang / rab tu 'don pa dang / lung nod pa dang / ston pa dang / kha ton byed pa dang / yi ger 'bri ba dang / me rtog dang /bdug pa dang / spos dang / me tog phreng dang / byug pa dang / phye ma dang / gos dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dag dang / khor yug tu mar me'i phreng ba dang / mchod pa rnam pa mang po dag gis bkur ltar byed/ bla mar byed/ ri mor byed/ mchod par byed/ rjed par byed/gsol bar byed pa'i sems can de dag ni/ sangs rgyas mthong ba dang ma bral ba dang / dam pa'i chos nyan pa dang ma bral ba dang / dge 'dun la rim gro byed pa dang ma bral bar rig par bya'o/ /kun dga' bo/sems can de dag ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i drung na spyod par rig par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po byams pa la sogs pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor dang / tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu dang / tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo dang / lha dang /mi dang / lha ma yin dang / dri zar bcas pa'i 'jig rten yid (yi )rangs te bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa las/ yongs su gtad pa'i le'u zhes bya ste/ bdun cu rtsa lnga pa'o// //rgya gar gyi
